Ni ahnsou me Koht tepin kapikada sampah oh mehkoaros me mi pahnlahng,
sampah me liseliping de sohte mwomwe. Rotorot kipe wasa loal kan, oh ngehn en Koht kin ketiketseli pohn pihl kan.
Koht eri ketin mahsanih, “Marain en miehla”—marain ahpw pwarada.
Koht eri kupwurperenkihda lingan en maraino. E ahpw ketin katohrepeseng maraino oh rotorot,
oh ketikihong eden maraino, “Rahn,” a eden rotoroto, “Pwohng.” Eri, pwohngo imwiseklahr oh marain en rahn pwarodohr—iei met wadepen keieun rahn.
Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “Pwalang ehu en miehla pwe en irepeseng pihl kan ong ni wasa tohrohr riau”—eri, e ahpw pweida. Koht eri ketin wiahda pwalang en lahng ehu me katohrepeseng pihl kan me mi pah oh powe.
<range>
Koht eri ketikihong eden pwalango, “Lahng.” Eri, pwohngo imwiseklahr oh marain en rahn pwarodohr—iei met wadepen keriaun rahn.
Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “Pihl kan me mi pahnlahng en kohpene wasateieu, pwe pwehl madekeng en pwarada”—eri, e ahpw pweida.
Ih eri ketikihong eden pwehl madekengo “Sahpw,” a pihl kan me kohpene wasatehkis “Madau.” Koht eri kupwurperenkihda wiepen nin lime wet.
E ahpw pil mahsanih, “Sahpw en kawosehda soangen tuhke koaros me kin kapwarehda wah laud oh wah tikitik”—eri, e ahpw pweida.
Eri, sahpw ahpw tapihada kawosehda soangen tuhke koaros me kin kapwarehda wah laud oh wah tikitik. Koht eri kupwurperenkihda wiepen nin lime pwukat.
Eri, pwohng imwiseklahr oh marain en rahn pwarodohr—iei met wadepen kesiluhn rahn.
Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “Marain kei en miehla pahnlahng, mehn irepeseng rahn oh pwohng, oh mehn kilelehdi ahnsou me rahn akan, sounpar akan, oh iren ahnsou kan pahn kin tepida;
re pahn kin lingaling pahnlahng oh kamakamarainih sampah”—eri, e ahpw pweida.
Koht eri ketin wiahda marain kalaimwun riau, iei ketipin me pahn kin kakaun nin rahn, oh maram me pahn kin kakaun nipwong; e pil ketin wiahda usu kan.
E ketikidahng marain pwukat pahnlahng, pwe re en kin dakedaker sampah,
kakaun rahn oh nipwong kan, oh ireirepeseng marain oh rotorot. Koht eri kupwurperenkihda wiepen nin lime pwukat.
Eri, pwohngo imwiseklahr oh marain en rahn pwarodohr—iei met wadepen kapahieun rahn.
Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “Soahng koaros me kin mie ar mour en audehla pihl akan, oh menpihr kan en audehla pahnlahng.”
Koht eri ketin kapikada mwahmw kalaimwun kan, oh soahng mour koaros me kin kousoan nan pihl, oh soangen menpihr koaros. Koht eri kupwurperenkihda wiepen nin lime pwukat.
E ahpw ketin kupwuramwahwih irail koaros, mahsanih, “Kumwail koaros me momour nan pihl oh nansed, kumwail en kaparaparala oh audehla madau kan, a menpihr kan en pil tohtohla.”
Eri, pwohngo imwiseklahr oh marain en rahn pwarodohr—iei met wadepen kelimaun rahn.
Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “Pwelin sampah en kapwarehda soangen mahn mand oh lawalo koaros oh soangen mahn laud oh tikitik koaros”—eri, e ahpw pweida.
Koht eri ketin wiahda soangen mahn pwukat koaros. E ahpw kupwurperenkihda wiepen nin lime pwukat.
Koht eri pil ketin mahsanih, “A met kitail pahn wiahda aramas; kitail pahn wiahda aramas rasehng kitail. Re pahn ahneki manaman en kaunda mwahmw akan, menpihr kan, mahn mand oh lawalo, mahn laud oh tikitik koaros.”
Koht eri ketin wiahda aramas; e ahpw ketin wiahda aramas rasehng ih. E ketin wiahda ohl oh lih,
oh kupwuramwahwih ira, mahsanih, “Kumwa kaparaparala pwe kadaudokamwa kan pahn kousoanla wasa koaros nin sampah oh kaunda mehkoaros. I kihong kumwa manaman en kaunda mwahmw akan, menpihr kan oh mahn lawalo kan koaros.”
Koht ahpw pil ketin mahsanihong ira, “Kumwa kilang pwe I kihong kumwa met soangen tuhke koaros me wararail kin mie, oh soangen wahntuhke koaros, pwe kumwa en wiahki amwa mehn tungoal;
a ong mahn lawalo kan oh pil ong menpihr kan, I kihong tehntuhke kan oh kisintuhke kan pwe re en kin kangkang”—eri, e ahpw pweida.
Koht eri inenen kupwurperenkihda wiepen nin lime pwukat koaros. Eri, pwohngo imwiseklahr oh marain en rahn pwarodohr—iei met wadepen keweneun rahn.
Eri, wiepen sampah oh pahnlahng oh audepara kan koaros ahpw imwisekla.
Koht eri ketin kaimwisekala sapwellime doadoahk me e ketin wiewia kohdo, oh ketin kommoaldi ni keisuhn rahn.
E ahpw ketin kupwuramwahwih keisuhn rahno, oh ketin kasarawihala pwe en wiahla rahn sarawi ehu, pwehki ih rahno me e ketin kaimwisekala wiepen nin lime kan oh ketin kommoaldihsang sapwellime doadoahk.
Ih duwen sampah eh wiawihda oh mehkoaros pahnlahng eh kepikipikda. Eri, ni ahnsou me KAUN-O Koht ketin wiahda sampah oh mehkoaros pahnlahng,
sohte kisin tuhke pwoat mie nin sampah, pil sohte kisin werentuhke kis wosada, pwehki Koht eh sohte ketin kamwerehdi keteu pohn sampah; oh sohte aramas me pahn koadoahki pwelin sampah.
Eri, mehnda ma sohte keteu, ahpw pihl kin kuskusdahsang nanpwel oh kin kalakalamwur sampah pwon.
KAUN-O Koht eri ketikihda nesen pwehl ehu sang nanpwel oh ketin wiahkihda war ehu me mwomwen aramas. E ahpw ketikihong ni waro angin mour; ni ahnsowohte mour ahpw miehla ni paliweren aramaso.
KAUN-O Koht eri ketin wiahda mwetuwel ehu ni palimese, me adaneki Ihden; oh ketikihong loale aramaso me e ketin wiahda.
E ahpw ketin kakairada soangen tuhke kaselel koaros oh soangen tuhke me wah kan kin mwahu ong tungoal. Nan werengen mwetuwelo mie tuhke riapwoat, iei tuhkehn komour oh pil tuhkehn kehsehki aramas dahme mwahu oh dahme suwed.
Pillap pwoat kin pwilipwilsang nan Ihden pwe en kin kalamwur mwetuwelo; e ahpw kasangpeseng wiahda kahngen pillap pahieu.
Keieun kahngo adaneki Pison; eri, ih pillap me tang kapilpene wehin Apila unsek.
(Ih wasakiset me kohl kaselel kin dierek ie, iangahki pwilin tuhke kesempwal, oh kisin takai kesempwal kin rek ie.)
Keriaun pillapo adaneki Kihon; me kapilpene wehin Kus.
Kesiluhn pillapo me ede Daikris, e tang ni palimesehn wehin Asiria. Kapahieun pillapo, iei Iupreitis.
KAUN-O Koht eri ketikihdiong aramaso nan mwetuwel en Ihden pwe en kin apwahpwalih oh sinsile.
E ahpw mahsanihong, “Ke kak tungoale wahntuhke koaros me mi nan mwetuwelet,
ahpw ihte wahntuhkehn kehsehki aramas dahme mwahu oh dahme suwed me ke sohte pahn tungoale, ma ke pahn tungoale, ke pahn mehkihla rahnohte.”
KAUN-O Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “E sohte konehng aramas menet en kelekelehpw. I pahn wiahiong eh werek en wia sawasepe.”
Eri, Koht ahpw pil ketin wiahda sang pwehl soangen mahn akan koaros oh soangen menpihr kan koaros. E ahpw ketikihong aramaso pwe en kihong adarail. Eri, ahd akan me e kihong emenemen, iei ih me re adaneki.
Eri, aramaso ahpw kihong eden menpihr kan, oh mahn akan koaros; ahpw e sohte diarada emen me konehng eh werek mehn sewese.
Eri, KAUN-O Koht ahpw ketin kameirkelikihala aramaso, oh nindokon eh memeir, Koht ahpw ketikihsang apwoat tihnkopwouwih ko, oh ketin pwurehng kapwurepene uduk en wasao.
E ahpw ketin wiahda lih emen sang tihnkopwou me e ketikihsang rehn aramaso, oh ketin kahredohng aramaso.
Aramaso eri patohwan, “Iei met emen me rasehng iehte— tih me sang tih kat, oh uduk sang ni udukei. E pahn adaneki ‘Lih’ pwehki eh kohsang rehn ohl.”
Iei kahrepe wet me ohl emen pahn kin mweikihsang seme oh ine oh ehukihong eh pwoud, pwe ira en kin wiahla ehu.
Eri, ira koaros, ohlo oh liho, ira kilisou; ira ahpw sohte kin namenengki.
Eri, sineik ih mahn me keieu mwersuwed nanpwungen mahn akan me KAUN-O Koht ketin wiahda. E ahpw idekda rehn liho, “Mehlel apwoat me Koht ketin keinepwihsang kumwa en dehr tungoale wahntuhke kan en nan mwetuwelet?”
Liho eri sapengki, “Se kak tungoale wahntuhke koaros en mwetuwelet,
ihte wahntuhke me mi nanwerengeo me se sohte kak tungoale. Koht ketin keinepwihsang kiht wahntuhke pwoatet se en dehr tungoale de sair, pwe se de mehkihla.”
Sineiko ahpw sapengki liho, “Likamw pwoat men; kumwa sohte pahn mehla.
Koht mahsanih men pwehki eh mwahngih me ni ahnsowohte me kumwa pahn tungoale wahntuhkehn, kumwa pahn marainla oh duwehla Koht, pwe kumwa pahn esehla dahme mwahu oh dahme suwed.”
Liho eri lingankihda tuhkeo oh men tungoalehda wah ko; e ahpw lemehda kamwahupen eh pahn marainla. Ih eri dolung wahntuhkeo oh tungoale. E ahpw pil kihong eh pwoudo pwe en pil iang tungoale. Eh pwoudo ahpw pil iang tungoale.
Ni ahnsowohte me ira tungoale, ira eri marainla oh diarada me ira kilisou; ira eri pahda tehntuhke pihk kei, wiahkihda ara koahl oh koalehda.
Nin soutik en rahno, ira ahpw rongada KAUN-O Koht eh ketiketseli nan mwetuwelo; ira ahpw rukula nanwerengen tuhke ko.
A KAUN-O Koht ahpw malipe ohlo, mahsanih, “Ia kowe?”
Ohlo ahpw sapeng, patohwan, ‘I patohwan rongada omwi ketiketseli nan mwetuwelet; I ahpw patohwan masepwehkada oh rukusang komwi, pwehki ei kilisou.”
Koht eri ketin keinemwe, “Pwe ihs me ndaiong uhk me ke kilisou? Ke so tungoalehda wahntuhke me I keinepwihsang uhko?”
Ohlo ahpw patohwan sapeng, “Lih me komw ketikihong ieo me patohwanohng ie I en tungoale, iei me I tungoalehkihda.”
KAUN-O Koht ketin keinemwe rehn liho, “Dahme ke wiahkihda met?” Liho ahpw patohwan sapeng, “Sineiko me keteweiehdi, ihme I patohwan tungoalehkihda.”
KAUN-O Koht eri mahsanihong sineiko, “Pwehki omw wiadahr met, ke pahn alehki kalokolok; kowehte me pahn pwukoahki keria wet. Sang met kohla ke pahn kin limwahdengki kapehdomw, oh pwehl me pahn kin wia konomw kisin mwenge erein omw mour.
Kowe oh liho pahn kin imwintihtipene; nein liho oh pil noumw kan pahn pil kin imwintihtipene kohkohlahte. Aramas akan pahn sok pohn moangomwen pwe en kamwutepene; oh ke pahn ke keimwen neh.”
E ahpw pil mahsanihong liho, “I pahn katohtowehla omw apwal kan ni omw pahn kin liseian, oh kalaudehla omw medek en neitik, ahpw ke pahn kin ininangihete omw pwoud, oh ih me pahn kin kaunuhkada.”
E ahpw pil mahsanihong ohlo, “Pwehki omw dukiong omw pwoudo oh tungoalehda wahntuhke me I keinepwihsang uhko, pwehki soahng wet me ke wiadahr, pwelin sampah pahn rialahr. Ke pahn doadoahk laud erein omw mour, pwe pwelin sampah en kawosada kisin mwenge me pahn itarohng uhk.
E pahn kawosada dihpw tekatek oh reh, oh ke pahn kin tungoale wahntuhkehn nanwel kan.
Ke pahn doadoahk oh kakerehdi pwudowomw, pwe ke en koadoahkihada wahn pwelin sampah, ke lao pwurehng wiepwella, me ke wiawihda sang ie. Pwe ke wiawihda sang pwehl oh ke pahn pwurehng wiepwella.”
Adam eri kihong eden eh pwoudo Ihp pwehki eh wia inen aramas momour koaros.
KAUN-O Koht eri ketin wiahiong Adam oh eh pwoud ara likou kilinmen, oh ketin kalikawihkinirahda.
KAUN-O Koht eri mahsanih, “Met aramas menet duwelahr emen kiht, pwehki eh esedahr dahme mwahu oh dahme suwed. E sohte pahn mweimweiong en tungoale wahntuhkehn komour oh en ahneki mour poatopoat.”
KAUN-O Koht eri ketin kausasang tepin aramas nan mwetuwel en Ihden, pwe en kin koadoahki pwelin sampah me pein ih wiawihda sang ie.
Koht ahpw ketikihong ni palimesehn mwetuwel en Ihden kerup kei, oh kedlahs kisiniei pwoat me mpwul sirangarang pali koaros, pwe en silehsang aramas koaros tuhken komouro.
Adam eri wiahiong nsenen pwopwoud ong eh pwoudo, liho eri liseianda. Liho naitikihada pwutak emen; ih eri patohwan, “I nainekidahr pwutak emen sang ni kalahngan en KAUN-O.” Ih eri kihong ede Kain.
Mwuri, e ahpw naitikihada pil emen pwutak, Eipel. Eipel eri wiahla sounsilepen sihpw, a Kain wia ohl en sapwasapw men.
Mwurin ahnsou kei Kain ahpw wahdo ekei wahnsapwe ko oh meirongkihong KAUN-O.
A mwuri, Eipel ahpw kihda mesenihen nah sihpw akan oh kemehla, pwe en meirongkihong KAUN-O uduk me keieu kaselel en sihpwo. KAUN-O eri kupwurehla Eipel oh kupwurperenkihda eh meirongo,
ahpw e sohte ketin kupwure Kain oh eh meirongo. Iei me Kain lingeringerkihda kowahlap oh pohtoutoukihla.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Kain, “Dahme ke lingeringerki oh pohtoutouki?
Ma ke wia mehkot pwung, ke pahn pereperen; a pwehki omw wiadahr mehkot suwed, dihp rasehng mahn lawalo men me nektehn poar pohmw. E men kaunuhkada, ahpw ke uhdahn pahn powehdi.”
Kain eri ndaiong rie Eipel, “Kita kolahng mwemweit nan mohso.” Ni ara lel nan mohso, Kain sohpeiongete rieo kemehla.
KAUN-O ketin keinemwe rehn Kain, mahsanih, “Ia riomwo, Eipel?” A e sapeng, patohwan, “I sohte patohwan. Dah? Ngehi silepen rieio?”
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Dahme ke wiahkihda suwed mwuledek wet? Ntahn riomwo likilikwerih ie sang nanpwel, likamwete ngihl ehu me pekipeki I en ikih.
Ke rialahr, oh ke pahn pekeussang pohn pwelin sahpw wet me direkilahr ntahn riomwo. Likamwete e sarapeseng pwe en ale ntao sang ni pehmwen.
Ma ke pahn sapwasapw, pwelin sahpw sohte pahn kawosadahng uhk mehkot; ke pahn sansaruaruseli nin sampah.”
Kain ahpw patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Kalokolok wet me nohn laud mehlel.
Rahnwet komw ketin kasareiesang nan sahpw wet oh sang mwohn silangmwi. I pahn sansaruaruseli nin sampah, oh mehmen me diar ie pahn kemeiehla.”
A KAUN-O ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Soh! Pwe mehmen me pahn kemeiukala, I pahn ikih suwed sang pahn pak isipak.” KAUN-O eri ketikihdiong pohn Kain kilel ehu, mehn kehsehki koaros me pahn kin tuhwong, pwe re de kemehla.
Kain eri patopatohla sang mwohn silangin KAUN-O oh kousoanla nan sahpw ehu me adaneki “Saruaru,” ni palimesehn Ihden.
Kain oh eh pwoudo ahpw naitikihada pwutak emen, oh kihong ede Enok. Kain eri kauwada kahnimw ehu oh kihong eden nah pwutako.
Enok pil wiahda nah pwutak emen me adaneki Irad, me wia semen Meusael, a Meusael nainekihda pwutak emen ede Medusael, me wia semen Lamek.
Lamek ahpw pwoudikihda lih riemen, eden emen Ada, a emen Silla.
Ada kaipwidi Sapal, pahpa kahlap en irail ko me kin kousoan nan impwal akan oh kin apwalih pelinmen kan.
Eden rieo Supal, pahpa kahlap en sounkeseng koaros me kin kesengki arp oh mehn pepeuk.
Silla kaipwidi Tupal Kain, pahpa kahlap en sounwia mete koaros me kin wiahkihda dipwisou kan prons oh mete. Rien Tupal Kain serepein adaneki Naama.
Lamek eri ndaiong eh pwoud ko, “Ada oh Silla, kumwa rong ie mahs: I kemehla mwahnakapw emen pwehki eh wokihiehdi.
Ma mehmen me pahn kemehla Kain pahn ale kalokolok pak isipak, a mehmen me pahn kemeiehla pahn ale kalokolok pak isihsek isuh.”
Adam oh eh pwoudo ahpw pil naitikihada pil emen pwutak. Liho eri patohwan, “Koht ketikihong ie nei pwutaket pwe en wiliandi Eipel, me Kain kemelahr.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako, Sehd.
Sehd eri wiahda pwutak emen me e kihong ede Enos. Ih ahnsou me aramas akan tapihada kaudok ni mwaren KAUN-O.

Ni ahnsowo aramas ngeder kaparaparalahr wasa koaros nin sampah, oh serepein kan ipwidier.
Ekei nein koht ko ni ar kilangada lingan en serepein ko, re ahpw pwoudikihda me re mwahuki kan.
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “I solahr pahn mweidohng aramas re en mour kohkohlahte; pwe re pahn mehla. Sang met kohla re solahr pahn daulih sounpar 120.”
Ni ahnsowo oh pil mwurihdohsang, mie kodon kei nin sampah, kadaudok en lih aramas akan oh koht ko. Iei irail me aramas kommwad oh ndand en mahsie.
Ni KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihada duwen aramas akan ar suwedlahr nin sampah, oh ar lamalam akan eh kin suwed ahnsou koaros,
e ahpw koluhkihla eh ketin wiahda aramas oh ketikihdiong nin sampah. Kupwure eri toutoukihla,
iei me e mahsaniheki, “I pahn kamwomwasang aramas koaros me I wiadahr, iangahki mahn akan oh menpihr kan, pwehki I koluhkilahr ei wiairailda.”
Ahpw Noha kelehpw me keniken pahn kupwur en KAUN-O.
Iet duwen poadopoad en Noha. E naineki pwutak silimen, Sehm, Ahm, oh Saped. Ohl lelepek men Noha, oh ihete me keniken rehn Koht ahnsowo. Eh mour poadidiong Koht,

Koht eri mahsanihong Noha, “I koasoanedier en kamwomwala aramas koaros. I pahn kamwomwala douluhl irail koaros, pwehki sampah direkilahr arail wiewia suwed kan.
Eri, wiahda weromw warihmw ehu sang tuhke mwahu; wiahda loale pere kei, oh litopwiheki loale oh liki tahr.
E pahn reireiki piht 450, oh tehlepe piht 75, oh ile piht 45.
Wiahiong pwelengen warihmwen, oh nanpwungen pwelenge oh keile kan wehwe ieu en mie, me uwe ins 18. E pahn poasoake siluh, oh ke pahn wiahda wenihmw ehu ni pengepenge.
Pwe I pahn kadardiong sampah nohlik ehu pwe en kamwomwala mehkoros me momour nin sampah. Mehkoaros nin sampah pahn mehla,
a ngehi I pahn kauwada ei inou nanpwungata. Eri, ke pahn pedolong nan warihmwo, iangahki omw pwoud, noumw pwutak kan oh ar pwoud kan,

Wahda soangen mwenge koaros me ke pahn kin tungoale oh irail pahn kin kangkang.”
Noha eri ahpw kapwaiada mehkoaros me Koht ketin mahsanih.
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Noha, “Pedolong nan warihmwen, iangahki omw peneinei koaros; pwe kowehte rehn aramas pwukat me I diarada me kin wia dahme pwung.
Sehrehlong pwopwoud en mahn wad isuh sang ni soangen mahn mwakelekel koaros, ahpw pwopwoud wad ehu sang ni soangen mahn samin koaros.
Pil sehrehlong pwopwoud en menpihr wad isuh sang ni soangen menpihr kan koaros. Ke pahn wia met pwe soangen mahn oh menpihr koaros en mourla, pwe re en kak pwurehng kaparaparala nin sampah.
Pwe mwurin rahn isuhte I pahn tapihada kamwerediong pohn sampah keteu me pahn mweremwer erein rahn pahisek oh pwohng pahisek, pwe en kamwomwala soahng mour koaros me I wiadahr.”
Noha eri kapwaiada mehkoaros me KAUN-O ketin mahsanih.
Noha mahkiher sounpar 600 ahnsou me nohlik lapalap lelohng sampah.
Ih, eh pwoudo, nah pwutak ko, oh ar pwoud kan eri pedolong nan warihmwo pwe re en pitsang nohlik lapalapo.
Soangen mahn oh menpihr koaros ohl oh lih, me mwakelekel oh samin,
re pil iang Noha pedolong nan warihmwo, duwen me Koht ketin mahsanih.
Mwurin rahn isuh nohlik lapalapo ahpw lel sampah.
Ni Noha eh sounpar 600, ni eisek isuhn Mei, keriaun sounpwong, pwarer koaros me mi pahn madau lapalap akan en sampah kakusada audeparail, oh pahnlahng likamwete e pwoarpeseng pwe en kakusedi pile kan.
Eri, keteu ahpw mweremwerki rahn pahisek oh pwohng pahisek.
Rahnohte Noha oh eh pwoudo, nah pwutak silimen, Sehm, Ahm oh Saped, iangahki ar pwoud kan, re ahpw pedolong nan warihmwo.
Soangen mahn akan koaros, mahn lawalo oh mahn mand, mahn laud oh tikitik, oh pil soangen menpihr kan koaros, pil iang irail pedolong.
Ohl oh lih sang ni soangen mahn oh menpihr koaros, re pil iang Noha pedolong nan warihmwo,
duwen me Koht ketin mahsanih. KAUN-O eri ketin ritingedi wenihmwen warihmwo sang liki.
Nohlik lapalapo ahpw wiewiawihki rahn pahisek, oh pihl kan lalaudlahte lao kapehda warihmwo sang nanpwel.
Pihlo inenen loalada mehlel, me kahrehda warihmwo peipeiseli powe.
Pihlo ahpw kohkohda oh koaduhpwaldi nahna me keieu ileile kan;
e ahpw pil sikdahsang kumwen nahna ileile kan piht 25.
Soahng koaros me momour nin sampah ahpw mehla—menpihr kan, mahn akan, oh aramas akan koaros.
Soahng koaros me momour nin sampah mehla.
KAUN-O ketin kamwomwala soahng momour koaros nin sampah— aramas akan, mahn akan, oh menpihr kan. Ihte me luhwe Noha oh irail ko me iang pedolong nan warihmwo.
Pihl akan eri mihmihte oh lalaudlahte pohn sampah erein rahn 150.
Koht sohte ketin meliehla Noha oh mahn akan koaros me iang mihmi nan warihmwo; iei me e kupwurehda en ketin ipiralahng pohn sampah kisinieng ehu, me kahrehda pihl kan ar tapihada pwuredi.
Pwarer en madau kan pahn sampah, oh pwoaren pahnlahng kan ahpw pinapinla. Keteu en nanleng ahpw tokedi,
pihlo ahpw wie ngalangaldi erein rahn 150,
oh ni eisek isuhn Oktoper, keisuhn sounpwong, warihmwo ahpw serada pohn nahnahn Ararat.
Pihl kan wia tikitiklahte, lel ni keieun Senweri, kaeisek en sounpwong, ahnsou me kumwen nahna kan pwarada.
Mwurin rahn 40 Noha ahpw ritingada wenihmwen warihmwo
oh kapihrei menpihr toantoal emen. E pihriei oh pipihrseli lao pihl kan madadahsang pohn sampah.
Mwuhr, Noha ahpw kadarei mwuroi men, mehn kehsehki ma pihl kan tikitiklahr,
ahpw pwehki pihl kan kipekipehte sampah, mwuroio sohte diar wasa e pahn sokedi ie. Noha eri kapaieila peho oh ale mwuroio, kapwurehlong nan warihmwo.
Noha eri awiawihete mwurin rahn isuh e ahpw pil kadar mwuroio.
Mwuroio ahpw pwurodo nin soutik, ilahda tehntuhke olip ehu me ahpwtehn wosada. Noha eri esekihda me pihl kan sosohredihsangehr pohn sampah.
E ahpw pil komodoaloanki erein rahn isuh; e ahpw pil kadarei mwuroio; eri mwo, mwuroio sohte pwurodo.
Ahnsou me Noha sounpar 601, ni keieun Eipril, keieun sounpwong, pihl akan ngalangaldier douluhl pohn sampah. Noha eri kihsang pwelengen warihmwo, e ahpw kilengiei oh kilangada duwen sahpw eh madekenglahr.
Ni 27 en Mei, keriaun sounpwong, sampah eri madekengda douluhl.
Koht eri mahsanihong Noha,
“Pedoisang nan warihmwen, iangahki omw pwoud, noumw pwutak kan oh ar pwoud kan.
Kahreiei mahn akan oh menpihr kan koaros, pwe re en kaparaparala oh kipehdi wasa koaros nin sampah.”
Noha eri pedoisang nan warihmwo, iangahki eh pwoudo, nah pwutak ko oh ar pwoud kan.
Mahn akan oh menpihr kan koaros ahpw pil pedohi wad soangen mahn akan sang loale.
Noha eri kauwadahng KAUN-O pei sarawi ehu; e ahpw pilada mahn ekei wad emen sang rehn mahn mwakelekel oh menpihr ko, e ahpw meirongkihla pohn pei sarawio.
KAUN-O eri kupwurperenkihda pwohn meirongo, e ahpw mahsanih, “I solahr pahn keriahla sampah kohkohlahte pwehki sapwung en aramas akan; pwe I ese me sang ni ar tikitik ar lamalam akan kin uhwongete ni me suwed. Eri, I solahr pahn pwurehng kamwomwala mour koaros nin sampah, duwen me I wiawiher met.
Nindokon sampah eh pahn mihmihte, ahnsoun kamwarak oh ahnsoun dolung pahn mie. Ahnsoun pou oh ahnsoun karakar pahn mie; rahn oh pwohng pahn mie.”
Koht ahpw ketin kupwuramwahwihki Noha oh nah pwutak ko mahsen wet: “Kumwail kaparaparala pwe kadaudokamwail kan en kousoanla wasa koaros nin sampah.
Mahn koaros en sampah, iangahki menpihr kan oh mwahmw akan, pahn lammwikin kumwail. Koaros pahn mi pahn amwail manaman.
Kumwail kak tungoale soahng me momour koaros oh pil tuhke koaros. I kihong kumwail koaros pwe kumwail en wiahki amwail mehn tungoal.
Ihte me kumwail sohte pahn tungoalehn: uduk me mie nta, I sohte mweidada pwehki mour mi nan nta.
Mehmen me pahn kihsang amwail mour, I pahn kalokehki mehla, oh I pahn kauwehla mahn emen me pahn kemeikumwailla.
Mehmen me pahn kemehla aramas, e pahn kamakamala rehn aramas; pwe aramas wiawihda rasehng Koht.
“Kumwail eri kaparaparala pwe kadaudokamwail kan en tohtohla oh kousoanla wasa koaros nin sampah.”
Koht pil mahsanihong Noha oh nah pwutak ko,
“Eri, met I pahn kauwada ei inou rehmwail oh rehn kadaudokamwail kan,
oh pil rehn mahn mour koaros me mi rehmwail—menpihr kan oh mahn akan—oh mehkoaros me kohieisang nan warihmwo.
Eri, iet audepen ei inou en: I inoukihda me I solahr pahn pwurehng kauwekihla nohlik lapalap soahng me momour kan nin sampah. Solahr pil ehu nohlik lapalap pahn wiawi pwe en kauwehla sampah.
Eri, iet kilel poatopoat en ei inou ong kumwail oh ong soahng me momour kan koaros:
ahia pwoat me I padokadahng nan depwek kan. Ih me pahn wia kilel en ei inou ong sampah.
Ahnsou koaros me I pahn kapwarehda depwek pohn sampah oh ahia pwoat pahn sansal nan depwek kan,
I pahn kin tamanda ei inou ong kumwail oh ong mahn akan koaros, duwen nohlik lapalap eh solahr pahn wiawi pwe en kauwehla soahng me momour kan koaros nin sampah.
Eri, ni ahia eh pahn kin pwarada nan depwek kan, I pahn kin kilang oh tamanda inou poatopoat wet me mie nanpwungen ngehi oh soahng me momour kan koaros nin sampah.”
Koht ahpw pil mahsanihong Noha, “Ih met kilel en inou me I padokadahr nanpwungen ngehi oh soahng me momour kan koaros nin sampah.”
Nein Noha ko me iang kohieisang nan warihmwo, iei Sehm, Ahm (semen Kenan), oh Saped.
Nein Noha pwukat silimen iei irail me semen aramas koaros nin sampah.
Noha, ohlen wia sapwasapw men. Ih me tepin wiahda mwetuwel en wain ehu.
Mwurin eh tungoale wain en eh mwetuwelo, e ahpw sakaula mehlel oh kilisouda wendiong nan imwe impwalo.
Eri, Ahm, semen Kenan, ni eh kilangada duwen semeo eh kilisou, e ahpw kohla oh padahkihong rie ko, Sehm oh Saped.
Sehm oh Saped eri ale likou reirei ehu, kidahng pohn pwopwara oh kahsekirla nan impwalo oh pwaindi samarao. Masara ko sohsohpeisangete pwe ira dehr kilang samarao ni eh kilisou.
Ni waino eh sarada oh Noha eri esehda dahme nah me tikitiko wiahiong,
e ahpw patohwan, “Kenan en riahla! E pahn wiahla lidun rie kan.
Kaping ong KAUN-O, Koht en Sehm! Kenan pahn wiahla lidun Sehm.
Koht en ketin kaparahla Saped! Kadaudoke kan en kousoanla rehn nein Sehm kan! Kenan pahn wiahla lidun Saped.”
Eri, mwurin nohlik lapalapo, Noha pil momourki sounpar 350.
E ahpw sipalla ni eh sounpar 950.
Iet kadaudok en nein Noha pwutak kan, Sehm, Ahm, oh Saped. Me silimenet naineki pwutak kei me ipwidi mwurin nohlik lapalapo.
Nein Saped pwutak kan iei—Komer, Makok, Madai, Sapan, Tupal, Mesek, oh Tiras—iei irail pwukat me wia pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en Komer iei irail mehn Askenas, Ripahd, oh Tokarma.
Kadaudok en Sapan iei irail mehn Elisa, mehn Spein, Saiprus, oh Rodes.
Iei irail me wia pahpa en aramas ako me kin koukousoan limwahn oaroahr oh nin deke kan. Ih met kan kadaudok en Saped, me kin koukousoan wasa kan rehn kadaudokarail tohrohr kan oh wasa kan, ehuehu pwihn kin lokaiahki pein ar lokaia.
Nein Ahm kan iei—Kus, Isip, Lipia, oh Kenan—irail me pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en Kus iei irail mehn Sepa, Apila, Sapta, Raama, oh Sapteka. Kadaudok en Raama iei mehn Sipa oh Dedan.
Kus naineki pwutak emen ede Nimrod, me wiahla sounpei keieu lapalap emen nan sampah.
Sang ni kupwur kalahngan en KAUN-O e wiahla sounkesik koahiek men, iei kahrepen aramas akan ar kin nda, “KAUN-O en ketin kupwurei komwi pwe komwi en wiahla sounkesik koahiek men duwehte Nimrod!”
Nin tapio eh wehi iangahki Papilon, Erek, oh Akad, wasa siluh pwukat koaros mi nan Papilonia.
Sang nan wehio e ketila Asiria oh kauwada kahnimw kan en Ninipe, Rehopod Ir, Kala,
oh Resen, me mihte nanpwungen Ninipe oh kahnimw laud en Kala.
Kadaudok en Isip kan iei mehn Lidia, Anam, Lehap, Napdu,
Padrus, Kaslu, oh Krihd, me mehn Pilisdia kan pwilisang ie.
Nein Kenan pwutak—Saidon, me keieu laud, oh Hed—irail me pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kenan pil wia pahpa kahlap en mehn Sepus, mehn Amor, mehn Kirkas,
mehn Ip, mehn Ark, mehn Sin,
mehn Arpad, mehn Semar oh mehn Amad. Kadaudok en mehn Kenan ikiparpeseng,
lao irepen Kenan lellahng palieir en Saidon lel Kerar limwahn Kasa oh kolahng palimese lel Sodom, Komora, Adma, oh Sepoim limwahn Lasa.
Ih met kan kadaudok en Ahm, me kin koukousoan rehn kadaudokarail kan oh wasa kan, ehuehu pwihn kin lokaiahki pein ar lokaia.
Sehm, rien Saped me laud, ih me wia pahpa kahlap en mehn Ipru koaros.
Nein Sehm pwutak—Elam, Ahsur, Arpaksad, Lud, oh Aram— irail me wia pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en mehn Aram ko iei mehn Us, Hul, Keder, oh Mesek.
Arpaksad me naineki Sela, Sela me naineki Eper.
Eper naineki pwutak riemen: emen adaneki Pelek, pwehki nindokon eh mwehi aramas en sampah pwalpeseng wiahda pali kei; oh meteio adaneki Sokdan.
Kadaudok en Sokdan kan iei mehn Almodad, Selep, Asarmaped, Sera,
Adoram, Usal, Dikla,
Opal, Apimael, Sipa,
Opir, Apila, oh Sopap. Irail koaros pwildohsang Sokdan.
Sahpw me re kin kousoan ie tepisang Mesa kolahng Separ ni palimesehn sahpwo.
Ih met kan kadaudok en Sehm, me kin koukousoan rehn kadaudokarail kan oh wasa kan, ehuehu pwihn kin lokaiahki pein ar lokaia.
Aramas pwukat koaros wia kisehn kadaudok en Noha, ehuehu wehi nin duwen wekpeseng en ar kadaudok. Mwurin nohlik lapalapo, wehin sampah kan koaros pwildohsang rehn nein Noha pwutak ko.
Nin tapio, tohn sampah koaros ahnekipene soangen mahsenteieu, pwe re kin doadoahngki soangen lepin mahsen kan me duwepenehte wasa koaros.
Ni ar mwekimwekidlahng palimese, re ahpw lel wasa patapat kis nan Papilonia, wasa re kousoanla ie.
Irail eri ndapene nanpwungarail, “Nna, kitail umwunda pwehl oh wiahkihda lepin takai.” Eri, re ahpw wiahda lepin takai pwehl, mehn kou ihmw, oh pil onopada tahr, mehn kapasapene takai ko.
Irail ahpw nda, “Eri, met kitail wiahda ehu kahnimw, oh ehu imwen doulik, me imwi pahn leldalahng pahnlahng, pwe kitail en ndandla oh dehr mwarahkpeseng wasa kan nin sampah.”
KAUN-O eri ketidi pwe en mahsanih kahnimwo oh imwen douliko me aramas ako kauwadahr.
E ahpw mahsanih, “Eri, aramas pwukat koaros wiahki ehu, oh re kin lokaiahki lokaiateieu; met iei tepin me re pahn wiewia kohwei. Mwurin met re pahn mwadangete kak wiahda soahng koaros me re anahne.
Eri, kitail kohdihwei oh kapingada ar lokaia, pwe re en dehr wehwehkipene ar lokaia kan.”
KAUN-O eri ketin kalipeihrpeseng ong wasa koaros nin sampah. Irail eri tokedihsang ar wiewia kahnimwo.
Kahnimwo adaneki Papilon, pwehki iei wasao me KAUN-O ketin kapingada lokaiahn aramas koaros, oh sang wasao me e ketin kalipeihrpeseng ong wasa koaros nin sampah.
Iet kadaudok en Sehm kan. Sounpar riau mwurin nohlik lapalapo, ni Sehm eh sounpar 100, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Arpaksad.
Mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 500 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Arpaksad eh sounpar 35, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Sela;
mwuri, e momourki sounpar 403 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Sela eh sounpar 30, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Eper;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 403 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Eper eh sounpar 34, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Pelek;
mwuri, e ahpw momourki sounpar 430 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Pelek eh sounpar 30, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Reu;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 209 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Reu eh sounpar 32, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Seruk;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 207 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Seruk eh sounpar 30, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Nahor;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 200 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Nahor eh sounpar 29, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Tera;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 119 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Mwurin Tera eh sounpar 70, e nainekihda Eipram, Nahor, oh Aran.
Iet kadaudok en Tera kan: Tera semen Eipram, Nahor oh Aran. Aran semen Lohd.
Eri, Aran mehla nan uhdakeo, Ur nan Papilonia, nindokon eh pahpao eh momourte.
Aran semen Iska oh pil serepein men, Milka, en Nahor eh pwoud; oh Eipram pwoudikihda Sarai.
Sohte nein Sarai seri, pwehki ih lih depwen men.
Tera eri kahrehda nah pwutak Eipram, oh Lohd nein Aran, rien Eipram ohl, oh Sarai, en Eipram eh pwoud; irail koaros ahpw mweselsang Ur, kahnimw en Papilonia, pwe re en kolahng Kenan. Irail ahpw lel kahnimw Aran, wasa re kousoanla ie.
Tera sipalla wasao ni eh sounpar 205.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Eipram, “Kohkohla sang nan sapwomwen, rehn kisehmw kan, sang ni imwen semomwen, kowe eri kohla nan sahpw ehu me I pahn kasalehiong uhk.
I pahn kihong uhk kadaudok ngedehrie, me pahn wiahla wehi lapalap ehu. I pahn kapaiaiukada oh kalinganahla edomw pwe en wiahla mehn kapai.
I pahn kapaiahda irail kan me kin kapaiaiukada. Ahpw I pahn keriahla irail kan me kin keriaiukala. Wehi koaros en sampah pahn peki rehi I en kapaiairailda duwehte ei kapaiaiukadahr.”
Eipram, ni eh mahkiher sounpar 75, e ahpw mweselsang Aran, nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih; Lohd eri iangihada.
E pil kahre eh pwoud Sarai, oh Lohd nein rieo, iangahki kepwe koaros oh ladu koaros me re naineki nan Aran. Irail eri tapihada seiloaklahng Kenan. Ni ar lel nan Kenan,
Eipram ahpw kotehla sahpwo lao lel wasa sarawien kahnimw Sekem, lel tuhke sarawien More. (Ni ahnsowo mehn Kenan kan mihmihte nan sahpwo.)
KAUN-O ahpw pwarohng Eipram oh mahsanihong, “Ih sahpwet me I pahn kihong kadaudokomw kan.” Eipram eri kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao ong KAUN-O, pwehki eh ketin pwarohng.
Mwurin mwo, e ahpw douluhlsang wasao ong palieir, lel nahna me mi palimesehn kahnimw Pedel; e ahpw kauwada ie imwe impwal kan, nanpwungen Pedel me mi palikapi oh Ai me mi palimese. E pil kauwada wasao pei sarawi ehu, oh kaudokiong KAUN-O.
Eri, e kin keseusang ehu wasa keseulahng ehu wasa, mwekimwekid kohla palieir en Kenan.
A pwehki eh sohte kisin mwenge nan sahpwo, oh lehk laud eh lalaudlahte, Eipram douluhldilahte lel Isip, wasa e kousoanla ie ahnsou kis.
Ni eh pahn kereniong pedolong nan Isip, e ahpw ndaiong eh pwoud Sarai, “Kilang, I ese me lih masamwahu men kowe.
Eri, ni mehn Isip kan ar pahn kilanguhkada, re pahn nda, ‘En Eipram eh pwoud met’—re ahpw pahn kemeiehla, oh re pahn mweidohng uhk ke en momour.
Eri, menlau ke ahpw ndaiong irail me riei serepein kowe; pwe re en kasamwo ie mwahu pwehki kowe oh mweidohng ie I en momourte.”
Eri, ni eh pedolong nan Isip, mehn Isip ko ahpw kilangada uwen lingan en eh pwoudo.
Lapalap akan ahpw kilangada liho oh kairehki Parao uwen eh lingan oh masamwahu; liho eri pakahrlahng nan tehnpas en Parao.
Parao ahpw kasamwo Eipram pwehki Sarai, oh ketikihong nah pelin sihpw oh kuht, kou, ahs, lidu, oh kamel tohto.
Ahpw pwehki Parao eh ketikihsang Eipram Sarai. KAUN-O ahpw ketin kalokehki ih oh tohn tehnpeseo kalokolok laud en soumwahu suwed kei.
Ihme Parao malipehdo Eipram oh keinemwe reh, “Dahme komw wiahiong ie? Dahme komw sohte padahkihongiehki me Sarai omwi pwoud?
Dahme kahrehda komw mahsaniheki me riomwi, ngehi eri alehda pwe I en pwoudiki? Eri, ien ih! Ale oh patopatohweisang met.”
Parao eri ketikihong Eipram rehn sapwellime aramas akan pwe re en kahreieisang nan irepen Isip, iangahki eh pwoud oh mehkoaros me e ahneki.
Eipram eri mweselsang Isip, kolahng paliepeng, iangahki eh pwoud oh mehkoaros me e ahneki, kolahng palieir en Kenan; Lohd pil iang ih.
Eipram inenen kepwehpwe, pwe e naineki sihpw, kuht, oh kou tohto, iangahki kohl oh silper.
Mwuhr, e ahpw douluhlsang mwo, mwekimwekid kolahng Pedel oh Ai, wasa e kauwada ie imwe impwal kan mahs
iangahki pei sarawi ehu. E ahpw kaudokiong KAUN-O wasao.
Lohd pil naineki sihpw, kuht, oh kou tohto, iangahki eh peneinei oh nah tohndoadoahk kan.
Eri, audepen sahpwo sohte itarohng pwe ira en kousoanpene ie; pwe ira koaros naineki pelinmen tohtohie.
Iei me pei oh akamai wiawihkihda nanpwungen nein Eipram oh nein Lohd neira silepen mahn akan. (Ni ahnsowo mehn Kenan oh mehn Peris kin kousoante nan sahpwo.)
Eipram eri ndaiong Lohd, “Kilang, kita peneinei, ihme noumw silepe kan oh nei silepe kan re en dehr akamaipene.
Kita tohrohrpeseng. Menlau pilada mehnia sahpw me ke mwahuki kousoan ie, pwe ke en tohrohrala oh kousoanla ie. Ma ke pahn kohwei wasa kis, a I pahn kohla ekis wasa tohrohr.”
Lohd ahpw irihrongseli oh kilangada duwen sahpw me Pillap Sordan tang loale eh patapat laud lellahng Soar oh eh diren pihl, likamwete sapwellimen KAUN-O mwetuwel de wehin Isip. (Eri, met mwohn KAUN-O eh ketin kamwomwala kahnimw kan en Sodom oh Komora.)
Lohd eri pilada sahpw patapat en Sordan oh tohrohralahng ni palimese. Ih duwen met en ohl riemenet ara tohrohrpeseng.
Eipram mihmihte nan Kenan, a Lohd kousoanla nanpwungen kahnimw kan me mi limwahn Sordan oh kauwada imwe impwal kan limwahn Sodom.
Tohn kahnimw wet aramas suwed kei, oh aramas dipan ekei mwohn silangin KAUN-O.
Mwurin Lohd eh tohrohrala sang Eipram, KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Eipram, “Sang wasa ke mihmi iehn, irongowei wasa koaros.
Pwe I pahn ketikihong uhk oh kadaudokomw kan sahpw koaros me ke kilikilang, oh e pahn wiahla sapwamwail kohkohlahte.
I pahn kangederehla kadaudokomw kan, re pahn uhdahn tohtohlahsang pwelpar en sampah. Ma mie me kak wadekedi pwelpar en sampah koaros, eri, e pahn kak wadekedi kadaudokomw kan.
Eri, met onopada oh kohwei wasa koaros nan sahpwet pwon, pwe I pahn ketikihong uhk koaros.”
Eipram eri kasauwada imwe impwal ko oh kohla kousoanla limwahn tuhke sarawi kan en Mamre karanih Epron. Ih eri kauwadahng KAUN-O pei sarawi ehu wasao.
Nanmwarki pahmen, Amrapel, nanmwarkien Papilonia, Ariok, nanmwarkien Elasar, Sedorlaomer, nanmwarkien Elam, oh Daidal, nanmwarkien Koim,
re mahweniong nanmwarki limmen pwukat: Pera, nanmwarkien Sodom, Pirsa, nanmwarkien Komora, Sinap, nanmwarkien Adma, Semeper, nanmwarkien Sepoim, oh nanmwarkien Pela (de Soar).
Nanmwarki limmen pwukat eri miniminpenehr nan Wahun Siddim, iei me ahnsou wet Sehden Mehla.
Erein sounpar eisek riau re ketiketkiher pahn manaman en Sedorlaomer, a ni kaeisek siluhn sounparo re pelianda oh moromorada.
Ni kaeisek pahieun sounparo, Sedorlaomer oh ienge nanmwarki kan ahpw pokonpene, iangahki sapwellimarail karis en sounpei, oh kalowehdi mehn Repa kan nan Asderod Karnaim, mehn Sus kan nan Ahm, mehn Em kan nan patapat en Kiriadaim,
oh mehn Hor kan ni nahna kan en Edom lellahng Elparan, me mi ni keilen sapwtehno.
Re ahpw pwurodohng Kades (de Enmispat). Re kalowehdi sapwen mehn Amalek koaros, oh kalowehdi mehn Amor kan, me kin kousoan nan Asason Damar.
Nanmwarkien Sodom, Komora, Adma, Sepoim oh Pela ahpw onopada sapwellimarail karis en sounpei kan nan Wauhn Siddim oh mahweniong
nanmwarkien Elam, Koim, Papilonia, oh Elasar, nanmwarki limmen uhwong nanmwarki pahmen.
Wahun Siddim me inenen diren pwoaren tahr. Eri, nanmwarkien Sodom oh Komora ahpw lempehdiong nan pwoahr ako, ni ara wekidek en tangasang nan mahweno. Iengara teiko ahpw tangdoaui oh rukula pohn nahna kan.
Nanmwarki pahmeno eri ketikihsang mehkoaros nan Sodom oh Komora, oh pil kisin mwenge; re ahpw ketiketlahsang.
Re pil wahsang Lohd oh mehkoaros me e ahneki, pwe e kin koukousoan nan kahnimw Sodom.
Ohl emen sang rehn me pitla ko ahpw kohdo oh kairehki Eipram mehn Ipruo mehkoaros. Eipram kin koukousoan limwahn tuhke sarawi ko en Mamre, mehn Amor, me iei rien Eskol oh Aner; irail kin miniminiong Eipram.
Eipram lao rongada duwen nein rieo eh iangehr lohdi oh selidi, e ahpw kapokonepene ohl loalopwoat kan en eh kahnimpwalo, irail koaros me 318; e ahpw kahreiraillahng Dan, raparapahki nanmwarki pahmen ko.
E ahpw katohrepeseng nah aramas ako ni pwihn kei wasao, e ahpw mahweniong irail nipwong oh kaloweiraildi. E ahpw pwakihirailla lao lel Hopa, paliepeng en Damaskus.
Ih eri kapwurehsang irail kepwe koaros. E pil kapwurehsang irail Lohd, nein rieo, iangahki lih akan oh aramas teikan.
Ni Eipram eh sapahldo sang eh kalowehdi nanmwarki Sedorlaomer oh nanmwarki teiko, nanmwarkien Sodom ahpw ketieila kasamwo ih nan Wahun Sape (me pil adaneki Wahun Nanmwarki).
Melkisedek, me iei nanmwarkien Salem oh pil samworo en Koht, Wasa Lapalahpie, e ahpw ketikihong Eipram pilawa oh wain.
E ahpw kapaiahkihda mahsen pwukat: “Koht, Wasa Lapalahpie, me ketin kapikada nanleng oh sampah, en ketin kupwuramwahwih Eipram.
Kaping en kohieng Koht, Wasa Lapalahpie, me ketikihong komwi manaman en powehdi omwi imwintihti kan.” Eri, Eipram ahpw ketikihong Melkisedek eisek kis ehun kepwe kan koaros me e kalowedier.
Nanmwarkien Sodom ahpw mahsanihong Eipram, “Komw kolokolete mehkoaros me komw kalowedier, ihte nei aramas akan me komw pahn kapwuredohng ie.”
Eipram eri sapeng, patohwan, “I kahukihla mwohn KAUN-O, Koht Wasa Lapalahpie, Sounwiepen nanleng oh sampah,
me I sohte pahn ale mehkot sang rehmwi, mehnda ma mwulen dereht ehu de selen suht ehu. Pwe komwi dehr mahsanih, ‘Ngehi me kahrehiong Eipram eh kepwehpwehla.’
Eri, sohte mehkot I pahn ale ahi. Ihte me I pahn ale, dahme nei ohl akan doadoahngkiher oh pwais me uhdahn en iengei kan, Aner, Eskol oh Mamre; irail me pahn ale pwaisarail.”
Mwurin mepwukat, Eipram ahpw kilangada kaudiahl ehu, e rongada KAUN-O eh mamahsanih, “Eipram, ke dehr masak; pwe iet ngehi perehpomw me pahn apwahpwalihiuk. I pahn kihong uhk keting ehu me lapalahpie.”
Eipram ahpw patohwan, “Maing KAUN, Wasa Lapalap, ia duwen omwi pahn ketikihong ie ketingpei lapalap, ni eh sohte ei tungoal seri? Elieser, mehn Damaskus, iei ihte me pahn ale ei sohso.
Pwehki sohte seri men komw ketikihong ie, ihme kahrehda emen ei ladu kan me pahn ale ei sohso.”
E ahpw pil rongada KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih, “Soh! Kaidehkin ladu menet me pahn ale omw sohso; pwe pein noumw pwutak.”
KAUN-O eri ketin kahreieilahng liki oh mahsanih, “Kilengdalahng pahnlahng, oh wadek usu kan, ma ke kak; pwe iei pahn duwen ngeder en kadaudokomw kan.”
Eipram eri likihala KAUN-O, oh ihme KAUN-O ketin kupwurperenkihla oh sapwellimanikihla.
Kedekedeo, KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Eipram, “Iet ngehi KAUN-O, me kahluweiukasang Ur nan Papilonia, pwe I en kihong uhk sahpw wet, pwe en wiahla uhdahn sapwomw.”
A Eipram sapeng, patohwanohng, “Maing KAUN, Wasa Lapalap, dahme I pahn patohwan esehki me sahpw wet iei uhdahn ei tungoal?”
KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanih, “Wadohng ie mahs emen koupwul me sounpar siluh, emen kuht me sounpar siluh, emen sihpw wol me sounpar siluh, emen mwuroi oh emen pitsin.”
Eipram eri patohwandohng Koht soangen mahn pwukat koaros. E ahpw pwalangirailpeseng wiahkihda riapali, e ahpw kasohpeipene kairekala; a menpihr ko e sohte pwalangpeseng.
Menpihr toantoal kei ahpw kin pihrdidohng pohn mahn mehla ko, a Eipram ahpw kin karawansang.
Ni ketipino eh peiklahr, Eipram ahpw meirla oh meirkelikla, oh lemw ehu ahpw kipehdi.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong, “Kadaudokomw kan pahn keikeiruseli nan sapwen wai ehu; re pahn wiahla lidu wasao oh ale lokolok erein sounpar 400.
Ahpw I pahn kaloke wehi me pahn wiahiong irail soahng wet, oh ni arail pahn kohkohlasang nan sahpwo, re pahn wahsang kepwe tohto.
A kowe, ke pahn mour werei, ke lao pahn mehla ni popohl. Ke pahn seridi mwurin omw pahn mour werei.
Eri, mwurin dih pahieu kadaudokomw kan pahn pwurodo met, pwe I pahn kasarehsang met mehn Amor kan ahnsou me re pahn konehng ale kalokolok pwehki ar suwed laud kan.”
Ni ketipino eh kihrla oh wasa rotorotala, dahl ehu me wie edied oh kisiniei me wie mpwumpwul powe pa pwarada oh mwekimwekid kohla nanpwungen mahn me pwalpeseng ko.
Rahno KAUN-O eri kauwada inou ehu nanpwungen ih oh Eipram, mahsanih, “I inoukihda me I pahn kihong kadaudokomw kan sahpw wet pwon, sang ni irepen Isip lel Pillap Iupreitis,
iangahki sapwen mehn Ken kan, sapwen mehn Kenis kan, mehn Kadmon kan,
mehn Id kan, mehn Peris kan, mehn Repa kan,
mehn Amor kan, mehn Kenan kan, mehn Kirkas kan, oh mehn Sepus kan.”
Sarai, en Eipram eh pwoud, sohte neitikihong Eipram. Ahpw mie eh lidu lih emen, mehn Isip, ede Akar.
Sarai eri ndaiong Eipram, “Kilang, KAUN-O sohte ketin kupwurehiong ie seri; dahme ke soh pekehikidahki ei liduwen? Mweinele e kak wiahiong ie emen serien.” Eipram ahpw pwungki dahme Sarai ndaiong.
Sarai eri kihong Eipram eh lidu Akar, mehn Isipo, pwe en pekehiki. (Met wiawiher sounpar eisek mwurin Eipram eh koukousoankiher nan Kenan.)
Eri, mwurin Eipram eh ale Akar oh kapwaiada reh nsenen pwopwoud, Akar ahpw liseianda. Eri, ni eh pehmadahr me e liseiandahr, e ahpw aklapalapkihla oh tapihada mwamwahlikihla Sarai.
Sarai eri ndaiong Eipram, “Kowe me kahrehda Akar eh mwamwahlikiniehla. I kihong uhk ei liduwet ke en pekehiki. Eri, sang ni ahnsou me e liseiandahr, e mwamwahlikiniehla. KAUN-O en ketin kupwurehda ihs me pwung rehta.”
Eipram ahpw sapengki, “Me mwahu. Kapwurewei omw liduwen, oh wiahiong nsenomw.” Sarai eri kapwurehla liduwo oh kin sakosakone, kahrehda Akar eh tangasang.
Tohnleng en KAUN-O ahpw tuhwong Akar limwahn pwarer en nan sapwtehn, nanial en kolahng Sur.
E ahpw mahsanihong, “Akar, en Sarai eh lidu, ke kohsang ia, oh ke kohkohla ia?” Akar ahpw sapeng, “I tangasang Sarai.”
Tohnlengo ahpw mahsanih, “Pwurala rehn omw kauno, oh peki mahk reh.”
E ahpw pil mahsanih, “I pahn kangederehla kadaudokomw kan, oh uwen tohtowe sohte me kak wadekada.
Kereniongehr ke pahn naitikihada noumw pwutak emen, oh ke pahn kihong ede, Ismael, pwe KAUN-O ketin karongeier ngilen omw apwal.
Ahpw mouren noumw pwutak en pahn rasehng mouren ahs lawalo men; e pahn uhwong aramas koaros, oh aramas koaros pahn uhwong. E pahn kousoan dohsang kiseh kan koaros.”
Akar eri mengimengloalki, “Mehlel, me I kilangehr Koht, I ahpw momourte?” Ih eri kamwarenki KAUN-O, me ketin mahseniong, “Koht Me kin Mahsanih Wasa.”
Ih kahrepen en aramas akan ar kin kahdanekihki pwarer me mi nanpwungen Kades oh Pered, “Pwarer en me Ieiaso Me ketin Mamahsanih Ie.”
Akar eri naitikihong Eipram pwutak emen; Eipram ahpw kihong ede Ismael.
Eipram sounpar 86 ni ahnsowo.
Ni Eipram eh sounpar 99, KAUN-O ahpw ketin pwarohng oh mahsanihong, “Ngehi me Koht, Wasa Lapalap. Ke pahn peikiong ie, oh wia dahme pwung ahnsou koaros.
I pahn wia ei inou ong uhk, oh I pahn kangederehla kadaudokomw kan.”
Eipram eri poaridi lel nanpwel, Koht ahpw mahsanih,
“Ih inowo met me I pahn wiahiong uhk: I inoukihong uhk me ke pahn wiahla semen wehi ngedehrie.
Sang met kohla ke solahr pahn adaneki Eipram, a ke pahn adanekihla Eipraam,
I pahn kangederehla kadaudokomw kan, oh ekei irail pahn wiahla nanmwarki. Kadaudokomw kan pahn ngeder mehlel, oh re pahn wiahla wehi kei.
“I pahn dadaurete ei inou ong uhk, oh pil ong kadaudokomw kan en dih me pahn kohdo kan oh pil kohkohlahte. I pahn kin wia omw Koht, oh Koht en kadaudokomw kan mwurimw.
I pahn kihong uhk oh kadaudokomw kan sahpw wet me ke keikeiru ie met. Ke pahn sapwenikihla Kenan pwon kohkohlahte, oh I pahn wia arail Koht.”
Koht ahpw pil mahsanihong Eipraam, “Ke uhdahn pahn pil kapwaiada inou wet, kowe oh kadaudokomw kan, erein dih kan me pahn kohdo.
Eri, iet inou me kowe oh kadaudokomw kan pahn inoukihdahn: ohl koaros rehmwail pahn sirkumsaisla.
Sang met kohla, seri wol koaros pahn sirkumsaisla ni ar pahn mahki rahn 8, iangahki lidu kan me ipwidi rehmwail oh me pweipweido sang liki. Eri, met pahn wia kilel en inou me poadadahr nanpwungen ngehi oh kumwail.
<range>
Emenemen pahn sirkumsaisla, oh met pahn wia kilel ehu ni paliwaramwail kan, me pahn kasalehda ei inou poatopoat ong kumwail.
Ohl emen me sohte pahn sirkumsaisla, eh solahr iang kisehn nei aramas akan, pwehki eh sohte kapwaiada ei inou wet.”
Koht ahpw pil mahsanihong Eipraam, “Sang met kohla ke solahr pahn kahdaneki omw pwoudo Sarai, ahpw Sara.
I pahn kapaiahda, oh I pahn kihong en naitikihong uhk noumw pwutak emen. I pahn kapaiahda oh e pahn wiahla inen wehi tohto, oh sang rehn kadaudoke kan nanmwarki kei pahn pwarada.”
Eipraam ahpw poaridi lel nanpwel, e ahpw tapihada kouruhrki pein eh lamalam, nda, “Mie ohl laud me kak wiahda seri ni eh sounparehr 100? A Sara me sounparehr 90 kak neitik?”
Ih eri patohwanohng Koht, “Maing, dahme komw sohte mweidohngki Ismael en wia semen kadaudok ei kan?”
A Koht mahsanih, “Soh. Omw pwoud Sara pahn naitikihada pwutak emen, me ke pahn kihong ede Aisek. I pahn kapwaiada ei inou ong ih oh ong kadaudoke kan. Pwe inou poatopoat ehu met.
I rongehr omw pekipek duwen Ismael, eri, I pahn kapaiahda oh kangederehla nah kan oh kadaudoke kan. E pahn wiahla semen kaun ehk riemen, oh I pahn kihong kadaudoke kan re en wiahla wehi laud ehu.
I pahn dadaurete ei inou ong noumw pwutak Aisek, me Sara pahn naitikihada ni soangen ahnsou wet nan sounpar kohkohdo.”
Mwurin mahsen pwukat, Koht ahpw ketiketla sang Eipraam.
Eri rahnohte, Eipraam sirkumsaisihala nah pwutak Ismael, oh ohl koaros en tohn imweo, iangahki lidu kan me ipwidi reh oh me e pwainda kan.
Eipraam sounpar 99, ni eh sirkumsaisla,
a nah pwutako Ismael sounpar 13.
Ira koaros sirkumsaisla rahnteieu,
iangahki nein Eipraam lidu ko koaros.
KAUN-O eri ketin pwarohng Eipraam ni tuhke sarawi kan en Mamre. Eipraam wie mwomwohd ni wenihmwen imwe impwalo ni ahnsou me karakar en rahn inenen laud.
Ih eri kilenglahte kilangada ohl silimen me kesikesihnen mwowe. Eri, ni ahnsowohte e tangalahng irail pwe en kasamwo irail. E ahpw poaridi lel nanpwel,
oh patohwan, “Maing ko, iet ngehi sapwellimamwail ladu, kumwail dehr douluhlweisang imweiet ahpw sohte kommoaldi.
I pahn wadohng kumwail pihl pwe kumwail en widen nehmwail kan; eri, kumwail kommoaldi mahs pahn mwetehn tuhkeht.
I pahn wiahda sakamwail, pwe kumwail en rosonda oh usehla amwail seiloaken. Kumwail leledohr ni imweiet; eri, I pahn papah kumwail.” Re ahpw sapeng, “Kalahngan en komwi; mehkoaros en wiawi duwen me komw mahsanih.”
Eipraam eri mwadangete patohlong nan impwalo oh ndahng Sara, “Mwadang umwunda pilawa, sang nan ehd en pilawa me keieu mwahu.”
Mwuri, e ahpw pil tangala rehn nah pelin kou ko oh pilada kou pwul me keieu pwulopwul oh mworourou, e ahpw kihong nah sounpapaho, pwe en pil kaunopada.
E pil ale pwete, milik, oh uduken kouo, oh kihong irail. Nindokon arail sakasak, Eipraam kesikesihnen mparail pahn tuhkeo.
Ni arail sakasak, re ahpw idek rehn Eipraam, “Ia Sara, omw pwoudo?” Eipraam ahpw sapeng, “E patopato nan impwalen.”
Emen irail ahpw mahsanih, “I inoukihong komwi me omwi pwoud Sara pahn naitikihada nah pwutak emen mwurin sounpwong 9, oh ni ahnsowo I pahn pwurodo.” Sara ahpw mihmi loale limwahn wenihmwen impwalo, rongorong mehkoaros.
Eipraam oh Sara ira inenen likeilapalahr, oh Sara solahr wia eh pwung.
Ihme e kouruhrkihda oh mengimengloalki, “Nan ei likeilapalahr oh solahr kak neitik, ia duwe, I pahn pil men wiewiahte nsenen pwopwoud? Oh ei pwoudo pil likeilapalahr mehlel.”
KAUN-O eri keinemwe rehn Eipraam, “Dahme Sara kouruhrki oh ndahki, ‘E pahn mehlel pwoat me I kak neitik nan ei likeilapalahr?’
Mie mehkot me apwal ong KAUN-O? Ni ahnsou me I kilelehdi, mwurin sounpwong 9, I pahn pwurodo rehmw oh Sara pahn naitikihada pwutak emen.”
Eri, pwehki Sara eh masepwehkada, e ahpw kahmahmkihla oh patohwan, “Soh! I sohte kouruhr.” KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanih, “Ei, ke kouruhrki.”
Eri, ohlen keiru silimeno ahpw ketida oh ketiketlahng wasa kis me re kak iroirlahng kahnimw Sodom, oh Eipraam ahpw pil iangirailla pwe en kamwurirailla nanialo.
KAUN-O eri ketin mengimengloalki, “I sohte pahn ekihsang Eipraam dahme I pahn wiaht.
Kadaudoke kan pahn wiahla wehi lapalap oh manaman ehu, oh wehi koaros en sampah pahn peki I en kapaiairailda duwehte ei kapaiadahr ih.
I pilada ih pwe en padahkihong nah kan oh kadaudoke kan re en kin peikiong ei kosonned akan ni ar pahn kin wia dahme mwahu oh dahme pwung. I ahpw pahn kin kapwaiong ih soahng koaros me I inoukidahr.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Ngilen kedip ong Sodom oh Komora me inenen suwed, oh dipara kan me inenen toutou mehlel.
I pahn kohdihwei pwe I en kadehde ma ngilen kedip kan me I rongehr me mehlel de soh.”
Mehn keiru ko eri ketida oh ketiketlahng Sodom, a KAUN-O ketikette rehn Eipraam.
Eipraam eri keilahng mpen KAUN-O oh patohwanohng, “Ia duwe, komw uhdahn pahn ketin kamwomwala me dipan akan, iangahki me sohte dipe kan?
Ma mie aramas sohte dipe limehk nan kahnimwo, komw pahn ketin kamwomwala kahnimwo pwon? Komw sohte pahn kupwur mahk oh sohte ketin kamwomwala kahnimwo pwehki me lelepek limehko?
Eri, uhdahn soh! Komw sohte kak kemehla me dipan akan iangahki me sohte dipe kan. Met sohte kak wiawi rehmwi. Pwe ma met pahn pweida, me sohte dipe kan pahn ale lokolok duwehte me dipan akan. Met sohte kak wiawi. Sounkopwung en sampah pwon uhdahn pahn kin pwung ni sapwellime wiewia kan.”
KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma I pahn diar nan Sodom aramas limehk me sohte dipe, I pahn mahkohng kahnimwo unsek pwehki me limehko.”
Eipraam ahpw pil pwurehng patohwan, “Maing KAUN, komw ketin kupwur mahk oh kupwure ei pahn pwurehng pato. Aramas emen ngehi, me sohwar mehlel en patohwanda mehkot.
Ahpw ia duwe, mweinele aramas sohte dipe lelete pehklimmen, re sohte lel limehk. Komw pahn ketin kamwomwalahte kahnimwo pwon pwehki eh sohte lel limehko?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala kahnimwo, ma I diar aramas sohte dipe pehklimmen ie.”
Eipraam pil pwurehng patohwan, “A ma ele mehte pehk me dierek?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala, ma mehte pehk me dierek ie.”
Eipraam ahpw patohwan, “Maing, komw dehpa engiengda pahi ma I pwurupwurehngete ei peidek kat. A ma mehte siliakan me dierekda?” KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala, ma me siliakan dierekda.”
Eipraam ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, komw ketin kupwur mahk oh kupwure ei pahn pwurehng pato. A ma mehte riehk me dierekda?” KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, I sohte pahn kamwomwala kahnimwo ma I diar aramas sohte dipe riehk ie.”
Eipraam ahpw pil patohwanohng, “Maing, komw kupwur mahk, peidektehr ehu me I pahn wia. A ma mehte ehk me dierek nan kahnimwo?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala, ma me ehk dierekda.”
Mwurin KAUN-O eh mahseniong Eipraam, e ahpw ketiketla sang; a Eipraam ahpw pwuralahng ni imweo.
Ni tohnleng riemeno ara lel Sodom nin soutikpene, Lohd wie mwomwohd ni ewen kelen kahnimwo, wasa aramas akan kin pokonpene ie. Eri, ni Lohd eh kilangirahda, e ahpw uhda oh rahnmwahwih ira
oh patohwan, “Maing ko, iet ngehi, I patopato wasaht pwe I en papah kumwa. Kumwa ketido ni imweiet. Kumwa pahn widen aluweluwamwa kan oh pweiekidi rehi. Nimenseng kumwa ahpw pahn usehla sapwellimamwa seiloak.” Ira ahpw sapeng Lohd, mahsanih, “Soh! Se pahn kommoaldi wasaht nan wasahn tuhpene en kahnimwet.”
Ahpw Lohd ngidingidkihong ira en iangada, ketilahng ni imweo. Re ahpw ketiketla. Lohd eri ndaiong nah sounpapah ko re en umwun pilawa oh kaunopada kisin sak mwahu ong aramas en keiru ko. Ni soahng koaros eh nekier, re ahpw sak.
Mwohn mehn keiru ko ara pahn kolahng meirla, ohlen Sodom kan ahpw kapilpene ihmwo. Ohl koaros en kahnimwo, me pwulopwul oh me mah kan, iang mi wasao.
Re ahpw likwerih Lohd oh idek reh, “Ia ohl ako me kodohng pweidi rehmw nipwonget? Waieirahdo mahs pwe se en kak kapwaiada rehra ineng suwed en paliwarat akan, pwe se en pein kalel mahs nanpwungat.”
Lohd ahpw pwerieila rehrail, oh ritingedi wenihmwo,
e ahpw ndalahng irail, “Maing ko, menlau kumwail dehr wia soangen tiahk suweden!
Iet, mie nei serepein riemen me meipwon. I pahn kihong kumwail pwe kumwail en wiahiong ira nsenamwail. Ahpw I peki rehmwail, kumwail dehr wiahiong mehkot ohl pwukat, pwe ira mehn keiru kei ni imweiet, oh I uhdahn pahn apwalih ira.”
A irail sapeng, ndalahng, “Pwulahkasang men; kowe mehn liki men! Ihs kowe pwe ke en ndahng kiht dahme se en wia? Keisang men, pwe se de pil wiahiong uhk me pahn suwed sang me se pahn wiahiong ira.” Re ahpw sikenla Lohd oh doudahla pwe re en kauwehla wenihmwo.
A iet ohl riemen me mihmi loaleo sewesehda Lohd, sikenlong ong loale; ira ahpw ritingedi wenihmwo.
Ira ahpw karotongehla mesen me mihmi liki ko koaros, irail eri sohla kak diar wenihmwo.
Ohlen keiru riemeno eri idek rehn Lohd, “Mie kisehmw wasaht—noumw pwutak kan, serepein kan, oh en noumw kan ar pwoud kan, de kisehmw me iang koukousoan nan kahnimwet—wairailsang wasaht,
pwe se pahn kamwomwala wasaht. KAUN-O ketin karongeier kedip suwed koaros ong tohn kahnimw wet, oh e ketin poaroneikitodo pwe se en kamwomwala Sodom.”
Lohd eri kohla rehn ohl ako me pahn pwoudiki nah serepein ko, oh ndaiong ira, “Kumwa mwadang iang kohkohla sang wasaht; pwe KAUN-O pahn ketin kamwomwala wasaht.” Ira ahpw kihkihong me e wie kamwakamwanohng ira.
Nin sohrahno tohnleng ko ahpw keruwahda Lohd, mahsanihong, “Mwadang! Ale omw pwouden oh noumw serepein riemen en, oh mwadangehisang met, pwe kumwail dehr pil iang ohla ni kamwomwmwomwlahn kahnimw wet.”
Lohd ahpw peikasalda; a KAUN-O ketin kupwurehla. Ihme tohnleng ko alehte pehn Lohd, pehn eh pwoudo, oh pehn nah serepein ko, oh kahreirailieisang nan kahnimwo.
Ni ar miher likin kahnimwo, emen tohnleng ko mahsanihong Lohd, “Tang, pwe ke en mourla! Ke dehpa sohpeila pohn souwomwen, oh dehpa uhdi nan wahu. Tenge nahna kan, pwe ke de pil iang kamakamala.”
Lohd ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Soh, maing! Kaidehkin men me pahn wiawi.
Maing, komw ketin kupwureielahr mehlel; sapwellimomwi kalahngan me doareielahr. Nahna kan me nohn doh; mwohn ei pahn lel mwo kalokolok wet pahn koanoaiehdi oh I pahn mehla.
Komw mahsanih kisin kahnimw kisen? I kak lellahng mwo pwe me keren. Komw mweidohng ie I en patolahng mwo—wasa tikitik kis—oh ih wasa I kak pitla ie.
Tohnlengo eri sapeng, “Eri, me mwahu! I sohte pahn kamwomwala kisin kahnimwen.
Nna, mwadang tenge wasao! I sohte kak wia mehkot ke lao lel mwo.” Pwehki Lohd e kahdaneki kahnimwo kisin kahnimw tikitik, ihme kahnimwo adanekihki Soar.
Lohd ahpw lel Soar ni ahnsou me ketipino ahpwtehn dakada.
KAUN-O eri ketin kamwerehdi suwepel okohk, pohn Sodom oh Komora.
E ahpw ketin kamwomwala kahnimw ko oh nan wahuo pwon, iangahki tohn kahnimw ko koaros oh mehkoaros me audepen sahpwo.
Ahpw en Lohd eh pwoud, me kilengla mwuri, e ahpw pikla wiahla uhr soahl.
Mandahn rahno, nimensehngie, Eipraam ahpw sangkalahng wasa e patohwan tuhwong KAUN-O ie.
E ahpw kilengdilahng Sodom oh Komora oh nan wahuo pwon, e ahpw kilangada duwen ediniei eh ediedida sang nan sahpwo, rasehng edin uhmw kalaimwun ehu.
Ahpw ni ahnsou me Koht ketin kamwomwala kahnimw ko nan wahuo, e ketin kupwukupwurehte Eipraam oh ketin mweidohng Lohd en pitla.
Pwehki Lohd eh masak mihmihte Soar, ih oh nah serepein riemeno ahpw douluhllahng nin nahna kan; irail eri kin koukousoan nan pwoar ehu.
Nah serepein laudo eri ndaiong me tikitiko, “Kilang, ata pahpao likeilapalahr, oh sohte ohl emen nin sampah pwon luhwehdi me kak pwoudikinkitahda pwe kita en neitik seri duwen me kin wiawi.
Nna, kita kasakawihkihla wain e lao sakaula douluhl; kita ahpw wendi reh tuhkihong paliwarata pwe kita en neitikihong ata pahpa.”
Eri, nipwongo ira ahpw kasakawihkihla wain e lao sakaula douluhl. Serepein laudo eri wendi rehn eh pahpao oh tuhkihong paliwereo. Eh pahpao ahpw sohte kehnda mehkot nan eh sakaula douluhl.
Mandahn rahno serepein laudo ahpw ndaiong me tikitiko, “Pwohng I wendi rehn pahpa oh tuhkihong paliwereiet. Kita pil kasakawihkihla wain pwonget, kowe eri pahn uhd wia duwen me I wiadahr. Kita koaros eri pahn neitikiong at pahpao.”
Eri, nipwongo ira ahpw pil kasakawihkihla wain e lao sakaula; oh serepein tikitiko ahpw uhd wendi rehn eh pahpao, oh tuhkihong paliwereo. Nan eh sakaula douluhl e ahpw sohte mwahn pil kehnda wasa.
Iei duwen met nein Lohd serepein riemeno ara liseianohng ara pahpao.
Serepein laudo eri naitikihada pwutak emen me e kihong ede Mohap. Ih me wia semen mehn Mohap en ahnsou wet kan.
Me tikitiko pil naitikihada nah pwutak emen, me e kihong ede Penami.
Eipraam eri mweselsang Mamre kolahng palieir en Kenan oh kousoanla nanpwungen Kades oh Sur. Nindokon eh koukousoanier nan Kerar,
e kin patohwan me Sara, eh pwoudo, uhdahn rie. Apimelek, nanmwarkien Kerar, ahpw ketin poaronehdo Sara reh pwehn pekehikihda.
Koht ahpw ketin pwarohng Apimelek nipwong nan ouraman ehu oh mahsanihong, “Komw pahn mehla pwe lih me komw aledahr mie eh pwoud.”
Ahpw Apimelek saikinte wia nsenen pwopwoud rehn liho, e ahpw patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, ia duwen omwi pahn ketin kemehla aramas emen me sohte dipe?
Pein Eipraam patohwanohng ie me rie lih menet oh pil pein lihet patohwan me rie Eipraam. Iei me I wiadahr met ni kapehd oh lamalam mwakelekel.”
Koht ahpw ketin sapeng nan eh ouraman mahsanih, “Mehlel, I ese me ke wiadahr met ni kapehd oh lamalam mwakelekel, pwe ngehi me kasilehsang uhk ke en dehr wiahda dihp oh sohte mweidohng ke en sair liho.
Eri, met ale lihen kapwurelahng rehn uhdahn eh pwoudo, pwe soukohp men ih; oh e pahn kapakapkin uhk pwe ke en dehr mehla. Ma ke sohte pahn kapwurehla, ke en ese pwe kowe oh noumw kan koaros pahn mehla.”
Mandahn rahno Apimelek ahpw mwadang kipada oh ketin kapokonepene sapwellime lapalap ako koaros oh mahsanihong irail soahng koaros me wiawihong, irail eri masepwehkada.
Apimelek ahpw malipehdo Eipraam oh mahsanihong, “Dahme komw wiahiong kiht? Dahme I wiahiong komwi pwe komwi en wadohng ie oh pohn ei wehi apwal laud wet? Komw wiahiong ie soangen ire ieu me sohte kin wiawihong ie sang mahs kohdo.
Dahme komw wiahki soangen irair wet?”
A Eipraam sapengki, “Pwehki I lemeleme me sohte me pahn wahuneki Koht rehmwail; kumwail eri pahn kemeiehla pwehki ei pwoudo.
Ahpw mehlel riei liho, pwe nein ei pahpa, ahpw kaidehn nein ei nohno, ihme I pwoudikihdahki.
Ni Koht eh ketin kupwurehda I en patopatohsang rehn ei pahpao oh patopatolahng nan sapwen mehn liki kan, I patohwanohng lihet, ‘Ke pahn kin ndahng aramas akan me riei kowe, pwe ih duwen omw pahn kak kasalehda omw loalopwoatohng ie.’”
Apimelek ahpw kapwurehla Sara rehn Eipraam, iangahki sihpw, kou, oh lidu kei.
E ahpw mahsanihong Eipraam, “Sahpwet pwon sapwei; kousoanla wasa me komw kupwurki.”
E ahpw pil mahsanihong Sara, “Kilang, I kihongehr riomwo mwohni silper kid, kadehdepen eh sohte dipomw; aramas koaros pahn ese me sohte sapwung ehu ke wiahda.”
KAUN-O ketin iredihsang lih koaros en peneinei en Apimelek re en dehr neitik, pwehki irairo me wiawihong Sara. Eri Eipraam ahpw kapakap ong Koht pwehki Apimelek; Koht eri ketin kupwurehla oh ketin kakehlahda iangahki eh pwoud oh neira lidu serepein kan, irail eri kakehr pwurehng neitik.
