KAUN-O ahpw ketin kupwuramwahwihala Sara, duwen me e ketin inoukidahr,
e ahpw liseianda oh wiahiong Eipraam pwutak emen, ni Eipraam eh likeilapalahr. Kisin pwutako ipwidi ahnsou me Koht mahsanih me e pahn ipwidi.
Eipraam eri kihong ede Aisek.
Ni eh mahkiher rahn 8, Eipraam ahpw sirkumsaisihala nin duwen me Koht ketin mahsanih.
Eipraam sounpar 100, ahnsou me Aisek ipwidi.
Sara eri patohwan, “Koht ketikihong ie peren oh kouruhr. Koaros me rong met pahn iang ie perenda.”
E ahpw pil ketihtihki, “Ihs me kak ndahng Eipraam me Sara pahn kadihdi nah seri kan? Ahpw met I naitikiadahr seri men ong ih ni eh likeilapalahr.”
Serio eri keirda, oh nin rahn me e mweisang dihdi, Eipraam wiahda lapalahn kamadipw ehu.
Rahn ehu, Ismael, nein Akar mehn Isipo ong Eipraam, oh Aisek, nein Sara kisin pwutako, ira wie mwadomwadong.
Sara eri kilangirahda oh ndaiong Eipraam, “Kilang, kasarehla lih liduwen oh nah pwutaken. Nein liduwen pwutaken sohte pahn kak iang ahneki mehkot sang omw kepwe kan, pwe nei pwutak, Aisek, me pahn sohsohki.”
Met kapwunodehda kowahlap Eipraam, pwe Ismael pil uhdahn nah seri.
Koht eri ketin mahsanihong, “Ke dehr pwunodki pwutaken oh omw lidu Akar. Kapwaiada mehkoaros me Sara pahn ndawei, pwe kadaudokomw kan me I inoukihonguhkehr pahn tepisang Aisek.
I pahn pil kangederehla kadaudok en nein liduwen nah pwutaken, pwe re en wiahla wehi laud ehu. Pwe pil noumw pwutaken.”
Nin sohrahn en mandahn rahno, Eipraam ahpw kihong Akar eh tungoal kepinwar oh ehden pihl ehu. E ahpw koasoanehdi serio pohn tihnsewen liho oh kadarala. Liho eri mwesel oh kohla sansaruaruseli nan sapwtehn Peersepa.
Ni nimara pihlo eh rosalahr, e ahpw kihdiong nah serio pahn tuhke pwoat.
Liho ahpw kohla mwohndi iaht 100 dohlahsang wasa serio mihmi ie. Ih eri mengimengloalki, “I sohte kakohng kilang nei seriet eh pahn mehla.” Eri, ni eh mwomwohd wasao, serio tapihada sengiseng.
Koht ketin karongehda ngilen serio, oh tohnleng en Kohto men sang nanleng ahpw mahsanihong Akar, “Akar, dahme ke pwunodkidahr? Ke dehr masak. Koht ketin karongeier ngilen noumw serien me wie sengiseng.
Uhda oh kohwei, ale oh kansenamwahwihala. I pahn wiahiong kadaudoke kan wehi lapalap ehu.”
Koht eri ketin kapehdpeseng pwoaren mese ko, liho eri kilangada pwarer ehu. E ahpw kohla oh idipada ehden pihlo, oh kanimpile nah serio.
Koht eri ketin kupwukupwurehte serio nindokon eh kekeirda. E ahpw kin koukousoan nan sapwtehn en Paran oh wiahla soupal en kesik mahn emen.
Eh nohno eri kapwopwoudikihda lihen Isip men.
Ni ahnsowo Apimelek oh Pikol, kaunen sapwellime sounpei kan, ira ketila rehn Eipraam oh mahsanihong, “Koht ketin ieiang komwi ni mehkoaros me komw kin wia.
Eri, komw kahukihla mwohn silangin Koht me komw sohte pahn pitihiehdi, oh pitihdi nei seri kan de kadaudokei kan. Komw inoukihda me komw pahn loalopwoatohng ie oh pil ong sahpwet me komw koukousoan ie, duwen ei loalopwoatohng komwi.”
Eipraam ahpw sapengki, “I inoukihda.”
Eipraam ahpw kaulimkihong Apimelek duwen pwarer ehu me sapwellimen Apimelek tohndoadoahk ko adihasangehr.
Apimelek ahpw mahsanihong, “I sohte ese ihs me wia met. Komw sohte padahkihong ie oh I ahpwtehn rongada duwen irair wet.”
Eipraam ahpw patohwanohng Apimelek sihpw kei oh kou kei, ira eri wiahda inou ehu.
Eipraam katohrehsang sihmpwul isimen sang nan nah pelin sihpwo.
Apimelek ahpw keinemwe reh, “Ia wehwehn met?”
Eipraam ahpw sapengki, “Komw pahn ketiki sihmpwul isimen pwukat. Eri, met wehwehki me komw ketin pwungki me ngehi me weirada pwarer wet.”
Ih kahrepe wet me wasao adanekihki, Peersepa, pwehki ih wasa me ohl riemenet wiahda inou ehu ie.
Mwurin ara wiadahr inou wet nan Peersepa, Apimelek oh Pikol ahpw sapahllahng nan Pilisdia.
Eipraam eri padokedi tuhke damarisk pwoat nan Peersepa oh kaudokiong KAUN-O, Koht Soutuk.
Eipraam eri koukousoan nan Pilisdia ahnsou reirei.
Kedekedeo, Koht ahpw ketin song Eipraam; e mahsanihong, “Eipraam!” A Eipraam sapeng, patohwan, “Iet ngehi, Maing!”
Koht ahpw ketin mahsanih, “Ale Aisek, noumw pwutak iehrosen, me ke kin kesempwalki, oh kohla nan wehin Moria. Kowe kohla meirongkihong ie nin duwen meirong isihs ehu pohn nahna me I pahn kasalehiong uhk.”
Eri, nin sohrahn en mandahn rahno, Eipraam ahpw wesehda eh tuwien meirongo, oh audehda nah ahso oh wahda Aisek, iangahki ladu riemen. Re ahpw mwesellahng wasa me Koht ketin mahsanih en patolahng ie.
Ni kesiluhn rahno Eipraam kilang wasao me sansaldo sang wasa doh.
Ih eri ndaiong eh ladu ko, “Kumwa mihmihte met rehn ahset. Ngehi oh pwutaket pahn kolahng wia kaudok mwo, se ahpw pahn pwurodo rehmwa.”
Eipraam eri kihong Aisek en wahda tuwien meirong ko, a pein ih wahda samwit en kisiniei oh pil naip pwoat. Ni ara kohkohla nanialo,
Aisek ahpw idek reh, “Ipa!” A e sapeng, “Dah mwo, samwa?” Aisek ahpw nda, “I kilikilang samwit en kisiniei oh tuwien meirong kat, a ia sihmpwul mehn meirongen?”
Eipraam sapeng, nda, “Samwa, Koht pahn pein ketikihda ata mehn meirong.” Ira eri dodouluhlla nanialo.
Ni ara lel wasa me Koht ketin kasalehiong Eipraam, e ahpw kauwada pei sarawi ehu oh koasoanediong powe tuwi ko. E ahpw salihedi nah pwutak Aisek oh kidahng pohn kapakap en tuwi ko pohn pei sarawio.
E ahpw ale nah naipo pwe en kemehkihla Aisek.
A iet tohnleng en KAUN-O ahpw malipe sang nanleng, mahsanih, “Eipraam, Eipraam!” A e sapeng, “Iet ngehi, Maing.”
Tohnlengo ahpw mahsanih, “Ke dehr sair pwutaken, de wiahiong mehkot. I dehdehkiher uwen omw poadidiong Koht, pwehki omw sohte kahng meirongkihong ie noumw pwutak iehrosen.”
Eipraam ahpw kilikilengseli oh kilangada sihpw wol emen me kode ko tengalahr ni kisin rahntuhke kei. E ahpw kohla ale oh wiahkihla eh mehn meirong isihs wiliandi nah pwutako.
Eipraam ahpw kihong eden wasao, “KAUN-O me ketin Sawaskihda.” Lel rahnwet aramas akan kin kahdanehkihki wasao, “Nahnahn Sawas en KAUN-O.”
Tohnleng en KAUN-O ahpw malipe Eipraam keriapak sang nanleng, mahsanih,
“I kahukilahr ni pein mwarei—KAUN-O me mamahsen—me I pahn kapaiaiukada mehlel, pwehki omw wiadahr met oh sohte kahng meirongkihong ie noumw pwutaken.
I inoukihong uhk me I pahn kangederehla kadaudokomw kan duwehte ngeder en usu kan en pahnlahng de ngeder en pihk kan pohn oaroahr kan. Kadaudokomw kan pahn kalowehdi ar imwintihti kan.
Wehi koaros pahn peki I en kapaiairailda nin duwen ei kapaiadahr kadaudokomw kan—pwehki omw kapwaiadahr ei mahseno.”
Eipraam eri pwurala rehn eh ladu ko, re ahpw sapahllahng Peersepa, wasa e kin kousoan ie.
Mwurin ahnsou ehu Eipraam ahpw esehda me Milka naitikihada seri welimen ong rie Nahor:
Us me mesenih, rie pwutak Pus, Kemuel semen Aram,
Kesed, Haso, Pildas, Sidlap, oh Petuel,
Petuel semen Repeka. Milka naitikihada pwutak welimen pwukat ong Nahor, rien Eipraam.
Reuma, en Nahor pekehi naitikihada Tepa, Kaam, Taas, oh Maaka.
Sara momourki sounpar 127.
E ahpw mehla nan Epron, nan Kenan; Eipraam ahpw mwahieiki eh mehlao.
E ahpw ketila sang wasa me paliweren eh pwoud wie wonohn ie oh ketila rehn mehn Id ko, oh mahsanihong irail,
“Ngehi mehn liki men me patopato rehmwail; kumwail menlau netikidohng ie wasa kis, me I kak nekidedi ie ei pwoudo.”
Re ahpw sapengki,
“Maing, komw karongei kiht mahs. Se patohwan wiahkin komwi ohl lapalap oh manaman emen; komw ketin nekidedi omwi pwoud nan wasa keieu mwahu me mie reht. Kiht koaros pahn perenki patohwanohng komwi sousou ehu, pwe komwi en nekidedi ie omwi pwoudo.”
Eipraham ahpw poaridi mwohrail
oh mahsanih, “Ma kumwail kupwure pwe I en nekidedi ei pwoud wasaht, a kumwail menlau peki rehn Epron nein Sohar
pwe en netikihong ie poaren paip Makpela, me mihte ni keilen sahpweo. Kumwail peki reh pwe en netikihong ie uwen pweinen sahpwo unsek, met, mwohmwail, pwe I en kak sapwenikihla oh wiahkihla ei wasahn sousou.”
Pein Epron iang patopato rehn mehn Id ko ni ewen kehl wasahn tuhpene en aramas; ih eri sapeng mwohn aramas koaros wasao,
“Maing, komw karonge mahs; I pahn patohwanohng komwi sahpwo pwon iangahki poaren paip me mihmi ieo. Met mwohn nei aramas akan, I pahn patohwanohng komwi, pwe komwi en kak nekidedi ie omwi pwoudo.”
Eipraam eri poaridi mwohn mehn Id ko
oh mahsanihalahng Epron, pwe koaros en kak rong, “Eri, I peki rehmwi komwi menlau karonge ie. I pahn pwainda sahpwo pwon, komw ale pweineht, eri I pahn sarepidi ei pwoudo wasao.”
A Epron sapengki,
“Maing, sahpwo me komw men ale pahn pweipweiki sekel pahpwiki en silper—dahme mie nanpwungata? Eri komw nekidedi omwi pwoudo wasao.”
Eipraam eri pwungkihda oh teneki uwen pweipwei me Epron patohwanda mwohn pokono—sekel silper pahpwiki, nin duwen pweipwei me kin wiawi rehn sounnetinet kan.
Ih duwen met sahpw me uhdahn sapwen Epron nan Makpela palimesehn Mamre, eh wiahla sapwen Eipraam. Met iangahki sahpwo, poaren paipo, oh tuhke koaros me mi loale.
Mehn Id koaros me iang mihmi wasao ahpw kileledier me uhdahn sapwen Eipraam wasao.
Eipraam ahpw nekidedi eh pwoud Sara nan poaren paip me mi nan sahpwo nan Kenan.
Eri sapwen mehn Id ko, oh poaren paipo me mi loale, ahpw wiahla en Eipraam eh wasahn sarepedi me melahr akan.
Eri, Eipraam inenen likeilapalahr, oh KAUN-O ahpw ketin kupwuramwahwiher ni mehkoaros.
Eipraam eri ndaiong nah laduwo me keieu maho, me pil sounkohwahn mehkoaros me e ahneki, “Kihdiong pehmwen nan dengeie oh wiahda inou.
I anahne ke en inoukihong ie oh kahukihla mwohn KAUN-O, Koht en nanleng oh sampah, me ke sohte pahn pilada en nei pwutaket eh pwoud emen sang wasaht nan Kenan.
Ke pahn pwurowei nan uhdakeio oh rapahkihda en nei pwutak Aisek, eh pwoud sang rehn kisehi ko.”
Laduwo ahpw idek, “A ma serepeino sohte pahn men iang ie kohdo met, dahme I pahn wia? I pahn kadarala sapwellimomwi pwutaket nan sahpw me komw ketido sang ie?”
Eipraam ahpw sapengki, “Kalekehte ke kadarala nei pwutaken wasao!
KAUN-O, Koht en nanleng, ketikiniesang rehn ei pahpao oh nan sapwen kisehi ko, ketikidohng ie wasaht, oh ketin kahukihla oh inoukihong ie me e pahn ketikihong sahpw wet kadaudokei kan. E pahn ketin kadar sapwellime tohnleng mwohmw pwe ke en kak alehsang wasao en nei pwutako eh pwoud.
A ma serepeino sohte men iang uhk kohdo met, ke pahn saledeksang inou me ke wiahiong ie. Ahpw ke sohte mwahn pahn kapwurehla wasao nei pwutako.”
Laduwo eri kihdi peho nanpwungen dengen Eipraam, eh soumaso, oh wiahda inou me e pahn kapwaiada mehkoaros me e kehkehlingkihong.
Laduwo, me sounkohwahn en Eipraam dipwisou kan, eri ale nein eh soumaso kamel ehk, e ahpw mwesel kohkolahng nan kahnimw wasa me Nahor kin koukousoan ie paliepeng en Mesopodamia.
Ni eh lel wasao, e kommoalehdi kamel ko ni pwarer ehu likin kahnimwo. Eri, wasa soutikpenehr, oh ahnsowo lihen kahnimwo kan kin kodohng idipil.
E ahpw kapakap, patohwan, “Maing KAUN, Koht en ei soumas Eipraam, komw ketin kupwure ie rahnwet oh kapwaiada sapwellimomwi inou ong ei tungoal soumaso.
Iet ngehi me patopato limwahn pwarer wet, wasa me serepein kan en kahnimw wet pahn patohdohng idipil ie.
Eri, serepein pwulopwul men me I pahn ndahng, ‘Menlau kaidi omw sahen pwe I en nimpil mahs.’ Ma e pahn nda, ‘Nna, ale oh nim; oh I pil pahn kanimpile noumw kamel kan,’ iei ih me komw ketin piladahr ong sapwellimomwi ladu Aisek. Ma met pahn pweida, I pahn patohwan esehki me komw ketin kapwaiada sapwellimomwi inou ong ei soumaso.”
Mwohn eh kanekehla eh kapakapo, iet Repeka pa lel wasao, kapaik eh saho. Repeka nein Petuel, a Petuel nein Milka, en Nahor rien Eipraam eh pwoud.
Eri, Repeka serepein meipwon emen, me inenen kaselel. E kohdihla ni pwarero oh idipada nah saho oh pwurodohsang ie.
Laduwo ahpw tangala reh oh ndaiong, “Menlau kihdo mahs nimei kis pihlen sang nan noumw sahen.”
A serepeino ahpw sapeng, nda, “Nna, komw ale, maing.” Ih eri mwadangete kihdihsang pohn pwopwe saho, kanimpilehki laduwo.
Mwurin eh kanimpile laduwo, serepeino ahpw nda, “I pahn pil kanimpile noumw kamel kan, irail koaros lao medla.”
Ih eri mwadangete wudekihdi audepen nah saho nan deupen pihl ko, oh pwuredihla idipil nan pwarero e lao kanimpile kamel ko koaros.
Laduwo ahpw mwasamwasahn, ma Koht ketin kupwurehla eh seiloak de soh.
Ni eh nekier en serepeino eh kanimpile mahn ako, laduwo ahpw ale rihng kesempwal ehu oh kihong ni tumwe, oh luwou kohl riau ong ni peh kan.
E ahpw idek reh, “Nein ihs kowe, ihs omw pahpa? Menlau ndadohng ie mahs. Mie wasa ni imwen omw pahpao me ngehi oh nei mahn akan kak pweidi ie pwohnget?”
Serepeino ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ngehi nein Petuel, nein Nahor oh Milka.”
Reh oh tahpwte reht, kenen mahn akan, oh mie wasa me kumwail kak pweidi ie.”
Ohlo eri kelehpwikihdi oh kaudokiong KAUN-O, ketihtihki,
“Kaping ong KAUN-O, Koht en ei soumas Eipraam, me ketin kapwaiadahr sapwellime inou ong ei soumas. KAUN-O me ketin kahluwaiedohng ni imwen kisehn ei soumaso.”
Serepeino ahpw mwadangalahng ni imwen eh nohno oh padahkihong mehkoaros me wiawiher.
Mie rien Repeka ohl emen me adaneki Lapan, me tenge pwarero wasa me nein Eipraam laduwo mihmi ie.
E kilangada rihngo oh luwou ko ni pehn rie serepeino, oh rongada mehkoaros me ohlo ndaiong serepeino. Ih eri kohla rehn nein Eipraam laduwo, me kesikesihnen limwahn kamel ko nin pwarero.
E ahpw ndahng, “Komw ketido, KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwhwihiukadahr. Dahme komw ketiketki met, ni ei kaunopadahr deumwi ni imweio, oh dewen noumwi mahn akan?”
Ohlo eri pedolong nan ihmwo, a Lapan akeredihsang pohn kamel ko kepwe ko oh kamwenge irail. Mwuhr, e ahpw kihong pihl laduwo oh ienge ko pwe re en widen nehrail ko.
Kisin sak pil kaunopadahr mwohrail; laduwo ahpw ketihtihki, “I sohte pahn tungoal mwohn ei pahn sakarakihda kahrepen ei pwarodo.” Lapan eri nda, “Nna, komw kaselehda.”
Ih eri tapihada koasoi: “Sapwellimen Eipraam ladu ngehi.
KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwih mehlel ei soumaso, oh ketin kapaiahda ni mehkoaros. E ketikihong pelin sihpw ngeder, pelin kuht oh kou, silper, kohl, oh lidu kei, ingahki kamel oh ahs tohtohie.
Sara, en ei soumaso eh pwoud, naitikihada pwutak emen ni eh likeilapalahr. Ei soumaso ketikihongehr eh sohso, mehkoaros me e ahneki.
E kehkehlingkihong ie I en inoukihda oh kapwaiada eh mahsen, ni eh mahsanih, ‘Kaleke ke pilada en nei pwutaket eh pwoud sang nan wehin Kenan.
Ke pahn kohwei rehn ei peneinei, rehn kisehi ko, oh pilasang rehrail en nei pwutaket eh pwoud.’
Ngehi ahpw patohwanohng ei soumaso, ‘A dahme pahn wiawi, ma serepeino sohte men iang patohdo?’
A e sapeng, mahsanih, ‘KAUN-O, me I kin peikiong ahnsou koaros, pahn ketin kadar sapwellime tohnleng pwe en ieiang uhk pwe omw seiloak en kak pweida. Ke pahn ale en nei pwutaket eh pwoud sang rehn ei peneinei, sang rehn en ei pahpao eh peneinei.
Eri, ma ke kapwaiada met, ke pahn saledeksang omw inowo; a ma ke kohla rehn ei peneinei, re ahpw kahng kihwei, ke pahn pil saledeksang omw inowo.’
“Eri, ni ei leledo rahnwet ni pwarero, I wia ei kapakap nin duwe met, ‘Maing KAUN, Koht en ei soumas Eipraam, komw ketin kupwure ei doadoahk.
Iet ngehi me patopato ni pwarer wet. Eri, ni serepein pwulopwul men eh pahn kohieidohng idipil, I pahn peki en kihdo mahs nimei kis pihl sang nan nah saho.
Eri, ma e kihdo oh e pil pahn kanimpile nei kamel akan, iei ih me komw ketin pilada en nein ei soumaso pwutak eh pwoud.’
Eri, mwohn ei kanekehla ei kapakapo, Repeka pa lella kapaik eh saho, e ahpw kohdihla idipil ni pwarero, I ahpw ndahng, ‘Menlau kihdo mahs nimei kis pihlen.’
A e mwadangete kihdi eh saho oh nda, ‘Ale, nim oh I pil pahn kanimpile noumw kamel akan.’ Ngehi eri nimpil oh ih kanimpile kamel ako.
I ahpw idek reh, ‘Nein ihs kowe? Ihs omw pahpa?’ A e sapeng, nda, ‘Nein Petuel ngehi, nein Nahor oh Milka.’ Ngehi eri kihong kisin rihngo ni tumweo oh luwou ko ni peh ko.
Ngehi eri kelehpwikihdi oh kaudokiong KAUN-O. I kapinga KAUN-O, Koht en ei soumas Eipraam, me ketin kahluwaiedohng rehn rien ei soumaso, wasa I diarehr ie en nein ei soumaso pwutak eh pwoud.
Eri, ma komw men kapwaiada omwi pwukoa ong ei soumaso, a komw menlau padahkihdo; ma so, komw pil mahsanihodo, pwe I en koasoanehdi dahme I pahn wia.”
Lapan oh Petuel eri sapeng, “Pwehki irair wet eh sang ni kupwuren KAUN-O, kitail sohte kak wia mehkot pwe kapwaiadahte.
Eri, iet Repeka; komw ale oh ketikihda. En pwoudikihda nein omw soumaso, pwutak, nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin kupwurkiher.”
Ni nein Eipraam laduwo eh rongada arail pasapeng en pekipek wet, e ahpw poaridi lel nanpwel oh kaudokiong KAUN-O.
E ahpw kapwarehda likou, silper, kohl oh dipwisou en kapwat ekei, oh kihong Repeka. E pil kihong ekei dipwisou pweilaud ko rehn rien Repeka ohlo oh eh nohno.
Eri, nein Eipraam laduwo oh ienge ko ahpw mwenge oh nim, oh pweidi wasao. Nimenseng en mandahn rahno, laduwo ahpw ndaiong irail, “Eri, kumwail mweidohng ie pwe I en pwuralahng rehn ei soumaso.”
Lapan oh eh nohno ahpw sapeng, “Serepeinen en mihmihte mahs reht wihk ehu de rahn eisek; mwuhr, e kak kohkohwei.”
A e sapeng ira, nda, “Kumwail dehr kapweiekiehdi, pwe KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwihalahr ei seiloaket. Kumwail mweidohng ie I en pwurala rehn ei soumaso.”
Irail eri sapeng, nda, “Kitail ekerodo serepeinen oh idek reh nsene.”
Irail eri ekerodo Repeka oh idek reh, “Ke men iangada ohl menet kohkohla?” A e sapeng, “Ei, I pahn iangada.”
Eri, irail ahpw mweidala Repeka oh neirail sounpapaho en iangada nein Eipraam laduwo oh ienge ko.
Irail eri kapaiahda Repeka, nda: “Kowe riat serepein, ke en wiahla inen kadaudok ngedehrie! Kadaudokomw kan en kalowehdi kahnimw en ar imwintihti kan!”
Mwuhr, Repeka oh nah pwihnen serepein kan ahpw karadahng pohn kamel ko oh iangada nein Eipraam laduwo, re ahpw mwesel kohkohla.
Aisek ahpw mwemweitlahng nan sapwtehn en “Pwarer en me Ieiaso Me ketin Mamahsanih Ie”; e ahpw kin koukousoan palieir en Kenan.
Soutik ehu, e ahpw wie mwemweitseli nan mohs akan, e ahpw kilangada kamel kei me kohkohdo.
Ni Repeka eh kilangada Aisek, e ahpw keredihsang pohn dakepeo,
oh idek rehn nein Eipraam laduwo, “Ihs ohl meno me kohkodohng kitail nan mohso?” Laduwo ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ih ei soumaso mwo.” Repeka eri alehte eh koaduhpwel, koaduhpwalkihdi meseo.
Laduwo eri ndaiong Aisek mehkoaros me e wiadahr.
Mwuhr, Aisek ahpw kahrehlong Repeka nan impwal en eh nohno, Sara, oh serepeino ahpw wiahla eh pwoud. Aisek poakepoakehla mehlel Repeka, iei me e sohla kin nsensuwedki mehlahn eh nohno.
Eipraam pil pwoudikihda emen lih torohr, me adaneki Ketura.
E ahpw naitikihong Simran, Soksan, Medan, Midian, Ispak, oh Sua.
Soksan me semen Sipa oh Dedan, oh kadaudok en Dedan iei mehn Ahsur, mehn Letus oh mehn Leum.
Nein Midian pwutak iei Epa, Eper, Anok, Apida, oh Eldaa. Irail pwukat koaros iei kadaudok en Ketura.
Eipraam kihong Aisek mehkoaros me e ahneki;
ahpw nindokon eh momourte, e kihong kisakis kei ong nah pwutak me eh pwoud teiko wiahiong. E ahpw kadaralahng seri pwukat palimese dohlasang nah pwutak Aisek.
Eipraam eri sipalla ni eh sounpar 175.
<range>
Nah pwutak Aisek oh Ismael nekidedi kahlepe nan poaren paip Makpela, nan sahpw palimesehn Mamre me kisehn sapwen Epron nein Sohar mehn Id.
Ih sahpwet me Eipraam pwainsang mehn Id ko; Eipraam oh eh pwoud ira koaros seridi wasao.
Mwurin sipallahn Eipraam, Koht ketin kupwuramwahwihala nah pwutak Aisek, me kin kousoan limwahn “Pwarer en me Ieiaso Me ketin Mahmahsanih Ie.”
Ismael, me Akar, lidu en Sara mehn Isipo, wiahiong Eipraam,
naineki pwutak pwukat, nin duwen irekidien ar ipwidi: Nepaiod, Kedar, Adpeel, Mipsam,
Misma, Duma, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Setur, Napis, oh Kedema.
Irail wia pahpa kahlap en kadaudok eisek riauo, oh mwararail kan ahpw kohieng pohn arail kousapw oh wasahn kousoan kan.
Ismael sounpar 137 ni eh sipalla.
Kadaudok en Ismael kan kousoanla nan sahpw me mi nanpwungen Apila oh Sur, ni palimesehn Isip nan ahl me tang kolahng Asiria. Re kin kousoan dohsang kadaudok teikan en Eipraam.
Iet duwen poadopoad en Aisek, nein Eipraam.
Aisek sounpar 40 ahnsou me e pwoudikihda Repeka, nein Petuel (mehn Aram oh Mesopodamia) oh rien Lapan serepein.
Pwehki Repeka eh sohte neitik, Aisek ahpw kapakapohng KAUN-O. KAUN-O ahpw kupwurehla eh pekipek, Repeka eri liseianda.
Ni kisin mpwero ara pisipisikenpene nan kapehde, Repeka ahpw nda, “Dahme soahng wet kak wiawihkihong ie?” Ih eri patohwan peki rehn KAUN-O en ketin kamarainih.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong, “Tohn wehi riau me mihmi nan kapehdomw. Ke pahn naitikihada tohn wehi riau me pahn uhpene nanpwungara. Ehu pahn kehlail sang ehu; oh me laudo pahn liduwih me tikitiko.”
Eri, ni eh lelehr ahnsoun eh neitik, Repeka ahpw naitikihada mpwer ehu.
Kisin pwutako me ipwidi mahso me poh weitahta, kili me wunaun; iei me irail kihongki ede Esau.
Ni rieo eh pil ipwidi, e kolokol teng keimwin nehn Esauo; iei me irail kihongki ede Seikop. Seri ko ipwidi ni ahnsou me Aisek sounpar 60.
Eri, ni pwutak ko ara keirda, Esau wiahla soupal en kesik mahn emen, me kin perenki mihmihseli nansapw; a Seikop pwutak nennen emen me kin mihmihte ni imwe.
Aisek ahpw kesempwalkihla Esau pwehki eh kin perenki sakan mahn me Esau kin kasikihdi; a Repeka kin mwohneki Seikop.
Rahn ehu nindokon Seikop eh inihnim kene kisin sali, Esau ahpw pwurodo sang kesik nansapw, inenen men mwengehda.
E ahpw ndahng Seikop, “I inenen duhpeklahr, kihdo mahs kenei kis konomw sali weitahtahn.” (Ihme e adanekihki Edom.)
Seikop ahpw sapeng, nda, “I pahn kihwei, ma ke pahn kihong ie omw pwungen sohso.”
Esau ahpw sapeng, ketihtihki, “I nektehn mehla, dah katepehiong ie ei sohso?”
Seikop eri sapeng, nda, “Nna, kahukihla mahs me ke pahn kihdo omw sohso.” Esau eri kahula oh inoukihong Seikop pwungen eh sohso.
Seikop eri kihong kene pilawa oh selie nan dahl ehu. E ahpw tungoalehla oh kohkohla. Ih duwen Esau eh sohte mwahn kesempwalki pwungen eh sohso.
Lehk lapalap ehu ahpw pweida nan sahpwo me tohrohrasang me wiawi ni mwehin Eipraam. Aisek eri kohla rehn Apimelek, nanmwarkien mehn Pilisdia kan, nan Kerar.
KAUN-O ketin pwarohngehr Aisek oh mahsanihongehr, “Ke dehr kohdihla Isip, ahpw mihmihte nan sahpwet, wasa me I ndaiong uhk ke en mihmi ie.
Mihmihte nan sahpwet, I ahpw pahn ieiang uhk oh kupwuramwahwihiuk, pwe I pahn kihong uhk oh kadaudokomw kan sahpw pwukat koaros, pwe I en kapwaiada inou me I wiahiong semomwo, Eipraam.
I pahn katohtowehla kadaudokomw kan duwehte usu en pahnlahng kan, oh kihong irail sahpw pwukat koaros. Wehi koaros pahn peki I en kapaiairailda duwehte ei kapaiadahr kadaudokomw kan.
I pahn kapaiaiukada, pwehki Eipraam e peikiong ie oh kapwaiada ei kosonned kan oh ei koasoandi koaros.”
Aisek eri kousoanla nan Kerar.
Ni ohl akan en wasao ar kin idek ihs Repeka, e kin ndahng irail me rie. E perki ndaiong irail me eh pwoud Repeka, pwe ohl en wasao de kemehla pwe re en kihsang Repeka, pwe liho me inenen kaselel.
Ni Aisek eh wereilahr wasao, Apimelek, nanmwarkien Pilisdia, ahpw mahsenieisang nan wenihmwtok ehu oh mahsanihada Aisek oh Repeka ara wiewia nsenen pwopwoud.
E ahpw malipehdo Aisek oh mahsanihong, “Uhdahn omw pwoud lih menen, a dahme ke ndahki me riomw?” Aisek ahpw sapengki, “I perki pwe aramas akan de kemehkiniehla ma I pahn nda me ei pwoud.”
Apimelek ahpw mahsanih, “Dahme ke wiahkihong kiht soangen piht wet? Emen ohl pwukat kakete engda rehn omw pwouden oh kowe me pahn pwukoahkihdi sapwung wet.”
Apimelek ahpw mahsanihong aramas koaros koasoandi wet, “Mehmen me pahn kedirapwa ohl menet de eh pwoud pahn kamakamala.”
Aisek eri padokedi wahntuhke nan sahpwo, e ahpw dolung pak epwiki tohtohsang me e padokedi, pwe KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwih.
Rahn koaros e ahpw kin kekeirda nan eh paiamwahu, e lao wiahla ohl kepwehpwe men.
E naineki kiden sihpw oh kou, oh tohndoadoahk ngeder, kahrehda mehn Pilisdia kan kin peiriniong.
Mehn Pilisdia kan eri audekihla pwehl pwarer en pihl koaros me nein eh pahpao, Eipraam, tohndoadoahk kan weiradahr mahs.
Apimelek ahpw mahsanihong Aisek, “Eri kohkohweisang nan wehiet, pwe ke inenen kehlailsangkihtehr.”
Aisek eri mwesel kohkohla oh kauwada imwe impwal kan nan Wahun Kerar, wasa me e kousoanla ie ahnsou kis.
Aisek ahpw pwurehng weirada pwarer me weiweidahr nan mwehin Eipraam, me mehn Pilisdia ko audekilahr pwehl. E ahpw kihong eden pwarer ko soangen ahd kante me eh pahpao kihong eden pwarer ko mahsie.
Nein Aisek tohndoadoahk ko weirada pwarer ehu nan wahuo oh diarada pihl me pwepwengkida sang loale.
Silepen sihpw kei en Kerar ahpw akamaiong nein Aisek silepen sihpw ko, ketihtihki, “Aht pwarer men.” Ih me Aisek kadanekihki pwarero “Akamai.”
Re pil weirada ehu pwarer, re ahpw pil akamaikihda; e ahpw kadanekihla pwarero “Pelian.”
E ahpw mwekidsang wasao oh pil weirada ehu pwarer. Eri pwarer wet sohte akamaipe wiawi, e ahpw kadanekihla “Saledek.” Aisek ahpw mahsanih, “KAUN-O ketikihongkitailehr saledek pwe kitail en kousoan nan sahpwet, eri kitail pahn paiamwahula wasaht.”
Aisek ahpw mweselsang wasao oh kohdahla Peersepa.
Nipwongohte KAUN-O ketin pwarohng oh mahsanihong, “Ngehi me Koht en semomw Eipraam. Ke dehr masak mehkot; I kin ieiang uhk. I pahn kapaiaiukada oh kangederehla kadaudokomw kan pwehki ei inou ong ei ladu Eipraam.”
Aisek eri kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao oh kaudokiong KAUN-O. Mwurin eh kauwada imwe impwal kan wasao, nah tohndoadoahk kan ahpw weirada pwarer ehu wasao.
Apimelek ketido sang Kerar, iangahki sapwellime sounkaweid Ahusad oh Pikol, kaunen sounpeio, pwe re en tuhwong Aisek.
Aisek eri idek rehrail, “Dahme kumwail ketikihdo rehi met, nan amwail sohte kupwurkin ie oh kausiesang nan sapwellimamwail wehi?”
A re sapeng, “Met se eseier me KAUN-O kin ketin ieiang komwi, iei me se koasoanehdi pwe kitail en wiahda inou nanpwungatail. Se men komwi en inoukihda
me komwi sohte pahn wiahiong kiht mehkot suwed, duwehte at sohte wiahiong komwi mehkot suwed. Se kadek ong komwi oh mweidohng komwi en mweselsang reht ni popohl. Eri e uhdahn sansal me KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwihkomwier.”
Aisek eri kamadipweirailda, irail eri konot oh sakau.
Nimensehngie en mandahn rahno, re ahpw wiahda ar inou oh kahula. Aisek eri kamwurirailla, re ahpw ketiketla ni popohl.
Ni rahnohte nein Aisek tohndoadoahngko ahpw pwarodo oh kairehki duwen pwarer me re weiradahr. Re ndahng, “Se diaradahr pihl.”
Ih eri kihong eden pwarero “Inou.” Ih me kahnimw en wasao adanekihki Peersepa.
Ni Esau eh sounpar 40, e pwoudikihda serepein en Id riemen; Sudid, nein Peeri, oh Pasemad, nein Elon.
Serepein pwukat koaros kahrehiong en Aisek oh Repeka ara nsensuwed mehlel.
Eri, ni Aisek eh ohl laudlahr oh maskunlahr, e ahpw ekerodo nah pwutak laudo, Esau, oh ndaiong, “Samwa!” Esau ahpw sapeng, “Maing.”
Aisek ahpw ndahng, “Kilang, pwe I ohl laudlahr oh nektehn mehla.
Ale noumw kesik ketieu oh kanenge kan, ke ahpw kohwei nansapw oh kasikiodo kenei emen mahnen.
Ke ahpw umwunda duwen me I kin ioukio, oh wahdo rehi, pwe I en tungoale, I ahpw pahn kapaiaiukada mwohn ei pahn mehla.”
Repeka ahpw wie rongorong Aisek ni eh ndindaiong Esau mepwukat. Eri, ni Esau eh mwesel kolahng kesik,
Repeka ahpw ndaiong Seikop, “I rong omw pahpao eh ndahng Esau,
‘Wahdo mahs kenei emen mahnen, umwunda, pwe I en tungoale oh kapaiaiukada mwohn silangin KAUN-O mwohn ei pahn mehla.’
Eri, samwa, kapwaiada me I pahn ndaiong uhk.
Kohwei rehn pelin kuhto, pilada riakis kuht mworourou en oh wahdo rehi, pwe I en umwunda nin duwen omw pahpao eh kin iouki.
Ke ahpw pahn walahng pwe en sakan, pwe en kapaiaiukada mwohn eh pahn mehla.”
Seikop ahpw ndahng eh nohno, “A ia duwen, pwe ke ese me riei Esau me kil wunaun, a ngehi I me kil medendel.
Ma ei pahpao pahn sair ie, e pahn esehda me I pitipitih; e ahpw pahn keriaiehla oh sohte kapaiaiehda.”
Eh nohno ahpw sapeng, nda, “Keriapomw koaros en kohdi pohi, samwa. Kapwaiadahte me I ndaweiet, kohwei wahdo kuht ko.”
Seikop eri kohla, pilada kuht ko, oh wahdo rehn eh nohno. Liho ahpw kaunopada nin duwen me Aisek kin inangih sakan.
Repeka eri ale en Esau eh likou kaselel ko, me e kin nekinekid nan imweo, oh kalikawihkihda Seikop.
E ahpw kidimkipene pehn Seikop oh tepinwere kilin kuht ko,
oh kihong kisin sak iou oh pilawa me e umwunda.
Seikop eri wa kohla rehn eh pahpao oh ndahng, “Ipa.” A e sapeng, “Ihs kowe?”
Seikop ahpw sapengki, “Ngehi Esau, noumwi pwutak mesenih. I wiahda mehkoaros duwen omwi mahsanihong ie. Pwourda oh sakan kisin uduk me I wadohng komwi pwe komwi en kapaiaiehda.”
Aisek eri sapeng, “Ke meid mwadang en diarada kisin uduk pwukan, samwa!” A e sapeng, nda, “KAUN-O, omwi Koht, me ketin sewese ie pwe I en mwadang diarada.”
Aisek eri ndalahng Seikop, “Keido mahs pwe I en sair uhk, mehlel me kowe Esau?”
Seikop eri keilahng mpen eh pahpao. Eh pahpao eri sair oh mahsanih, “Ngilomwen ngilen Seikop, a pehmw kan pehn Esau.”
E sohte lemeleme me Seikop mwo, pwehki peh kan eh wunaun duwehte pehn Esau. Ih eri pahn kapaiahda Seikop,
e ahpw pil pwurehng idek, “Mehlel me kowe Esau?” A Seikop sapeng, “Ei, maing,”
Aisek eri ndalahng, “Nna, kihdo mahs delen uduken, pwe I en tungoale; I ahpw pahn kapaiaiukada.” Seikop eri kailahng dahlo, e ahpw pil kihong wain pwe en nim.
Eri, E pahpao ahpw ndahng, “Keido metik ie, samwa.”
Seikop eri keila oh metik eh pahpao. Eri, ni Aisek eh nedada pwohn eh likou ko, e ahpw kapaiahda oh nda, “Pwohtik pwohmwahu en nei pwutaket rasehng pwohtik pwohmwahu en sahpw ehu me KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwiher.
Koht en ketikihong uhk pwoaiken lahng oh kangederehla audepen sapwomw kan; en ketikihong uhk rahk en pilawa oh wain.
Wehi kan en uhpahiong uhk, oh aramas akan en poaridi mwohmw. Ke en kaunda omw peneinei kan, oh kadaudok en omw nohno kan en poaridi mwohmw. Irail kan me pahn keriaiukala, re en riahla, oh irail kan me pahn kapaiaiukada, re en paiamwahula.”
Aisek eri kairalahte kapaiamwahu wet, Seikop ahpw mwesel kohkohla. Mwurihte, rie Esau pa pwersang.
E pil wa kodohng eh pahpao kisin uduk me e umwundahr, oh ndahng, “Ipa, pwourda oh sakan, oh kapaiaiehda.”
Aisek ahpw idek reh, “Ihs kowe?” A Esau sapeng, “Noumwi pwutak mesenih, Esau.”
Aisek ahpw tapihada rerrer oh idek, “A pwe ihs me apwtehn kemehla mahn emen oh wadohng ie I en tungoale mwohn omw pwarodo? I tungoalehr oh kapaiadahr; oh e pahn pai kohkohlahte.”
Esau lao rong mepwukat, e ahpw weriwer oh nsensuwedla mehlel, e ahpw ndaiong eh pahpao, “Ipa, menlau pil kapaiaiehda.”
Aisek ahpw sapeng, nda, “Riomwo kohdo oh pitihiehdi; e kihsangehr kapaipomw.”
Esau eri nda, “Ih keriapak en eh pitihiehdi met. E konehng mehlel edeo, Seikop. E kihsangieier pwungen ei sohso, a met e pil kihsangehr kapaipei. Ia duwe, sohte kapaiamwahu ehu komw nekinekidohng ie?”
Aisek ahpw sapeng, “I koasoanehdi en kaunuhkada, oh kilelehiong kiseh kan koaros re en kin liduwih. I kihong rahk en pilawa oh wain. Eri, met solahr me I kak wiahiong uhk, samwa.”
Esau usehlahte eh pekipek ngidingid rehn eh pahpao, ndinda, “Ipa, ia duwe, kapaiamwahuteieu me mi rehmw? Menlau pil kapaiaiehda.” Ih eri sengiseng.
Aisek eri ndahng, “Sohte kapaien sampah ong kowe, sohte pahn pwoaiken nanleng ong sapwomw kan.
Ke pahn momourki noumw kedlahs, oh uhpahiong riomwo. Ahpw soh, ni omw pahn pelian, ke pahn pitsang omw uhpahiong.”
Esau eri kailongkihla mehlel Seikop, pwehki kapaiamwahu me eh pahpa wiahiong. E ahpw mengimengloalki, “Ahnsoun mwahieiki mehlahn ei pahpao kerendohr. Eri, mwurin ahnsowo, I ahpw pahn kemehla Seikop.”
Ahpw ni Repeka eh rongada duwen lamalam en Esau, ih eri ekerodo Seikop oh ndahng, “Kilang, riomw Esau lemeleme en dupukohng uhk oh kemeiukala.
Eri, samwa, kapwaiada me I pahn ndawei. Onopada pwe ke en tangala rehn riei Lapan nan Aran.
Mihmi mahs reh ekis ahnsou, nsensuwed en riomwo lao meleileidi,
oh e lao manokehla me ke wiahiong. Mwuhr, I ahpw pahn kadarala emen pwe en kapwureiukodo. Dahme nei pwutak riemenet pahn pwupwukihsang ie rahnteieu?”
Repeka ahpw ndahng Aisek, “I inenen tihwokilahr en Esau eh pwoud kan, lihen liki kan. Ma Seikop pahn pwoudikihda emen soangen lih pwukat, me pwilidak en Id, eri a, ihte me mwahu, I en mehla.”
Aisek eri ekerodo Seikop oh rahnmwahwih, e ahpw kehkehlingkihong nda, “Ke dehpa pwoudikihda emen lihen Kenan.
Onopada pwe ke en kohwei Mesopodamia, ni imwen Petuel, semen omw nohno. Ke ahpw pwoudikihda emen lihen wasao, emen nein Lapan, rien omw nohno, nah serepein ko.
Koht, Wasa Lapalap, en ketin kupwuramwahwihiuk oh ketikihong uhk noumw seri tohto, pwe ke en wiahla semen wehi tohto!
En pil ketin kupwuramwahwihiuk oh kadaudokomw kan duwehte eh ketin kupwuramwahwih Eipraam, pwe kumwail en sapwenikihla sahpw wet me ke keikeiruier loale, oh me Koht ketikihong Eipraam.”
Aisek eri kadarala Seikop Mesopodamia, rehn Lapan, nein Petuel mehn Aram. Lapan, iei rien Repeka me naineki Seikop oh Esau.
Esau ahpw esehda me Aisek kapaiadahr Seikop oh kadaralahngehr Mesopodamia, pwe en ale eh pwoud emen lihen wasao. E pil esehda me ni Aisek eh kapaiahda Seikop, e kehkehlingkihong en dehr pwoudikihda emen lihen Kenan.
E pil diarada me Seikop peikiong eh pahpa oh nohno oh samwalahr Mesopodamia.
Eri, ni Esau eh esedahr me eh pahpa Aisek sohte pwungki lihen Kenan men en pwoudiki nah pwutako,
e ahpw kohla rehn Ismael, nein Eipraam, oh pekehikihda emen lih tohrohr, ede Maalad, me tiksang Nepaiod.
Seikop eri mweselsang Peersepa oh seiloaklahng Aran.
E ahpw lellahng wasa kis me e pweidi ie, pwehki wasa pwongihdi. Ih eri ale takai ehu wasao pwe en ulung oh meirla.
E ahpw ouramanda dene e kilangada kehndake ieu me uhdahsang sampah oh leldahla nanleng; a tohnleng en Koht kei kin doudou kohda oh kin doudou kohdi powe.
A dene KAUN-O ketiket limwah, e ahpw mahsanihong, “Ngehi me KAUN-O, Koht en Eipraam oh Aisek. I pahn kihong uhk oh kadaudokomw kan sahpw wet me ke pweidi ieht.
Kadaudokomw kan pahn ngeder, rasehng pwelpar en sampah; re pahn kaparaparala nan sahpw koaros nin sampah. Eri, wehi kan koaros nin sampah pahn men I en kapaiairailda nin duwen ei kapaiadahr kowe oh kadaudokomw kan.
Tamataman me I pahn ieiang uhk oh sinsileiuk wasa koaros me ke pahn kohla ie, oh I pahn kapwuredohng uhk nan sahpw wet. I sohte pahn keseiukala I lao kapwaiada mehkoaros me I inoukihong uhk.”
Seikop ahpw pirida, oh nda, “Mehlel me KAUN-O ketiket wasa kiset, I ahpw sohte ese.”
E ahpw lemmwida oh nda, “Meid kelemw wasa kiset! Mehlel me tehnpas en Kohto met, oh wenihmwen lahng.”
Seikop ahpw pwourda nin sorahnie. E ahpw ale takai me e ulungo oh kauwada pwe en wia mehn kataman ehu. Ih eri kieldiong powe leh pwe en kasarawihong Koht.
E ahpw kihong eden wasao Pedel. (Mahsie kahnimw en wasao adaneki Lus.)
Seikop ahpw pil wiahiong KAUN-O inou ehu, patohwanohng, “Maing, ma komw pahn ketin ieiang ie oh sewese ie ni ei seiloak wet, oh ketikihdo ei tungoal mehn ketihnain oh likou,
oh ma I pahn paiamwahu pwuralahng ni imwen semeio; eri, komwi, maing, me pahn wiahla ei Koht.
Takai wet me I kauwadahr pwe en wia mehn kataman ehu, pahn wiahla tehnpasomwi, oh I pahn kin meirongkihong komwi eisek kis ehun mehkoaros me komw pahn kin ketikihong ie.”
Seikop eri usehla eh seiloaklahng sapwen mehn palimese.
Ni eh kohkohla nanialo e ahpw kilangada pwarer ehu nan mohs ehu, oh pelin sihpw siluh me mihmi limwah. Pwe pelin sihpw ko kin nimpilsang ni pwarer wet, oh lapalahn takai ehu kin pwaindi pwarero.
Ni pelin sihpw ko koaros ar kin pokonpene wasao, silepe kan kin katapwurehsang takaio pohn pwarero, oh kin kanimpile sihpw kan. Eri mwuhr, re kin kapwurehiong powe.
Seikop eri idek rehrail, “Riei ko, mehnia kei kumwail?” Irail ahpw sapeng, “Kiht mehn Aran.”
A e idek, “Kumwail ese Lapan nein Nahor?” A irail sapeng, “Ei, se ese.”
A e pil pwurehng idek, “E me kehlail, de soh?” Re ahpw sapengki, “Ei, e me kehlail; oh iet Resel nah serepein me kahkahre kohdo nah pelin sihpw.”
Seikop eri nda, “Pwehki wasa eh sousouwasete oh eh saikinte ahnsoun kapokonepene sihpw kan nan kehl, dahme kumwail so kanimpileirail oh kapwureiraillahng nan mohs pwe re en mwengemwenge mahs?”
Irail eri sapeng, nda, “Se sohte kak wia men; pelin sihpw koaros lao pokonpene, se ahpw pahn katapwurehsang takaien pohn pwareren oh kanimpile sihpw akan.”
Nindokon Seikop eh lokolokaiaiong irail, Resel pa lel wasao, kahre nein eh pahpao pelin sihpw; pwe ih me kin apwahpwalih irail.
Ahnsou me Seikop kilangada Resel, nein Lapan rien eh nohno, ni eh kahkahre sihpw ko, e kohla ni pwarero oh katapwurehsang takaio powe, e ahpw kanimpile nein Lapan nah sihpw ko.
Ih eri metik Resel oh sengisengki eh peren.
E ahpw ndaiong, “Ngehi nein Repeka, oh kisehn omw papaho.” Resel eri tangala ndahng eh pahpao.
Lapan rongadahte duwen Seikop, nein rie serepein Repeka, e mwadangalahte kasamwo, pwoalehdi oh metik; e ahpw kahrehdo ni imweo. Seikop eri koasoiaiong Lapan mehkoaros me wiawiher.
Lapan ahpw ndaiong, “Ei, mehlelete, pwe kowe kisehn udukei oh kisehn ntai.” Seikop eri mihmihki reh sounpwong ehu.
Lapan eri ndahng Seikop, “Mehnda ma kita peneinei ehu, a e sohte konehng ke en doadoahkohng ie ni sohte pweipwei. Ia uwen pweipwei me ke anahne?”
Mie nein Lapan nah serepein riemen: me laudo ede Lia, a me tikitiko Resel.
Ahpw Lia me ekis kersuwed, a Resel me inenen masamwahu oh paliwaramwahu.
Seikop mwahuki mehlel Resel, iei me e ndakihong Lapan, “I pahn doadoahkohng komwi erein sounpar isuh pwe I en pwoudiki Resel.”
A Lapan sapeng, ndaiong, “Ei, I mwahuki kihong uhk sang emen tohrohr. Eri, ke pahn mihmihte rehi.”
Seikop eri doadoahngki erein sounpar isuh pwehki Resel, a sounpar isuho likamwete rahnte depe pwehki eh nohn poakepoake Resel.
Seikop eri ndaiong Lapan, “Eri, komw mweidohngiehla Resel pwe I en pwoudikihda, pwe ahnsou leledohr.”
Lapan eri wiahda kamadipw en kapwopwoud ehu oh lukehiong aramas koaros en wasao.
A nipwongo, e kawaila Lia wiliandi Resel rehn Seikop; Seikop eri wiahda reh nsenen pwopwoud.
(Lapan ahpw kihong Lia emen nah serepein lidu ko, ede Silpa, pwe en papah.)
Eri, nimensengo Seikop ahpw diarada me Lia me e wiahda reh nsenen pwopwoud. Ih eri ndahng Lapan, “Dahme ke wiahkihong ie met? I doadoahkohng komwi pwe I en ale Resel. Dahme komw pitihkiniehdi?”
Lapan ahpw sapeng, nda, “Iet duwen tiahk en sahpwet, se sohte kin kapwopwoudihala nait serepein tikitik kan mwohn me laud kan.
Awih lao wihk ehu dou pohn kasarawihpen kapwopwoud wet, I ahpw pahn kihong uhk Resel, ma ke pahn doadoahkohng ie pil erein sounpar isuh.”
Seikop eri pwungkihda, oh mwurin wihk ehu, Lapan ahpw kihong Resel pwe en pwoudikihda.
(Lapan ahpw kihong Resel emen nah serepein lidu ko, ede Pila, pwe en kin papah.)
Seikop eri pil wiahda nsenen pwopwoud rehn Resel oh e poakepoake laudsang e poakepoake Lia. Ih eri doadoahkohng Lapan pil erein sounpar isuh.
KAUN-O lao ketin mwahngihada me Seikop sohte nohn poakepoake Lia, e ahpw ketin kupwurehla pwe en neitik; a Resel sohte neitik.
Lia eri liseianda oh naitikihada pwutak emen. Ih eri patohwan, “KAUN-O ketin kupwurehla ei apwal oh met ei pwoudo pahn poakepoakeiehla.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Reupen.
E pil pwurehng liseianda oh naitikihada pil emen pwutak. Ih eri patohwan, “KAUN-O pil ketikihong ie pwutak menet, pwehki eh karongehda duwen Seikop eh sohte nohn poakepoake ie.” Ih eri kihong ede Simion.
E ahpw pil pwurehng liseianda oh naitikihada pil emen kisin pwutak. Ih eri patohwan, “Eri, met ei pwoudo pahn patehng ie oh poakohng ie, pwehki ei naitikiadahr pwutak silimen.” Ih eri kihong ede Lipai.
E ahpw pil pwurehng liseianda oh naitikihada pil emen pwutak. Ih eri patohwan, “Met, I pahn kapinga KAUN-O.” Ih eri kihong ede Suda. Eri mwuri, e ahpw sohla neitik.
Eri, ni Resel eh eseier me e sohte neitik, e ahpw peiriniongada rieo Lia oh ndaiong Seikop, “Menlau wiahiong ie nei seri, ma soh, I pahn mehla.”
Seikop eri lingeringerda pahn Resel oh ndaiong, “Dah, ngehi me Koht? Pwe ih me ketin kupwurehda ke en wia lih depwen.”
A Resel ahpw sapeng, nda, “Iet ei lidu, Pila. Ale oh pekehikihda, pwe en liseianda oh wiahiong ie nei seri. Eri, ih duwen ei pahn kak naineki seri sang rehn ei liduwet.”
Ih eri kihong Seikop eh lidu Pila pwe en pekehikihda; Seikop eri wiahda rehn Pila nsenen pwopwoud.
Pila eri liseianda oh naitikihada kisin pwutak kis.
Resel eri nda, “Koht ketin kasalehiongieier ei pwuhng. E ketin karonge ei pekipek oh ketikihong ie nei seri.” Ih eri kihong ede Dan.
Eri, en Resel eh lidu ahpw pil pwurehng liseianda oh naitikiadahng Seikop nah pwutak keriemen.
Resel ahpw nda, “I uhwong oh pelianda riei serepein, oh kalowehdi.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Napdali.
Ni Lia eh eseier me e solahr neitik, e kihong Seikop eh lidu Silpa pwe en pekehikihda.
Silpa eri naitikihong Seikop pwutak emen.
Lia eri nda, “I paiamwahulahr.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Kad.
En Lia eh liduwo ahpw pil naitikihong Seikop nah pwutak keriemen.
Lia eri nda, “Meid pai ngehi, pwe lih akan pahn kapaia ie.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Aser.
Eri, ni ahnsoun dolung wahn pilawa, Reupen ahpw kohla nansapw oh diarada soangen kisin tuhke me adaneki mandreik. Ih eri wadohng eh nohno Lia. Resel eri peki rehn Lia, nda, “Menlau kihdo ekis kisin mandreik sang rehn noumw serien.”
Lia ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ke sohte itarki omw adihasang ie ei pwoudo, ke ahpw pil men song en kihsang en nei seriet eh mandreik kan?” Resel ahpw ndalahng, “Ma ke pahn kihdo en noumw serien eh mandreik kan, ke pahn wendi rehn Seikop pwonget.”
Eri, ni Seikop eh pwurodo sang nansapw nin soutiko, Lia ahpw kohieila oh kasamwo, oh ndahng, “Ke pahn wendi rehi pwonget, pwe I pwainkidahr en nei seriet eh mandreik ko.” Eri, Seikop ahpw wiahda reh pwongo nsenen pwopwoud.
Koht eri ketin karonge en Lia eh kapakap, ih eri liseianda oh naitikiadahng Seikop kelimmen en nah pwutak.
Lia eri nda, “Koht ketin katingihkin ie ei kihong ei pwoud ei liduwo.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Isakar.
Lia ahpw pil pwurehng liseianda oh naitikiadahng Seikop kewenemen en nah pwutak.
Ih eri nda, “Koht ketikihong ie kisakis mwahu ieu. Eri met, ei pwoudo pahn perenki mihmi rehi, pwehki ei kihong nah pwutak wenemen.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Sepulon.
Mwuhr, e ahpw naitikihada serepein men, me e kihong ede Daina.
Koht pil ketin kupwukupwurehte Resel, pwe e ketin karonge eh pekipek oh kupwurehiong en kak neitik.
Resel ahpw liseianda oh naitikihada pwutak emen. Ih eri nda, “Koht ketikihsang ie kanamenekpen ei depwen.
En pil ketikihong ie pil emen pwutaken.” Ih eri kihong eden pwutako Sosep.
Mwurin Sosep eh ipwidi, Seikop ndahng lapan, “Menlau mweidohng ie I en kohkolahng nan sapweio.
Kihdo ei pwoud kan oh nei seri kan me I papahkinuhkehr, pwe I en kohkohla. Ke ese mehlel duwen sawas me I wiahionguhkehr.”
Lapan eri sapengki, “I pahn koasoia met: I eseier sang nan ei kosetipw me Koht ketin kupwuramwahwihieier pwehki kowe.
Ke en kilelehdi dahme ei pweipwand ong uhk, I ahpw pahn pwainohng uhk.”
Seikop ahpw sapeng, “Ke ese duwen doadoahk me I wiahiong uhk oh duwen epwel mwahu me I wiahiong noumw mahn akan;
mwohn ei pwarodo met re me malaulau, a met re tohtolahr mehlel, pwehki KAUN-O eh ketin kupwuramwahwihiuk sang ni ei pwarodo. Eri met e lelehr ei ahnsoun doadoahk ong ei peneinei.”
Lapan eri idek reh, “A dahme I pahn katingihkin uhk?” Seikop ahpw sapeng nda, “Ke sohte pahn kihong ie mehkot, ahpw I pahn usehlahte apwahpwalih noumw mahn akan ma ke pahn mweidohng ie met:
I en dawih noumw mahn akan koaros rahnwet oh katohrehsang sihpw poh toantoal koaros iangahki kuht mwangerenger koaros. Ihte soangen mahn pwukat me ke pahn pwainkin ie.
Sang met kohla, ni omw pahn kin dawih nei mahn akan; kuht men me sohte mwangerenger de sihpw men me sohte poh toantoal, ke pahn ese me I pirapahda.”
Lapan eri nda, “Me pwung duwen me ke ndahn.”
A rahnohte Lapan ahpw katohrehsang kuht wol alahl de mwangerenger ko oh kuht lih mwangerenger oh alahl koaros me mie mwei pwetepwet rehrail; oh sihpw toantoal koaros. E ahpw kihong rehn nah pwutak ko pwe re en apwahpwalih.
E ahpw wahda nah pelinmeno oh kohkohla sang Seikop oh dohlahsang erein rahn siluh. Seikop ahpw apwahpwalih luhwen pelinmeno.
Seikop ahpw pelehdi lepin rahntuhke mour kei sang ni soangen tuhke kei, e ahpw tehrasang apali kilin tuhke ko pwe en kak mwomwen ahl pwetepwet.
E ahpw kauwada lepin tuhke ko wasahn nimpil en mahn ako. E kauwada lepin tuhke pwukat wasao mwohn pelinmeno, pwe mahn ako en kin kowerek ni ahnsou me re pahn kin kolahng nimpil.
Eri, ni mahn ako ar kin kowerek limwahn lepin tuhke ko, re kin liseianda oh naitikihada kisin kuht alahl oh mwangerenger.
A Seikop katohrehsang sihpw ko rehn kuht ko, e ahpw koasoanediong irail re en mihte mwohn nein Lapan sihpw me alahl oh poh toantoal ko. Ih eri pein apwalihada nah pelinmeno oh e sohte kin kapatahiong nein Lapan ko.
Ni ahnsou me mahn me sohte soumwahu ko kin kowerek, Seikop kin kauwada lepin rahn tuhke ko ni wasahn nimpilo, mwohn mesen mahn ako, pwe re en kin kowerek limwahn lepin tuhke ko.
Ahpw e sohte kin kihdi lepin tuhke ko mwohn mahn me soumwahu ko. Lapan eri kin inenehdi mahn soumwahu ko, a me kehlail ko Seikop.
Ih duwen Seikop eh kepwehpwehla oh nainekihla pelinmen tohto, iangahki lidu, kamel oh ahs tohto.
Seikop esehda me nein Lapan pwutak ko koasoakoasoia dene, “Seikop kihsangehr mehkoaros me e ahneki sang rehn atail pahpao, oh e kepwehpwehkihla en atail pahpao dipwisou kan.”
Seikop pil tehkada me mwomwen Lapan ong ih solahr duwehte mahs.
KAUN-O eri ketin mahsanihong Seikop, “Pwurala nan sapwen omw pahpa kahlap ako, wasa ke ipwidi ieo, pwe I pahn ieiang uhk.”
Seikop eri ileklahng Resel oh Lia ira en pwarodo nansapw wasa e kin apwahpwalih ie nah pelin sihpw.
E ahpw ndaiong ira, “I tehkadahr me mwomwen amwa pahpao ong ie solahr duwehte mahs; ahpw Koht en semeio ketin ieiangiehte.
Kumwa inenen dehdehki uwen laud en ei doadoahkohng amwa pahpao.
Ahpw amwa pahpao pitihiehdi oh wekidala pak eisek pweinen ei doadoahk. Ahpw Koht sohte ketin mweidohng en wiahiong ie mehkot suwed.
Ahnsou koaros me amwa pahpao kin ndahng ie, ‘Kuht mwangerenger kan pahn wia pweinen omw doadoahk,’ pelin meno unsek kin naitikihada me mwangerenger. A ni eh kin nda, ‘Kuht alahl kan pahn wia pweinen omw doaodahk,’ pelin meno unsek kin naitikihada kuht alahl.
Koht ketikihsang nein amwa pahpao pelinmen ko oh kitikihong ie.
“Ni ahnsou mwahu en kaparmen, I auramanda me I kilenglahte kilangada duwen kuht wol kan ar kin kowerekiong kuht lih kan, re alahl oh mwangerenger.
Nan auramano tohnleng en Kohto ahpw malipe ie oh mahsanih, ‘Seikop!’ I ahpw sapeng patohwan, ‘Iet ngehi, maing.’
Ih eri mahsanih, ‘Kilang oh tehk mwahu duwen kuht wol kan ar kin kowerekih kuht lih kan, koaros alahl oh mwangerenger. I wiadahr met, pwe I kilangehr soahng koaros me Lapan wiahiong uhk.
Ngehi me Koht me pwarohng uhk nan Pedel, wasa me ke keiehki takai lehn olip mehn kataman ehu oh wiahiong ie inou ehu. Eri, onopada oh kohkohla nan sahpw me ke ipwidi ieo.’”
Resel oh Lia ahpw sapeng nda, “Sohte mehkot luhwe me se pahn sohsohki sang at pahpao.
E kin wiahkin kiht mehn liki kei. E netkinkitala oh doadoahngkihla pweinat ko.
Dipwisou koaros me Koht ketikihsang at pahpao uhdahn aht oh en nait seri kan. Eri kapwaiada mehkoaros me Koht mahsanihong uhk ke en wia.”
Seikop eri kaunopada mehkoaros, e kidahng nah seri ko, oh eh pwoud ko pohn kamel kei oh mwesel iangahki nah pelinmen koaros oh mehkoaros me e alehdi nan Mesopodamia, kohkolahng rehn eh pahpa Aisek nan Kenan.
<range>
Nindokon Lapan eh kolahng sehk winen nah sihpw ko, Resel ahpw kawaisang nein Lapan nah kisin mwomwen koht ko.
Seikop widinge Lapan ni eh sohte kehsehki me eh pahn mwesel.
Iei me Seikop tangasang Lapan wa soahng koaros me e ahneki. Mwurin e kotehla Pillap Iupreitis, e inenlahng ni wasa nahnahn Kilead.
Mwurin rahn siluh, Lapan ahpw rongada me Seikop tangehr.
E mwadangete pwakihala iangahki kiseh ko oh mwurin rahn isuh e ahpw koanoahdi Seikop ni sahpw nahnahn Kilead.
Ahpw nipwongo Koht ketin sansalohng Lapan nan auraman ehu oh mahsanihong, “Kaleke ke wiahiong Seikop mehkot suwed.”
Seikop koasoanedier imwe impwal ko pohn nahna ehu. Lapan oh kiseh ko ahpw uhd kauwada imwarail impwal ko nan wasa nahnahn Kilead.
Lapan ahpw ndahng Seikop, “Dahme ke widingekin ie oh tangahkihsang nei serepein kan likamw aramas en poar mour kei?
Dahme ke widingehkin ie oh tangdoaui sohte padahkihong ie, pwe I en iang uhk kohdo oh kokoul en peren kesekesengki dampwurin oh arp?
Ke sohte mweidohng ie I en kamwurimwuriong oh metik nei serepein kan oh neirail seri kan. Tiahk sakanakan ehu me ke wiadahr!
I kakete wiahiong uhk mehkot suwed, ahpw Koht en semomwo mahsanihong ie pwohng, ‘Kaleke ke wiahiong Seikop mehkot suwed.’
I ese me ke men samwewohngehr rehn omw peneinei pwehki omw loaleidkiniraildahr, a dahme ke pirapasangki nei kisin mwomwen koht ko?”
Seikop ahpw sapeng nda, “I wiadahr met, pwehki ei perki ke de adihasang ie noumw serepein kan.
Ahpw nin duwen pirapasang en noumw koht kan me ke kekeinakin ie, en kamakamala mwohtail koaros ihs me pahn dierekda kolokol noumw kisin koht ko, kisehtail kan me mihmi met re en wia sounkadehde en ire wet. Ma ke diarada mehkot met me uhdahn ahmw, a ale oh wahda.” Seikop sasairki me Resel me kawaisang nein Lapan kisin mwomwen koht ko.
Lapan eri pedolong nan impwal en Seikop oh impwal en Lia pwehn rapahki kisin mwomwen koht ko oh pil nan impwal en lidu riemeno; ahpw e sohte diarada kisin mwomwen koht ko. E ahpw pedoisang mwo kohla nan en Resel.
A Resel ahpw ale kisin mwomwen koht ko, oh ekihla pahn mehn mwomwohd en kamelo oh mwohdala powe. Lapan eri rapahkiseli nan impwal en Resel e ahpw sohte diar.
Resel ndalahng eh pahpao, “Maing, komw en kupwur mahk oh dehr suwedki ei sohte kak patohda mwohn silangmwi; pwe I patohwan wiewia met ei soumwahu en lih,” Lapan eri raparapahkiseli oh sohte diar kisin mwomwen koht ko.
Seikop eri lingeringerda oh ndalahng Lapan, “Sapwung dah de dihp dah me I wiahda, pwe ke en pwakihiehdo, oh
sarepseli ei kepwe kan koaros? Dahme ke diarada me uhdahn ahmw sang ni ei kepwe kan? Ma mie mehkot ke diarada, a pwilikihdi met mwohn kisehta kan oh irail en wia sounkopwung nanpwungata.
Erein sounpar rieisek me I mihmihki rehmw, noumw sihpw lih kan oh kuht kan so mwahn emen iohla; I so mwahn kangasang mehmen sang rehn noumw pelin sihpw.
I sohte mwahn wadohng uhk mahn emen me mahn lawalo kan kin kemehla; I kin pein kapwungala sapwung kan oh mehkoaros me kin wiawihong pelinmen ko sang ni pirap en nipwong de nin rahn.
Ni rahn I kin mwasingkihla karakar uk en ketipin oh nipwong I kin kereniong mehkihla lemwulemwur en keteu, oh I sohte kak meirki.
Sang nan sounpar rieisek me I doadoahkohng uhk, sounpar eisek pahieu I lidiliduwihiuk pwehki noumw serepein riemenen oh sounpar weneu pwehki noumw pelinmen kan. Komwi ahpw wekidala pak eisek pweinen ei doadoahk.
Ma Koht en semei ko, Koht en Eipraam oh Aisek, sohte ketin kupwure ie, ele ke kasareielahr sohte wa mehkot. Ahpw Koht ketin mwahngihada ei apwal oh wahn ei doadoahk, ihme e ketin kapwungki ong uhk pwohng.”
Lapan ahpw sapeng Seikop nda, “Uhdahn nei serepein kan iangahki neirail seri kan, oh pelinmen kan pil uhdahn nei. Mehlel, mehkoaros me ke kilang wasaht uhdahn ahi. Ahpw I sohte kak kolokol serepein pwukat oh nair seri kan.
Eri, kita pahn wiahda inou ehu nanpwungata. Kita koasoakehda ekei takai pwe en wia mehn kataman en ata inou.”
Seikop eri ale takai ehu oh kauwada mehn kataman.
E ahpw ndaiong kiseh ko re en rikpene ekei takai oh koasoakehda. Irail eri tungoal limwahn koasoakoasoako.
Lapan eri kihong eden wasao Sekar Saaduda, a Seikop kahdaneki Kaleed.
Lapan eri ndahng Seikop, “Pehs wet pahn wia mehn kataman nanpwungata.” Ihme wasao adanekihki Kaleed.
Lapan pil nda, “KAUN-O en ketin sinsile nanpwungata, ni ata pahn tohrohrpeseng.” Eri wasao pil adanekihla Mispa.
Lapan ahpw pil nda, “Ma ke wiakauwe nei serepein kan de pwoudikihda ekei lih tohrohr, mehnda ma I sohte ese met, a ke en tamataman me Koht me pahn ketin mwahngih kita.
Iet takai pwukat me I koasoakedahr nanpwungata, oh takai wet pahn wia mehn kataman.
Koasoakoasoak en takai pwukat oh takai en kataman wet pahn wia mehn kataman ehu. I sohte pahn kotehwei koasoakoasoak wet pwe I en uhwong uhk, oh ke sohte pahn kotehdo takai en kataman wet pwe ke en uhwong ie.
Koht en Eipraam oh Koht en Nahor me pahn wia sounkopwung en nanpwungata.” Seikop eri kahukihla ni mwaren Kohto me seme Aisek kin kaudokiong, me e pahn kapwaiada inou wet.
Ih eri kemehla mahn emen oh meirongkihla pohn nahnao oh luhkeiong kiseh ko pwe re en iang tungoal reh. Mwurin ar tungoal, re ahpw pweidi pohn nahnao.
Lapan eri pwourda nin sohrahnie, kamwurimwuriong irail, metik nah serepein ko oh neira pwutak ko, oh mwesel kohkolahng nan sapweo.
Nindokon Seikop eh wiewia eh seiloak, tohnleng en Koht kei ahpw tuhwong.
Eri, ni eh kilangirailda eh ahpw patohwan, “Iet karis en Koht kei.” E ahpw kihong eden wasao Mahanaim.
Seikop eri kadarala mwowe meninkeder kei rehn rie Esau nan wehin Edom.
E kehkehlingkihong meninkeder ko re en ndaiong Esau, “Iet ngehi, Seikop, sapwellimomwi ladu, me patohwan pakairkiwohng ei kaun Esau duwen ei keikeiruier rehn Lapan oh mihmihte reh lel rahnwet.
Mie rehi nei pelin kou, pelin ahs, pelin sihpw oh kuht, oh pil kiden lidu ohl oh lih. I patohwanowohng komwi, maing, pakair wet, pwe I en diar kalahngan pahn kupwuromwi.”
Meninkeder ko pwurodo rehn Seikop oh patohwanohng, “Se patohla rehn riomwi Esau, ahpw iet e ketiket kohdo rehmwi iangahki aramas 400.”
Seikop eri masepwehkada kowahlap, oh nehkpeseng aramas me mihmi reh ko, oh pil nah pelin sihpw oh kuht, pelin kou oh kamel ko, wiahkihda pwihn riau.
E ahpw mengimengloalki, “Ma Esau pahn peiong ehu pwihn, a pwihn teio kakete pitlahsang.”
Seikop eri kapakap, patohwan, “Maing Koht en semei Eipraam, Koht en semei Aisek, komw ketin karong ie! Maing KAUN, komw ketin mahsanihongieier, ‘Pwurowei nan sapwomw rehn kisehmw kan, I ahpw pahn kupwuramwahwihiuk.’
I sohte warohng kalahngan koaros oh loalopwoat poatopoat me komw ketin kupwurehki sapwellimomwi ladu menet. I kotelahr Pillap Sordan sohte wa mehkot ihte sokon pwoat, a met I pwurodohr kahre pwihn riau wet.
Komw ketin doareiesang ni manaman en riei Esau. I perki ni eh patopatohdo pwe ede uhwong kiht oh kauweikitala koaros, iangahki lih akan oh pil seri kan.
Komw kupwukupwure sapwellimomwi inowo me mahsanih, ‘I pahn kupwuramwhwihiuk pwe mehkoaros en pweida rehmw, oh I pahn kihong uhk kadaudokomw ngedehrie me soh kak wadawad. Re pahn tohto duwehte pihken ni oaroahr akan.’”
Eri, mwurin eh pweidi wasao nipwongo, e pilada sang nan dipwisou ko me mihmi reh kisakis me e pahn kihong rie Esau.
Eri, iet kan: kuht lih 200 oh kuht wol 20, sihpw lih 200 oh sihpw wol 20,
kamel lih me apwtehn neitik 30 iangahki wahrail kan, kou lih 40 oh kouwol 10, ahs lih 20 oh ahs wol 10.
E ahpw nehkpeseng pelinmen pwukat rehn ladu kei, oh ndaiong irail, “Kumwail tiengwei mwohi, oh dehr kapatapene pelinmen kan, ahpw irepeseng ehute soangen mahn ekis wasa.
E ahpw pil kehkehlingkihong ladu me tiengo, “Ni omw pahn tuhwong riei Esau oh eh pahn idek rehmw, ‘Ihs me omw soumas? Ke pahn mi ia? Nein ihs mahn pwukat me ke kahkahre?
Ke pahn sapengki, ‘En sapwellimomwi ladu Seikop eh tungoal mahn pwukat. Eh tungoal kisakis me e patohwan kadarodohng komwi, maing. Pein ih patopato kohdo mwurit.’”
E ahpw pil wiahiong soangen kehkehlikohte ong keriemen, oh pil kesilimen, oh koaros me idihdawehn pelinmen ko, e ndaiong irail, “Ih soangen pato wette me kumwail pahn patohwanohng Esau, ni amwail pahn tuhwong.
Kumwail pil pahn ndahng, ‘Ei, sapwellimomwi ladu Seikop patopatohdo mwurit.’” Seikop ahpw mengimengloalki, “I pahn kameleileikihdi Esau kisakis pwukat me pahn tiengla mwohi, oh ni ei pahn tuhwong, ele e pahn kadekohng ie oh mahkohng ie.”
Kisakis ko eri pekederla mwowe, a ih e pweidi nipwongo nan imwe impwalo.
Nipwongohte Seikop pwourda oh ale eh pwoud riemeno, eh lih lidu riemeno, oh nah seri 11 ko oh kotehla Pillap Sappok.
Mwurin eh kadarihralahr, e ahpw pil kadarala eh kepwe ko koaros.
Ih eri kelekelepw wasao. A iet ohl emen ahpw pwarohng oh poadoarohng lao lel nin sohrahn.
Ni ohlo eh pehmada me e sohte kak kesehdi, e poakih pwonen Seikopo. Eri, pwonen Seikopo ahpw piselpeseng.
Ohlo ahpw nda, “Eri, pweisang ie, pwe wasa rahnehr.” A Seikop sapeng, nda, “I sohte pahn pweisang uhk, ke lao pahn kapaiaiehda.”
Ohlo ahpw idek reh, “Ia edomw?” Seikop ahpw sapeng, “Seikop.”
Ohlo ahpw ndahng, “Ke solahr pahn adaneki Seikop. Pwe ke poadoarongehr Koht oh aramas akan, ke ahpw powedier. Eri, ke pahn adanekilahr Israel.”
Seikop ahpw idek, “A komwi, ia mwaromwi?” A e sapeng, “Dahme ke idengki mwarei?” Ih eri kapaiahda Seikop wasao.
Seikop eri kihong eden wasao Peniel oh ketihtihki, “I kilangehr Koht ni uhdahn silangi, ahpw iet I momourte.”
Eri, ni eh mweselsang Peniel, ketipin ahpw dakerada, ih eri alu pelingek kohkohla pwehki pwoneo eh piselpesengehr.
Ih kahrepen kadaudok en Israel kan ar sohte tungoale uduk me kin mi ni pwonen mahn, pwehki ih wasa me ohlo poakihdi rehn Seikop.
Seikop ahpw kilenglahte kilangada Esau eh kohkohdo iangahki ohl pahpwiki. Ih eri nehkpeseng nah seri ko nanpwungen Lia, Resel oh eh pekehi lih riemeno.
E ahpw koasoanehdi mwohrail eh pekehi riemeno iangahki neira seri ko, mwuri Lia oh nah seri ko, a Resel oh Sosep me keieu mwuhr.
Seikop ahpw tiengla mwohrail oh poaridiong nanpwel pak isuh, ni ahnsou me rieo leledo.
Esau tangalahte pwoalehdi oh metik, ira koaros eri sengiseng.
Ni Esau eh sarada oh kilangada lih ako oh seri ko, e ahpw idek, “Ihs aramas pwukat me ianguhket?” Seikop ahpw sapeng, “Maing, ih ei tungoal seri kan me Koht ketin kupwurehkin ie.”
Pekehi ko oh neira seri ko ahpw aluhdo oh rahnmwahwih oh poaridi mwowe;
mwuri Lia oh nah ko pil aluhdahdo rahnmwahwih oh poaridi, Resel oh Sosep me aluhdahdo keieu mwuhr, ira ahpw rahnmwahwih oh pil poaridi.
Esau ahpw idek, “A ia wehwehn pwihn me I tuhwongo?” Seikop ahpw sapeng, “Maing, pwe I en diar kuwpuramwahu rehmwi.”
Esau ahpw nda, “Itar kepwe kan me I ahneki; kolokolete mehkan me uhdahn ahmw.”
Seikop eri patohwan, “So maing, ma komw kupwureielahr, a komw ketikihda kisakis wet. Pwe ei pato pahn silangmwi rasehng ei pato pahn silangin Koht, pwehki omwi nohn kadekohng ie.
Komw ketikihda kisakis wet me I patohwandohng komwi; Koht ketin kupwurkalahngan ong ie oh ketikihong ie soahng koaros me I anahne.” Seikop eri wie ngidingidkihong eh lao ale dipwisou ko.
Esau eri nda, “Eri me mwahu, kitail onopada mwesel. I pahn tiengla mahs.”
A Seikop sapengki, “Duwen omwi mahsanih, seri pwelel kat me luwet, oh pil mie pelin sihpw kei oh kou kei iangahki wahrail kan. Ma re pahn pakahrwei ni karuaru, pelinmen ko koaros pahn mehla.
Komw tiengwei, I ahpw pahn wawai kohwei ieiang mwekid en pelinmen kan oh seri kan, I lao lel rehmw nan Edom.”
Esau ahpw nda, “Eri mweidohng ie I en kihdi ekei nei ohl ako pwe re en ianguhk.” Seikop ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Komw dehr kupwurohki men, ihte I men komwi en kupwureiehla.”
Eri ni rahnohte Esau pwuralahng Edom.
Seikop ahpw kohla Sukot, wasa e kauwada ie imwe ihmw ehu oh impwal kei ong nah pelinmen ko. Ih kahrepen wasao e adanekihla Sukot.
Ni Seikop eh pwurodohsang Mesopodamia, e sohte diar apwal ehu ih lao lel nan kahnimw en Sekem nan Kenan, e ahpw kauwada imwe imwpal ko nan mohs ehu limwahn kahnimwo.
E pwainsang sahpwo rehn kisehn kadaudok en Amor ko, semen Sekem, ni uwen silper epwiki.
E ahpw kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao, oh kihong eden wasao El, Koht en Israel.
Rahn ehu Daina, nein Lia serepein ong Seikop, ahpw mwemweitla rehn lihen Kenan kei.
Sekem, nein Amor mehn Ip, kaunen wasao, e kilangete Daina oh mwahukihda, e ahpw angkehlailiong.
E ahpw kilangada uwen kaselel en serepeino, ihme kahrehda e inenen poakepoakehla oh song en kansenamwahwihala.
E ahpw ndaiong eh pahpao, “Menlao pekihda serepein menet ei pwoud.”
Seikop eri rongada duwen nah serepeino eh adsuwedlahr, e ahpw sohte wia mehkot pwehki nah pwutak ko ar mihmi nansapw, apwahpwalih nair pelinmen ko, e sohte mwahn mweseiseiki, re lao pwurodo sang nansapw.
Amor, semen Sekem, ahpw kohla rehn Seikop pwe ira en koasoia duwen ire wet,
ni ahnsowo nein Seikop pwutak ko pa lelodo sang nansapwo. Ni ar rongada ire wet, re inenen pwuriamweikihla oh lingeringerkihda kowahlap, pwehki Sekem eh wiadahr soangen tiahk wet oh kanamenekilahr aramas en Israel kan.
Amor eri ndaiong Seikop, “Ei tungoal pwutako, Sekem, men pwoudiki sapwellimomwi serepeinen; komw kupwurehla oh ketikihong pwe en pwoudikihda.
Kitail inoukipene en kapwopwoudipene neitail kan, kumwail mweidodohng kiht noumwail kan, a kiht se pahn uhd mweidohng kumwail nait kan.
Pwe kumwail en kak iang kousoanla nan sahpwet; kumwail kak kousoan wasa kan me kumwail anahne, oh iang wie netinetseli ni saledek, oh uhdahn sapwenikihla sahpw akan me kumwail kousoan loale.
Sekem eri ndaiong semen Daina oh rie ko, “Kumwail kupwurehla ei pekipek, I ahpw pahn patohwanohng kumwail soahng koaros me kumwail anahne.
Kumwail kilelehdi uwen pweinen serepeinen, oh soangen kisakis me kumwail anahne, pwe I pahn kihong kumwail soahng koaros me kumwail pahn peki, ma kumwail pahn mweidohng ie I en pwoudiki serepeinen.”
Nein Seikop pwutak ko ahpw wiahiong Sekem oh eh pahpao pasapeng widing ehu, pwehki ar lingeringerki riarail serepeino eh adsuwedlahr.
Irail eri nda, “Se sohte kak mweidohng riat serepeinet en pwoudiki aramas me sohte sirkumsais; pwe mehkot kanamenek reht soahngen.
Ihte se pahn pwungki ma ohl koaros rehmwail pahn sirkumsaisla.
Eri kitail ahpw pahn kihpene neitail kan re en pwopwoudpene. Se pahn mihla rehmwail oh wiahla kisehmwail.
Ahpw ma kumwail sohte pwungki at koasoandi duwen sirkumsaisla, eri, se pahn wahda serepeinet oh kohkohla.”
Amor oh nah pwutako, Sekem, ahpw pwungki koasoandi wet.
Pwutako eri mwadangete kapwaiada dahme re koasoanehdio, pwehki eh limpoakohng mehlel nein Seikop serepeino. Pwutaket me keieu wahu nan eh peneinei.
Amor oh nah pwutak Sekem eri kohla wasahn tuhpene en kahnimwo oh padahkihong aramas ako:
“Aramas pwukat me kadek; kumwail mweidohng re en kousoanla rehtail oh seiloakseli ni saledek. Pwe sahpwet me laud oh itar irail en iang kousoan loale. Kitail kihong irail neitail serepein kan pwe re en pwoudiki, oh re pahn pil kihong kitail en pwoudiki neirail kan.
Ahpw aramas pwukat pahn pwungki mihla rehtail oh wiahla kisehtail, ma ohl koaros rehtail pahn sirkumsaisla duwehte irail.
Eri, kitail sou pahn pil ahnekihla ar kepwe kan oh nair pelimen kan? Eri kitail mweidohng re en mihla rehtail.”
Eri ohl koaros en kahnimwo ahpw pwungkihda dahme Amor oh nah pwutak Sekem ndahng irail, ohl koaros en kahnimwo ahpw sirkumsaisla.
Eri mwurin rahn siluh, nindokon ohl ako ar weiweirengki ar sirkumsaiso, riemen nein Seikop pwutak ko, rien Daina ko, Simion oh Lipai, ira ahpw ale neira kedlahs oh waila kemehla ohl koaros en kahnimwo,
iangahki Amor oh nah pwutak Sekem. Ira eri wahsang Daina nan imwen Sekemo oh kohkohla.
Mwurin ara kemehla ohl ako, nein Seikop pwutak teiko pedolong oh kauwehla kahnimwo, dupuken ar kadsuwedihala riarail serepeino.
Re pil wahsang mahn ako, sihpw, kou, ahs, oh mehkoaros me mi nan kahnimwo oh nansapw.
Re wahsang kepwe kesempwal koaros, iangahki lih oh seri koaros oh dipwisoun nan ihmw koaros.
Seikop ahpw ndaiong Simion oh Lipai, “Kumwail kahrehiongieier nan apwal laud ehu; mehn Kenan oh Peris, iangahki koaros tohn sahpwet pahn kailongkiniela. Nei ohl akan me malaulau; ma re pahn ehupene oh mahweniong ie, atail peneinei pwon pahn mwomwla.”
A re sapengki, “Se sohte kak mweidohng re en wiahkihla riato lih me kin netiki paliwere.”
Koht ketin mahsanihong Seikop, “Kohdawei Pedel met, oh kousoanla wasao. Kauwada ehu pei sarawi ong ie, ong Koht me pwarohng uhk ni ahnsou me ke tangatangasang riomw Esau.”
Seikop eri ndahng eh peneinei oh irail koaros me ieiang ih, “Kumwail kesehla koht en liki kan koaros me mihmi rehmwail; kumwail eri kamwakeleikumwailda oh pwuhriong nan likou mwakelekel.
Pwe kitail pahn kohdahla Pedel met, oh I pahn kauwada wasao pei sarawi ehu ong Koht me ketin karonge ie nan ei apwal oh ketin ieiang ie nan ei seiloak.”
Irail eri kihong Seikop koht en liki koaros me re kolokol oh mentiati koaros me mi ni salengarail kan.
Ni Seikop oh nah pwutak ko ar mweselda, lemmwin Koht ahpw kipehdi kahnimw koaros me kapilirailpene, me kahrehda sohte emen pwakihirailla.
Seikop oh aramas koaros me ieiang ih ahpw lel Lus, me ahnsou wet adaneki Pedel, nan wehin Kenan.
E kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao oh kihong ede Pedel, pwe iei wasao me Koht ketin sansalohng ih nindokon eh tangatangasang rieo.
Depora, lih me kin apwahpwalih Repeka, eri mehla oh seridi pahn tuhke ohk pwoat pahnengin Pedel. Iei me tuhkeo adanekihki “Ohk en Mwahiei.”
Ni Seikop eh pwurodohsang sang Mesopodamia, Koht ketin pwurehng pwarohng oh kupwuramwahwih.
Koht ahpw mahsanihong, “Sang met kohla ke solahr pahn adaneki Seikop, ahpw ke pahn adanekilahr Israel.” Ih eri adanekihla Israel.
Koht pil mahsanihong, “Ngehi Koht Wasa Lapalap. Noumw seri en ngederla. Wehi tohtohie pahn pwilisang rehmw oh nanmwarki kei pahn ipwisang rehmw.
Sahpw me I kihongehr Eipraam oh Aisek, I pahn uhd kihong uhk oh kadaudokomw kan.”
Koht eri ketin sohrala sang reh.
Seikop eri kauwada pei sarawi ehu mehn kataman, wasa me Koht ketin mahseniong ih, oh e ahpw kasarawihala ni eh wudekihdiong powe wain oh lehn olip.
E ahpw kihong eden wasao Pedel.
Seikop oh eh peneinei ahpw mweselsang wasao kohkolahng Eprat. Ni ar kohkohla nanialo Resel ahpw lelehr eh ahnsoun neitik, e ahpw medekda oh mihla nan apwal en neitik.
Ni eh medeko eh uklahr mehlel, sounkaneitiko ahpw ndaiong, “Ke dehr masak pwe pil emen pwutak men.”
Ahpw ni eh pahn melahr, e ahpw kihong eden nah pwutako Penoni, a eh pahpao kihong ede Pensamin.
Resel eri mehla oh seridi limwahn ahl en kolahng Eprat, me ahnsou wet adaneki Pedleem.
Seikop eri kauwada mehn kataman ehu pohn eh sousowo; oh iei kilel en mehn kataman wet me mihmihte lel rahnwet.
Seikop ahpw douluhlla oh kauwada imwe impwal ko palilahsang kengkeng en Eder.
Nindokon Seikop eh koukousoan wasao, Reupen kohla oh wiahiong nsenen pwopwoud rehn Pila, emen en eh pahpao eh pekehi ko. Ahnsou me Seikop rongada met, e inenen lingeringerkihda mehlel. Seikop naineki pwutak ehk riemen.
Nein Lia pwutak kan iei Reupen (nein Seikop pwutak mesenih), Simion, Lipai, Suda, Isakar, oh Sepulon.
Nein Resel pwutak kan iei Sosep oh Pensamin.
Pila, nein Resel liduwo me naitikihada Dan oh Napdali.
Silpa, nein Lia liduwo me naitikihada Kad oh Aser. Pwutak pwukat ipwidi nan Mesopodamia.
Seikop eri kohkohla rehn eh pahpa Aisek nan Mamre, limwahn Epron, wasa me Eipraam oh Aisek kin kousoan ie mahs.
Aisek momourki sounpar 180,

Iet kadaudok en Esau kan, me pil kin adaneki Edom.
Esau pwoudikihda lihen Kenan kei: Ada, nein Elon mehn Id; Olipama, nein Anah serepein, Anah nein Sipeon mehn Id;
oh Pasemad, nein Ismael serepein oh rien Nepaiod.
Ada naitikihada Elipas; Pasemad naitikihada Reuel;
oh Olipama naitikihada Seus, Salam, oh Kora. Pwutak pwukat koaros ipwidiong Esau nan Kenan.
Esau eri ale eh pwoud ko, nah pwutak ko oh serepein ko, oh tohn imwe koaros, iangahki nah mahn koaros oh mehkoaros me e ahneki nan Kenan oh kohkohla sang rehn rie Seikop, kohkolahng nan sahpw tohrohr ehu.
E kohkohla sang wasao pwehki sahpwo me ih oh Seikop koukousoan loale sohte itar pwehn komokomour irail koaros; re naineki mahn tohto oh re solahr kak mihmipene.

Eri, Seikop ahpw usehlahte eh keikeiru nan Kenan, wasa me eh pahpao kin kousoan ie mahs.
Eri, iet duwen poadopoad en eh peneinei. Sosep, pwutak pwulopwul men me mahkiher sounpar eisek isuh oh kin iang rie ko, nein Pila oh Silpa en eh pahpao eh pekehi ko, apwahpwalih nair pelin sihpw oh pelin kuht kan. E ahpw kedipairailda rehn ar pahpao duwen mehkot sapwung me re wiahda.
Sosep inenen soisoi pahn Seikop sang rie teiko koaros, pwehki eh ipwidi ni eh pahpao eh ohl laudlahr. Seikop eri wiahiong Sosep eh likou reirei me kaselel oh peh reirei.
Ni rie ko ar tehkada duwen ar pahpao e kesempwaliki kowahlap Sosep sang irail koaros, re kailongkihla mehlel, oh solahr men lokaia mwahu ong.
Kedekedeo, Sosep ahpw wiahda ouraman ehu, e ahpw koasoiaiong rie ko duwe. Met ahpw kahrehiong ar inenen kailongkihla.
E ndaiong irail, “Kumwail rong mahs duwen me I ouramandahro.
Dene kitail koaros mihmi nansapw piripirepene kapakap en pilawa kei; a iet ei kapakapo pa kesihnenda, a amwail ko kapilpene ahio oh poaridi mwowe.”
Rie ko ahpw idek reh, “Ke lemeleme me ke pahn wiahla at nanmwarki, de ke pahn kaunkitada?” Ar kailongki ahpw ukla mehlel, pwehki eh ouramano.
Sosep pil pwurehng ouraman, oh ndaiong rie ko, “I pil pwurehng ouraman oh kilangada duwen ketipin, maram, oh usu eisek ehu ar poaridi mwohi.”
E ahpw pil ndaiong eh pahpao duwen ouramano, eh pahpao eri lupwoarehda, ndaiong, “Ia duwe? Pwehki omw ouraman, ke lemeleme me omw nohno, riomw kan, oh pil ngehi, se pahn poaridi mwohmw?”
Rien Sosep ko ahpw kin peipeiriniong, a eh pahpao ahpw kin medemedewe irair wet.
Rien Sosep ko eri kohla likin Sekem pwe re en sinsile nein ar pahpao pelin mahn kei.
Seikop eri ndaiong Sosep, “I men ke en kohla Sekem, wasa me riomw ko kin apwahpwalih pelinmen ko.” Sosep ahpw sapeng, “Iet ngehi, I onopadahr.”
Eh pahpao eri ndahng, “Eri, kohwei oh kilang ia iren riomw ko, oh ia iren mahn akan. Ke ahpw pwurodo oh pakairkihong ie.” Semeo eri kadarala Sosep sang nan Wahun Epron. Ni Sosep eh lel Sekem,
ohl emen ahpw tuhwong ni eh kohkohseli nansapw, e ahpw idek reh, “Dahme ke raparapahki?”
Sosep ahpw sapeng, “I raparapahki riei ko. Ia wasa re kin apwahpwalih ie nait pelinmen ko?”
Ohlo ahpw nda, “Re apwtehn mweselsang met. I mwur rong ar ndinda me re pahn kohla Dodan.” Sosep eri douluhlla raparapahki rie ko, e ahpw diarihrada Dodan.
Rie ko eri kilangada eh kohkohdo dohsang irail, oh mwohn eh kerendohng irail re inoukihda re en kemehla.
Re ndapene nanpwungarail, “Ien sounouramano, e kohkohdo.
Nna, kitail kemehla oh kesehdiong nan ehu pwareren. Kitail nek nda me mahn lawalo me kangala. Kitail ahpw pahn kilang da katepen eh ouraman kan.”
Reupen rongada arail koasoio, e ahpw song en kapitasang Sosep rehrail. Ih eri ndahng irail, “Kitail dehr kakerehdi nta.
Kumwail dehr kemehla. Kumwail kesehdiongete nan ehu pwareren nan sapwtehnet, ieremen kauwehla paliwere.” E ndaiong irail met pwe e men kapitasang Sosep rehrail oh kapwurelahng rehn eh pahpao.
Ni Sosep eh lel rehn rie ko, re kapwuhrasang eh likou reireio;
oh koledi kesehdiong nan pwoahr madekeng ehu.
Nindokon ar mwengemwenge, re kilenglahte kilangada mehn Ismael kei me seiseiloaksang Kilead. Neirail kamel kan wa diren kepwe kesempwal kei, me re weuwa kolahng Isip.
Suda eri ndaiong rie ko, “Dah katepehiong kitail, ma kitail kemehla riatailo oh ekihla eh mehla?
Kitail netikihla rehn mehn Ismael pwukat, oh dehr wiahiong paliwere mehkot suwed; pwe ih pil riatail, kisehn udukatail oh ntahtail.” Rie ko eri pwungkihda.
Eri, ni sounnet en Midian kei ar keid wasao, pirieno ahpw apihadahsang Sosep nan pwoahro oh netikihong mehn Ismael ko ni mwohni silper 20. Mehn Ismael ko eri walahng Sosep Isip.
Ni Reupen eh pwuralahng ni pwoahro oh diarada me Sosep solahr mi loale, e tehrasang eh likou ko uwen eh nsensuwedla.
Ih eri pwurala rehn rie ko, oh ndahng irail, “Pwutako solahr mi wasao! Dahme I pahn wia?”
Irail eri kemehla kuht men, re ahpw ale en Sosep eh likou reireio oh kaduhdi nan ntahn kuhto.
Re ahpw walahng ar pahpao, nda, “Se diar likou wet. Kilang ma kaidehn en noumw pwutako?”
Seikop kadehdehte me iei, e ahpw nda, “En nei pwutako eh likowo met! Mahn lawalo me kemehla; mahn kommwad me kangala.”
Seikop eri tehrpeseng eh likou ko oh pwuhriong nan likoun nsensuwed. E ahpw mwahieiki nah pwutako rahn tohtohie.
Nah pwutak ko oh nah serepein koaros ahpw kin pokondohng reh, pwe re en kansenamwahwihala. Ahpw e sohte men nsenamwahula, e kin ndindahte, “I pahn mwahmwahieiki nei pwutako, I lao pahn kohdihla reh nan sousou.” Ih eri usehlahte mwahmwahieiki nah pwutak Sosep.
Ni ahnsowo, mehn Midian ko netikihla Sosep rehn Podipar nan Isip, emen sapwellimen Parao lapalap ako, me kaunen pwihnen silasil en tehnpaso.
Ni ahnsowo Suda eri mweselsang rehn rie ko oh kohla kousoanla rehn ohl emen ede Ira, sang kahnimw en Adullam.
E ahpw tuhwong wasao serepein en Kenan men, me eh pahpa adaneki Sua. E ahpw pwoudikihda serepeino.
Serepeino eri naitikihong pwutak emen me e kihong ede Er.
E pil pwurehng liseianda oh naitikihada pil emen pwutak, e ahpw kihong eden Onan.
E pil neitik kasilipak oh kihong eden pwutako, Sela. Suda mihmi nan Aksip ni ahnsou me pwutako ipwidi.
Kedekedeo, Suda ahpw kapwopwoudihada nah pwutak mesenih Er, ong lih emen me ede Damar.
Ahpw tiahk en Er me sohte mwahu, kahrehda e kahngiangihada kowahlap KAUN-O, iei me KAUN-O ketikihsang eh mour.
Suda eri ndaiong Onan, rien Er, “Kohwei kapwaiada nsenen pwopwoud rehn liohdio, en riomwo eh pwoudo, pwe ke en kapwaiada omw pwukoa ong riomwo oh wiahda nah seri, pwe en mie kadaudoke.”
Ahpw Onan ese me seri me e pahn wiahda, kaidehn ih me pahn adki, eri ahnsou koaros me e kin kapwaiada nsenen pwopwoud rehn liohdio, e sohte kin kusiong, ahpw e kin kakusala liki, pwe en dehr wiahda kadaudok en rieo.
E ahpw kahngiangihkihda KAUN-O soahng me e kin wiao, KAUN-O eri pil ketikihsang eh mour.
Suda eri ndaiong Damar, “Pwurala ni imwen omw pahpao wiewiate liohdi men, nei pwutak Sela lao keirda wiahla ohl.” Pwe e perki Sela de pil mehla duwehte rie ko. Damar eri pwurala ni imweo.
Kedekedeo, en Suda eh pwoudo mehla. Mwurin ahnsoun mwahiei eh dauliher, Suda ahpw kohla Timna iangahki Ira mehn Adullam, pwe en sehkasang winen nah sihpw ko.
Damar eri rongada me Suda pahn kohla Timna pwehn sehk winen nah sihpw ko.
E ahpw pwuhrsang nan eh likoun liohdi, pwainkihdi meseo koaduhpwel ehu, oh mwohndiong ni keilenial me tang kolahng Timna, pwe eh ese me nein Suda pwutak pekindihdi, Sela, wialahr ohl emen, e ahpw sohte kohieng pwe en pwoudiki.
Ni Suda eh kilangada liho, e kihkihong me lihen netiki paliwere men ih, pwehki eh pwaindi meseo.
E ahpw keilahng mpe ni keilenialo oh ndahng, “Ia uwen pweinomw?” (E sasairki me en nah pwutako eh pwoudo mwo.) Liho ahpw sapeng, “Dahme ke pahn kihong ie?”
A ohlo sapengki, “I pahn kadarodohng uhk emen kisin kuht sang nan nei pelinmeno.” Liho ahpw nda, “Me mwahu, ma ke pahn kihong ie mehkot pwe I en kolokol oh wiahki kilel en ata inou lao ke kadarodohng ie kuhto.”
Suda eri idek, “Dahme I pahn kihong uhk me pahn wia kilel en ata inou?” A liho sapengki, “Omw katengen oh sokon me ke kolokolen.” E ahpw kihong liho dipwisou ko. Ira eri kapwaiada nsenen pwopwoud, liho eri liseianda.
Damar eri pwurala ni imweo, e ahpw kihsang eh koaduhpwelo, oh pwurehng pwuhriong nan likoun liohdi.
Suda eri kadarala Ira pwe en wahla kisin kuhto oh en kapwurehdo sang rehn liho dipwisou ko me wia kilel en ara inou. Ahpw Ira sohte diar liho.
E ahpw idekseli rehn mehn Enaim ko, “Ia lih me kin netiki paliwereo me mihmi ni keileniale?” A irail sapeng, “Sohte mwahn lih emen me kin netiki paliwere men wasaht.”
E ahpw pwurala rehn Suda oh ndahng, “I sohte diar liho. Tohn kahnimwo pil nda me sohte mwahn lihen netiki paliwere men wasao.”
Suda eri nda, “Eri, en ahnekihla ei dipwisou ko, pwe aramas de kouruhrkin kita. I kadarowohngehr kisin kuht me I inoukihong, ahpw ke sohte diar.”
Ahpw mwurin sounpwong siluh, mie me ndahng Suda, ketihtihki, “En noumw pwutako eh pwoudo wialahr lihen netiki paliwere men, oh met e liseiandahr.” Suda eri nda, “Kumwail wahieila pwehn isihsla.”
Nindokon eh pakapakahrlahng wasahn kalokolok, e ahpw kadaralahng semen eh pwoudo pakair wet: “I liseianohng ohl me ahneki dipwisou pwukat. Kumwail kilang en ihs dipwisou pwukat— kilel me mi ni katenget oh sokonet.”
Suda kilangada dipwisou ko, e ahpw nda, “E pwung sang ie. Eh sapwung tikitik sang ei sapwung, pwehki ei sohte kihong nei pwutak Sela en pwoudiki.” Suda eri sohla wiahiong nsenen pwopwoud.
Ni ahnsoun eh neitik eh lelehr, Damar diarada me mpwer ehu me mi nan kapehde.
Ni eh pahn neitikier, emen mpwero kapwadei apali peho; sounkeneitiko ahpw koledi oh pirehiong ni peho kisinsel weitahta kis, pwe en wia kilel me ih me ipwidi mahs.
Ahpw ni eh kapwurehlong peho, rie teio uhd pwediei; sounkeneitiko ahpw nda, “Ih duwen omw nantihong pwe ke en pwediei!” Ih me e adanekihki Peres.
Mwuri rieo ahpw pwediei; e ahpw adanekihla Sera.
Eri, mehn Ismael ko walahng Sosep nan Isip. Re ahpw netikihong Podipar, mehn Isip men, emen sapwellimen Parao lapalap ako, kaunen silepen tehnpas en nanmwarkio.
KAUN-O eri kin ketin ieiang Sosep, pwe mehkoaros en kin pweida mwahu reh. E kin koukousoan ni imwen eh soumaso, me wia pwilidak en Isip men.
Ohlo ahpw esehda me KAUN-O kin ketin ieiang Sosep oh mehkoaros kin pweida mwahu reh.
Podipar ahpw perenkihda mehlel en Sosep eh papah mwahu. Ih eri kasapwiladahng Sosep sounkohwahn imweo oh eh kepwe kan koaros.
Sang ni ahnsowo kohla, KAUN-O kin ketin kupwuramwahwih imwen Podipar pwehki Sosep oh pil kin ketin kupwuramwahwih mehkoaros me mi nan imwe oh pil nan sapwe kan.
Podipar eri kihong mehkoaros Sosep en kin apwahpwalih oh sohte kin kedirepwki mehkot, ihte kisin tungoal kan me e kin tungoale. Sosep, pwutak paliwaramwahu men oh pil masamwahu.
Kedekedeo, en Podipar eh pwoud ahpw inangihada Sosep oh peki en kohla mahs wendi reh.
A Sosep sohte men dukiong, e ahpw ndaiong liho, “Ei soumas sohte kin kedirepwki mehkot nan ihmwet, pwehki eh likih ie. E wiahkinielahr sounkohwahn mehkoaros me e ahneki.
At manaman duwepenehte nan ihmwet, oh e sohte irehdihsang ie mehkot, ihte komwi, eh pwoud, me e irehdihsang ie. Eri a, ia duwen ei pahn wiahda soangen sapwung laud wet, oh dipkihda mwohn Koht?”
Liho ahpw kin pekipeki reh rahn koaros, ahpw Sosep sohte dukiong wendi reh.
Rahn ehu Sosep ahpw pedolong nan ihmwo pwe en wia eh doadoahk, oh sohte ohl emen nan ihmwo ni ahnsowo.
Liho ahpw koledi en Sosep likowo oh ndahng, “Nna, wendi mahs rehi.” A Sosep uhdahte tangasang, tangeila liki, a eh likowo mihmihte rehn liho.
Ni liho eh kilangada me e sohte wa eh likowo ni eh tangeisang reh,
e ahpw ekerpene ladu ko en nan ihmwo, oh ndahng irail, “Kumwail kilang mahs! Ei pwoudo wadohng ni imwatailet mehn Ipru menet oh met e men kapailokei kitail. E pedolongodo nan ei pere oh song en angkehlailiong ie, I ahpw weriwer uwen ei kak.
Ni ei weriwer, e ahpw kesehla eh likowet, ih eri tangeila likio.”
Liho eri nekidala likowo lao en Sosep eh soumaso pwurodo.
E ahpw ndaiong koasoiohte, ketihtihki, “Omw lidu, mehn Ipruo, me ke wadohng kitail, pedolong nan ei pere oh kapailokei ie.
Ahpw ni ei weriwer, e kesehlahte eh likowet, ih tangeila likio.”
Eri, en Sosep eh soumaso lingeringerda kowahlap.
Ih eri ale Sosep oh kihong nan imweteng, wasa me sapwellimen nanmwarki aramas selidi kan kin sensel ie. Sosep eri mihla nan imwetengo.
Ahpw KAUN-O ketin ieiangete Sosep, oh ketin kupwuramwahwihala, iei me kaunen imwetengo inenen perenkihla Sosep.
Ih eri kasapwiladahng Sosep en kin apwahpwalih tohnimwetengo koaros. Sosep eri kin pwukoahki mehkoaros me kin wiawi nan imwetengo.
Kaunen imwetengo sohte kin kedirepwki en Sosep pwukoa, pwe KAUN-O kin ketin ieiang Sosep pwe mehkoaros me e kin wia en pweida mwahu.
Kedekedeo, sounkohwahn wain, oh kaunen wia pilawahn nanmwarki, ira koaros kahngiangihada nanmwarkien Isip.
Parao eri engiengda pahra,
oh ketikihlong ira nan imweteng rehn kaunen silasil ko; wasaohte me Sosep wie sensel ie.
Kaunen silasilo eri kilelehiong Sosep pwe en papah ira. Irail ahpw mihmi nan imwetengo ahnsou reirei.
Pwohng ehu, sounkohwahn wain oh kaunen pilawahn nanmwarkio ira koaros ahpw ouramanda. Eri, wehwehn ara ouraman ko wekpeseng.
Sosep lao pedolong rehra nimengseng, e ahpw kasawihada ara mwomwen pahtou.
Ih eri idek rehra, “Dahkot mwo, maing ko, dahme kumwa mwomwen pahtouki rahnwet?”
Ira ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ahki kiht koaros se ouraman pwohng. Eri, sohte emen met me kak kawehwehiong kiht wehwehn at ouraman ko.” Sosep ahpw ndahng ira, “Koht kelehpw me kak ketin kawehwehda ouraman kan. Nna, kumwa ndadohng ie amwa ouraman kan.”
Sounkohwahn waino eri nda, “I ouraman me tuhkehn wain pwoat mi mwohi
me rah siluh mie. Ni tehntuhkeo eh pwerla oh wah, wahn wain akan eri mahla.
I wie kolokol sapwellimen Parao dahlo. I ahpw dolungete wahn wain ako, wengidediong nan dahlo, oh loangedahng Parao.”
Sosep ahpw ndaiong, “Eri, iet wehwehn ouramanen: rahn tuhkehn wain siluho wehwehki rahn siluh me luhwe.
Mwurin rahn siluh Parao pahn kasaledekeiukala, mahkohng uhk, oh kapwurehiong uhk nan deumw. Ke pahn loangedahng sapwellime dahl duwen me ke kin wia mahso, ni omw kin sounkohwahn wain.
A ke ahpw tamantaman ie nan omw paiamwahu, oh menlau kataman ie rehn nanmarkio, pwe en ketikihsang ie nan imweteng wet.
Pwe ngehi aramas emen me pirapodohsang nan sapwen mehn Ipru kan, oh lao lel met sohte mehkot I wiahda pwe re en keseiehlong nan imweteng wet.”
Eri, ni kaunen wie pilawa eh rongada duwen kawehwehpen ouramano eh mwahu, e ahpw pil ndahng Sosep, “Ngehi pil ouraman. Eri, iet duwe: I ouraman me kopwoun pilawa siluh poasoakehda pohn moangeiet.
Kopwou me keieu powe, inenen audaud en soangen kisin konot koaros, konot en Parao; ahpw menpihr kan wie kangkang.”
Sosep eri sapeng, nda, “Iet wehwe: kopwou siluho wehwehki rahn siluh me luhwe.
