Mwaren emenemen ohl ntingdi nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihong Moses; oh sang ni mahsen me KAUN-O wiahiong Moses, emenemen ohl kileldiongehr eh pwukoa ong ni doadoahk en papah de wisik dipwisou.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Koasoanediong mehn Israel kan re en kesehsang nan kahnimpwalo koaros me soumwahu tokutok oh me nahn kin pwilisang ni paliwere oh koaros me saminkilahr ar sairada aramas mehla.
Kadarala soangen aramas me samin ong kaudok pwukat koaros, pwe re dehr kasaminehla kahnimpwalo, wasa me I kin koukousoan ie rehn nei aramas akan.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kapwaiada oh keseirailsang nan kahnimpwalo.
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses
kaweid pwukat pwe en padahkihong mehn Israel ko. Ma aramas emen pahn soaloalopwoatohng KAUN-O oh wiahda mehkot sapwung ong emen,
e pahn sakarkihda eh sapwungo oh kapwungala ni unsek, patehng persent 20, ong aramas me e wiahiong sapwungo.
Ahpw ma aramaso melahr oh sohte kiseh me karanih me pweipweio kak kohieng, e pahn kohieng KAUN-O pwe en uhd kohieng samworo. Pweipwei wet pahn patehng meirong en sihpw wol me samworo kin wia pwehn kamwakelehda aramas dipan meno.
Pil duwehte kisakis kesempwal koaros me mehn Israel kin meirongkihong KAUN-O kin uhd kohieng pweisen samworo men me re kin kihong meirongo.
Emenemen samworo pahn tungoalenkihla meirong kan me kin kohieng.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en padakihong mehn Israel ko kaweid pwukat. Ma ohl emen pahn lemelemehkohng eh pwoud me dene e kin pitipitih oh kasaminehkilahr pein ih pwehki eh kapwaiada nsenen pwopwoud ong emen ohl tohrohr. Ahpw e sohte dehdehiong ohlo pwehki ele liho eh kin karkaririh—sohte sounkadehde, oh sohte me diarada eh wiewia tiahko. De ohl emen kak lemelemehkohng eh pwoud, mehnda ma liho sohte wia mehkot sapwung.
<range>
<range>
Eri, nan ire pwukat koaros ohlo pahn kahrelahng eh pwoud rehn samworo. E pil pahn wa kohla mehn meirong me koasoandier, paun riau en pilawa parli, ahpw e sohte pahn doaloahki lehn olip de warpwohmwau, pwehki eh wia meirong en ohl lemelemehk men, me men diarada dahme mehlel.
Samworo pahn kahrehla lih pwehn kesihnenda mwohn pei sarawio.
E pahn wudekihong pihl sarawi nan pwohl ehu oh ale pwehl sang nan taten Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale oh kihong nan pihlo.
Mwuri, e pahn sapwadpeseng pitenmoangen liho oh kihdiong nan pehn liho pilawa amas mehn meirong. Samworo ahpw pahn kolada pwohl me audauhdki pihl katiko mehn keriahla aramas.
Samworo ahpw pahn ndahng liho en pwungki kahula wet me samworo pahn wia, “Ma ke sohte wia dipen kamwahl, ke sohte pahn ale keria sang nan pihl wet.
Ahpw ma ke wiadahr dipen kamwahl,
KAUN-O en ketin wiahkihla edomwen mehn keria ieu rehn kisehmw kan. En ketin kupwurehda pwe omw wasa sarawien en wetikitikla oh kapehdomwen en mpwospeseng.
Pihl wet en kohlong nan kapehdomwen oh kamwpwosepeseng oh kanurpene omw wasa sarawien.” Liho ahpw pahn sapeng, nda, “Ei, I pwungki, kupwur en KAUN-O en pweida.”
Samworo ahpw pahn ntingihedi keria wet oh widensang ntingo nan pwohl en pihl katiko.
Mwohn eh pahn kihong liho en nim pihlo me pahn kak en kahrehiong weirek laud,
samworo pahn ale meirong en pilawa me mi nan pehn liho, oh kolada pwehn kasarawihong KAUN-O oh patohwandiong pohn pei sarawio.
E ahpw pahn ale ehu oaroahr en pilawao nin duwen kilel en meirong oh isikala pohn pei sarawio. Mwuhr e pahn kihong liho en nim pihlo.
Ma e wiahda dihp ong emen ohl tohrohr, pihlo pahn kahrehiong eh pahn weirek laud; kapehde pahn mpwospeseng oh eh wasa sarawio pahn nurpene. Ede pahn wiahla mehn keria rehn kiseh kan.
Ahpw ma e sohte dipada, e sohte pahn ale mehkot suwed oh e pahn kak neitik.
Ih duwen kosonned ong ohl akan me kin luwak oh lemelemehk me ar pwoud kan kin kamwahl. Liho pahn kesihnenda mwohn pei sarawio, samworo ahpw pahn wia sarawi wet.
<range>
Ohlo pahn saledeksang dihp, ahpw ma liho dipada, e pahn lokolongki dipeo.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en padahkihong mehn Israel ko kaweid pwukat. Ohl emen de lih emen me pahn wiahda inou en wiahla Nasaraid men oh kasarawihong pein ih KAUN-O
pahn mweisang nim wain oh pihru. E sohte pahn nim mehkot me wiawihsang kreip de kang kreip de reisin.
Nindokon eh wiewia Nasaraid men, e sohte pahn kang mehkot me kohsang ni tuhkehn kreip, mehnda ma were de kilin kreip.
Erein eh pahn mihmi nan eh inowo, e sohte pahn sehk pitenmoange de koakoahsang eh alis. E pahn kapwaiada eh inowo erein eh kasarawihong KAUN-O, oh e pahn kadarala pitenmoange oh eh alis.
Pitenmoange iei kilel en eh kasarawihong Koht, eri e sohte pahn kasaminehla pein ih ni eh pahn karanih aramas mehla men, mehnda ma eh pahpa de nohno, de rie.
<range>
Erein eh wiewia Nasaraid men, e kasarawihongehr KAUN-O.
Ma pitenmoangen Nasaraid men me kasarawilahr pahn saminkihla eh mihmi limwahn aramas emen me mwadangete mehla ni ahnsowohte; e pahn awih erein rahn isuh oh e ahpw pahn sehkasang pitenmoange oh eh alis, eri e ahpw pahn mwakelekella ong kaudok.
Ni kawaluh en rahn, e pahn wahla rehn samworo mwuroi riemen de pitsin riemen ni wenihmwen Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale.
Samworo ahpw pahn meirongkihla emen mwuroi ko pwehn wiahki meirong en dihpo oh emen mwuroi ko e pahn wiahki meirong isihs mehn kamwakelehsang samin en eh sairada aramas mehlao. Ni rahnohte aramaso pahn kasarawihala sapahl pitenmoangeo
oh tapihada sapahl eh mour en Nasaraid. Lepin ahnsou me e wiewiahki nasaraid mahs, solahr katepe, pwehki pitenmoange me kasarawilahro eh saminlahr. Pwehn wia meirong en kapwungala, e pahn wahdo emen sihmpwul me sounpar ehu.
Ni ahnsou me Nasaraid men pahn kanekelahr eh inou, e pahn wia sarawi. E pahn kohla ni wenihmwen Impwalo
oh patohwandahng KAUN-O mahn silimen me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail: emen sihmpwul wol me sounpar ehu mehn meirong isihs, emen sihmpwul lih me sounpar ehu mehn meirong en dihp, emen sihpw wol mehn meirong en kaminimin.
E pil pahn meirongkihla ehu kopwoun pilawa me sohte doal ihs: lopwon en pilawa mosul me doal lehn olip oh keik menipinip me lehn olip kohieng powe, oh pahn kapatahiong mepwukat meirong en wahnsahpw oh wain duwen me koasoandier en kin iang meirong kan.
Samworo ahpw pahn patohwandahng KAUN-O mepwukat oh wia meirong en dihp oh meirong isihs.
E pahn meirongkihla sihpw wolo ong KAUN-O nin duwen meirong en kaminimin, iangahki kopwoun pilawao; e pahn pil patohwandahng meirong en wahnsahpw oh wain.
Nasaraido ahpw pahn sehkasang pitenmoange ni wenihmwen Impwalo oh isikala nan kisiniei en meirong en kaminimin me wie lullulo.
Mwuhr, ni tihnsewen sihpw wolo eh pwoailehr, samworo pahn ale oh kihong nan pehn Nasaraido, iangahki ehu lopwon en pilawa mosul oh keik menipinip sang nan kopwowo.
Mwuri, samworo pahn patohwandahng KAUN-O nin duwen kisakis kesempwal ehu; me wialahr meirong sarawi me pahn kohieng samworo, iangahki mwaremware oh neh me pahn kohieng pweisen samworo nin duwen kosonned. Mwurin met, Nasaraido kakehr nim wain.
Ih met kosonned kan me pid Nasaraid kan; ahpw ma Nasaraid men inoukihda en kihda meirong ehu me laud sang uwen me koasoandi ong eh inowo, e pahn kapwaiada inou me e wiadahro.
Eri, KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en padahkihong Aaron oh nah pwutak kan re en wia kapakap en kapai pwukat ni ahnsou me re pahn kapakapki mehn Israel kan:
KAUN-O en ketin kupwuramwahwih kumwail oh apwahpwalih kumwail;
KAUN-O en ketin kamarainihkin kumwail silangi oh kupwureikumwail:
KAUN-O en ketin kasalehda sapwellime kupwurkalahngan ong kumwail oh ketikihong kumwail popohl.
KAUN-O pil ketin mahsanih, “Ma re pahn kin kapaiakihda mehn Israel kan mwarei, eri I pahn kin kapaiairailda.”
Ni rahn me Moses kaimwisekala kokoudahn Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale, e ahpw keiehla oh kasarawihala Impwalo iangahki dipwisawi kan koaros oh pil pei sarawio iangahki dipwisawi kan koaros.
Soupeidi en peneinei kan me wia kaunen kadaudok en Israel, iei irail ko me pil iang kaunda aramas akan me wadawadier,
irail ahpw patohwanda ar mehn meirong kan ong KAUN-O: kuruma weneu oh kou ehk riemen, ehu kuruma ong kaun riemen oh kou men ong kaun emen. Mwurin ar wapenehr dipwisou pwukat,
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses,
“Ale meirong pwukat me pahn wia doadoahk ong ni Impwalo; ke ahpw kihong mehn Lipai kan pwehn wia doadoahk me re pahn wia.”
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Lipai ko kuruma ko oh kou ko.
E kihong mehn Kerson kuruma riau oh kou pahmen,
oh kuruma pahieu oh kou welimen ong mehn Merari. Ar doadoahk koaros pahn kin wiawi pahn epwelpen Idamar, nein samworo Aaron.
Ahpw Moses sohte kihong mehn Kohad kuruma de kou, pwehki ar pahn kapaik dipwisou sarawi ko me re kin pwukoahki apwalih.
Kaun akan pil patohwanpene meirong kei mehn iang wia kasarawihpen pei sarawio. Ni ar onopadahr re en patohwanda ar meirong kan ni pei sarawio,
KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Moses, “Patohwanohng irail me erein rahn eisek riau irekweite emenemen kaun pahn wahdo eh kisakis en kasarawih pei sarawiet.”
Irail eri patohwando ar meirong kan nin duwe met: Kisakis kan me emenemen patohwanda soahngteieu, me iei: ehu pwohl silper me toutouki ouns 50 oh ehu peisin silper me toutouki ouns 30 nin duwen me koasoandier, koaros diren pilawa doal leh mehn wia meirong en wahnsahpw; ehu dahl kohl me toutouki ouns 4, diren warpwohmwahu; emen koupwul wol, emen sihpw wol, oh emen sihmpwul me sounpar ehu, mehn wia meirong isihs; emen kuht, mehn meirong en dihp; oh pil kou wol riemen, sihpw wol limmen, kuht limmen oh sihmpwul limmen me sounpar ehu, mehn wia meirong en kaminimin.

Iet kan uwen tohtohn mehn meirong me kaun ehk riemeno wapene mehn wia kasarawihpen pei sarawio:
<range>
<range>
<range>
<range>
Ni ahnsou me Moses patohla nan Impwalo pwehn patohong KAUN-O, e ahpw rongada duwen KAUN-O e ketin mahmahseniong sang pohn pweinen Kohpwahn Inowo nanpwungen kerup riemeno.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Padahkihong Aaron me ni eh pahn kin koasoanehdi lamp isuh ko nan dewen lampo, en koasoanehdi pwe marain en kin dakerada mwohn dewen lampo.”
Aaron eri kapwaiada oh koasoanehdi lamp ako pwe en sohpeiong dewen lampo.
Dewen lampo pwon wiawihda sang kohl sukusukda nin duwen mwohmw me KAUN-O ketin kasalehiong Moses.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Katohrehsang mehn Lipai kan sang rehn mehn Israel teikan oh kamwakeleirailda
nin duwe met: usupihkin irail pilen kamwakel oh re en sihpih wasa koaros ni paliwararail kan oh lopworada ar likou kan. Ih duwen ar pahn mwakelekella ong kaudok.
Re ahpw pahn ale emen koupwul wol iangahki mehn meirong en wahnsahpw me doal lehn olip; a kowe, ke pahn pil ale emen kouwol mehn wia meirong en dihp.
Mehn Lipai ko ahpw pahn patohdahdo mwohn Impwalo, wasa ke pahn kapokonepene ie mehn Israel kan koaros.
Eri mehn Israel kan pahn kidahng pehrail kan pohn moangen mehn Lipai kan,
oh Aaron ahpw pahn kasarawihong ie mehn Lipai kan nin duwen kisakis kesempwal ehu sang rehn mehn Israel kan, pwe re en wia ei doadoahk.
Mehn Liapi kan ahpw pahn kidahng pehrail kan pohn moangen kouwol riemeno; emen mehn wia meirong en dihp, oh emen mehn wia meirong isihs, pwehn wia tiahk sarawien kamwakel ong mehn Lipai kan.
“Kasarawihala mehn Lipai kan pwe re en wia kisakis tohrohr ehu ong ie, oh kihong Aaron oh nah pwutak kan en kin apwahpwali irail.
Eri ih duwen omw pahn katohrehsang mehn Lipai kan sang rehn mehn Israel teikan, pwe re en wiahla nei.
Mwurin omw pahn kamwakelehda oh kasarawihala mehn Lipai kan, re pahn kakehr doadoahk nan Impwalo.
I nainekiniraillahr wiliandi nein mehn Israel kan nair mesenih pwutak koaros oh re wialahr nei kelehpw.
Ni ei kemehla mesenihen mehn Isip ko, I kasarawihalahr mesenih pwutak koaros en peneineien Israel oh mesenih koaros en nair mahn akan pwe re en wiahla nei.
Eri, met I nainekilahr mehn Lipai kan wiliandi mesenihen mehn Israel kan,
eri I ketikihongehr Aaron oh nah pwutak ko mehn Lipai kan, pwe re en wia kisakis ehu sang mehn Israel kan, me pahn wiliandi mehn Israel oh doadoahk nan Impwalo oh sinsile irail sang apwal me pahn lelohng irail ma re pahn kin keidohng limwahn Wasa Sarawio.”
Eri Moses, Aaron oh mehn Israel koaros ahpw kasarawihala mehn Lipai ko, nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses.
Mehn Lipai ko eri pein kamwakeleirailda oh lopworada ar likou kan, Aaron ahpw kasarawihirailla nin duwen kisakis tohrohr ehu ong KAUN-O. E pil wia sarawien kamwakeleirailda.
Mehn Israel ko eri kapwaiada mehkoaros me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses me pid duwen mehn Lipai ko. Eri mehn Lipai ko kakehr doadoahk nan Impwalo pahn kaweidpen Aaron oh nah pwutak ko.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Mehn Lipai koaros me sang sounpar rieisek limau pahn kin wia arail pwukoa kan nan Impwal me I pahn kin ketiket laole,
oh re pahn kommoaldi ni ar pahn lel sounpar limeisek.
Mwurin met re kak sewese mehn Lipai teikan ni ar pwukoa kan nan Impwalo, ahpw re sohte pahn kelehpw wia sarawi. Ih duwen met omw pahn koasoanehdi en mehn Lipai kan ar doadoahk.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses nan Sapwtehn Sainai ni keieun sounpwong en keriaun pahr mwurin mehn Israel ko ar mweselsang Isip, e mahsanih,
“Ni kaeisek pahieun rahn en sounpwong wet, tepida nin soutik, mehn Israel kan pahn wia Sarawien Pahsohpa nin duwen koasoandi koaros en sarawi wet.”
<range>
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Israel ko re en wiahda Sarawien Pahsohpa,
oh nin soutik en kaeisek pahieun rahn ni keieun sounpwong re ahpw wiahda sarawio nan Sapwtehn Sainai. Re wiahda soahng koaros nin duwen me KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses.
Ahpw mie aramas ekei me samin ong kaudok, pwehki ar sairada aramas mehla, irail eri sohte kak iang wia Sarawien Pahsohpa rahno. Re ahpw patohla rehn Moses oh Aaron
oh patohwanohng ira, “Se me samin pwehki at sairada aramas mehla, ahpw dahme se sohte pahn iangki mehn Israel kan patohwandahng KAUN-O at tungoal meirong?”
Moses ahpw sapengkin irail, “Kumwail awih I lao ale kaweid sang rehn KAUN-O.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses
en patohwanohng mehn Israel ko, “Ni ahnsou me emen mehn Israel de emen kadaudoke kan pahn saminla pwehki eh sairada aramas mehla de e seiseiloakseli wasa doh, ahpw e men iang wia Sarawien Pahsohpa,
e mweimweiong en iang wia sarawio ahpw mwurin sounpwoung ehu, nin soutik en kaeisek pahieun keriaun sounpwong. Soangen aramas menet pahn wia sarawio ni eh pahn tungoale pilawa me sohte doal ihs oh dihpw katik.
Sohte mehkot pahn luwehdi sang ni kisin tungoal pwukat ong manda sang rahno oh sohte tih pwoat rehn mahno pahn katipwitimwpeseng. Re pahn kapwaiada koasoandi koaros en Pahsohpa.
Ahpw mehmen me mwakelekel ong kaudok oh sohte seiseiloakseli wasa doh, ahpw sohte iang kapwaiada Pahsohpa, e solahr pahn iang wia kisehn nei aramas akan, pwehki eh sohte iang patohwandahng ie meirong ni ahnsou me kileldi. Aramas meno pahn pwukoahki eh sapwung.
“Ma mehn liki men me kin koukousoan rehmwail men iang wia Sarawien Pahsohpa, e pahn iang wia nin duwen koasoandi koaros en Sarawien Pahsohpa. Koasoandi ehute me pahn doadoahk ong aramas koaros, ong mehn liki de pwilidak kan.”
Eri, rahn me Impwal me KAUN-O pahn kin ketiket loale eh kokouda, pelien depwek pali ahpw pwarada oh kipehdi. Nipwong, depweko kin mwomwen mpwulen kisiniei.
<range>
Ni ahnsou me pelien depweko kin mwekidida, mehn Israel ko kin mweselda; oh wasa me e kin uhdi ie, re pil kin uhdi oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan.
Sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O re kin mwekidwei, oh sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O re kin uhdi. Re kin mihmihte wasatehkis erein pelien depweko eh kin mihmi pohn Impwalo.
Eri, ma pelien depweko pahn kin mihmi werei pohn Impwalo, mehn Israel ko kin peikiong KAUN-O oh sohte kin mwekidwei.
Ekei ahnsou pelien depweko kin mihmihki pohn Impwalo rahnte depe; ahpw mehnda, re kin mihmihte de mwekidida sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ekei ahnsou pelien depweko kin mihmihte sang nin soutik lel nimenseng; eri, aramas ako kin mwesel ni ahnsou me e kin mwekidida. Mehnda ma ni rahn de nipwong, ahpw re kin mweselda ni ahnsou me pelien depweko kin mwekidida.
Mehnda ma e mihmihki rahn riau, de sounpwong ehu, de sounpar ehu, de pil reireisang, erein pelien depweko eh kin mihmi pohn Impwalo, aramas akan sohte kin mweselda; a ni eh pahn mwekidida, re ahpw kin mweselda.
Eri, re kin kauwada imwarail impwal, oh re kin kihdihsang oh mweselda, nin duwen koasoandi kan me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Wiahkihda sowi riau silper sukusukda, mehn doadoahk pwehn kin kapokonepene aramas akan oh pwehn wia kilel en mweselda.
Ahnsou me sowi riau wet pahn pepeuk ni ngihl reirei, mehn Israel koaros pahn pokonpene rehmw ni wenihmwen Impwal me I kin ketiket loale.
Ahpw ahnsou me sowi teieu pahn pepeuk, kaunen peneinei kante me pahn pokonpene rehmw.
Ni pepeuk mwotomwot ehu, e pahn wia kilel pwe kadaudok kan me imwarail impwal kan mi ni palimese en mwekidida oh mwesel.
Ni pepeuk mwotomwot keriapak, kilel pwe kadaudok en palieir kan re en mwekidida oh mwesel. Eri pepeuk mwotmwot kan pahn wia kilel en mwekidida oh mweselda,
a pepeuk reirei pahn kin wia kilel en kapokonepene aramas akan.
Nein samworo Aaron nah pwutak kan me pahn kin peuk sowi kan. “Koasoandi wet pahn poatopoat sang met kohkohlahte.
Ni ahnsoun mahwen nan sapwamwail kan, ni amwail pahn kin doandoare pein kumwail sang amwail imwintihti kan me pahn kin mahweniong kumwail, kumwail peuk sowi kan, Eri ngehi, KAUN-O, amwail Koht, pahn sewesei kumwail oh doarehsang kumwail amwail imwintihti kan.
Ni amwail mwekid kaperen kan, ni Sarawien Maram Pwul oh rahn sarawi teikan, kumwail pahn pil kin peuk sowi kan ni ahnsou me kumwail pahn patohwanda amwail meirong isihs kan oh meirong en kaminimin kan. I ahpw pahn sewesei kumwail. Ngehi KAUN-O, amwail Koht.”
Ni kerieisek en rahn en sounpwong keriau nan sounpahr keriau mwurin mehn Israel ko ar mweselsang Isip, pelien depweko me kin uh pohn Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale pa mwekidida sang powe.
Mehn Israel ko eri mweselda nan ar seiloak sang nan Sapwtehn Sainai. Pelien depweko eri uhdi pohn sapwtehn en Paran.
Irail tapihada mwekid nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin koasoanediong Moses,
eri ni ahnsou koaros me re kin pwurehng mweselda, re kin wia soangen mwekidteieu. Irail kan me mi pahn pilaik en pwihnlap en kadaudok en Suda me kin tieng oh Nahson, nein Aminadap, me kaunda.
Nedanel, nein Suar, ih me kaunen kadaudok en Isakar,
oh Eliap, nein Elon, ih me kaunen kadaudok en Sepulon.
Eri, Impwalo pahn kin kamweremwerdi, oh peneineien Kerson oh Merari me kin wa, pahn mweselda.
Mwuhr irail kan me mi pahn pilaik en pwihnlap en kadaudok en Reupen, pahn mweselda oh Elisur, nein Sedeur, me kaunda.
Selumiel, nein Surisadai me kaunda kadaudok en Simion,
oh Eliap, nein Deuel me kaunda kadaudok en Kad.
Mwuhr peneineien Kohad mehn Lipai ahpw pahn mweselda wa dipwisou sarawi ko. Ni ahnsou me re kin lellahng wasa me re pahn kin pwurehng kommoaldi ie, Impwalo pahn kin kokoudahr sapahl wasao.
Mwuri, irail kan me mi pahn pilaik en pwihnlap en kadaudok en Epraim ahpw pahn mwekid oh Elisama, nein Ammihud, me kaunda.
Kamaliel, nein Pedasur, me kaunda kadaudok en Manase,
oh Apidan, nein Kideoni, me kaunda kadaudok en Pensamin.
Me keieu mwesel mwuhr, irail kan me mi pahn pilaik en pwihnlap en kadaudok en Dan, me wia silepen pwihnlap kan koaros me mi mwuhr, ahpw pahn mweselda oh Ahieser, nein Amisadai, me kaunda.
Pakiel, nein Okran, me kaunda kadaudok en Aser,
oh Aira, nein Enan, me kaunda kadaudok en Napdali.
Eri ih duwen met, koasoandien kapar ong pwihn kan, ahnsou koaros me mehn Israel kan kin kamwerepeseng imwarail impwal kan oh mweselda.
Moses eri patohwanohng en rie lih eh pwoud Opap, nein Sedro mehn Midian, “Kita pahn mwesel kohkolahng wasa me KAUN-O ketin mahsanih e pahn ketikihong kitail. E ketin inoukihda me e pahn ketin kapaiahda Israel; eri kohdo iangkitada pwe ke en iang ahneki at pai.”
Opap ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Soh, I sohte pahn iang kumwail, pwe I pahn pwuralahng nan uhdakeio.”
Moses ahpw ndalahng, “Menlau ke dehr kohkoweisang reht. Ke ese wasa se kak kauwada ie at impwal akan nan sapwtehnet, ke kak kaweidkin kiht.
Ma ke pahn iangkitala, ke pahn iang kiht ahnekihla pai kan me KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwurehiong kiht.”
Mehn Israel ko eri mweselsang nin nahna sarawi Sainai, re ahpw seiseiloak erein rahn siluh. Sapwellimen KAUN-O Kohpwahn Inowo kin tieng ahnsou koaros pwe en rapahkihong irail wasa me re pahn kin kommoaldi ie.
Ni arail kin mweselsang wasahn kommoal koaros, pelien depwek en KAUN-O kin mihmi pohrail ni rahn.
Eri, ahnsou koaros me Kohpwahn Inowo kin mwekidida, Moses kin patohwan, “Maing KAUN, komw ketida oh kamwarakpeseng sapwellimomwi imwintihti kan pwe irail kan me kin kailongkin komwi en tangpeseng mwohmwi.”
A ni depweko eh kin uhdi, Moses kin patohwan, “Maing KAUN, komw ketido nan peneinei en Israel pwukat me ngedehrie, me soh kak wadawad.”
Aramas ako ahpw kaulimkihla ar apwal akan oh lipahnedihada KAUN-O. Eri, ni eh ketin karongehda, e ahpw engiengda kowahlap. Kisiniei en KAUN-O eri lulda nanpwungarail oh kamwasikehla apalien ar kahnimpwalo.
Aramas ako eri likwerih Moses pwe en sewese irail. Moses ahpw kapakapohng KAUN-O, kisinieio eri kunla.
Irail eri kihong eden wasao Taperah, pwehki kisiniei en KAUN-O eh luldahng irail wasao.
Mie mehn liki kei me iangala mehn Israel ko. Aramas pwukat eri tapihada ar inengieng tungoale uduk, oh mehn Israel ko pil iang irail kaulimala, ndinda, “Ihs me kak kihong kitail uduk pwe kitail en tungoale?
Tamanda kisin mwahmw ko me kitail kin tungoale, sohte pwain, nan Isip; iangahki kiuhri, wasmelen, anien, oh karlik!
A met, kitail inenen luwetalahr. Sohte mehkot kanatail pwe mannate rahn koaros!”
(Manna duwehte kisin weren wahntuhke kan, ahpw mwomwe me oangoang pohpwetepwet.
E kin iang pwoaik mweredi nipwong nan kahnimpwalo. Aramas ako ahpw kin kohseli oh rikpene nimenseng, re kin sukpene pwe re en pwoailihada nan einpwoat oh wiahkihda kisin pankeik kei. Nemeneme duwehte pilawa umw me doal lehn olip.)
<range>
Moses ahpw rongada en aramas ako ar kaukaulim, ni arail kin tuhpene ni wenihmwen imwarail impwal kan. E ahpw pahtoula pwehki KAUN-O eh ketin engiengda pahrail.
E ahpw patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Dahme komw ketin wiakauwekinielahr? Dahme komwi solahr kupwurperenkiniehki? Dahme komw ketin kapwukoahkin ie epwelipen aramas pwukat koaros?
Kaidehkin ngehi me kapikirailda de kaipwidiong irail nin sampah. Dahme komw ketin kupwurehkihong ie I en wairailla duwehte sounepwel seri men oh tupwengeirailda duwehte seri pwelel kolahng nan sahpwo me komw ketin inoukihong ar pahpa kahlap ako?
I pahn kihsang ia uduk pwe I en kak katungoalehki soangen aramas pokon wet? Re kin kalap sengiseng oh pekipeki kanarail uduk.
I sohte kak kelehpw pwukoahki epwelpen aramas pwukat koaros, e me nohn toutou ong ie!
Ma ih duwen kupwuromwi en met, a komw ketin kemeiehla; pwe I en sohla mi pahn sapwellimomwi engienget.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Kapokonepene kaun isiakan me keniken pahn arams akan; oh kahreiraildohng ie ni ei Impwalo, pwe re en kesihnenda mpomw.
I pahn ketidihdo oh mahseniong uhk wasao. I pahn kikihsang ekis manaman en ngehn me I ketikihong uhk oh ketikihong irail. Eri, re pahn kakehr iang uhk apwahpwalih aramas pwukat; eri, ke solahr pahn kelekelepwkin irail.
Eri, padahkihong aramas akan, ‘Kumwail kamwakeleikumwailda ong lakapw, pwe kumwail pahn tungoale uduk. Pwe KAUN-O karongedahr amwail sengiseng oh ndinda me kumwail men tungoale uduk, oh me dene mourimwail nan Isip me mwahu. Eri, KAUN-O pahn ketikihong kumwail kanamwail uduk, oh kumwail uhdahn pahn tungoale.
Kumwail pahn tungoale, kaidehkinte rahn ehu de riau, rahn limau de eisek, kaidehkin pil rahn rieisek,
pwe erein sounpwong ehu pwon, kumwail lao pahn sangatkihda oh sohla men ned pwowe. Met pahn wiawi pwehki amwail kesehla KAUN-O me kin ketiket rehmwail oh kaulimala oh ndinda dahme kumwail kohkihdohsang Isip.’”
Moses eri patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Mie met aramas 600,000, a komw ketin mahsanih me komw pahn katungoalehkin irail uduk erein sounpwong ehu pwon?
Ma kou koaros oh sihpw koaros pahn kamakamala, e pahn itarohng irail? Ma mwahmw akan koaros en nansed pahn lohdi, e pahn itarohng irail?”
KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Moses, “Ia duwe, mie irepen ei manaman? Ke pahn mwadang kilang ma ei koasoi pahn pweida de soh!”
Moses eri kohieila oh patohwanohng aramas ako dahme KAUN-O mahsanih. E kapokonepene ohl isiakan sang rehn kaun akan; e ahpw koasoaneiraildi kapilkipene Impwalo.
KAUN-O eri ketidihdo nan pelien depwek pali oh mahseniong Moses. E ahpw ketikihsang ekis manaman en ngehn me e ketin audehkihda Moses mahso, oh ketikihong kaun isiakano. Eri, ni ngehno eh ti pohrail re ahpw tapihada kokohp ni ngihl laud; eri, re pil mwadangete tokedi.
Eri, kaun riemen, sang rehn kaun isiakano, me adaneki Eldad oh Medad, ira sohte iang kohla ni Impwalo, ira mihmihte nan kahnimpwalo. Ahpw wasao, nan kahimpwalo, ngehno pil ti pohra; eri, ira pil iang tapihada kokohp ni ngihl laud.
Mwahnakapw emen eri tenge Moses pwe en kehsehki dahme Eldad oh Medad wiewia.
Eri, Sosua, nein Nun, me papah Moses sang ni eh tikitik, ahpw ndalahng Moses, “Maing, komw katokeirahdi!”
Moses ahpw sapengki, “Dah? Kowe me pahn kaweid ie? I ahpw men KAUN-O en ketin audehki aramas koaros sapwellime ngehn pwe re en pil kokohp ni ngihl laud!”
Moses oh kaun isiakano eri pwuralahng ni kahnimpwalo.
Eri, mwurin met, kisinieng ehu ahpw kohda sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O; e ahpw ipirodohng nan kahnimpwalo lapalahn pelin kulu ieu, me kin pipihrseli piht siluh sang pohn pwehl. Re ahpw sokedi pohn kahnimpwalo oh pil pohn sahpw lel mwail kei pali koaros.
Aramas ako eri soupisengkihla ar rikirikpene kulu ko ni rahno pwon, nipwongo pwon, oh pil manda sang rahno. Eri, me keieu malaulau me emen rikada, kohpwa laud limeisek. Re ahpw palangada pahn ketipin kapilpene kahnimpwalo.
Eri, nindokon arail tungoal udungko eh saikinte rosala, KAUN-O ahpw engiengda pahn aramas ako oh ketin kalokehkin irail soumwahu lusulus ehu.
Iei me wasao adanekihla Kiprod Attapa (me wehwehki “Sousoun Mehwo kei”), pwehki ar sarepedi wasao aramas ako me mehwokihda uduk.
Mehn Israel ko eri mweselsang wasao, mwesellahng Aserod, wasa re kauwada ie imwarail impwal ko.
Eri, Miriam oh Aaron ahpw tapihada lipahnedih Moses, pwehki eh pwoudikihda lihen Kus men.
Ira eri nda, “Pwe dah? Moseste me KAUN-O ketin mahseniong? E soh pil mahsenihong kita?” KAUN-O eri ketin karongehda ara lipahnedo.
(Moses, iei ohl aktikitik men, me keieu aktikitik rehn aramas en sampah kan.)
Ni ahnsowohte, KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Moses, Aaron oh Miriam, “I men kumwail silimenen en kohdo ni ei Impwalo.” Irail eri patohla.
KAUN-O eri ketidihdo nan pelien depwek pali, e ahpw ket ni ewen Impwalo oh malipe Aaron oh Miriam. Ira eri patohla.
A KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, “Kumwa rong ei koasoi kat! Ma mie soukohp kei rehmwail, I pahn kasalehiong irail pein Ngehi nan kaudiahl, I pahn mahseniong irail nan ouraman.
E pahn wekisang duwen ei kin mahseniong nei laduwen Moses, pwe I ketikihongehr en pwukoahki epwelpen nei aramas en Israel koaros.
Eri, I kin mahseniong sang ni silangi, ni sansal, kaidehn ni mwohmw. E kilang ei lingan! Eri, ia duwen amwa kak kommwad en lipahnedih ei ladu Moses?”
KAUN-O ketin engiengda pahrail; ih eri ketiketlahsang irail
oh pelin depweko sohrasang pohn Impwalo, kilin Miriam ahpw tokutokla duwehla sinoh. Ni Aaron eh kilangada eh tokutoklahr,
e ahpw patohwanohng Moses, “Maing, menlau komw dehr kapwukoahkin kiht kalokolok en dihp me se patohwan wiadahr nan at rotorot.
Komw dehr mweidohng lih menet en wiahla mehkot me ipwidi sohte mwomwe pwehki elep paliwere eh mwengesangehr.”
Moses eri ngil laudida patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Maing Koht, komw kupwure oh ketin kamwahwihala liho!”
KAUN-O eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma eh pahpao kendipiong ni mese, e pahn namenekla erein rahn isuh. Eri en lekdeksang nan kahnimpwalen erein rahn isuh; mwuri e kak kapwurupwurdo.”
Miriam eri katohrohralahsang nan kahnimpwalo erein rahn isuh, eri aramas akan sohte mweselda e lao kapwurpwurdo nan kahnimpwalo.
Irail eri mweselsang Aserod oh kohla kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan sapwtehn en Paran.
KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses,
“Pilada emen kaun sang ni ehuehu kadaudok eisek riaun Israel kan oh kadarirailewei nan Kenan, nin duwen lipoahrok kei, pwe re en kasawih oh dawih sahpwo me I pahn kihong mehn Israel kan.”
Moses eri kapwaiada oh kadarala lipoahrok pwukat sang ni sapwtehn en Paran:.

Ih met kan lipoahrok kan me Moses kadarala pwehn kasawih oh dawih sahpwo. Eh ahpw kihong Osea, nein Nun, mwar kapw ehu, iei Sosua.
Ni ahnsou me Moses kadarirailla, e patohwanohng irail, “Kumwail pahn keidwei paliepeng kolahng palieir en Kenan oh mwuhr keidwei pohn sahpw dohl kan.
Kumwail ahpw kilang soangen sahpw da ieu mwo, aramas depe me mihmi mwo oh ma re me kehlail.
Kumwail pil kilang ma sahpwo me kaselel de sakanakan oh ma aramas ako kin kousoan nansapw de nan kelen mahwen.
Pil kadehde ma pwelen sahpwo me mwahu oh ma mie tuhke tohto wasao. Kumwail pil wahdo ekei wahntuhke me kin keirda wasao.” (Ahnsowo iei ahnsoun pwerlahn wahn kreip.)
Ohl ako eri keidla paliepeng oh dawih sahpwo sang nan sapwtehn en Sin ni palieir lao lel Rehop, limwahn Wasahn Kot en Amad ni paliepeng.
Re keidla ni palieir en sahpwo oh lel Epron, wasa me peneineien Aiman, Sesai, oh Talmai, kadaudok en kodon ko me adaneki mehn Anak kin kousoan ie. (Epron kokouda sounpar isuh mwohn Soan nan Isip.)
Irail ahpw lel nan Wahun Eskol, re ahpw pelehdi wasao rahntuhke kreip ehu me emwiemwin oh toutou, kahrehda ohl riemen me iniehda. Re pil wa pwurodo pwohmakraneid kei oh wahn pik kei.
(Wasao adanekihla Wahun Eskol pwehki emwin kreip me mehn Israel ko wahsang wasao.)
Eri, mwurin rahn pahisek lipoahrok ko ahpw pwurodo sang ar dawih sahpwo;
re ahpw pwurodo rehn Moses, Aaron oh pokon en mehn Israel ko nan Kades nan sapwtehn en Paran. Re ahpw koasoiaiong ira oh mehn Israel ko duwen dahme re kilang, oh re pil kasalehiong irail wahnsahpw ako me re wahdo sang nan sahpwo.
Eri, iei koasoi me re wiahiong Moses; “Se lel nan sahpw me komw ketin kadarkitalahng ie. Sahpwo me audapan oh pwelmwahu, oh iet ekei wahnsahpwo.
Ahpw towe kan me inenen kehlail, oh kahnimw kan me laud oh inenen kelpene mwahu. Se pil kilangada wasao aramas akan me kadaudok en kodon ko.
Mehn Amalek kin mihmi ni palieir; mehn Id, mehn Sepus oh mehn Amor kin mihmi ni wasa nahnahn kan; oh mehn Kenan kin mihmi limwahn Sehd Mediderenien oh ni keilen Pillap Sordan.”
Kalep eri oale irail en nennenla mwohn Moses, e ahpw nda, “Nna, kitail mwadang kohla mahweniong oh sapwenikihla sahpwo; pwe kitail uhdahn kak en kalowehdi.”
Ahpw ohl ako me iang ih kohla, ahpw ketihtihki, “Soh! Kitail sohte kak mahweniong tohnsahpw pwukat, pwe re inenen kehlail sang kitail.”
Eri, arail koasoi ong mehn Israel ko duwen sahpw me re dawih oh kasawih me likamw. Re ahpw nda, “Wahnsahpw akan nan sahpwo sohte itarohng kamwenge towe kan. Aramas koaros me se kilangada wasa ko inenen reirei,
oh se pil kilangada kodon kei wasao, me kadaudok en Anak, likamwete kiht mensiek uwen ar lapala.”
Eri, pwohng ehu pwon aramas ako sengisengki ar pwunod.
Re ahpw lipahnedihada Moses oh Aaron, ketihtihki, “Me pahn mwahu atail mehlahte nan Isip de nan sapwtehn wet!
Dahme KAUN-O ketikinkitaildohki nan sahpw wet? Kitail uhdahn pahn mehla nan mahwen; eri, atail pwoud kan oh neitail seri kan pahn wiahla dipwisou me lohdi mahwen. Atail pwuralahng Isip soh pahn mwahusang met?”
Irail eri tapihada ndapene, “Nna, kitail pilada emen me pahn kapwureikitailahng Isip.”
Eri, Moses oh Aaron ahpw poaridi nanpwel mwohn pokon en mehn Israel ko.
Oh riemen lipoahrok ko, me dawih sahpwo, Sosua, nein Nun, oh Kalep, nein Sepune, ahpw tehrpeseng ara likou ko, uwen ara nsensuwed,
ira eri ndalahng aramas ako, “Sahpw me se dawihero iei sahpw mwahu ehu.
Ma KAUN-O ketin kupwurei kitail, e pahn ketin kahluwaikitaillahng nan sahpw kaselel wet oh ketikihong kitail.
Eri, kumwail dehr kahngohdiong KAUN-O. Kumwail dehr masak tohnsahpw wet; me mengei kitail en kaloweiraildi. KAUN-O pahn ketin ieiang kitail. E ketin kamwomwala ar koht akan, mehn doareparail. Kumwail dehr masak!”
Ahpw pokono wie songosong en katehkin ira takai lao ira mehla; a ni ahnsowohte lingaling en KAUN-O pa sansalda pohn Impwalo.
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “Ia erein aramas pwukat ar pahn mwamwahlikin ie? Ia erein ar pahn kahng kamehlele ie, ni ei wiadahr manaman tohtohie mwohn masarail kan?
Eri, I pahn kalokehkin irail soumwahu lusulus ehu pwe en kemeirailla. A kowe, I pahn wiahkin uhk wehi kapw ehu, wehi ehu me pahn lapalapasang oh tohtohsang irail.”
Moses ahpw sapeng KAUN-O, patohwan, “Komwi me ketikihsang aramas pwukat nan Isip ni manaman lapalap en nin limomwi. A ni mehn Isip ar pahn rong dahme komw ketin wiahiong sapwellimomwi aramas pwukat,
re soh pahn patohwanohng tohnsahpw wet? Pwe re pil iangehr rong duwen komwi, Maing KAUN, duwen omwi kin ketin ieiang kiht, duwen omwi kin ketin pwarada ni sansal mwohn masat ni ahnsou me sapwellimomwi pelien depweko eh kin uhdi poht, oh pil duwen omwi kin ketieng mwoht ni rahn ni mwomwen uhr depwek oh nipwong ni mwomwen uhr kisiniei.
Eri, ma komw pahn ketin kemehla sapwellimomwi aramas pwukat koaros, tohnwehi kan me rongehr duwen omwi ndand, pahn patohwan,
‘KAUN-O sohte eh manaman pwe en ketikihong sapwellime aramas akan nan sahpw me e ketin inoukihong irail; ihme kahrehda e ketin kauwehkinirailla nan sapwtehn.’
Eri, Maing KAUN, komw ketin kasalehda roson en sapwellimomwi manaman, oh wiahda dahme komw ketin inoukihong kiht ni sapwellimomwi mahsen wet,
‘Ngehi me KAUN-O, eri, I kin kanengamah oh kalahngan oh limpoak poatopoat; I kin mahkikihong dihp oh suwed en aramas; ahpw I pahn kaloke seri kan lel dih kesiluh oh kapahieu pwehki dipen ar pahpa oh nohno kan.’
Eri, komw ketin kupwurkalahngan mahkikihong dipen aramas pwukat, duwen me konehng omwi limpoak lapalap oh poatopoat, nin duwen omwi ketin wiahiongirailehr sang ni ar mweselsang wehin Isip.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Eri, I pahn mahkohng irail duwen me ke pekien.
Ahpw I kahukihla ni mwarei oh pil ni ei lingaling me kin kadirehla sampah,
me sohte emen nanpwungen aramas pwukat pahn pedolong nan sapwen inowo. Re kilangehr ei lingaling oh pil manaman akan me I wiadahr nan Isip oh pil nan sapwtehno; irail ahpw uhwong ie pak tohto oh sohte peikiong ie.
Eri, re sohte pahn pedolong nan sahpw wet me I inoukihong ar pahpa kahlap ako, sohte emen irail me mwamwahlikin ie pahn iang pedolong loale.
Ahpw ei ladu Kalep kasalehda ehu soangen mour tohrohr oh e kin loalopwoatohng ie; ihme I pahn kahluwahng ih nan sahpw me e dawih oh kasawih, oh kadaudoke kan pahn sapwenikihla
wasa patapat akan, wasa me mehn Amalek oh mehn Kenan kin kousoan ie met. Eri, lakapw kumwail mwesel oh pwurala nan sapwtehn kolahng ni Sehd Weitahta.”
Eri, KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron,
“Ia erein pokon en aramas suwed pwukat ar pahn lipilipahnede ie? I pwahngahkidahr rongorong ar kaulim!
Eri, kihong irail ei pasapenget: ‘I kahukiha ni mwarei me I pahn wiahiong kumwail soahngohte me I rongasang kumwail. Ngehi, KAUN-O me mahmahsen.
Kumwail pahn mehla oh kahlepamwail kan pahn pwupwudiong nan sapwtehn wet. Pwehki amwail kaulimeielahr, sohte emen kumwail me mahkier sounpar rieisek kohda pahn pedolong nan sahpw
me I kahukilahr mehlel I en koasoaneikumwaildi ie. Sohte mehmen kumwail pahn pedolong, ihte Kalep oh Sosua.
Kumwail nda me noumwail seri kan pahn wiahla dipwisou lohdi nan mahwen, ahpw iei irail pwukat me I pahn kapedolong ong nan sahpw me kumwail soikalahr; eri, re pahn sapwenikihla.
A duwen kumwail, kumwail uhdahn pahn mehla nan sapwehten wet.
Noumwail seri kan pahn wiahla silepen sihpw oh kakahnseli nan sapwtehn erein sounpar 40, pweinen amwail soaloalopwoat, kumwail koaros lao pahn mehla.
Kumwail pahn ale lokolok pwehki dipamwail kan erein sounpar 40, sounpar ehu ong ehuehu rahn pahiseko me kumwail dawihki sahpwo. Kumwail eri pahn pehmada wehwehn ei pahn uhwong kumwail.
I kahukihla me I pahn wia soahng wet ong aramas suwed koaros me ehupene oh kahngohdihong ie. Kumwail koaros pahn mehla nan sapwtehn wet. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.’”
Eri, ohl ako me Moses kadarala pwe re en dawih oh kasawih sahpwo, ahpw pwurodo oh wia koasoi likamw, me kahrehda mehn Israel ko kaulimehkihla KAUN-O oh lahlahwe. Eri, e ahpw ketin kalokehki lipoahrok pwukat soumwahu laud ehu me re mehkihla.
<range>
Sang rehn lipoahrok ehk riemeno, ihte me luhwehdi momour, Sosua oh Kalep.
Ni Moses eh kasalehiong mehn Israel ko sapwellimen KAUN-O mahsen pwukat, aramas ako inenen pahtoula oh nsensuwedla kowahlap.
Eri, mandahn rahno, nimensehngie, re ahpw kohdalahng mahwen wasa nahna kan, ndinda, “Nna, kitail patopatohdalahng wasa me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong kitail duwe. Kitail patohwan ese me kitail dipadahr.”
Moses ahpw patohwan, “Eri, dahme kumwail pahn ketiwohki sapeikiong KAUN-O met? Kumwail sohte pahn pweida.
Kumwail dehr kohdawei, pwe KAUN-O sohte ketin ieiang kumwail; kumwail uhdahn pahn lohdiong pahn amwail imwintihti kan.
Ni amwail pahn mahweniong mehn Amalek kan oh mehn Kenan kan, kumwail uhdahn pahn kamakamala, pwehki amwail kahngalahr idawehn KAUN-O, me kahrehda e solahr pahn kin ketin ieiang kumwail.”
Irail ahpw wonlahte mwowe kohdalahng pohn nahna ko, mehnda ma sapwellimen KAUN-O Kohpwahn Inowo oh Moses sohte mwahn mwekidsang nan kahnimpwalo.
Eri, mehn Amalek oh Kenan ahpw kohiei mahweniong irail oh kaloweiraildi, re ahpw pil pwakih irail lao lel Orma.
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses koasoandi pwukat
pwe mehn Israel kan en kin kapwaiada nan sahpw me e pahn ketikihong irail.
Kouwol men, sihpw wol men, sihpw men de kuht men pahn kin kak mweimweidahng KAUN-O pwehn wia meirong isihs de meirong en kapwaiada inou ehu de meirong en nsen, de meirong en warpwohmwahu, de meirong ni amwail sarawi kan. Pwohn meirong en konot pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Mehmen me pahn patohwandahng KAUN-O sihpw men de kuht men, e pahn iangahki mahno paun en pilawa riau me doalki pain riau en lehn olip pwehn wia meirong en wahnsahpw, iangahki pain riau en wain.
<range>
Ma sihpw wol men me pahn wia mehn meirong, paun pahieu en pilawa me doalki pain siluh en lehn olip me pahn meirongala pwehn wia meirong en wahnsahpw,
iangahki pain siluh en wain. Pwohn meirong pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ma kouwol men me pahn meirongala pwehn wia meirong isihs de meirong en kapwaiada inou ehu de meirong en kaminimin,
paun weneu en pilawa me doalki pain pahieu en lehn olip me pahn wia mehn meirong en wahnsahpw,
iangahki pain pahieu en wain. Pwohn meirong pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ih soahng pwukat me pahn meirongala ong emenemen kouwol, sihpw wol, sihpw de kuht eh pahn meirongala.
Ni ahnsou me mahn tohtohsang emen me pahn meirongala, dipwisou me pahn iang emenemen mahn pahn duweduwehte ong emenemen mahn ako.
Mehn Israel koaros pahn kin wia met, ni arail pahn kin wia meirong en konot, pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ahpw ahnsou koaros me mehn liki men me kin koukousoan rehmwail, mehnda ma ahnsou mwotomwot de reirei, me pahn wia meirong en konot, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O, e pahn pil kapwaiada soangen koasoandiohte.
Sang met kohla koasoandi pwukat kin manaman ong kumwail oh ong mehn liki kan me kin kousoan rehmwail. Pwe kumwail oh irail soangen pahrekte ieu mwohn silangin KAUN-O.
Soangen kosonned oh koasoandi koaros kin doakedoake kumwail oh pil irail.
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses
koasoandi pwukat pwe mehn Israel ko en kin kapwaiada nan sahpw me e pahn ketikihong irail.
Ni amwail pahn kin tungoale wahnsahpwo, kumwail pahn kin katohrehsang ekis pwehn wia mehn kisakis kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O.
Ni ahnsou me kumwail pahn umwun pilawa, keieun lopwon sang ni wahn pilawa kapw pahn wia mehn kisakis kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O. Met pahn meirongala duwehte kisakis kesempwal me kumwail kin wia ni meirong en wahnsahpw sang amwail wasahn koadoahki wahnsahpw.
Sang met kohla soangen kisakis kesempwal wet pahn kin wiawihong KAUN-O sang pilawa me kumwail pahn kin umwun.
Ahpw ma emen depweila oh sohte kapwaiada ehu koasoandi pwukat me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses,
oh ma sang met kohla mehn Israel koaros sohte kapwaiada mehkoaros me KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses pwe en padahkihong irail.
Ma sapwung wet wiawi pwehki ar sohte wehwehki, eri re pahn meirongkihla emen kouwol nin duwen meirong isihs, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O, iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw oh wain me kin wiawi. Re pil pahn kapatahiong emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp.
Samworo ahpw pahn wia sarawien kamwakele mehn Israel koaros, oh diparailo ahpw pahn lapwada, pwehki ar depweikihla sapwung wet oh re patohwandahr ar meirong en dihp nin duwen meirong isihs ong KAUN-O.
Mehn Israel koaros iangahki mehn liki kan me kin kousoan rehrail pahn ale lapwepen diparailo, pwehki irail koaros iang pwukoahkihdi sapwung wet.
Ahpw ma aramas emen me depweikihla dihp ehu, e pahn meirongki kuht lih men me sounpar ehu nin duwen meirong en dihp.
Samworo ahpw pahn wia sarawien kamwakel mwohn silangin KAUN-O ni pei sarawio, dipen aramaso ahpw pahn lapwada.
Soangen koasoandihteieu doake koaros me pahn depweikihla dihp ehu, mehnda ma ih mehn Israel men de mehn liki men me kin kousoan rehmwail.
Ahpw aramas emen sohte lipilipil, mehn Israel de mehn liki, me dipada sang ni pein insene, e milahr nan dipen mwamwahliki KAUN-O, eri e pahn kamakamala,
pwehki eh soikala kosonned en KAUN-O oh kauwehla ehu sapwellime koasoandi kan. E pahn pein pwukoahki eh mehla.
Nindokon mehn Israel kan ar koukousoan nan sapwtehn, ohl emen ahpw dierekda eh wesewesei tuwi ni rahnen Sapad.
E ahpw pakahrdo rehn Moses, Aaron oh rehn mehn Israel ko koaros,
re ahpw kihong nan imweteng, pwehki ar sehse dahme re pahn wiahiong.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Aramas menet pahn kamakamala; mehn Israel koaros pahn katehki takai likin kahnimpwalo e lao mehla.”
Mehn Israel koaros ahpw kahreieila ohlo likin kahnimpwalo oh katehki takai e lao mehla duwen KAUN-O e mahsanihong Moses.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en patohwanohng mehn Israel kan, “Kumwail wiahda pengkir mehn kataman ni pwungipen amwail likou kan oh kihong kisin sahl poh mei ni ehuehu mehn kataman kan. Met pahn wiawi sang met kohkohlahte.
Mehn kataman pwukat pahn katamankin kumwail ei kosonned koaros pwe kumwail dehr kin sohpeisang ie oh idawehn ineng en nan kapehdamwail kan.
Mehn kataman pwukat pahn kin katamankin kumwail en kapwaiada ei kosonned koaros; eri kumwail pahn wiahla nei aramas.
Ngehi, KAUN-O amwail Koht, me kahreikumwaildo sang Isip pwe I en wiahla amwail Koht. Ngehi KAUN-O.”
Kora, nein Isar, peneineien Kohad sang kadaudok en Lipai, ahpw kahngohdiongda Moses. Kadaudok en Reupen silimen ahpw iangala ih—Dadan oh Apiram, nein Eliap, oh On, nein Peled—pil iangahki mehn Israel 250, kaun ndahnd kei me pilipilda sang rehn mehn Israel ko.
<range>
Irail eri pokonpene mwohn Moses oh Aaron oh patohwanohng ira, “Kumwa nohn daulihala! KAUN-O ketin sapwellimaniki mehn Israel koaros, oh KAUN-O kin ketiket rehtail koaruhsie. Eri, a dahme komwi, Moses, kin pein kasapwilkomwihda pohn sapwellimen KAUN-O aramas akan?”
Ni Moses eh rong met, e poaridiong nanpwel oh kapakap.
E ahpw patohwanlahng Kora oh ienge ko, “Nimenseng en lakapw KAUN-O pahn ketin kasalehiong kitail ihs me e ketin sapwellimaniki; e pahn ketin mweidohng ih me e ketin sapwellimanikio, mehmeno, me e ketin piladahr en keieng mpe ni pei sarawio.
Nimenseng en lakapw kowe oh iengomw kan pahn ale noumwail pan en kisiniei kan, audekihda mwoalus ngkingken oh warpwohmwahu, kumwail ahpw pahn walahng ni pei sarawio. Kitail ahpw pahn kilang ihs rehtail me KAUN-O ketin piladahr. Kumwail mehn Lipai kan, kumwail me nohn daulihalahr!”
<range>
Moses pil usehla patohwanohng Kora, “Kumwail rong, kumwail mehn Lipai kan!
Kumwail wiahki mehkot mwahl, en Koht en Israel eh ketin katohreikumwailsang rehn mehn Israel teikan, pwe kumwail en kak keieng mpe, oh wia amwail doadoahk ni Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale, oh papah mehn Israel kan?
E ketin mweidohng kumwail oh mehn Lipai teikan, kumwail en kak keieng mpe, a met kumwail pil anahne wiahla samworo!
Ni omw akupwungiong Aaron, ni mehlel, KAUN-O, me kowe oh iengomw kan kahngohdiong.”
Moses eri ekerodo Dadan oh Apiram, ahpw ira sapeng ketihtihki, “Se sohte pahn kohwei!
Komw sohte itarki omwi kahreikitodo sang nan sahpw me pwelmwahu nan Isip, pwe komwi en kemeikitala nan sapwtehnet? Komw pil pahn kaunkitadahr?
Komw sohte kahreikitodohng nan sahpw pwelmwahu de kihong kiht mwetin wain, a met komw songosong en pitihkitedi. Soh, se sohte pahn patohwei rehmwi!”
Moses eri lingeringerda oh patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Maing, komw dehpa kupwure meirong me aramas pwukat pahn patohwandohng komwi. I sohte wia mehkot suwed ong ira. I pil sohte kihsang emen neira ahs akan.”
Moses ahpw patohwanohng Kora, “Kowe oh iengomw me 250 koaros pahn patohdo ni Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale; Aaron pahn pil iang mi wasao.
Emenemen kumwail pahn wa kohdo nah pan en kisiniei, oh audekihda mwoalus ngkingken oh warpwohmwahu loale, oh meirongki ong KAUN-O ni pei sarawio.”
Eri, emenemen irail ahpw ale nah pan en kisiniei, oh audekihda mwoalus ngkingken oh warpwohmwahu, oh uh ni wenihmwen Impwalo, iangahki Moses oh Aaron.
Kora eri kapokonepene aramas koaros, re ahpw uh sohpeiong Moses oh Aaron ni wenihmwen Impwalo. Lingaling en KAUN-O pa mwadangete pwaradahng aramas koaros,
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron,
“Kumwa keiweisang rehn aramas pwukat, pwe I pahn mwadang kamwomwirailla.”
Moses oh Aaron ahpw poaridiong nanpwel oh kapakap patohwan, “Maing Koht, komwi me pwarer en mour. Ahnsou me aramas emen kin dipada, komw kin ketin engiengda pahn aramas koaros?”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Ndaiong aramas akan re en keiweisang ni en Kora, Dadan oh Apiram imwarail impwal kan.”
Moses eri patohla rehn Dadan oh Apiram iangahki kaunen mehn Israel ko.
E ahpw patohwanohng irail, “Kumwail keiweisang limwahn en aramas suwed pwukat ar impwal kan oh dehr doahke mehkot me arail. Ma soh, kumwail pahn iang kamwomwmwomwla pwehki diparail kan.”
Irail eri keilahsang limwahn en Kora, Dadan oh Apiram ar impwal ko. Dadan oh Apiram ahpw pedoi oh kesikesihnen ni wenihmwen imwara impwal, iangahki ara pwoud kan oh neira seri kan.
Moses ahpw patohwanohng aramas ako, “Ih duwen met amwail pahn ese me KAUN-O ketin kedariehdo pwe I en kapwaiada mepwukat koaros ahpw kaidehkin nsenei me I wiewiahki mepwukat.
Ma aramas pwukat pahn mehkihla mehla mwahl ni sohte kalokolok sang rehn KAUN-O, eri a KAUN-O sohte ketin kadariehdo,
ahpw ma KAUN-O pahn ketin wiahda mehkot kapwuriamwei oh sampah pahn sarapeseng oh kadallehla ira oh mehkoaros me ira ahneki, pwe ira en kohdihla nan wasahn me melahr akan ni ara momourte, kumwail pahn esehki me aramas pwukat kahngohdiong KAUN-O oh soikala ih.”
E nekte eh patohwan mepwukat, pwehl me mi pahn nehn Dadan oh Apiram pa sarapeseng
oh kadallehla ira koaros oh ara peneinei kan iangahki iengen Kora koaros oh mehkoaros me irail ahneki.
Irail eri mourte kohdihla nan wasahn me melahr akan, iangahki ar dipwisou koaros. Pwehlo eri pwurpene oh irail sohrala.
Mehn Israel koaros me mihmi wasao ahpw tangpeseng ni ar rongada ngilen ar mwahmwahiei. Re ahpw weriwer ndinda, “Kitail tang pwe sampah dehr pil kadalleikitailla.”
KAUN-O ahpw ketin kadaridi kisiniei me kamwasikahla aramas 250 me meirongki warpwohmwahu.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses,
“Ndaiong Eleasar, nein samworo Aaron, en kihsang pan prons en kisiniei me mihmi rehn ohl me melahr ako, oh en kamwarakpeseng mwoalus ko ekis wasa doh, pwe pan en kisiniei ko me sarawi.
Pan pwukat kasarawihla ni ahnsou me re mweimweidahng KAUN-O ni pei sarawio. Eri, ale nein aramas pwukat me kamakamkihla diparail kan, neirail pan en kisiniei kan oh sukpene lao wiahla pelien mete menipinip oh wiahkihla mehn pwaindi pei sarawio. Met pahn wiahla mehn kapar ehu ong mehn Israel.
Eri, samworo Eleasar ahpw ale pan en kisiniei ko oh sukpene lao wiahla pelien mete menipinip pwe en wiahda pweinen pei sarawio.
Met wiahla mehn kapar ehu ong mehn Israel ko pwe emen me kaidehn kisehn kadaudok en Aaron dehr keiong mpen pei sarawio pwe en meirongkihong KAUN-O warpwohmwahu. Ma e pahn wia, e pahn kamakamala duwehte Kora oh ienge ko. Mepwukat koaros wiawiher nin duwen KAUN-O eh masanihong Moses en patohwanohng Eleasar.
Manda sang rahno aramas koaros ahpw lipahnedihada Moses oh Aaron ketihtihki, “Kumwa kemelahr ekei sapwellimen KAUN-O aramas akan.”
Ni ar pokonpene pwe re en uhwong Moses oh Aaron, re sohpeilahng Impwalo oh kilangada duwen pelien depwek pali eh pwapwaindi oh lingaling en KAUN-O eh pwarada.
Moses oh Aaron ahpw kohla oh uh mwohn Impwalo,
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses,
“Keiweisang mpen aramas pwukat pwe met I pahn kamwomwirailla!” Ira riemeno eri poaridiong nanpwel,
Moses eri patohwanohng Aaron, “Ale noumw pan en kisiniei, oh audekihda mwoalus ngkingken sang ni pei sarawio oh kihong ekei warpwohmwahu nan mwoalus kan. Kowe eri mwadang kohwei rehn aramas akan oh wia sarawien kamwakel. Nna mwadang! Pwe engieng en KAUN-O tepidahr oh soumwahu lusulus ehu tepidahr.”
Aaron eri kapwaiada, e ale nah pan en kisiniei oh tangala wasa me aramas ako wie pokopokon ie, ni eh kilangada me soumwahwo tepidahr, e ahpw kihong warpwohmwahu pohn mwoalus ko oh wiahda sarawien kamwakele aramas ako.
Met kahrehda soumwahwo eh tokedi, Aaron ahpw uh nanpwungen me momour oh me melahr akan.
Wadepen aramas me mehla mihmi ni 14,700, me mehla ni moromor en Kora sohte wadawadohng.
Ni ahnsou me soumwahu lusuluso tokedi, Aaron ahpw pwurala rehn Moses ni wenihmwen Impwalo.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Patohwanohng mehn Israel kan re en kihong uhk sokon ehk riapwoat, apwoat sang rehn kaunen ar kadaudok kan. Ke ahpw ntingihedi eden emenemen kauno ni eh sokon
oh pil ntingihedi eden Aaron ni sokon en Lipai. Emenemen kaunen kadaudok kan pahn ahneki apwoat sokon.
Ke ahpw wahla ni Impwal me I pahn kin ketiket loale oh kihdiong mwohn Kohpwahn Inowo, wasa I kin tuhwong uhk ieo.
Eri sokon en aramas me I piladahr pahn masalpeseng. Ih duwen met ei pahn katokihedi en mehn Israel kan ar kin lipahnedihiuk.”
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Israel ko, oh emenemen kaun ahpw kihong ar sokon kan, ehu sang ehu kadaudok, eri koaros patpene me ehk riapwoat, oh en Aaron eh sokon pil iang patehng.
Moses eri patohwandiong nan Impwalo sokon ko koaros mwohn Kohpwahn Inowo.
Mandahsang rahno ni en Moses eh patohla nan Impwalo, e kilangada duwen en Aaron eh sokono, me wiliandi kadaudok en Lipai, eh masalpesengehr. E mpwekda, masalpeseng oh kapwarehda wahn almond kei me mahier.
Moses eri ale sokon ko koaros oh wahiei oh kasalehiong mehn Israel ko. Re kilangehr dahme pweidahr oh emenemen ahpw ale uhdahn eh sokon.
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “Kapwurediong en Aaron sokonen mwohn Kohpwahn Inowen. Pwe en nekinek men pwe en wia mehn kapar ong mehn Israel me kahngohdi kan, pwe re en katokihedi ar lipahned kan; pwe ma soh, re pahn mehla.”
Moses eri wiahda nin duwen KAUN-O eh mahsanih.
Mehn Israel ko eri patohwanohng Moses, “Eri ih pahn imwilaht met!
Mehmen me pahn keiwohng mpen Impwalo eh pahn kamakamala, eri kitail koaruhsie pahn mehla!”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Aaron, “Kowe, noumw seri oh mehn Lipai kan, kumwail pahn pwukoahki mehkoaros me sapwung ni amwail doadoahk nan Impwal me I pahn kin ketiket loale; ahpw kowe oh noumw seri kan me pahn pwukoahki me sapwung ni amwail doadoahk en samworo.
Pil kahrehdo kisehmw, me kadaudok en Lipai, pwe re en kin sewesei kumwail nindokon kowe oh noumw seri kan amwail pahn kin doadoahk nan Impwal wet.
Re pahn seweseiuk oh kapwaiada arail pwukoa kan nan Impwalo, ahpw re sohte pahn sair pei sarawio de dipwisou sarawi kan nan Wasa Sarawio. Ma re pahn sair mepwukat, kowe oh irail koaros pahn kamakamala.
Irail pahn iang uhk doadoahk oh re pahn kapwaiada ar pwukoa kan me pid arail doadoahk nan Impwalo; ahpw sohte emen tohrohr me pahn iang uhk doadoahk.
Kowe oh noumw pwutak kante me pahn pwukoahki doadoahk nan Wasa Sarawio oh ni pei sarawio, pwe ei engieng en dehr pwurehng lel mehn Israel kan.
Ngehi me pilada kisehmw kadaudok en Lipai kan sang rehn men Israel kan, eri kalahngan ehu sang rehi. Re kasarawilahr ong ie pwe re en kapwaiada arail pwukoa kan nan Impwalo.
Ahpw kowe oh noumw pwutak kante me pahn pwukoahki pwukoahn samworo me pid pei sarawio oh audepen Wasa Sarawiheo. Ih met kan amwail pwukoa, pwehki ei kihong kumwail kalahngan en samworo. Mehmen me sohte iang pwihn en samworo e ahpw keieng mpen dipwisou sarawi pwukat pahn kamakamala.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Aaron, “Tamataman pwe ngehi me kihong kumwail samworo kan pwaisamwail sang ni meirong kesempwal kan likin meirong isihs en mehn Israel kan. I kihong kumwail oh kadaudokamwail kan pwehn wia pwaisamwail kohkohlahte.
Iet kan pwaisamwail sang ni meirong sarawi kan me sohte kin isihsla pohn pei sarawio: meirong en wahnsahpw, meirong en dihp, oh meirong en kapwungala sapwung kan. Mehkoaros me mweimweidahng ie pwehn wia meirong kesempwal iei pwaisomw oh pwaisen noumw seri kan.
Kumwail pahn kin tungoale soahng pwukat wasa sarawi ehu, oh ohl kante me pahn kin tungoale. Kumwail pahn kin wiahki mepwukat mehkot sarawi.
“Kumwail pil pahn pwaisanki meirong kesempwal teikan me mehn Israel kan pahn kin mweidadahng ie. I kihong mepwukat ong kowe, noumw pwutak kan oh noumw serepein kan sang met oh kohkohlahte. Koaros me kisehn omw peneinei oh mwakelekel ong kaudok pahn kak iang tungoale.
“I pil kihongkumwailehr keieun wahnsahpw kaselel me mehn Israel kan kin nohpeikihong ie nan sounpar koaros: eri lehn olip, wain oh wahnsahpw.
Koaros pahn kohieng kumwail, oh tohn amwail peneinei koaros me mwakelekel ong kaudok kak iang tungoale.
“Mehkoaros nan wehin Israel me kasarawihongieier pahn wia pwaisamwail.
“Mesenih koaros, aramas de mahn, me mehn Israel kan kin meirongkihong ie pahn kohieng kumwail, pwe kumwail en ahnekihla. Ahpw kumwail pahn ale pweinen pweipweida sapahl en mesenihen aramas koaros, oh pil ale pweinen mesenihen mahn me samin ong kaudok.
Seri kan pahn kin pweipweida sapahl ni ar sounpwong ehu ni pweipwein mwohni silper limau nin duwen me koasoandier.
Ahpw mesenihen kou, sihpw, oh kuht kan sohte pahn pweipweida sapahl, pwe ngehi me naineki oh re pahn meirongala. Kumwail usupihki ntahrail pei sarawio oh isikala wihe ko pwehn wia meirong en konot, me pwowe kin kaparaniehda.
Uduk kan iei pwaisamwail, duwehte mwaremware, oh neh palimaun en meirong kesempwal kan.
“I kihonguhkehr, oh ong noumw pwutak kan oh noumw serepein kan, sang met oh kohkohlahte, meirong kesempwal kan koaros me mehn Israel kan kin meirongkihong ie. Met inou ehu me sohte kak ohla me I wiahiong kumwail oh kadaudokamwail kan.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Aaron, “Ke sohte pahn ale sohso ieu sang ni sapwen mehn Israel kan de sohte wasa kis pahn kohieng uhk, pwe ngehi, KAUN-O, me pahn wia pwaisomw oh omw sohso.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Mehn Israel kan kin meirongkihong ie eisek kis ehun arail dipwisou kan; eri meirong pwukat I kihongehr mehn Lipai kan. Met pwehn wia pweinen doadoahk en apwahpwalih Impwal me I pahn kin ketiket loale.
Mehn Israel teikan solahr pahn keieng mpen Impwalo, pwe re dehr ale kalokolok en kamala.
Sang met kohla mehn Lipai kante me pahn kin apwahpwalih Impwalo oh irailte me pahn kolokol pwukoa kan koaros. Met koasoandi poatopoat ehu me doke kumwail oh kadaudokamwail kan. Mehn Lipai kan sohte pahn sohsohki mehkot nan Israel,
pwe I kihongirailehr ar sohso eisek kis ehun kisakis kan me mehn Israel kan kin mweidadahng ie ni mwomwen meirong kesempwal ehu. Ih me I ndakihong irail me re sohte pahn sohsohki mehkot nan Israel.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en ndaiong mehn Lipai ko, “Ni ahnsou me kumwail kin ale meirong kan sang mehn Israel kan me KAUN-O ketikihong kumwail pwe kumwail en pwaisanki, kumwail en patohwandahng KAUN-O eisek kis ehun meirong ko pwehn wia amwail kisakis kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O.
Soangen meirong kesempwal wet kumwail pahn kin wiahki duwehte meirong me soumwet men kin wiahsang ni wahnsahpw kapw oh wain kapw.
Ih duwen met amwail pahn pil wia amwail meirong kesempwal ong KAUN-O sang ni meirong koaros me kumwail kin ale sang rehn mehn Israel kan. Kumwail ahpw pahn patohwanohng Aaron meirong kesempwal pwukat me ong KAUN-O.
Kumwail patohwanohng me keieu kaselel sang ni kisakis pwukat me kumwail kin ale.
Mwurin amwail patohwandahngehr me keieu kaselel kan, kumwail kak pwaisanki me luhwe kan, duwehte soumwet me kin pwaisanki luhwen me e kin meirongkihla.
Kumwail oh amwail peneinei kan kak tungoale luhwe kan wasa koaros sohte lipilipil, pwe ih pweinen amwail doadoahk nan Impwalo.
Kumwail sohte pahn dipaniki amwail pahn tungoale mepwukat pwehki amwail patohwandahngehr KAUN-O. Ahpw kumwail kanahieng pwe kumwail de kasaminehla kisakis sarawi pwukat en mehn Israel, ni amwail pahn tungoale mwohn ahnsou me keieu kaselel eh pahn meirongala; ma kumwail pahn wia met, kumwail pahn mehla.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron
ira en ndaiong mehn Israel kan koasoandi pwukat. Re en wahdo kou weitahta men me sohte kisin samin kis reh oh me saikinte doadoahk,
oh re en kihong samworo Eleasar. Kouo ahpw pahn pakahrlahng likin kahnimpwalo oh kamakamala ie mwohn samworo.
Samworo Eleasar ahpw pahn kaduh sendinpeh nan ntao oh usupihki pak isuh mwohn Impwalo.
Mwuhr, mahno pwon, iangahki kili, uduke, nta oh kepwehn loale kan pahn isihsla mwohn mesen samworo.
Samworo ahpw pahn ale rahntuhke sidar ehu, isop ehu oh kisin sahl weitahta kis, oh keselahng nan kisinieio.
Samworo ahpw pahn lopworada eh likou kan oh duhpki paliwere pihl; mwurin met e pahn kak pwurodohng nan kahnimpwalo; ahpw e pahn samisaminte lao lel nin soutik.
Aramas me isikala mahno pahn pil lopworada eh likou kan oh duhpki pihl paliwere, ahpw e pahn pil samisaminte lao lel nin soutik.
Eri aramas emen me mwakelekel ong kaudok pahn kihpene pehs en kouo oh koasoanediong wasa mwakelekel kis likin kahnimpwalo. Ih wasao me e pahn nekinek ie pwe mehn Israel kan en kin doadoahngki ni ar pahn kin kaunopada pihl mehn kamwakel. Sarawi wet iei sarawien lapwahsang dihp.
Aramas me kihpenehr pehs en kouo pahn pil lopworada eh likou kan oh e pahn samisaminte lao lel nin soutik. Koasoandi wet pahn manaman kohkohlahte ong mehn Israel kan oh ong mehn liki kan me kin kousoan rehrail.
Mehmen me pahn sairada aramas mehla e pahn saminla ong kaudok erein rahn isuh.
E pahn kamwakelkihda pilen kamwakel ni rahn kesiluh oh ni rahn keisuh, e ahpw pahn mwakelekella. Ahpw ma e sohte kamwakelehda pein ih ni kesiluh oh keisuhn rahn, e sohte pahn mwakelekella.
Mehmen me sairada aramas mehla men ahpw sohte kamwakelehda pein ih pahn samisaminte pwehki pilen kamwakel eh sohte kamwakelehda. E pahn kasaminehla Impwalen KAUN-O, oh e sohlar pahn wia kisehn sapwellimen Koht aramas akan.
Ma aramas emen pahn mehla nan impwal ehu, mehmen sohte lipilipil me mihmi nan impwalo ni ahnsoun mehlao de pedolong loale, pahn saminla erein rahn isuh.
Sah koaros oh einpwoat koaros me sohte pweine pil pahn saminla.
Ma mehmen sairada aramas emen me kamakamalahr de melahr mwahl likin ihmw ehu, de ma mehmen sairada tihn aramas de sousou ehu, e pahn saminla erein rahn isuh.
Pwehn kamwakelsang soangen samin pwukat, pehs en kou weitahtao me isihslahr pwehn lapwahda dihp pahn wisikdo oh kohieng nan ehu einpwoat, oh pil iangahki pihl mwakelekel.
A duwen impwalo me aramas mehla loale, mehmen me mwakelekel ong kaudok pahn ale rahn isop, kaduh nan pihlo oh usupihki impwalo, dipwisou kan koaros loale, oh iangahki aramas koaros me mihmi loale. Nin duwen aramaso me sairada aramas mehlao de tihn aramas de sousou ehu, mehmen me mwakelekel ong kaudok pahn usupihki pihlo aramaso me sairada soahng pwukat.
Ni kesiluh oh keisuhn rahn aramaso me mwakelekel ong kaudok pahn usupihki pihlo aramas samino. Ni keisuhn rahn e pahn kamwakelehda aramaso, oh mwurin aramaso eh pahn lopworada eh likou kan oh pein duhpki pihl paliwere, eri e pahn mwakelekelda nin soutik.
Mehmen me pahn saminla ong kaudok ahpw sohte kamwakelehda pein ih pahn samisaminte pwehki pilen kamwakel eh sohte kamwakelehda. E pahn kasaminehla Impwalen KAUN-O, oh e solahr pahn wia kisehn sapwellimen Koht aramas akan.
Kumwail pahn kin kapwaiada koasoandi wet kohkohlahte. Aramas me kin usupiki pihl en kamwakel pahn pil lopworada eh likou kan, oh mehmen me pahn doahke pihlo, pahn saminla ong kaudok lao lel nin soutik.
Soahng koaros me aramas samin men pahn doahke pahn saminla, oh mehmen me pahn doahke soahng pwukat pahn saminla lao lel nin soutik.
Mehn Israel ko koaros eri lel nan sapwtehn Sin ni keieun sounpwong, re ahpw kousoanla wasao ahnsou kis, oh ih wasao me Miriam mehla oh seridi ie.
Pihl eri rosala wasao; aramas ako eri kohla kapilpene Moses oh Aaron,
re ahpw kaulimla, ketihtihki, “E mwahwongete kitail en iang riatail mehn Israel ko mehla mwohn Impwalen KAUN-O.
Dahme komw kahrekinkitodohng nan sapwtehn wet? Pwe kiht oh nait mahn akan en mehla wasaht?
Dahme komw wahkinkitasang Isip, weikitodohng nan sahpw sakanakan wet? Sohte mehkot kak keirda wasaht, sohte kohn, sohte tuhke pik, sohte wahn wain, sohte tuhke pwohmakraneid. Pil sohte mwahn kisin pihl kis mehn nimpil.”
Moses oh Aaron eri tohrohrala sang pokono oh patohla ni wenihmwen Impwalo. Ira eri poaridiong nanpwel, oh lingaling en KAUN-O ahpw pwarohng ira.
KAUN-O eri ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Ale sokon me mi mwohn Kohpwahn Inowo. Eri, kowe oh riomw Aaron, kumwa kapokonepene mehn Israel kan koaros. Eri, mwohn masarail koaros kumwa lokaiaiong paipalapen, e ahpw pahn kakusada pihl. Ih duwen met amwa pahn kapwilasang pihl nan paipen pwe aramas akan, iangahki neirail mahn akan, re en nim.”
Moses eri kohla ale sokono, nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih.
Ih oh Aaron eri kapokonepene aramas ako koaros mwohn paipalapo. Moses eri mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail rong, kumwail me nan kapehd keptakailahr kan. Ia duwe, se pahn kakusieisang pihl nan paipalap wet, pwe kumwail en nim?”
Moses eri kolada sokono wokihki pak riau paipo. Pihl pa kusukusiei. Irail koaros oh nair mahn akan eri nimpil.
Ahpw KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron, “Pwehki amwa pwoson sohte itarohng amwa pahn kalohkihda roson en ei manaman sarawi mwohn mehn Israel kan, kumwa sohte pahn kahluwairaillahng nan sahpw me I inoukihong irail.”
Met wiawiher nan Meripa, wasa me mehn Israel ko uhwong KAUN-O oh kaulimala, oh wasa me e ketin kasalehiong irail ie me ih me sarawi.
Moses eri kadarala meninkeder kei rehn nanmwarkien Edom sang Kades, ketihtihki, “Pekipek wet sang rehn kisehmwi kan, me kadaudok en Israel. Komw mwahngih duwen apwal akan me lelohngkitehr,
duwen at pahpa kahlap ako ar patohdihla Isip, oh duwen at kousoan wasao erein sounpar tohto. Mehn Isip ko ahpw wiakauwehla at pahpa kahlap ako, oh pil kiht.
Se ahpw likweriong KAUN-O en ketin sewesei kiht. E ketin karongei kiht oh ketin kadarodo tohnleng men, oh ketin kahluwaikitasang wehin Isip. Eri met se patopato Kades, kahnimw ehu ni irepen sapwellimomwi wehi.
Komw kupwurkalahngan mweidohng kiht se en patohwan kotehla sapwellimomwi wehi. Kiht oh nait kou kan sohte pahn keid nansapw de nan mwetin wain kan. Se sohte pahn nimasang pilen sapwellimamwail pwarer kan. Se pahn keid nan allap, se lao daulih sapwellimomwi wehi.”
Mehn Edom kan ahpw sapeng, ketihtihki, “Se sohte pahn mweidohng kumwail en kotehla at wehi. Ma kumwail kotehla, se pahn mahweniong kumwail.”
Mehn Israel ko eri patohwan, “Ahpw ia duwe, pwe se pahn kekeidte nan elen wehi, ma kiht oh nait mahn akan pahn nim amwail pihl kan, se pahn pwainohng kumwail—ihte me se mwahuki, se en kotehwei sahpwen.”
Mehn Edom kan ahpw pwurehng ketihtihki, “Soh! Kumwail sohte pahn kotehdo at wehi.” Irail eri kohieilahng tuhwong mehn Israel ko iangahki karis en sounpei pwe re en mahweniong irail.
Eri, pwehki mehn Edom kan ar kahngete mehn Israel ko en kotehla sapwarailo, mehn Israel ko eri keid ni apwoat ahl tohrohr.
Mehn Israel ko koaros eri mweselsang Kades, re ahpw kohla oh lel nin Nahna Or,
limwahn irepen wehin Edom. Eri, KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron wasao,
“Aaron sohte pahn iang pedolong nan sahpw me I inoukihda me I pahn kihong mehn Israel kan. E pahn mehla pwehki amwa uhwong ei mahsen kan nan Meripa.
Eri, ale Aaron oh nah pwutak Eleasar oh kahreiralahng nin Nahna Or.
Eri, ke ahpw kihsang en Aaron eh likoun samworo kan oh kalikawihkihda Eleasar, pwe Aaron pahn mehla wasao.”
Moses eri kapwaiada mehkoaros duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih. Irail kohdahla pohn Nahna Or mwohn mesen aramas ako koaros.
Moses ahpw kihsang en Aaron eh likoun samworo ko oh kalikawihkihda Eleasar. Aaron eri mehla wasao pohn nahnao; oh Moses oh Eleasar pwuredihsang pohn nahnao.
Mehn Israel ko ahpw rongada me Aaron melahr, re ahpw mwahieiki erein rahn silihsek.
Ni ahnsou me nanmwarkien Arad, mehn Kenan men me kin ketiket palieir en sahpwo, karongehda me mehn Israel ko kohkohdo nanial en Adarim, e ahpw mahweniong irail oh salihedi ekei irail.
Mehn Israel ko eri kahula oh inoukihong KAUN-O, patohwan, “Ma komwi pahn ketikihong aramas pwukat pahn at manaman, se pahn patohwan kasarawiong komwi douluhl ar kahnimw kan.”
KAUN-O eri ketin karonge mehn Israel ko oh e ahpw ketikihong mehn Kenan ko pahn ar manaman. Mehn Israel ko eri kamwomwirailla douluhl iangahki ar kahnimw kan; ihme re kahdanekihla wasao Orma.
Mehn Israel ko eri mweselsang nin Nahna Or kolahng ni Sehden Akapa, pidipidahki likin wehin Edom. Ahpw aramas ako sohla kak kanengamahiong apwal en seiloako;
re ahpw tapihada lipanedihada Koht oh Moses, ketihtihki, “Dahme komw waikinkitodohsang Isip? Pwe se en kodohng mehla nan sapwtehnet, wasa me sohte kisin tungoal, oh sohte pihl? Se solahr kak tungoale kisin tungoal sakanakan wet!”
KAUN-O eri ketin kadarala sineik pwoisin kei rehn aramas ako me keirailpene oh kemehla mehn Israel tohto.
Aramas ako eri kohla rehn Moses oh ndaiong, “Se dipadahr ong KAUN-O oh pil ong komwi ni at lipanedih kumwa. Eri, komw kasakaskin kiht rehn KAUN-O pwe en ketikihsang sineik pwukat.” Moses eri kapakapki aramas ako.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses en wiahkihda mete emen sineik oh langahda ni apwoat tuhkehn, pwe mehmen me sineik kan pahn ngalispene ahpw kilengdahng, e pahn mourla.
Moses eri wiahda sineik men sang prons oh langahda ni tuhke pwoat. Pwe mehmen me sineik kan pahn ngalispene en kak kilengdahng oh e ahpw pahn mwahula.
Mehn Israel ko ahpw mwekidla oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko Apod.
Mwurin ar mweselsang wasao re kauwada imwarail impwal ko nan mohn imwen Aparim nan sapwtehn ni palimesehn sapwen mehn Mohap kan.
Mwuhr re ahpw kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan Wahun Sered.
Sang wasao re pil mwekidla oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan ni paliepeng en Pillap Arnon, nan sapwtehn me kohla lel sapwen mehn Amor kan. (Arnon iei irepen sapwen mehn Mohap oh sapwen mehn Amor.)
Ih kahrepen Pwuken Mahwen kan en KAUN-O koasoia “...kisin kahnimw en Wahep nan Supa, oh wahu kan; Pillap Arnon,
oh wasa ukedi en wahu kan me kolahng kahnimw Ar oh lellahng irepen Mohap.”
Sang wasao re ahpw kohla wasa kis me adaneki Pwarer Kan, wasa me KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses, “Kapokonepene aramas akan pwe I pahn kihong irail pihl.”
Ni ahnsowo mehn Israel ko ahpw koulki koul pwoatet: Pwarer kan, kakusada amwail pihl; se ahpw pahn pereperen kasamwohki at koul—
pwarero me soupeidi kan weirada oh kaunen aramas akan weirkihda reireiso pwoat oh arail sokon kan.” Re mwekid sang nan sapwtehn kolahng Madana,
oh sang mwo re kohla Nahaliel, oh sang Nahaliel kolahng Pamod,
oh sang Pamod kolahng wahun sapwen mehn Mohap kan, pahn kumwen Nahna Piska, sallahng sapwtehno.
Mehn Israel ko eri kadaralahng Sihon, nanmwarkien mehn Amor, meninkeder kei me ketihtihkihong,
“Komw kupwurkalahngan mweidohng kiht se en patohwan kotehla sapwellimomwi wehi. Kiht oh nait kou kan sohte pahn patohsang nan ahl, se sohte pahn keid nansapw de nan mwetin wain kan. Se sohte pahn nimasang pilen sapwellimomwi pwarer kan. Se pahn keid nan allap, se lao daulih sapwellimomwi wehi.”
Ahpw Sihon sohte kupwurki mehn Israel ko en kotehla sapwellime wehi. Iei me e kapokonepene sapwellime karis oh ketla Sahas nan sapwtehn oh mahweniong mehn Israel ko.
Ahpw mehn Israel ko kemehla kiden imwintihti nan mahwen oh kalowehdi sapwen mehn Amor ko sang Pillap Arnon ni paliepeng en Sappok lel ni irepen mehn Ammon kan, pwe mehn Ammon kan kin sinsile mwahu sapwarailo.
Mehn Israel ko eri kalowehdi kahnimw koaros en mehn Amor iangahki Espon oh kahnimw koaros me mi limwah, re ahpw kousoanla wasa ko.
Espon iei poahsoan kaunen sapwellimen Sihon kahnimw, nanmwarkien mehn Amor kan, me mahweniong mahs nanmwarkien Mohap oh kalowehdi sahpwo pwon lellahng Pillap Arnon.
Ih kahrepen koul pwoatet me ketihtihki, “Kumwail kohdo nan Espon, sapwellimen Nanmwarki Sihon kahnimw! Se men kilang eh pahn kokouda oh onohnda sapahl.
Ahnsou ehu sang wasaht nan kahnimw Espon sapwellimen Sihon karis mwekidsang ie rasehng mpwul en kisiniei; e kamwomwala kahnimw Ar nan Mohap oh kalowehdi dolen Arnon palipowe kan.
Meid kamasepwehk ong kumwail tohn Mohap! Kumwail me kin kaudokiong Kemos, kumwail olahr! Amwail koht keselahr noumwail sounpei kan, nanmwarkien Amor koledier lih akan.
Ahpw met kadaudokarail kan kamwomwmwomwlahr, sangete Espon lellahng Dipon, sang Nasim lel Nopa, limwahn Medepa.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kousoanla nan sapwen mehn Amor ko.
Moses eri kadarala ohl ekei pwe re en rapahki wasa mwahu en mahwen ong mehn Saser. Mehn Israel ko ahpw kalowehdi wasao oh kahnimw ko me kapilpene oh kausasang mehn Amor me kin kausoan wasao.
Mehn Israel ko ahpw pwurala oh keid ni ahl me kolahng Pasan, oh Ok, nanmwarkien Pasan, ahpw mwekidla iangahki sapwellime karis pwehn mahweniong mehn Israel ko ni Edrei.
KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Moses, “Ke dehr masak nanmwarki menet. Pwe I pahn mweidohng uhk ke en kalowehdi ih, sapwellime aramas akan koaros iangahki sapweo. Wiahiong soahng me ke wiahiong Sihon, nanmwarkien mehn Amor kan, me kaunda Espon.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kemehla Ok, nah pwutak ko oh sapwellime aramas koaros, sohte emen luwehdi; mwuhr, re ahpw kousoanla nan sahpwo.
Mehn Israel ko eri wonlahte mwowe re lao lel wasa patapat akan nan wehin Mohap; re ahpw kauwada imwarail impwal kan wasao, ni palimesehn Pillap Sordan, sallahng Seriko.
Eri, ni nanmwarki Palak, nein Sippor, eh mwahngihada dahme mehn Israel ko wiahiong mehn Amor ko,
ih oh mehn Mohap ko koaros ahpw masakada mehn Israel ko pwehki ar nohn tohto.
Mehn Mohap ko eri ndaiong kaunen mehn Midian kan, “Aramas pwukat pahn mwadangete kamwomwala atail wehi kan koaros, rasehng kouwol me kin kangasang dihpw nan mohs. Nanmwarki Palak eri
poaronelahng meninkeder kei rehn Palaam, nein Peor, me kin mihmi Pedor nan Amaw limwahn Pillap Iupreitis, pwe re en patohwwanohng, “I men kairehkin komwi me lapalahn wehi ehu kohdo sang Isip; re mwarahkpeseng wasa koaros oh likamwete re pahn mahweniong kiht oh sapwenikihla sahpwat akan.
Re nohn tohto oh kehlailasang kiht. Eri, menlau, ketido pwe komwi en keriahla tohnwehi wet. Iei duwen ele at pahn kak kaloweiraildi oh kasareirailsang nan at wehi. Pwe I ese me irail kan me komw kin kupwuramwahwih, re kin paiamwahula; a irail kan me komw kin keriahla, re kin paisuwedla.”
Kaunen Mohap oh Midian kan eri wahda pweinen kosetipwo oh kohkohla. Re kohla rehn Palaam oh ndaiong mehkoaros me Palak mahsanihong irail.
Palaam eri sapeng irail, “Kumwail pweidi rehi pwohnget; lakapw I ahpw pahn sapengkin kumwail dahme KAUN-O pahn mahsanihong ie.” Kaunen Mohap ko eri pweidi ni imwen Palaam.
Koht eri ketido oh keinemwe rehn Palaam, “Ihs aramas pwukan me mihmi rehmw?”
Palaam eri sapeng, patohwan, “Nanmwarkien Mohap, Palak, me patohwan kadariraildo pwe re en patohwanohng ie duwen aramas ekei me patohdo sang Isip oh mwarahkseli nan sahpwo pwon. E peki I en kohla oh keriairailla pwe re en kak mahweniong irail oh kaloweiraildi oh kasareirailla sang wasao.”
