Koht eri mahsanihong Palaam, “Ke dehr iang aramas pwukan kohwei; ke pil sohte pahn keriahla tohnwehien, pwe I kapaiairaildahr.”
Eri, mandahn rahno, nimenseng, Palaam ahpw ndaiong meninkeder ko, “Kumwail pwurowei nan amwail wehi, pwe KAUN-O sohte kupwurki I en iang kumwailda.”
Meninkeder ko eri mwesel pwurala rehn Palak oh patohwanohng me Palaam kahng iang irail patohdo.
Eri, Palak ahpw pil ketin poaronehla ekei meninkeder me tohto oh lapalapasang mehn mahs ako.
Re ahpw kohla rehn Palaam oh ndaiong en Palak mahsen wet: “Menlau, komw dehr mweidohng mehkot en iredihsang omwi pahn ketido rehi.
I pahn kihong komwi keting laud mehlel ehu, oh I pahn kapwaiada mehkoaros me komw pahn peki rehi. Menlau, ketido oh keriahla aramas pwukat.”
Palaam ahpw sapeng patohwanohng meninkeder ko, “Mehnda ma Palak pahn pil ketikihong ie silper oh kohl koaros en tehnpeseo, ahpw I sohte kak kauwehla kosonned en KAUN-O, ei Koht, ni mehkot tikitik de laud.
Ahpw kumwail pil pweidi rehi pwohnget, duwehte pwihn teio, pwe I en kak ese dahme kapw ni kupwur en KAUN-O ong ire wet.”
KAUN-O eri ketido rehn Palaam nipwongo oh mahsanihong, “Ma aramas pwukat kodohn likwerihiuk, eri, pwourda oh iangirailda; ahpw ke dehr wia mehkot tohrohrasang me I pahn ndaiong uhk.”
Eri, manda nimenseng Palaam ahpw kaunopaoda nah ahso, oh iangala kaunen Mohap ko.
Koht eri ketin engiengkihda Palaam eh kohkohla, oh ni eh kohkohla dake nah ahso iangahki eh ladu riemen, tohnleng en KAUN-O pa uh nanialo pwehn irehdi ih.
Ni ahso eh kilangada tohnleng men eh kesikesihnen wasao oh kolokol kedlahs pwoat, e ahpw wetsang nan ahlo wetlong nan dihpw ko. A Palaam ahpw wokih ahso pwe en kapwurelahng nanialo.
Tohnleng en KAUN-O ahpw uhda wasa wetikitik kis nanpwungen kelen mwetin wain kei.
Ni ahso eh kilangada tohnlengo, e keilahng ni kehlo oh idangehng nehn Palaamo ie. Palaam eri pil pwurehng wokih ahso.
Tohnlengo ahpw pil ketila uh wasa me wetikitik mehlel, wasa me ahso sohte kak mwekidla ni palimeing de palimaun.
Eri, met ni ahso eh kilangada tohnlengo eh uh mwowe, e ahpw mwohndiong nanpwelo pahn Palaam. Palaam eri lingeringerdahte oh tapihada wokihki ahso eh sokono.
KAUN-O eri ketin kupwurehda ahso en lokaia, ahso ahpw ndahng Palaam, “Dahme kahrehda ke wokihkin ie pak silipak?
A Palaam ahpw sapeng, “Pwehki omw kapakapailokei ie! Ma mie nei kedlahs met, I kemeiukalahr.”
Ahso ahpw ndalahng Palaam, “Kaidehkin noumw ahs ngehi, oh kaidehkin dakepomw ahs ngehi sang ni omw tikitik? Sang mahs kohdo, mie ahnsou ehu me I sohte papah iuk?” Ohlo ahpw sapeng, “Soh.”
KAUN-O eri ketin mweidohng Palaam en kilangada tohnlengo eh kesikesihnen nanialo ngapkihda nah kedlahs pwoat. Palaam eri poaridiong mwowe lel nanpwel.
Tohnlengo ahpw mahsanihong, “Dahme ke wokihki pak silipak noumw ahsen? I kodohn karomwpwaiukala, pwe ke sohte pahn wia seiloak wet.
Ahpw noumw ahsen kilangiehda, iei me e wetkihsang nan ahlet, mahkete I kemeiukalahr, a ahsen pahn pitla.
Palaam eri sapeng patohwan, “I dipadahr, I sohte patohwan me komwi ketiket mwohi nan ahlet pwe komwi en uhwong ie. Eri, ma komw sohte kupwurki ei seiloaket, a I pahn pwuralahng ni imweio.”
Tohnlengo ahpw mahsanihong, “Iangeweite aramas pwukat, ahpw ke pahn koasoia soahng kante me I padahkihong uhk ke en koasoia.” Palaam eri iangada nein Palaam meninkeder ko.
Ni Palak eh karongehda me Palaam patopato kohdo, e ahpw ketieila pwe en tuhwong ni kahnimw Ar, me mi limwahn Pillap Arnon ni irepen wehin Mohap.
Palak ahpw mahsanihong Palaam, “I seu kadarowohng uhk meninkeder ko pwe ke en patohdo? Dahme ke sohte mwadangkihdo? Ke lemeleme me I sohte pahn kihong uhk keting laud?”
Palaam ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Ahpw iet I patodohr. A soangen manaman dah me mie rehi? Ihte mahsenohte me Koht ketikihong ie me I pahn kak patohwanda.”
Palaam eri iangada Palak, ira ketiketlahng kahnimw Usod,
Palak ahpw kemehla sihpw oh kou kei wasao, oh kadaralahng kisin uduk kis Palaam oh meninkeder ko me e iangodo.
Eri, mandahn rahno, nimenseng, Palak eri ketin kahredalahng Palaam Pamod Paal, wasa Palaam kak kilang ekei aramas en Israel ko.
Palaam eri patohwanohng Palak, “Komw ketin kauwada wasaht pei sarawi isuh oh ketikidohng ie kouwol isimen oh sihpw wol isimen.”
Palak eri ketin kapwaiada pekipek en Palaam. Ira ahpw meirongkihla kouwol men oh sihpw wol men pohn ehuehu pei sarawi ko.
Palaam eri patohwanohng Palak, “Komw ketin sepit mahs limwahn sapwellimomwi meirong isihs pwukat, pwe I pahn patolahng patohwan mahs ma KAUN-O ele pahn ketin tuhwong ie. Mehkoaros me e pahn mahsanihong ie, I pahn patohwanohng komwi.” Palaam eri patopatolahng pohn nahna ehu,
oh Koht ahpw ketin tuhwong Palaam wasao. Palaam ahpw patohwanohng, “I patohwan kauwada pei sarawi isuh oh meirongkihla kouwol men oh sihpw wol men pohn ehuehu pei sarawi ko.”
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, “Pwurowei rehn Palak oh patohwanda mahsen kan me I pahn mahsanihong uhk.”
Palaam eri pwurala oh tuhwong Palak me ketikette limwahn sapwellime meirong isihso, iangahki kaun koaros en wehin Mohap.
Palaam eri patohwanda mahsen en kokohp pwukat: 1 “Palak, nanmwarkien Mohap, ketin malipeiehdo sang Siria, sang nin nahna kan en palimese. E mahsanih, ‘Kohdo wia kokohp ni mwarei; komw keriahla mehn Israel ko.”
A ia duwen ei pahn keriahla me Koht sohte ketin keriahla? Ia duwen ei pahn kailongkihla me Koht sohte ketin kalahdeki?
Sang pohn paip ile kan I kak uduhdiahl irail, sang pohn dohl akan I kak mwasamwasahn irail. Wehi ehu irail me uhtohrada, me paiamwahusang wehi teikan.
Kadaudok en Israel kan me ngeder duwehte pwelpar, ihs me kak wadekada tohtohn irail? Komwi ketin kupwure ie pwe ei mour en imwisekla duwehte emen sapwellimen Koht aramas akan, pwe imwilahn ei mour en duwehte imwilahn me pwung kan.”
Eri, Palak ahpw mahsanihong Palaam, “Dahme ke wiewiahiong ie? I ekeruhkodo pwe ke en keriahla ei imwintihti kan, a dahme ke wia, ihte ke kapakapkin irail.”
A Palaam sapeng, patohwan, “Pwe da? Kakete I en potohwanda ehu soahng tohrohrasang me KAUN-O ketikihong ie?”
Palak eri mahsanihong, “Iangiehda mahs, kita kohla ekis wasa tohrohr, wasa me ke pahn kilang ekeite mehn Israel ko. Eri, ke pahn keriairailla sang wasao.”
Ih eri ketin kahrelahng Palaam nan mohsen Sopim, me mi pohn Nahna Piska, wasa me e ketin kauwada ie pei sarawi isuh oh ketin meirongkihla kouwol men oh sihpw wol men pohn ehuehu pei sarawi ko.
Palaam eri patohwanohng Palak, “Komw sepit mahs limwahn mehn meirong isihs pwukat, pwe I pahn patolahng tuhwong Koht mahs.”
KAUN-O eri ketin tuhwong Palaam oh mahsanihong dahme e pahn patohwanda; e ahpw pil ketin kapwurelahng rehn Palak.
Palaam eri pwurala oh tuhwong Palak me ketikette limwahn mehn meirong isihs ko, iangahki kaunen Mohap ko. Palak eri keinemwe dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanih;
a Palaam ahpw patohwanda mahsen en kokohp pwukat: “Palak, nein Sippor, komw ketido mahs; oh rong kanahieng dahme I pahn patohwan.
Koht kaidek aramas emen me kin lokaia likamw; pil kaidehk aramas emen me kin wekidala audepen kupwure. Ni eh pahn ketin inoukihda mehkot, e kin ketin kapwaiada; mehkot me e kin mahsanih kin pweida.
E ketin mahsanihong ie I en kapaiahda; eri, me Koht ketin kupwuramwahwih, I sohte kak wekidala.
I sohte kilangada mehkot suwed rehn mehn Israel, de kahpwal, ni ahnsou kohkohdo. KAUN-O, arail Koht, kin ketin ieiang irail; re patohwan wiahki ih arail nanmwarki.
Koht ketin kahluwairaildo sang wehin Isip; e ketin uhpalihkin irail nan mahwen, rasehng kou lawalo men.
Sohte katepen tiahk en wunahni rehn mehn Israel, pil sohte ketepen kosetipw rehrail. Ih ahnsowo met ahnsoun patohwan duwen mehn Israel, ‘Kilang dahme Koht ketin wiadahr!’
Iet wehin Israel me rasehng laion kehlail men: e sohte pahn wendi e lao kadallehla seike, oh nimala ntahn irail me e kemehla.”
Eri, Palak ahpw mahsanihong Palaam, “Ma ke sohte pahn keriahla mehn Israel kan, ke sohte pil pahn kapaiairailda.”
Palaam ahpw sapeng Palak, patohwan, “I soh patohwanohngkomwiher me I pahn patohwanda mehkoaros me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie?”
Palak eri mahsanihong, “Kohdo mahs; I pahn kahreiukalahng ekis wasa tohrohr; mweinele Koht pahn ketin kupwurki ke en keriairailla sang wasao.”
Ih eri ketin kahrelahng Palaam pohn kumwen Nahna Peor, sallahng sapwtehno.
Palaam ahpw patohwanohng, “Komw ketin kauwada pei sarawi isuh wasaht, oh ketikidohng ie kouwol isimen oh pil sihpw wol isimen.”
Palak eri ketin kapwaiada me Palaam patohwanohng; ih eri meirongkihla kouwol men oh sihpw wol men pohn ehuehu pei sarawi ko.
Palaam eri esehda me KAUN-O ketin kupwurki en kapaiahda mehn Israel ko. Kahrehda e sohla kohla rapahki kupwur en KAUN-O duwen me e kin wia. E ahpw kilikilengseli nan sapwtehn
oh kilangada mehn Israel ko ni imwarail impwal ko ni wad kadaudok. Ngenen Koht eri ti powe,
ih eri patohwanda mahsen en kokohp pwukat: “Iet mahsen en Palaam, nein Peor, mahsen en aramas emen me kak kilang mehkoaros ni sansal,
me kak rong mahsen en Koht. Mesei kat pehdpesengehr, I aleier kaudial ehu sang rehn Koht, Wasa Lapalap.
Impwal kan en mehn Israel ko me kaselel,
rasehng nih kei me irihrek kohwei, mwetuwel kei ni keilen pillap, tuhkehn alos kei me KAUN-O ketin padokedi, rasehng tuhke sidar kei limwahn pihl.
Keteu pahn mwuledek rehrail oh arail werentuhke pahn poadidi nan pwehl wisekesek mwahu. Arail nanmwarki pahn lapalapasang Akak, oh roson en eh wehi pahn kohieng wasa doh kan.
Koht ketin kahluwairaildo sang wehin Isip; e kin ketin uhpalihkin irail nan mahwen, rasehng kou lawalo men. Re kin kadallehla arail imwintihti kan, kauwehla tihrail kan oh katimpeseng kanengen neirail kesik ketieu.
Arail wehi kin rasehng laion kehlail men; ni eh pahn memeir, sohte me eimahiong kapirida. Mehmen me pahn kapaiahda Israel, e pahn pil paiamwahu; a mehmen me pahn keriahla Israel, e pahn riahla.”
Palak eri engiengda kowahlap pahn Palaam. Ih eri rakopene lime ko oh mahsanihlahng Palaam, “I ekeruhkodo pwe ke en keriahla ei imwintihti kan, ke ahpw kapaiairailda pak siluh.
Eri, pwilipwilahkewei sang met, pwilahkewohng ni imwomwo! I inoukihda me I pahn kihong uhk keting laud ehu, a met KAUN-O ketikihsangehr keting wet rehmw.”
Palaam eri sapeng, patohwan, “I soh patohwanohng meninkeder ko me komw ketin kadaralahng ie,
me mehnda ma komw pahn ketikihong ie silper oh kohl en tehnpasomwi koaros, ahpw I sohte kak kauwehla kosonned en KAUN-O ni ei pahn wiahda mehkot ni pein nsenei; pwe ihte me I pahn kin patohwandahn, dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie.”
Palaam pil patohwanohng Palak, “Ahnsou wet I pahn patohla rehn riei aramas ako, ahpw mwohn ei pahn patohla, I men kehsehkin komwi dahme mehn Israel kan pahn wiahiong sapwellimomwi kan ni rahn akan me pahn kohdo.”
Ih eri patohwanda mahsen en kokohp pwukat: “Iet mahsen en Palaam, nein Peor, mahsen en aramas emen me kak kilang mehkoaros ni sansal,
me kak rong mahsen en Koht, me kin kupwurokongki kupwurokong en Wasa Lapalahpie. Mesei kat pehdpesengehr, I aleier kaudial sang rehn Koht, Wasa Lapalap.
I patohwan kilikilenglahng ahnsou me pahn kohdo, I ahpw kilangada wehin Israel. Nanmwarki men pahn ketin pwarada nan wehio, rasehng usu ehu, e pahn ketieisang nan Israel, rasehng rakim lingaling ehu. E pahn ketin kauwehla kaunen wehin Mohap kan, oh kamwomwala me akalapalap oh lemei kan koaros.
E pahn ketin kalowehdi sapwellime imwintihti kan nan Edom, oh ketin nin limanikihla sapwarail; Israel eri pahn kin poweiraildi.
Wehin Israel pahn kaitiekiraildi oh kamwomwala douluhl me pitla kan.”
“Eri, nan kaudialo, Palaam pil kilangada mehn Amalek kan; ih eri pil patohwanda mahsen en kokohp wet: “Wehin Amalek me keieu kehlail nanpwungen wehi kan, ahpw ni imwilah e pahn kamwomwmwomwla douluhl.”
Oh nan kaudialo, e ahpw pil kilangada mehn Ken kan; ih eri pil patohwanda mahsen en kokohp pwukat: “Amwail wasahn kousoan me kehlail oh mwahu, rasehng pesen menpihr men pohn paipalap ileilehie;
ahpw kumwail, mehn Ken, kumwail pahn mwomwla ni ahnsou mehn Asiria kan pahn kaloweikumwaildi.”
Palaam ahpw pil patohwanda mahsen en kokohp pwukat: “Ihs aramas pwukat me pokonpene ni paliepeng?
Karis kan pahn seiloakdo sang Saiprus; re pahn kalowehdi Asiria oh Papilon, a mwuhr, re ahpw pahn pil mwomwla kohkohlahte.”
Palaam eri uhdahte kohkohla ni imweo, oh Palak pil ketiketla sang wasao.
Ahnsou me mehn Israel ko kauwada imwarail impwal ko nan Wahun Akasia, ohl ako ahpw tapihada neneke lih en Mohap kan me mihmi wasao.
Lih pwukat kin luhke ohlen Israel ko ong arail kamadipw sarawi kan, wasa me re kin pwongih ie koht en Mohap. Mehn Israel ko eri kin iang tungoale kisin mwenge me kin meirongala ong Paal, koht en Peor, oh pil pwongih ih. KAUN-O eri ketin engiengda pahn mehn Isreal,

oh mahsanihong Moses, “Ale kaunen mehn Israel kan oh kemeirailla ni pokon sansal, pwe iei duwen met ei sohla pahn engieng pahn aramas akan.”

Emen mehn Israel ko ahpw pedolong nan imwe impwal iangahki lih en Midia men mwohn mesen Moses oh mwohn mehn Israel koaros, nindokon ar mwahmwahiei mwohn Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale.
Ni Pineas, nein Eleasar, me pahpa kahlapki samworo Aaron, kilang met, e ahpw udahte kohkohla sang nan pokono. E ahpw ale ketieu pwoat,
oh idawehnla ohlo oh liho nan impwalo oh doakohki ketieuo pwar paliwarara ko koaros. Ih duwen met soumwahu lusuluso me kamwomwalahr mehn Israel ko eh tokedi,
ahpw mwurin soumwahwo eh kemelahr aramas rianen pahkid.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Pwehki wiewiahn Pineas, I solahr engieng pahn mehn Israel kan. E sohte mwahn mweidohng re en pwongih koht emen likin ngehi, ih kahrepen ei sohte kamwomwirailla nan ei engieng.
Eri, ke pahn padahkihong me I pahn kauwada inou ehu nanpwungen ngehi oh ih me pahn manaman kohkohlahte.
Ih oh kadaudoke kan pahn wialahr samworo poatopoat kohkohlahte, pwehki eh nohn loalopwoat ong ie oh kahrehiong kupwurmahk pohn mehn Israel kan.”
Eden ohl en Israel me iang lih en Midiano kamakamala iei Simri, nein Salu, kaunen peneinei ehu nan kadaudok en Simion.
Eden liho iei Kospi. Sur, eh pahpa, wia kaunen ehu peneineien mehn Midia.

pwehki suwed me re wiahiong uhk ni ahnsou me re pitihiukedi nan Peor, oh pwehki Kospi, me kamakamlahr ni ahnsoun soumwahu lusulus nan Peor.”

KAUN-O ketin mahsanih me irail koaros pahn mehla nan sapwtehn, ihte me soh, Kalep nein Sepune oh Sosua, nein Nun.
Mahla, Noha, Okla, Milka, oh Tirsa, ih serepein pwukat me nein Selopehad, Selopehad, nein Eper, Eper nein Kilead, Kilead, nein Makir, Makir, nein Manase, Manase nein Sosep.

Pwehki eh sohte nah pwutak, ia kahrepen eden at pahpao eh pahn sohrala sang wehin Israel? Kumwail ketikidohng kiht at sohso sang rehn en pahpa peneinei kan.”

KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong,
“En nein Selopehad serepein kan ar pekipek me pwung; ke pahn kihong irail arail sohso sang rehn kisehn arail pahpao. En arail pahpa eh sohso en kohieng irail.
Ndaiong mehn Israel kan me ahnsou me ohl emen pahn kin mehla sohte nah pwutak, nah serepein me pahn ale sohso.
Ma sohte nah serepein, rie pwutak kan me pahn ale sohso.
Ma sohte rie pwutak, rien eh pahpa ohl akan me pahn ale.
Ma sohte rie de rien eh pahpa, a kiseh me keieu karanih me pahn sohsohki oh wiahkihla uhdahn ah. Mehn Israel kan pahn kin kapwaiada koasoandi wet, nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, ei mahsanihong uhk.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses, “Kohdahwei pohn Nahna Aparim; ke ahpw pahn kilang sang wasao sahpw me I pahn kihong mehn Israel kan.
Mwurin omw pahn kilang sahpwo, ke pahn mehla, duwehte riomw Aaron,
pwehki amwa sapeikiong ei mahseno nan sapwtehn en Sin. Ni ahnsou me mehn Israel koaros pelianiehda nan Meripa, kumwa sohte uhkihda roson en ei manaman sarawi mwohrail.” (Meripa, iei utuhnpihl me mi nan Kades nan sapwtehn en Sin.)
Moses eri kapakap, patohwan,
“Maing KAUN, Koht me wia poahsoan en mour koaros, I peki komwi en ketin kilelehdi ohl emen me pahn kin kaweid aramas pwukat,
oh kaunirailda nan mahwen, pwe sapwellimomwi aramas akan en dehr rasehng pelin sihpw me sohte silepahr.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Ale Sosua, nein Nun, pwe ih ohl koahiek men, kowe eri kidahng pehmw kan pohn moange.
E ahpw pahn patohda mwohn samworo Eleasar oh aramas akan koaros. Ke ahpw pahn pakairkihong irail koaros me iei ih wiliepomw.
Ke ahpw pil kihong apalien omw manaman, pwe mehn Israel kan koaros en peikiong.
E pahn peikiong samworo Eleasar, me pahn esehkihla kupwurei Urim oh Dumim. Ih duwen met me Eleasar pahn kaweidki Sosua oh pil mehn Israel kan mehkoaros me irail pahn kin wia.”
Moses eri kapwaiada me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong. Ih eri ale Sosua oh kahrelahng rehn samworo Eleasar mwohn mesen mehn Israel kan koaros.
E ahpw kidahng peh ko pohn moangen Sosua, oh pakairkihong aramas ako me iei ih wiliepe, nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsaniher.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en kehkehlingkihong mehn Israel kan me re en patohwanohng Koht ar meirong en konot me kin kaparanda kupwure, ni ahnsou kan me kileldier.
Eri, iet kan meirong en konot me kumwail pahn kin patohwandahng KAUN-O: mehn meirong isihs en rahn koaros, sihmpwul wol riemen me sounpar ehu sohte kisin samin kis rehra.
Keieun sihmpwulo pahn meirongala nimenseng, a keriemeno nin soutik;
ong emenemen mahno ako, kumwail pahn iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw me pahn mihmi ni paun 2 en pilawa me doalki pain 2 en lehn olip kaselel.
Ih met meirong en rahn koaros me kin pwonte isihsla, me tepin wiawi nin Nahna Sainai nin duwen meirong isihs, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Wudekihong pohn pei sarawio pain 2 en wain; iei met meirong en wain me pahn iang keieun sihmpwulo.
Nin soutik kumwail pil pahn meirongkihla keriemen en sihmpwulo duwehte mehn nimensengo, iangahki meirong en wain. Met pil wia meirong en konot, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ni rahnen Sapad kumwail pahn meirongkihla sihmpwul wol riemen me sounpar ehu me sohte kisin samin kis rehra, oh paun 4 pilawa me doal lehn olip nin duwen meirong en wahnsahpw, oh iangahki meirong en waino.
Meirong isihs wet pahn kin wiawi rahnen Sapad koaros pwehn patehng meirong en rahn koaros oh pil meirong en wain.
Ni tepin sounpwong koaros kumwail pahn patohwandahng KAUN-O meirong isihs me pahn mihmi ni koupwul wol riemen, sihpw wol men, sihmpwul wol isimen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Mehn meirong en wahnsahpw pahn mihmi ni pilawa me doal lehn olip, paun 6 ong emenemen kouwol; paun 4 ong emenemen sihpw wolo,
oh paun 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul. Meirong isihs pwukat iei meirong en konot, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Meirong en wain me pahn iang mahn pwukat: pain 4 ong emenemen kouwol, pain 3 ong sihpwo, oh pain 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul. Ih met koasoandi en meirong isihs ni keieun rahnen sounpwong koaros erein pahr ehu.
Kumwail pil pahn meirongkihla emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp, pwehn patehng meirong en rahn koaros, oh pil meirong en wain.
Sarawien Pahsohpa, mehn kauwawih KAUN-O, pahn wiawi ni rahn kaeisek pahieu ni keieun sounpwong.
Ni kaeisek limaun rahn iei rahn me sarawi ehu pahn tepida oh wiewiawihki erein rahn isuh. Erein rahn pwukat kumwail pahn tungoale pilawa me sohte doal ihs.
Ni keieun rahn en sarawi wet kumwail pahn pokonpene wia kaudok, oh sohte me pahn doadoahk.
Meirongkihong KAUN-O meirong isihs wet nin duwen meirong en konot: koupwul wol riemen, sihpw wol men, oh sihmpwul wol isimen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Pil meirongki wahnsahpw me kin wiawi: pilawa me doal lehn olip, paun 6 ong emenemen kou, paun 4 ong sihpw wolo,
oh paun 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul.
Pil meirongki emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp; eri ih duwen amwail pahn wia sarawien kamwakele aramas akan.
Kumwail pahn kapatahiong mepwukat meirong isihs me kin wiawi nimenseng koaros.
Pil duwehte, erein rahn isuh kumwail pahn meirongkihong KAUN-O meirong en konot, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwure. Meirong wet pahn patehng meirong isihs en rahn koaros oh pil meirong en wain.
Ni keisuhn rahno kumwail pahn pokonpene pwehn wia kaudok oh sohte me pahn doadoahk.
Ni keieun rahnen Sarawien Dolung Wahnsahpw, ni amwail pahn kin meirongkihong KAUN-O wahnsahpw kapw, kumwail pahn pokonpene wia kaudok oh sohte doadoahk pahn wiawi rahno.
Kumwail pahn wia meirong isihs ehu, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O: koupwul wol riemen, sihpw wol men, oh sihmpwul wol isimen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Pil meirongki wahnsahpw me kin wiawi, pilawa me doal lehn olip: paun 6 ong emenemen kou, paun 4 ong sihpw wolo,
oh paun 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul.
Pil meirongkihla emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp, met iei duwen amwail pahn wia sarawien kamwakele aramas akan.
Wia meirong pwukat iangahki meirong en wain pwehn patehng meirong isihs oh meirong en wahnsahpw en rahn koaros.
Ni keieun rahnen keisuhn sounpwong kumwail pahn pokonpene pwehn wia kaudok, oh sohte doadoahk pahn wiawi rahno. Ni rahno sowi kan pahn pepeuk.
Kumwail pahn patohwandahng KAUN-O meirong isihs ehu, me pwowe pahn kin kaparanda kupwure: koupwul wol men, sihpw wol men, oh sihmpwul wol isimen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Pil wia meirong en wahnsahpw me kin wiawi: pilawa doal lehn olip, paun 6 ong kouo, paun 4 ong sihpwo,
oh paun 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul.
Kumwail pahn pil meirongki emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp, met iei duwen amwail pahn wia sarawien kamwakele aramas akan.
Kumwail pahn meirongki mepwukat pwehn patehng meirong isihs en keieun rahnen sounpwong iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw oh meirong isihs en rahn koaros iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw oh wain. Pwohn meirong en konot pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ni kaeisek en rahnen keisuhn sounpwong kumwail pahn pokonpene pwehn wia kaudok, kumwail pahn kaisihsol oh sohte doadoahk pahn wiawi rahno.
Kumwail meirongkihong KAUN-O meirong isihs ehu, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwure: koupwul wol men, sihpw wol men, oh sihmpwul wol isimen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pil pahn meirongki wahnsahpw me kin wiawi: pilawa me doal lehn olip, paun 6 ong kouo, paun 4 ong sihpwo,
oh paun 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul.
Kumwail pil pahn meirongki emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp, me pahn patehng meirong en kuht me kin wia sarawien kamwakele aramas akan, oh meirong isihs en rahn koaros iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw oh wain.
Kumwail pahn pokonpene pwehn wia kaudok ni kaeisek limaun rahnen keisuhn sounpwong. Kumwail pahn wia sarawi wet pwehn kawauwih KAUN-O erein rahn isuh oh sohte me pahn doadoahk.
Ni keieun rahn pwukat kumwail pahn meirongkihong KAUN-O meirong en konot ehu, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwure: koupwul wol ehk silimen, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Pil wia meirong en wahnsahpw: pilawa me doal lehn olip, paun 6 ong emenemen kou, paun 4 ong emenemen sihpw wol,
oh paun 2 ong emenemen sihmpwul, iangahki meirong en wain kan me koasoandier.
Pil meirongkihla emen kuht wol ong ni meirong en dihp. Meirong pwukat pahn patehng meirong isihs en rahn koaros iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw oh meirong en wain.
Ni keriaun rahn kumwail pahn meirongki koupwul wol ehk riemen, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen me sounpar ehu, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pil iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ni kesiluhn rahn kumwail pahn meirongki koupwul wol ehk emen, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pil iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ni kapahieun rahn kumwail pahn meirongki koupwul wol ehk, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pahn iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ni kelimaun rahn kumwail pahn meirongki koupwul wol duwemen, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pahn iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ni keweneun rahn kumwail pahn meirongki koupwul wol welimen, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pahn iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ni keisuhn rahn kumwail pahn meirongki koupwul wol isimen, sihpw wol riemen, oh sihmpwul wol ehk pahmen, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pahn iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ni kawaluhn rahn kumwail pahn pokonpene wia kaudok oh sohte me pahn doadoahk.
Kumwail pahn meirongkihong KAUN-O meirong en konot ehu, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwure: koupwul wol men, sihpw men, oh sihmpwul wol isimen, me sohte kisin samin kis rehrail.
Kumwail pahn iangahki soangen meirong ko me wiawiher ni keieun rahno.
<range>
Ih koasoandi pwukat me pid meirong isihs kan, meirong en wahnsahpw, meirong en wain, oh meirong en kaminimin me kumwail pahn kin wiahiong KAUN-O ni rahnen sarawi me kileldier kan. Iei mepwukat me pahn patehng meirong kan me kumwail pahn kin wia pwe kumwail en kapwaiada inou ehu de me kumwail wia ni pein nsenamwail.
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Israel ko mekoaros me KAUN-O mahsanihong.
Moses kehkehlingkihong kaunen kadaudok en mehn Israel ko ire pwukat.
Ni ahnsou me aramas emen pahn inoukihda en meirongkihong KAUN-O mehkot de kahukihla me e pahn mweisang mehkot, e sohte pahn kauwehla eh inowo, ahpw e pahn kapwaiada mehkot me e inoukidahr.
Ma peinakapw men me mihmihte rehn eh pahpa inoukihda en wia mehkot ong KAUN-O de kahukihla en mweisang mehkot,
e uhdahn pahn kapwaiada mehkoaros me e inoukidahr ma eh pahpa pahn pwungki.
Ahpw ma eh pahpa esehda duwen eh inou ahpw sohte pwungki, peinakapwo pahn saledeksangehr nan eh inowo. KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwurmahk ong ih, pwehki eh pahpao eh sohte pwungki.
Ma lih kiripw men wiahda inou ehu sang ni nsene de wia inou mwahl ehu, de ma e kahukihla en mweisang mehkot, a mwuhr eh ahpw pwopwoudida,
e pahn kapwaiada mehkoaros me e inoukihda de kahukihla ma eh pwoudo sohte sapwungki ni eh pahn esehda.
Ahpw ma eh pwoudo pahn irehdihsang eh inowo ni ahnsou me e esehda, eri e saledeksangehr, e sohte pahn kapwaiada. KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwurmahkohng liho.
Ma liohdi men de lih emen me mweisangehr eh pwoud pahn inoukihda en mweisang mehkot, e uhdahn pahn kapwaiada.
Ma lih pwopwoud men inoukihda de kahukihla en mweisang mehkot,
e pahn kapwaiada mehkoaros me e inoukidahr de kahukilahr ma eh pwoudo pahn esehda ahpw sohte sapwungki.
Ahpw ma eh pwoudo pahn irehdihsang en kapwaiada inowo ni eh esedahr, liho saledeksangehr eh inowo oh e kakehr sohla kapwaiada. KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwurmahkohng, pwehki eh pwoudo eh irehdihsang.
Eh pwoudo ahneki pwung en irehdi de kasohrehla inou me liho wiadahr.
Ahpw ma mwurin rahn ehu eh ahpw esehda duwen eh inowo, e ahpw sohte irehdi, liho pahn kapwaiada mehkoaros me e inoukidahr. Ohlo pwungki inowo ni rahn me e esehda ahpw sohte irehdi.
Ahpw ma mwurin inowo ahpw irehdi, e pahn pwukoakihdi ma liho sohte pahn kapwaiada.
Ih kosonned pwukat me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses me pid duwen inou me lih kiripw men me kin mihmi ni imwen eh pahpa de lih pwopwoud men wiadahr.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Dupukohng mehn Midian kan dahme re wiahiong mehn Israel kan. Mwurin omw pahn kapwaiada met, ke ahpw pahn mehla.”
Moses eri patohwanohng aramas ako, “Kumwail onopada, pwe kumwail en mahweniong mehn Midian kan oh kaloke irail pwehki ar kauwehla kupwuren KAUN-O.
Kumwail pahn pilada ohl kid sang ni ehuehu kadaudok en mehn Israel kan pwe re en onopada ong mahwen.”
Ohl kid eri pilipilda sang ehuehu kadaudok en mehn Israel ko, koaros patpene me nen riekid me onopada ong mahwen.
Moses eri kadar irail pahn kaweidpen Pineas, nein samworo Eleasar, me kolokol dipwisou sarawi ko iangahki sowi ko mehn wia pakair.
Re ahpw tapihada mahweniong mehn Midian duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihong Moses, oh re kemehla ohl koaros,
iangahki nanmwarki limmen en Midian: Epi, Rekem, Sur, Hur, oh Repa. Re pil kemehla Palaam, nain Peor.
Mehn Israel ko eri salihedi lih en Midian ko oh nair seri ko iangahki neirail pelinmen ko, oh kihsang ar dipwisou kan koaros.
Re pil isikala ar kahnimw kan oh imwarail impwal kan.
Re ahpw ale dipwisou lohdi koaros, iangahki aramas selidi koaros oh pelinmen kan,
oh wahla rehn Moses oh Eleasar oh rehn mehn Israel ko me mihmi ni imwarail impwal ko nan patapat en Mohap ni keilen Pillap Sordan sallahng Seriko.
Moses, Eleasar oh kaunen mehn Israel koaros ahpw kohieilasang nan ar kahnimpwalo pwe re en kasamwo karis en sounpei ko.
Moses eri lingeringerda pahn kaunen sounpei ko, irail kan me kaweid pwihn kan me sapahldohsang nan mahwen.
E ahpw idekda rehrail, “Ia kahrepen amwail sohte kemehla lih akan?
Kumwail tamataman pwe iei irail me idawehnla kaweid en Palaam oh kahrehiong mehn Israel kan ar soaloalopwoat ong KAUN-O nan Peor. Ih kahrepen soumwahu lusulus me KAUN-O ketikidohng pohn mehn Israel ko.
Eri met kumwail kemehla pwutak koaros oh lih koaros me wiahier nsenen pwopwoud.
Ahpw kumwail kak kolokol ong pein kumwail serepein kan oh lih meipwon kan.
Eri met kumwail koaros me kemelahr aramas emen de doahkehda aramas mehla men pahn mihmi likin kahnimpwalo erein rahn isuh. Ni kesiluhn rahn oh ni keisuhn rahn kumwail pahn kamwakeleikumwailda iangahki lih akan me kumwail salihedi.
Kumwail pahn pil kamwakelehda likou koaros oh mehkoaros me wiawihda sang kilin kou, kilin kuht de tuhke.”
Eleasar eri patohwanohng sounpei ko me ahpwtehn pwurodo sang mahwen, “Ih met koasoandi me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses.
Mehkoaros me sohte kin mwasikala, rasehng kohl, silper, prons, mete, dihn oh leht pahn kohieng nan kisiniei pwehn mwakelekella. Soahng teikan koaros pahn kin kamwakelkihda pilen kamwakel.
<range>
Ni keisuhn rahn kumwail pahn lopworada amwail likou kan; kumwail ahpw pahn mwakelekella ong kaudok, oh pwurehng pedolong nan kahnimpwalo.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Kowe oh Eleasar iangahki kaun teikan en mehn Israel, pahn wadekedi mehkoaros me lohdi nan mahwen, iangahki aramas selidi kan oh pelinmen kan.
Kumwail ahpw pahn nehkpeseng ni pahrek, apali pahn kohieng sounpei kan, a apali pahn kohieng mehn Israel teikan.
Daksis pahn kohieng KAUN-O, sang pali me pahn kohieng sounpei kan, eri emen aramas sang nan wad en aramas selidi limepwiki, pil duwehte sang rehn mahn akan, kou, ahs, sihpw, oh kuht kan.
Patohwanohng samworo Eleasar nin duwen meirong kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O.
Sang ni pali me pahn kohieng mehn Israel kan, ale emen aramas sang nan wad en aramas selidi limehk, pil duwehte sang rehn mahn akan, kou, ahs, sihpw, oh kuht kan. Mepwukat pahn kohieng mehn Lipai kan me kin apwahpwalih Impwalen KAUN-O.”
Moses oh Eleasar eri kapwaiada dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanih.
Iet uwen tohtohn mehkoaros me sounpei kan kalowehdi nan mahwen, likin me emenemen koledi ong pein ih: sihpw oh kuht me 675,000, kou 72,000, ahs 61,000, serepein meipwon 32,000.

Uwen me kohieng mehn Israel ko pil duwehte me kohieng sounpei ko: sihpw oh kuht 337,500, kou 36,000, ahs 30,500 oh serepein meipwon 16,000.

Sang ni pali wet Moses alehsang emen aramas sang ni wad en aramas selidi limehk, pil duwehte ong mahn akan, duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih, e ahpw patohwanohng mehn Lipai ko me kin apwahpwalih Impwalen KAUN-O.
Kaunen pwihn en sounpei kan eri patohla rehn Moses
oh patohwanohng, “Maing, se patohwan wadekehr sounpei ko me emenemen kiht kaunda, oh sohte me salongala.
Eri se patohwandohr kapwat kohl pwukat, luwou, rihng, mehn tiati, oh mwaramwar kan me emenemen kiht aledier. Se patohwan mweidohng KAUN-O pwehn wia at tungoal meirong oh en ketin sinsilei kiht.”
Moses oh Eleasar ahpw ale kohl me mihmi ni kapwat kan.
Toutou en kapwat pwukat koaros me sounpei ko kihda mihmi pohnangin paun 400.
Koaros me sohte iang sounpei wie kolokolete dipwisou me re koledi ko.
Moses oh Eleasar eri wahla kohl ko ni Impwalo, pwe KAUN-O en kin apwahpwalih oh sinsile mehn Israel ko.
Kadaudok kan en Reupen oh Kad naineki kiden pelinmen. Ni ar tehkada duwen wehin Saser oh Kilead eh mwahu ong nair kou kan,
re ahpw patohla rehn Moses, Eleasar oh kaun teiko en mehn Israel, oh patohwanohng irail,
“Sahpwet me KAUN-O ketin sewesehki mehn Israel kan pwe re en patopato loale—kahnimw en Atarod, Dipon, Saser, Nimra, Espon, Eleale, Sipma, Nepo, oh Peon—me mwahu ong neitail pelinmen kan, pwe nait pelinmen kan me tohto.
<range>
Menlau kumwail kidohng kiht se en sapwenikihla sahpwet, a ieremen se kotehla Pillap Sordan oh kousoanla wasao.”
Moses ahpw sapeng irail, ketihtihki, “Kumwail men mihmihte met nindokon riamwail mehn Israel kan kohkolahng mahwen?
Ia duwen amwail kak eimah oh song en katikitikihala kapehd en mehn Israel kan ong ar pahn kotehla Pillap Sordan oh kolahng nan sahpw me KAUN-O ketikihong irail?
Ihme samamwail ko wia ni ei kadarirailsang Kades Parnea pwe re en kolahng kasawih sahpwo.
Re kohla lel ni Wahun Eskol oh kilangada sahpwo, ahpw ni ar pwurodo, re katikitikihala kapehd en mehn Israel ko pwe re dehr pedolong nan sahpw me KAUN-O ketikihong irail.
KAUN-O eri engiengda rahno oh ketin wiahda inou ehu:
‘I kahukihla me ni ar sohte loalopwoatohng ie, sohte ohl emen me sounpar rieisek kohda me iang kohdo sang Isip pahn iang pedolong nan sahpw me I inoukihong Eipram, Aisek, oh Seikop.
Eri met pid koaros, likin Kalep, nein Sepune mehn Kenis oh Sosua, nein Nun; ira kelehpw me loalopwoatohng KAUN-O.
KAUN-O ketin engiengda pahn aramas ako oh kupwurehda re en kakahnseli nan sapwtehn erein sounpar pahisek, dih ko koaros me kahngiangihada KAUN-O lao mehla.
Eri met kumwail wiliandier samamwail ako, wia dih kapw en aramas dipan me kaunopadahngehr pwe engieng en KAUN-O en pwurehng kohdi pohn mehn Israel kan.
Ma kumwail kadaudok en Reupen oh Kad pahn kahng idawehn ih met, e pahn pwurehng kesehla aramas pwukat nan sapwtehn, kumwail eri pahn pwukoakihdi ar pahn mwomwla.”
Irail eri keieng mpen Moses oh patohwanohng, “Komw ketin mweidohng kiht mahs se en kauwada kehl takai met ong nait pelinmen kan oh pil wiahda ekei kisin kahnimw me pahn ahneki kehl kehlail ong at tungoal peneinei kan.
Se ahpw pahn onopada pwe se en iang mehn Israel kan kolahng mahwen oh koasoanediong irail nan sahpw me pahn wiahla uhdakarail. Ahpw at tungoal peneinei kan pahn koukousoan nan kahnimwet dohsang imwintihti kan.
Se sohte pahn pwurodo ni at tungoal ihmw kan lao mehn Israel koaros pahn alehdi sahpw me pahn kohieng irail.
Se sohte pahn ale mehkot pwe se en ahnekihla palio Pillap Sordan, pwe se aleier pwaisat wasaht palimesehn Sordan.
Moses ahpw sapeng irail, ketihtihki, “Ma kumwail uhdahn pahn kapwaiada dahme kumwail ndindahn, eri met mwohn silangin KAUN-O kumwail onopada pwe kumwail en kolahng mahwen.
Noumwail sounpei koaros en kotehwei Sordan pahn kaweidpen KAUN-O; re en mahweniong atail imwintihti kan lao KAUN-O pahn kaloweiraildi,
oh alehdi sahpwo. Eri mwuhr, kumwail kak pwurodo, pwehki amwail kapwaiadahr amwail pwukoa ong KAUN-O oh ong riamwail mehn Israel kan. KAUN-O ahpw pahn kadehdehda me sahpwet ni palimesehn Sordan iei sapwamwail.
Ahpw ma kumwail sohte kapwaiada amwail inou, eri kumwail pahn dipada ong KAUN-O, oh kumwail pahn ale kalokolok en dipamwail.
Eri, kumwail kauwada kahnimw kan ong amwail peneinei kan oh kehl kan ong noumwail pelinmen kan oh kapwaiada dahme kumwail inoukidahr!”
Kadaudok en Reupen oh Kad ahpw patohwan, “Maing, se pahn kapwaiada omwi mahsen.
At pwoud oh nait seri kan, iangahki nait kou oh sihpw kan pahn mihmite nan kahnimw kat en Kilead.
Ahpw kiht koaros onopadahngehr mahwen duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih. Se pahn kotehla Pillap Sordan oh iang mahwen nin duwen omwi mahsanih.”
Moses eri patohwanohng koasoandi pwukat ong Eleasar, Sosua oh kaun teiko en mehn Israel:
“Ma kadaudok en Kad oh Reupen pahn kotehla Sordan pwehn kolahng mahwen duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih, oh ma sang ni arail sawas kumwail pahn kak kalowehdi sahpwo, eri kumwail kihong irail re en sapwenikihla Kilead.
Ahpw ma re sohte kotehla Sordan oh iang mahwen, re pahn ale pwaisarail sang nan wehin Kenan, duwehte kumwail.”
Kadaudok en Kad oh Reupen ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, se pahn kapwaiada dahme KAUN-O mahsanih.”
Se pahn patohla pahn sapwellime kaweid oh kotehla wehin Kenan oh iang mahwen, pwe se en ale sapwat wasaht, ni palimesehn Sordan.”
Moses eri kelelehiong kadaudok en Kad oh Reupen oh apali en kadaudok en Manase sahpw koaros me mi pahn Sihon, nanmwarkien mehn Amor, oh Ok, nanmwarkien Pasan, iangahki kahnimw kan oh pil sahpw akan me kapilpene.
Kadaudok en Kad ahpw pwurehng onehda sapahl kahnimw kan en Dipon, Atarod, Aroer,
Atrod Sopan, Saser, Sokpea,
Ped Nimra, oh Ped Aran.
Kadaudok en Reupen pwurehng onehda sapahl Espon, Eleale, Kiriadaim,
Nepo, Paal Meon (ahd wet wekidekla), oh Sipma. Re kihong ahd kapw kei ong kahnimw kan me re onehda sapahl.
Peneineien Makir, nein Manase, ahpw mahweniong wehin Kilead, oh kousoanla ie oh kasarehsang mehn Amor ko me koukousoan wasao.
Moses eri kihong peneineien Makir wehin Kilead, irail eri kousoanla wasao.
Sair, kisehn kadaudok en Manase, ahpw mahweniong oh kalowehdi kisin kousapw kei oh kahdankinirailla “Kousapwen Sair.”
Nopa mahweniong oh kalowehdi Kenad oh kousapw ekei limwah, e ahpw kihong eden wasao Nopa, me iei ede.
Poadopoad me pahn wad met kasalehda eden wasa kan me mehn Israel ko kauwada ie imwarail impwal kan mwurin ar mweselsang Isip ni kadaudok kan pahn kaweidpen Moses oh Aaron.
Sang ni mahsen en KAUN-O Moses ahpw ntingihedi eden wasa kan ahnsou koaros me re kin kauwada ie imwarail impwal kan.
Mehn Israel ko mweselsang Isip ni kelimaun rahnen keieun sounpwong en pahro, mandahn rahn keieun Pahsohpa. Re mweselsang kahnimw Rameses pahn epwelipen nin limen KAUN-O mwohn mesen mehn Isip kan,
me sansarepedi nair mesenih pwutak kan me KAUN-O ketin kemehla. Ni eh ketin wiahda met, e ketin kasalehda duwen eh ketin manaman sang koht en Isip ko.
Mehn Israel ko mweselsang Rameses oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan Sukot.
Mwurin met re kauwada imwarail impwal ko ni Edam ni keilen sapwtehno.
Sang mwo re pwurodohng Pi Airod, paliepeng en Paal Sepon oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko limwahn Mikdol.
Re mweselsang Pi Airod oh kotehla Sehd Weitahtao kolahng nan sapwtehn en Sur; mwurin ar pil seiseiloangki rahn siluh, re ahpw kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan Mara.
Re mweselsang mwo kolahng Elim, wasa re pil kauwada imwarail impwal kan, pwehki eh mie wasao pwarer eisek riau oh nih isiakan.
Re mweselsang Elim oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko limwahn Dahun Sues.
Mwurin met re pil mweselda oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko nan sapwtehn en Sin.
Mwuri nan Dopka,
oh mwuri nan Alus.
Mwurin met nan Repidim, wasa me re sohte diar ie pihl en nimpil.
Re mweselsang Repidim kolahng Nahna Or, re ahpw pil kauwada imwaril impwal ko wasa pwukat: Sapwtehn Sainai, Kiprod Attapa (de “Sousou kan en Ineng”), Aserod, Ridma, Rimmon Peres, Lipna, Rissa, Kehelada, Nahna Seper, Arada, Makelod, Tahad, Tera, Midka, Asmona, Moserod, Pen Sahkan, Or Akkidkad, Sotpada, Aprona, Esiongkeper, sapwtehn en Sin (me iei Kades), oh Nahna Or, ni keilen wehin Edom.

KAUN-O ketikihong Moses kaweid pwukat, nan patapat en Mohap palio Sordan sallahng Seriko,
“Ni amwail pahn kotehwei Sordan kolahng nan wehin Kenan,
kumwail pahn kasarehsang tohn sahpwo koaros. Kamwomwala arail dikedik en eni kan me wiawihkihda takai de mete oh pil ar wasahn kaudok kan.
Kumwail kolowehdi sahpwo oh kousoanla ie, pwe I kihong kumwail.
Kumwail nehkpeseng sahpwo nanpwungen kadaudok kan oh peneinei kan ni usuhs, oh pelien sahpw laud pahn kohieng peneinei me tohto kan, oh pelien sahpw tikitik pahn kohieng peneinei me malaulau kan.
Ahpw ma kumwail sohte pahn kasarehla tohn sahpwo, irail kan me luhwehdi pahn wiahla mwahi apwal nan pwoaren masamwail oh tuhke tekatek limwahmwail, irail ahpw pahn mahweniong kumwail.
Ma kumwail sohte pahn kasareirailla, I pahn kamwomwkumwailla, duwehte ei kupwukupwure I en kamwomwirailla.”
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses
kaweid pwukat pwehn patohwanohng mehn Israel ko: “Ni amwail pahn pedolong nan Kenan, sahpw me I pahn kihong kumwail, eri, iet pahn mwomwen irepen sahpwo.
Irepen palieir pahn sang nan sapwtehn en Sin oh peianla irepen wehin Edom. E pahn tepisang ni palimese ni palieir en imwin Sehden Mehla.
Mwuhr e ahpw pahn wetilahng palieir kolahng Wasahn Kot en Akrappim oh kolahng Sin lellahng palieir en Kades Parnea. Mwuhr e ahpw pahn wet kolahng ni paliepeng en palikapi kolahng Asar Addar oh douluhllahng Asmon,
wasa e pahn wet peianla wahwo ni irepen Isip oh ididi ni Sehd Mediderenien.
“Sehd Mediderenien me pahn wia irepen palikapi.
“Irepen paliepeng pahn inen sang Sehd Mediderenien lel Nahna Or,
oh sang mwo kolahng Wasahn Kot en Amad. E ahpw pahn douluhllahng Sedad,
oh kolahng Sipron, oh pahn ididi ni Asar Enan.
“Irepen palimese pahn inen sang Asar Enan kolahng Sepahm.
E ahpw pahn wet kohdilahng palieir ong Arpel, palimese en Ain, ahpw kolahng ni dohl akan ni palimesehn oaroahr en Lehen Kalili,
ahpw tang kodihla palieir ni keilen Pillap Sordan kolahng Sehden Mehla. “Ih met irepe pahieu en sapwamwail.”
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Israel ko, “Ih sahpwo met me kumwail pahn usuhski, sahpw me KAUN-O ketin kilelehiong kadaudok duwau elep.
Kadaudok kan en Reupen oh Kad oh palimesehn kadaudok en Manase aleier sapwarail, me nehnepesengehr nin duwen ar peneinei kan,
ni palimesehn Sordan, sallahng Seriko.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Samworo Eleasar oh Sosua, nein Nun, pahn nehkpeseng sahpwo ong aramas akan.
Pil ale emen kaun sang ni ehuehu kadaudok pwe re en sewese nehk sahpwo.”
