Sises eri usehlahte, mahsanih, “Ih duwen met me kin wiawi ong aramas akan me kin koasoakepene ong pein irail kepwehn sampah, ahpw semwehmwe mwohn silangin Koht.”
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Ihme I ndahkihong kumwail: kumwail dehr kin pwunodki mourimwail, dahme kumwail pahn tungoale, de paliwaramwail, dahme kumwail pahn likawih.
Pwe mour me kesempwalsang kisin tungoal, oh paliwar kesempwalsang likou.
Kumwail kilang menpihr en pahnlahng kan: re sohte kin kamwarak, re pil sohte kin dolung; sohte arail imwen nahk; a Koht kin ketin katungoale irail. A kumwail uhdahn kesempwalsang mehlel menpihr kan!
Ihs rehmwail me kak mour wereiki pwunopwunodki mepwukat?
Ma kumwail sohte kakohng soahng mengei wet, mehnda kumwail pahn pwunodki soahng teikan?
Kumwail kilang kiepw en nansapw akan duwen ar kin keirda; re sohte kin doadoahk, re sohte kin mengkoalpene. Ahpw kumwail en ese pwe pil Solomon, nan eh kepwehpwe, sohte kin kapwatki likou kaselel duwehte apwoat kiepw pwukat.
Koht me kin ketin kapwatahda dipwen nansapw akan, dihpw kan me rahnwet kin mie, a lakapw kin lekdekiong nan sidohp pwe en wiahda kisiniei. Eri, ma ih duwe, e soh pahn pil ketin kalikawihkumwailda? Kumwail meid pwoson tikitik!
Eri, kumwail dehr kin ngoangki de raparapahki ahnsou koaros dahme kumwail pahn tungoale de nim.
(Pwe me rotorot akan iei irail me kin pwunopwunodki ahnsou koaros mepwukat koaros.) Samamwail me ketiket nanleng mwahngih duwen amwail kin anahne mepwukat.
Kumwail eri kin rapahki mahs Wehin Koht, e ahpw pahn ketikihong kumwail mepwukat.”
“Kumwail kisin pwihn sihpw, kumwail dehr perki mehkot. Pwe Samamwail kupwurperenkidahr en ketikihong kumwail sapwellime wehi.
Kumwail netikihla amwail kepwe kan, oh kihong pweine me semwehmwe kan. Kumwail pein wiahiong kumwail pilihs me sohte ohla, oh nekidala nanleng amwail pai kan, wasa e sohte kin tikitikla ie, pwehki eh sohte lipirap me kak pirapahsang, sohte loangenmwet kak kauwehla.
Pwe wasa omw pai mi ie, omw lamalam unsek kin uhlahng ie.”
“Kumwail onohnop ong dahme pahn kohdo, katengehdiong amwail likou kan nin lukepemwail kan oh amwail mehn ser en kin lullul,
duwehte ladu kan me kin awiawih ar mwohnsapw me pahn sapahldo sang ni kamadipw en kapwopwoud. Ni eh kin leledo oh letelet, re mwadang ritingadahng wenihmwen imweo.
Meid pai ladu kan me ar mwohnsapw kin diar ar pepehd oh mwasamwasahn oh onohnop! Kumwail en ese pwe e pahn katengehdi eh kateng, kamwohdangiraildi nin tehpel oh papah irail.
Meid pai irail, ma e kasaingiraildi ar onohnop, mehnda ma e pwarodo nin lukepen pwong de pwandasang!
Kumwail tamataman met: ma kaunen ihmw ehu ese ahnsou me lipirap emen pahn pwarodohng ni imweo, e sohte pahn mweidohng en wehdpeseng ihmwo.
Eri, kumwail pil onohnop, pwe Nein-Aramas pahn pwarodo ahnsou me kumwail sasairki.”
Piter ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing, ia duwen karasaras pwoatet, e uhwong kiht, de ong aramas koaros?”
Kaun-o ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ihs me ke wiahki ladu lelepek oh loalokong? Iei ih me eh mwohnsapw pahn kasapwiladahng pohn sapwellime ladu kan oh nehkohng irail arail kisin tungoal ni ahnsou me konehng.
Meid pai ladu meno, ma eh mwohnsapw kasaingedi eh wiewia met, ni eh pahn pwurodohng ni imweo!
Kumwail en ese pwe e pahn kasapwilada pwe en kaunda sapwellime dipwisou kan koaros.
A ma laduwo pahn lemeleme nan kapehde, ‘Ei mwohnsapwo pwapwand en pwurodo,’ e ahpw tapihada keme ladu oh lidu teikan, oh wia kamadipw, oh sakaula;
mwohnsapwo pahn pwurodo rahn oh awa me laduwo sasairki. Mwohnsapwo ahpw pahn pelepeseng oh kesepwekelahng nanpwungen me sapeik kan.
“Eri, ladu me ese kupwur en eh mwohnsapw, ahpw sohte kaunopada pein ih oh kapwaiada dahme eh mwohnsapw kupwurki, nahn e uhdahn pahn ale kamakam laud.
A me sehse kupwur en eh mwohnsapw, ahpw wia mehkot me konehng en kamakamki, nahn, e pahn ale kamakam tikitik. Pwe aramas me aleier uwe ehu me laud, uhdahn pahn kihda uwe ehu me laud; a me kowahkier uwe ehu me inenen laud mehlel, uhdahn pahn kapwurehdo uwe ehu me pil inenen laud mehlel.”
“I kohdo pwe I en saunehng sampah kisiniei; eri, ia uwen ei ngoangkilahr pwe en lulda!
I pahn ale papidais ehu, oh ia uwen pwunod me mi rehi, e lao pahn imwisekla!
Kumwail lemeleme me I wa kodohng sampah meleilei? Soh! Kaidehkin meleilei, pwe saminimin.
Sang met kohla, peneinei ehu me towe limmen pahn saminimin nanpwungarail—silimen pahn uhwong riemen, oh riemen pahn pelianda silimen.
Sahm akan pahn uhwong nair pwutak kan, oh pwutak kan pahn uhwong samarail kan; ihn akan pahn uhwong nair serepein kan, oh serepein kan pahn uhwong inarail kan; ihn akan pahn uhwong en neirail pwutak kan ar pwoud kan, oh serepein kan pahn uhwong en ar pwoud ar nohno kan.”
Sises pil ketin mahsanihong pokono, “Ni amwail kin udiahl depwek ehu sang kepinleng, kumwail kin mwadang nda, ‘E pahn keteuda,’ e ahpw kin pweida.
Oh ni amwail kin kilang kisinieng eh uhsang ni palieir, kumwail kin nda, ‘E pahn karakar,’ e ahpw kin pweida.
Mwalaun kumwail! Ma kumwail ese kasawih mwomwen sampah oh lahng, dahme kumwail sehsehki kasawih wehwehn ahnsou wet?”
“Dahme kumwail sohte pein kasawiheki dahme pwung sang nan kapehdomwail?
Ma aramas emen pahn lelkin uhk mwoalen kopwung, nantiheng kapwungala nanpwungamwa mwohn amwa pahn wia kopwung, pwe en dehr penguhkalahng rehn sounkopwung, oh sounkopwung uhd penguhkalahng rehn pilismen, a pilismen ahpw keseiukolong nan imweteng.
Kumwail en ese pwe kumwail sohte pahn pedoisang wasao, kumwail lao pahn kapwungala kisin sens toantoal luhwehdien amwail pweipwand.”
Ni ahnsowo, mie ekei aramas wasao me patohwanohng Sises duwen me wiawi rehn mehn Kalili kei, me Pailet ketin kemehla nindokon ar wiewia ar meirong ong Koht.
Sises eri ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail lemeleme me mehn Kalili pwuko, me mehkihla soangen kamakamo, ihr uhdahn aramas dipan suwedsang mehn Kalili teikan koaros?
Soh kowahlap! Kumwail en ese pwe ma kumwail sohte koluhla oh wiliakapwala, kumwail koaruhsie pahn mehla duwehte irail.
A duwen ohl ehk welimeno, me wasahn iroir en Siloham pwupwudiong pohrail oh kemeirailao, kumwail lemeleme me met kadehdehda me re suwedsang aramas koaros me kin kousoan Serusalem?
Soh kowahlap! Kumwail en ese pwe ma kumwail sohte koluhla oh wiliakapwala, kumwail koaros pahn mehla duwehte irail.”
Sises pil ketin mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet: “Aramas emen mie me eh tuhke pik pwoat mi nan sapwe. E ahpw kolahng dolung wah; ahpw e sohte diar me ieu.
Ih eri ndahng nah soumweto, ‘Nahn, kilang pwe sounparehr siluh I pwarepwarek wasaht pwe I en dolung wahn tuhke pik wet, ahpw sohte me I kin diar. Ke pahn pelehdihsang, pwe sohte katepe, kapwekapwe eh mihmi nan sahpwet.’
Soumweto eri sapeng ohlo, patohwan, “Komw ketin mweidohng mahs ma e sohte pahn wa nan sounparet. Pwe I pahn song kapilkipene tapiet ehu warawar en oh kesehiong koiasi loale.
Ma e pahn wa nan sounpar kohkohdo, me mwahu; a ma soh, eri, kitail nek pelehdihsang.’”
Rahnen Sapad ehu Sises ketin wiewia sapwellime padahk nan sinakoke ehu.
Lih emen iang mi wasao, me ngehn suwed tiadahr powe erein sounpar eisek waluh me kahrehda eh soumwahu. Liho mpwokos oh inenen kospene, sohte kak dengda oh kesihnenda.
Ni Sises eh mahsanihada liho, e ahpw mahsanihong, “Lih maiauda sang omw soumwahuen!”
Ih eri ketikidahng powe lime ko, a ahnsowohte liho pa dengpeseng oh kesihnenda, kapikapinga Koht.
Soumas en sinakokeo ahpw lingeringerkihda Sises eh ketin kakehlahda lih menet rahnen Sapad. Ih eri uhdahte patohwanohng pokono, “Mie rahn weneu me kitail pahn kin doadoahk; eri, ih rahn ako me kumwail pahn kin kohdo pwe kumwail en ale kakehlapamwail, a kaidehk rahnen Sapad!”
Kaun-o ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Mwalaun amwailen! Kumwail koaros kin lapwahda noumwail kou kan oh ahs akan sang nan dewerail oh kahreiraillahng ni pihl pwe re en nimpil rahnen Sapad.
A lih menet, me nein Eipraam, me senselkiher rehn Sehdan sounpar eisek waluh; e soh konehng en lapwada sang nan selipe kan rahnen Sapad?”
Sapwellimen Sises pasapeng wet kasarowehdi irail koaros me uhwong, a aramas teiko koaros perenkihda wiewia kapwuriamwei koaros me e kin ketin wiewia.
Sises pil mahsanih, “Dahme Wehin Koht rasehng? Dahme I kak karasahiong?
E rasehng kisin werentuhke kis me tikitihkie, me aramas emen ale oh kamwerehdiong nan sapwe. Kisin waro wosada, keirda oh wiahla tuhke pwoat, menpihr kan ahpw kin wiahda pasarail nin rah kan.”
Sises pil ketin mahsanih, “Dahme I pahn karasahiong Wehin Koht?
E rasehng ihs me lih emen ale oh doaloakihda nesen pilawa ieu, nesen pilawao lao mwutala oh mpwosada.”
Sises eri ketiket kohla nan kahnimw laud oh tikitik kan padapadahk ong aramas akan ni eh ketiket kohdalahng Serusalem.
Mehmen ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, mehlel apwoat me me malaulau me pahn mourla?” Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanihong irail,
“Kumwail nantihong pwe kumwail en keid nan wenihmw wetikitik; pwe I ndaiong kumwail, me tohto pahn song keid ie, ahpw re sohte pahn kak.
Ni kaunen peneinei men eh pahn uhda oh ritingedi wenihmwen imwe, kumwail pahn mi liki wie letelet oh ndinda, ‘Maing, komw ketin ritingadahng kiht.’ E ahpw pahn sapengkin kumwail, “I sehse mehnia kei kumwail.’
Kumwail ahpw pahn tapihada ndinda, ‘Kiht, se iang komwi mwohdehng tehpel oh iang komwi kamadipw; komw ketin padapadahkehr nan at kahnimw!’
E ahpw pil pahn mahsanih, ‘I sehsei kumwail, I pil sehse wasa kumwail kohsang ie. Kumwail kohkohweisang ie, kumwail koaros aramas tiahk suwed kei!
Ia uwen mwahiei oh tehtehrek en ngih me pahn wiawi ni amwail pahn kilang Eipraam, Aisek, oh Seikop, oh soukohp koaros nan Wehin Koht, a kumwail ahpw pahn pisikensang loale!
A mehn palimese oh palikapi, mehn paliepeng oh palieir, ahpw pahn uhd kohdo oh mwohndiong tehpel nan Wehin Koht.
Kumwail en ese pwe irail ko me ikmwurih ahnsou wet, re pahn mwowehla ahnsowo; a me mwowe kan ahnsou wet, re pahn ikmwurihla.”
Ni ahnsowohte Parisi kei pwarodohng Sises oh patohwanohng, “Maing, komw uhdahn pahn ketiketiweisang wasaht, ketiketla ekis wasa tohrohr, pwe Erod kupwukupwure en kemeikomwihla.”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail kohwei oh ndahng kidien wel menen: ‘Ke en ese pwe rahnwet, oh lakapw, I pahn kausasang ngehn suwed kan rehn aramas akan, kamwahwihala me soumwahu kan; oh ni kesiluhwen rahn I pahn kaimwisekala ei doadoahk.’
Ahpw rahnwet, pil lakapw, pil pali, me I pahn kohkohla; pwe sohte wasa kis konehng soukohp men en kamakamala ie pwe nan Serusalemte.
“Serusalem, Serusalem! Kowe me kin kemehla soukohp kan, oh kin katehki takai irail kan me kin pekederdohng rehmw! Ia uwen tohtohn ei men kompwalehkipene pehi kat noumw aramas akan, rasehng litok emen me kin kompwalpene nah kan pahn peh kan, a ke ahpw kahng mweidohng ie!
Eri, Koht solahr pahn ketiket rehmw! Ke en ese pwe ke solahr pahn kilang ie, ahnsou lao leledo me ke pahn nda, ‘Koht en kupwuramwahwih me ketiket kohdo ni mwaren Kaun-o!”
Kedekedeo, ni rahnen Sapad ehu Sises ketin iang konot rehn Parisi lapalap emen ni imwe; a aramas akan ahpw mwasamwasahn kowahlap.
Ohl emen me neh oh peh kan mpwospeseng ahpw pwarala rehn Sises.
Sises ahpw sohpeiong sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko oh Parisi ko oh mahsanih, “Ia duwen atail pelien Kosonned, e mweimweiong kitail en kakehlahda aramas rahnen Sapad, de soh?”
Irail eri nennenlahte sohte mwekid. A Sises ahpw ketin doahke ohlo, kakehlahda, oh mahsanih en patopatohla sang wasao.
E ahpw pil mahsanihong irail, “Mie mehmen rehmwail me nah pwutak emen de nah kou men pahn pwupwudiong nan pwoahr ehu rahnen Sapad, a e soh pahn mwadang kihda sang loale, mehnda ma rahno rahnen Sapad?”
Irail ahpw sohte kak sapengki mehkot.
Ni Sises eh ketin tehkada duwen mehkei me iang lukedohng kamadipw ehu, ar kin pilada dehu kesempwal kan nin tehpel, e ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail koaros karasaras pwoatet:
“Ma ke ale luken iang kamadipw en kapwopwoud ehu, ieremen ke kohdo oh mwohndi lempahntamw. Pwe emen me lapasang uhk de pil iang lukohng ni kamadipwo,
oh me lukei kumwa dehr kohdo oh ndaiong uhk, ‘Nahn, kihong mahs ohl menet deumwen.’ Ke ahpw pahn sarohdi tohrekdidohng ni kapio.
Ahpw, ma ke pahn ale luk, kohdo oh mwohndiong ni kapio, pwe me lukeiuko en kohdo oh ndaiong uhk, ‘Kompoakepahi, menlau sipaladahdo met.’ Met pahn kahrehiong omw pahn adamwahula rehn tohnkapar en kamadipwo koaros.
Pwe irail koaros me kin aklapalapki pein ihr, pahn tikitikla, oh me kin aktikitingki pein ihr, pahn lapalapala.”
Sises eri pil mahsanihong ohl me lukehdo pwe en konot reho, “A komwi, ni omwi pahn kin wiahda kisin kamadipw, nin souwas de nin soutik, ieremen komw lukeiong kompoakepahmwi kan, de riomwi kan, de soumwi kan, de mehn mpomwi me kepwehpwe kan—pwe re de dupuk ong komwi oh lukeikomwihong ni arail kamadipw.
Ma komw pahn wia omwi kamadipw, a komw luke me paisuwed kan, me mwoator kan, me nehtuk kan, oh me maskun kan.
Komwi ahpw pahn diarki omwi pai; pwehki ar sohte kak dupukohng komwi. Komw pahn ale dupuk en omwi kadek sang rehn Koht ni ahnsou me me lelepek kan pahn iasada sang mehla.”
Ni emen tohnkapar ko me iang mwohd nin tehpelo eh rongada mepwukat, e ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Meid pai me pahn iang mwohdehng tehpel nan Wehin Koht!”
A Sises ketin mahsanihong, “Mie ohl emen me wiahda lapalahn kamadipw ehu; e ahpw lukeiong ni kamadipwo aramas tohto.
Ni eh lel ahnsoun konot, e ahpw kadarala eh ladu men rehn me aleier luk ko pwe en kairehkin irail re en ketidohla pwe soahng koaros mwahwer.
A emenemen irail ahpw tapihada akahkpwungki ar sohte men iang pwarala. Emen ndahng laduwo, ‘Mahkohng ie mahs; pwe I pwaindahr sahpw ehu, eri, I uhdahn pahn kolahng kilang.’
A emen pil ketihtihkihong, ‘Mahkohng ie mahs; pwe I pwaindahr nei kou ehk, I kohkolahng song irail met.’
A pil emen nda, ‘I ahpwtehn pwopwoudida, ihme kahrehda I sohte kak iangki kohwei.’
Laduwo eri pwurala oh kairehki eh mwohnsapwo mehkan koaros. Mwohnsapwo eri engiengda kowahlap, e ahpw mahsanihong eh laduwo, ‘Kohwei nan ahllap akan oh nan alosop akan en kahnimw wet, ke ahpw kahrehdo me paisuwed kan, me mwoator kan, me nehtuk kan, oh me maskun kan me ke pahn tuhwong.’
Mwurin ahnsou ehu, laduwo ahpw patohwan, ‘Maing, soahng koaros wiawihier duwen me komw mahsanih; a pil mihmiehte dewen ekei.’
Mwohnsapwo eri mahsanihong laduwo, ‘Kohwei nanial en likin kahnimw wet, oh ngidingidkihong aramas akan en kohdo, pwe imweiet en dirala.
Kumwail koaros en ese pwe sohte emen rehn me ale luk ko pahn iang song ei kamadipw!’”
Kedekedeo, pokon lapalap ehu ideidawehn Sises. Ih eri ketin sohpeiong irail oh mahsanih,
“Mehmen me men idawehniehdo oh iangiehla, e ahpw mwohneki seme oh ine oh eh pwoud oh nah seri kan, oh rie kan oh pil pein ih sang ngehi, nahn, e sohte kak wiahla nei tohnpadahk.
Oh mehmen me sohte kin kapaikada eh lohpwu oh idawehniehdo, e sohte kak wiahla nei tohnpadahk.
Pwe ihs rehmwail, nan eh koasoakoasoane en kauwada eh imwen doulik ehu, e soh pahn mwohndi mahs oh medemedewe uwen pweine, pwe en kilang ma mie reh mwohni me itar kanekehla ihmwo.
Pwe ma e sohte pahn wia met, e sohte pahn kak kanekehla ihmwo mwurin eh kihdiongehr poahsoane. Aramas koaros me pahn kilang met, re pahn kouruhrki de kepitki, nda,
‘Aramas menet tapihada kauwada ihmw ehu, e ahpw sohte kanekehla!’
Ma nanmwarki men pahn ketin mahwenkihong aramas nen emen nanmwarki me sapwellimaniki aramas rienen, e uhdahn pahn ketin kupwukupwure mahs ma e kak kalowehkihdi aramas rieneno sapwellime aramas neno.
Pwe ma e sohte kak, e pahn ketin kadarala sapwellime meninkeder ni ara dohpeseng pwe en peki mahk oh mweimwahu.”
Sises pil mahsanih, “Ih pil duwen kumwail; sohte emen kumwail kak wiahla nei tohnpadahk, ma e sohte mweisang mehkoaros me e ahneki.”
“Soahl mehkot me mwahu; ahpw ma nemenemen soahlo pahn sarasang, sohte mehkot kitail pahn wia pwe nemenemen soahlo en pwurehng miehla.
E pil sohte katepehiong pwehl de ong wia koiasi; e kin lekdekla. Eri, kumwail rong ma mie salengamwail mehn rong wasa!”
Ehu ahnsou sounrik daksis oh aramas sekeniken tohto ahpw keiong mpen Sises pwe re en iang rong sapwellime mahsen.
Parisi ko oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw tapihada lipilipahnede, ndinda, “Ohl menet kin kasamwo me sekeniken kan oh pil kin iang sak rehrail!”
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet:
“Ma emen kumwail mie nah sihpw epwiki, a emen ahpw salongala—dahme e pahn wia? E soh pahn pwilikihdi me duwehk duwemeno nan eh kehl, oh kohwei rapahkiseli me salongalahro, e lao diar?
A ni eh diaradahr, e pahn perenda oh kidahng pohn pwopwe,
walahng ni imwe oh kapokonepene kompoakepah kan oh mehn mpe kan, oh ndahng irail, ‘Kumwail iang ie perenda, pwe I diarehr nei sihpw me salongalahro!’
Eri, kumwail en ese pwe ih duwen me pahn wiawi nanleng, nanleng pahn perenkihda koluhla oh wiliakapwalahn me dipan emen laudsang aramas keniken duwehk duwemen me sohte anahne koluhla.”
“Pil ma lih emen me nah mwohni silper eisek mie, ehu ahpw salongala—dahme e pahn wia? E soh pahn isikada lamp oh koahkoa nan imweo oh rapahki mwahu wasa koaros, e lao diar?
A ni eh diaradahr, e ahpw pahn kapokonepene kompoakepah kan oh mehn mpe kan, oh ndahng irail, ‘Kumwail iang ie perenda, pwe I diarehr nei sent me salongalahro!’
Eri, ih duwen tohnleng en Koht kan, re kin perenkihda me dipan emen eh kin koluhla oh wiliakapwala.”
Sises pil ketin mahsanih, “Ohl emen mie me naineki pwutak riemen.
Me tikitiko ahpw ndahng seme, ‘Ipa, kihongiehla pwaisei me uhdahn ahi sang nin sohso.’ Semeo eri pwalangpeseng sohso ong nah pwutak riemeno.
A mwurin rahn ekei, me tikitiko ahpw netikihla pwaise sang ni eh sohso, oh wahda mwohni ko oh seiloaklahng sahpw doh ieu, wasa e kesehla mwahl ie nah mwohni ko ni mour suwed oh tiahk suwed.
E kamwusala mehkoaros me e ahneki. Mwuri, lehk lapalap ehu ahpw lel sahpwo, pwutako ahpw tapihada duhpekla.
Ih eri pwarala rehn pwilidak en sahpwo men pwe en doadoahk reh. Pwilidak en sahpwo eri kadarala pwutako nan eh kelen pwihk pwe en kin apwahpwalih nah pwihk kan.
Pwutako ahpw kin mehkihla eh men iang kang kenen pwihk ko, ahpw sohte me kin kihong.
Kedekedeo, ni eh kolulahr nan kapehde, e ahpw mengimengloalki, ‘Ia uwen reken kisin mwenge rehn nein ei pahpa tohndoadoahk ko, a I ahpw mehkilahr ei men mwenge!
I pahn uhda oh pwurala rehn semeio oh ndahng, ‘Ipa, I dipadahr rehn Koht oh rehmw.
I solahr warohng ke en nainekin ie. Eri, wiahkiniehla emen noumw ladu.” ’
Ih eri uhdahte pwurala rehn seme. “E saikinte karanih ihmwo, a eh pahpao kilangada. Nan kapehde mwekidkihda kowahlap kompoakehn nah pwutako; ih eri tangalahte pwoalehdi oh metik.
A pwutako ahpw nda, ‘Ipa, I dipadahr rehn Koht oh pil rehmwi; I solahr warohng ke en wiahkin ie noumw pwutak.’
A semeo ahpw ekerpene eh ladu ko oh ndahng irail, ‘Kumwail pitipit wahdo likou me keieu kaselel oh kalikawihada. Kumwail kihong rihng nin sendin peh oh suht nin neh kan.
Kumwail wahdo kou pwul mworourou oh kemehla, pwe kitail en kamadipwki!
Pwe nei pwutaket melahr, e ahpw mourdahr; e salongalahr, e ahpw dierekier.’ Irail eri tapihada arail kamadipwo.
“A nindokon mepwukat eh wiewiawi, pwutak laudo mihmi nansapw. Ni eh pwurodo oh kerendohng ni ihmwo, e rongada ar kesekeseng oh kahkahlek nan ihmwo.
Ih eri ekerodo emen ladu ko oh idek dahme wiewiawi mwo.
A laduwo sapeng, ndahng, ‘Riomwio me pwurodohr, oh semomwio ahpw kemehla kou pwul mworourouwo, pwehki eh pwurodo ni eh mour oh kehlail.’
Pwutak laudo ahpw mwakarkihda oh sohte men pedolong nan ihmwo. Semeo ahpw pedoila oh peki reh en pedolong iang kamadipwo.
E ahpw sapeng semeo, nda, ‘Sounpar tohtohie I doadoahkohnguhkehr duwehte ladu men oh sohte mwahn kauwehla omw kosonned ehu. A dahme ke kihong ie? Pil sohte kisin kuht kis me I en kamadipwehki kompoakepahi kan!
A noumw pwutak menet me kamwusalahr pwaise sang ni eh sohso ong lih suwed kan, ke ahpw kemehiong kou pwul mworourouwen, ni eh pwurodohr!’
Semeo ahpw sapeng, nda, ‘Lao, nei seri kompoake kowe, ke kin mihmihte rehi ahnsou koaros, oh ei dipwisou koaros iei ahmw.
Me mwahu ke en iang kiht perenda oh wia kamadipw wet, pwe riomwo melahr, ahpw mourdahr; e salongalahr, e ahpw dierekier.’”
Sises ketin mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Ohl kepwehpwe men mie, me nah sounkohwa men adsuwedla, dene me peidlakid ong eh kohwa kepwe kan.
E ahpw ekerodo nah sounkohwao oh idek, ‘Ia duwen rohng pwoatet duwen kowe? Wehkada mahs omw kohwahn, pwe ke solahr kak wia ei sounkohwa.’
Sounkohwao ahpw mengimengloalki, ‘Dahme I pahn wiaht? Pwe ei mwohnsapwo pahn ketikihsang ie ei kohwa doadoahket. I sohte kakohng doadoahk en pwehl, I namenengki pekipekseli.
Eri, soh pwe I ese dahme I pahn wia, pwe aramas akan en kasamwoielong nan imwarail kan, ni ei pahn lekdeksang nan ei kohwa.’
Ih eri ekerodo aramas koaros me pweipwand ong eh mwohnsapwo. E ahpw idek rehn me kohdo mahso, ‘Ia uwen omw pweipwand ong mwohnsapwo?’
A e sapeng, nda, ‘Kalon en lehn olip epwiki.’ A e ndahng, ‘Ale noumw pwuhken, mwohndi oh ntingihedi me limeisekte.’
A e pil idek rehn emen, ‘A kowe, ia uwen omw pweipwand?’ A e sapeng, nda, ‘Edin pilawa kid.’ A e ndahng, ‘Ale noumw pwuhken, mwohndi oh ntingihedi me welipwikihte.’
Ni mwohnsapwo eh mwahngihada met, e ahpw kapingahla loalokong suwed en sounkohwao; pwe aramas akan me kisehn sampah, re me kin loalokong ni mehkan me pid pein irail laudsang me kisehn marain kan ni mehkan me pid ar mour soutuk.”
Sises eri pil mahsanih, “Eri, I ndaiong kumwail, kumwail en doadoahngkihong aramas teikan amwail dipwisoun sampah kan, pwe re en wiahla kompoakepamwail; pwe ni amwail dipwisou eh pahn sohrala, Koht pahn ketin kasamwolong kumwail nan dehu soutuk kan.
Me kin loalopwoat ni mehkot tikitik, e pahn pil loalopwoat ni mehkot laud; oh me kin keseulikilik ni mehkot tikitik, e pahn pil keseulikilik ni mehkot laud.
Eri, ma kumwail sohte pahn loalopwoat ni paien sampah kan, a ihs me pahn liki ong kumwail ni pai mehlel kan en powe?
Oh ma kumwail me keseulikilik ni doadoahk en kohwahki ong emen eh dipwisou, a ihs me pahn kihong kumwail mehkot pwe en wia uhdahn amwail?
“Sohte ladu men kak papah soumas riemen: pwe e pahn kailongki emen oh poakohng meteio; e pahn kesempwalki emen, oh mwamwahlki meteio. Eri, kumwail sohte kak papah Koht oh dipwisoun sampah.”
Parisi ko iang rongorong mepwukat koaros, re ahpw kin kepikepitki Sises, pwehki ar kesempwalki mwohni.
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kin akupwungki pein kumwail mwohn mesen aramas akan, a Koht ketin mwahngih dahme audepen nan kapehdomwail kan. Pwe me kin kalap kesempwal rehn aramas akan, kin wiahla mehkot mwahl mwohn silangin Koht.
“Manaman en Kosonned en Moses oh padahk en soukohp ako mieier sang kawao kohdo lel ni mwehin Sohn Sounpapidais; a sang ni ahnsowo Rongamwahu duwen Wehin Koht lolohkseli oh aramas koaros kin nannantihong re en pedolong nan Wehin Koht.”
Ahpw me mengei ong nanleng oh sampah en sohrala sang kisin mesen nting kis en Kosonnedo en sohrala.
“Mehmen me kin mweisang uhdahn eh pwoud oh pwoudikihda emen lih tohrohr, kin wiahda dipen kamwahl; oh mehmen me kin pwoudikihda lih me eh pwoud keselahr, e pil wiahda dipen kamwahl.”
“Ahnsou ehu ohl kepwehpwe men mie, me kin likawih likou melengileng weitahta oh kaselel, oh kin kamakamadipw rahn koaros.
Pil mie ohl semwehmwe men, ede Lasarus, diren kens ni paliwere, me kin wisikiong ni wenihmwen imwen ohl kepwehpweo;
pwe e kin men tungoale mweremwer en kisin mwenge me kin pwupwudi sang pohn en ohl kepwehpweo eh tehpel. Kidi kan pil kin keiong mpe oh tamwetamwe eh kens kan.
Kedekedeo, ohl semwehmweo ahpw mehla, tohnleng kan ahpw wahdalahng nanleng mpen Eipraam. Me kepwehpweo pil mehla, oh seridi.
Nan eh weiweirek laud rehn me lekdeklahr akan, e ahpw kilengdahla kilangada Eipraam wasa doh iangahki Lasarus.
Ih eri likwerlahng Eipraam, patohwan, ‘Semei Eipraam, komw ketin kupwure ie! Komw ketin kadarodo mahs Lasarus pwe en kaduh sendin peh nan pihl oh kalamwurehki loweiet, pwe I mwasingkilahr kowahlap kisiniei wet.’
Eipraam ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, ‘Kompoakepahi, tamanda me ke aleier omw pai koaros ni omw mour nin sampah, a Lasarus ale soahng suwed koaros; ihme e nsensenamwahuki ahnsou wet, a kowe wie weiweirengki.
A pil ehu, wahu kalaimwun ehu mie nanpwungatail; sohte mehmen reht kak sipalowohng rehmwail, pil sohte mehmen rehmwail kak sipalodohng reht.’
Ohl kepwehpweo ahpw sapeng, nda, ‘Eri, I peki rehmwi, semei, komw poaronelahng Lasarus mahs ni imwen ei pahpao nin sampah,
rehn riei me limmeno. Komw poaronehla pwe en kolahng kehsehkin irail wasaht, pwe re dehr pil leledohng nan wasahn weirek wet.’
Eipraam mahsanihalahng, ‘Pwuken Moses oh soukohp ako mie rehn riomw ko pwe en kehsehkin irail soahng koaros. Re en rong dahme Moses oh soukohp ko kin mahsanih.’
Ohl kepwehpweo ahpw sapeng, patohwan, ‘Maing, semei Eipraam, soahng wet sohte itar! Ma emen sang rehn me melahr akan pahn pwarala rehrail, eri, re pahn koluhla oh wiliakapwala.’
Eipraam sapeng, mahsanih, ‘Ma re sohte rong Moses oh soukohp ako, re pil sohte pahn kamehlele emen me pahn pwarala sang rehn me melahr akan.”
Sises ketin mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Soahng kan me kin kahrehiong aramas nan dihp uhdahn pahn kin mie; ahpw meid suwediong aramaso me kin kahrehdo soahng pwukat!
E pahn mwahwongete, ma peitehl ehu pahn pirapiriong ni tepinwere, oh lekdeklahng nan madau, sang ma e pahn kahrehiong mehmen me tikitik pwukat nan dihp.
Kumwail eri kaleke pein kumwail! “Ma riomw men dipada, kapwungala ni meleilei; oh ma e koluhla, mahkohng.
A ma e wiahda sapwung ehu ong uhk pahn isipak rahn ehu, oh pahn isipako e kohdo rehmw oh nda, ‘I nsensuwedkihla ei sapwung,’ a ke uhdahn pahn mahkohng.”
Wahnpoaron ko ahpw patohwanohng Kaun-o, “Maing, komw ketin kalaudehla at pwoson.”
Kaun-o ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ma amwail pwoson pahn laud duwehte kisin weren kadiring kis, kumwail pahn kak ndahng tuhke pwoatet, ‘Pein usukekda sang men oh kohla poadada nan madau,’ a e pahn dukiong kumwail.”
“Ma mehmen rehmwail mie eh ladu me wie mwetimwet de kamwekamwenge sihpw kan nansapw; eri, ni eh pahn pwurodo rehmwail, kumwail sohte kin ndahng en mwohndi oh mwengehla,
ahpw en onopada mwengehn soutik, en likawihada likoun papah oh papah kumwail nindokon amwail pahn sakasak, pwe ih me pahn uhd mwenge mwuhr.
Ladu men sohte kin warohng ale kasapahlkalahngan, pwehki e uhdahn pahn kapwaiada mahsen en eh kaun.
Ih pil duwen kumwail: kumwail pahn kin kapwaiada mehkoaros me kileldiong kumwail en wia, oh kumwail pahn kin nda, ‘Kiht, lidu soh katepe kei; ihte pwaisat, se en kapwaiada at pwukoa.’”
Ni Sises eh ketiket kohdalahng Serusalem, e ketin weid nanpwungen Sameria oh Kalili.
Oh ni eh ketilong nan kisin kahnimw kis e ahpw tuhwong ohl tokutok ehk. Re ahpw uh dohlahsang ekis,
oh likwerlahng, patohwan, “Maing, Sises, at Mwohnsapw! Komw ketin kupwurei kiht!”
Sises ketin mahsanihirailda, e ahpw mahsanih, “Kumwail kohwei rehn samworo ko oh ale keseu rehrail.” A nindokon ar patopato kohla, re ahpw mwakelekella.
Emen irail, ni eh kilangada duwen eh mwakelekellahro, e ahpw pwurodo rehn Sises, ngihl laudida, kapikapinga Koht.
E ahpw poaridiong mwohn aluweluwe kan, pil kapikapinga Sises. Eri, mehn Sameria men ohlo.
Sises eri mahsanih, “Kaidehk me ehk me mwakelekellahro? A ia me duwemeno?
Dahme mehn liki menette me pwurodo pwe en kasapahlkalahngan ong Koht?”
Sises eri mahsanihong ohlo, “Eri, uhda, oh kohkohwei; pwe omw pwosonen me kakehleiukadahr.”
Parisi kei ahpw kalelapak rehn Sises, “Iahd Wehin Koht pahn pwarodo?” E ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Wehin Koht sohte kin kohdo ni mwohmw sansal.
Sohte me pahn nda, ‘Ietet Wehin Koht,’ de ‘Ionen;’ pwe Wehin Koht miher loalamwail.”
E ahpw mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Ahnsou ehu pahn kohdo me kumwail pahn anahne kilang ehu rahn ako en Nein-Aramas, kumwail ahpw sohte pahn kakohng.
Mie me pahn ndahng kumwail, ‘Kumwail kilang, ionen ih!’ de, ‘Iet ih!’ Kumwail dehr kohieiwohng rapahki.
Pwe duwen lioal eh kin pir, oh linge ahpw kin kamarainihada wasa sang apalien lahng lel apali, iei duwen me pahn wiawihong Nein-Aramas ni sapwellime rahn.
Ahpw e uhdahn pahn lokolok laud mahs oh posoik sang rehn aramas en dih wet.
Me wiawihier ni mwehin Noha, e pil pahn wiawi ni rahn akan en Nein-Aramas.
Aramas koaros kamakamadipw, kangkang sakau, wiewie pwopwoud, lao lel rahn me Noha pedolong nan warihmwo, nohlik lapalapo ahpw leledo oh kamwomwirailla koaros.
Pil duwen me wiawihier ni mwehin Lohd, aramas koaros kamakamadipw, kangkang sakau, wie netinet, wie sapwasapw, kokou ihmw;
a ni rahn me Lohd mweselsang Sodom, kisiniei oh suwepel ahpw mweredi sang nanleng oh kemeirailla koaros.
Eri, ih duwen me pahn wiawi ni rahnen Nein-Aramas eh pahn sansalda.
“Ni rahno, mehmen me mi pohn imwe, e dehpa kohdiong ale eh kepwe me mihmi loale. Pil duwehte mehmen me mihmi nansapw, e dehpa pwurodo ni imwe.
Kumwail tamataman en Lohd eh pwoudo!
Mehmen me men doarehla eh mour, e pahn pwupwusang; a mehmen me men tounmeteikihla eh mour, e pahn doarehla.
I ndaiong kumwail pwe nipwongo, aramas riemen pahn memeir pohn peht teieu; emen pahn wisiksang, a emen pahn luhwehdi.
Lih riemen pahn kepekepel pilawa; emen pahn wisiksang, a emen pahn luhwehdi.
[Aramas riemen pahn mihmi nansapw; emen pahn wisiksang, a emen pahn luhwehdi.”]
Tohnpadahk ko eri patohwan idek rehn Sises, “Maing, ia wasa mepwukat pahn wiawi ie?” Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Wasa me mahn mehla men kin mie, iei wasao menpihr me adaneki puldur kin pokonlahng ie.”
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet, pwe en ketin padahkihong irail re en kin poaden kapakap oh dehr tokedihsang.
“Sounkopwung men mie nan kahnimw ehu, me sohte kin masak Koht pil sohte kin wauneki aramas.
Pil liohdi men mie nan kahnimwohte, me kin pwurepwure sounkopwungo oh reperepen pwung reh, ‘Komw menlau sewese ie ni repenpwung wet ong pelieio!’
Ahnsou reirei sounkopwungo sohte men tehk liohdio. Kedekedeo, e ahpw mengimengloalki, ‘Mehnda ma I sohte masak Koht oh pil sohte kin wauneki aramas,
ahpw I pahn sewese mahs lih menet en rapahkihda eh pwung, pwe e dehr kedirepwei ie oh dehr kin pwurodo kauwehla ei onepek.’”
Sises pil ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail rong dahme sounkopwung suwed menet ketihtihki.
Ia duwe, Koht sohte pahn ketin sewese sapwellime aramas akan me kin pekipeki sawas ni rahn nipwong? E pahn ketin pwapwand en sewese irail?
Kumwail en ese pwe e uhdahn pahn mwadang sewese irail nan arail apwal akan. Eri a, kumwail lemeleme me Nein-Aramas pahn ketin diar pwoson nin sampah ni eh pahn ketido?”
Sises pil ketin mahsanih karasaras pwoatet ong aramas ekei me kin akupwungki pein ihr oh pohnmwahsoiong meteikan:
“Aramas riemen kohdalahng kapakap nan Tehnpas Sarawio; emen ira Parisi men, a emen sounrik daksis.
Parisio kesihnenda oh wia eh kapakap nin duwe met: ‘Maing Koht, I kapingkalahngankihong komwi ei sohte kin noahrok, ei sohte kin mwersuwed, ei sohte kin kamwahl duwehte aramas teikan. I kapingkalahngankihong komwi ei pil sohte duwehte sounrik daksis menet.
I kin kaisihsol pak riau nan wihk ehu, oh I kin meirongki eisek kis ehu sang ni mehkoaros me I ahneki.’
A sounrik daksiso kesihnen ekis dohlahsang, e ahpw sohte men saradalahng nanleng, pwe ihte me e wiewia, pikipikir nan mwaremware, ndinda, ‘Maing Koht, komw ketin kupwurei ie, pwe aramas dipan emen ngehi!’”
Sises eri mahsanih, “Kumwail en ese pwe ohl menet pwungla rehn Koht ahpw pwurala ni imweo; a meteio, soh. Pwe me kin aklapalapki pein ih, pahn tikitikla; a me kin aktikitingki pein ih, pahn lapalapala.”
Aramas ekei ahpw patohwanohng Sises nair kisin seri kei pwe en ketkidahng pohrail lime kan. Tohnpadahk ko eri kilangada oh lipwoarehkinirailda.
A Sises ahpw malipehdo kisin seri ko oh mahsanihong tohnpadahk ko, “Kumwail pweisang, kumwail mweidohng kisin seri kan en kohdo rehi; pwe iei arail wehi, Wehin Koht.
Kumwail en ese pwe mehmen me sohte pahn ale Wehin Koht duwehte kisin seri kis, e sohte pahn pedolong loale.”
Emen lapalap en mehn Suhs ako ahpw idek rehn Sises, patohwan, “Maing, Sounpadahk mwahu, dahme I uhdahn pahn wia pwe I en kak alehki mour soutuk?”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Dahme komw ekerkiniehki Sounpadahk mwahu? Sohte emen me mwahu pwe Kohtohte.
Komw eseier kosonned kan: ‘Dehr kamwahl; dehr kemehla aramas; dehr pirap; dehr likamw; kahkahki semomw oh inomw.’”
Ih eri patohwanohng Sises, “I kapwaiadahr kosonned pwukat koaros sang ni ei tikitik.”
Ni Sises eh karonge met, e ahpw mahsanihong, “Pil mie mehkot me komw uhdahn pahn wia: netikihla omw kepwe kan koaros, oh nehkohng pweine kan me semwehmwe kan; omwi pai ahpw pahn mie nanleng. Komw ahpw kohdo oh iangiehla.”
Ni ohlo eh rongada mahsen wet, e ahpw nsensuwedkihla kowahlap, pwe aramas kepwehpwe men ih.
Ni Sises eh ketin mahsanihada duwen eh nsensuwedlao, e ahpw mahsanih, “Meid apwal ong me kepwehpwe kan en pedolong nan Wehin Koht!
Me pahn apwal mehlel ong me kepwehpwe men en pedolong nan Wehin Koht sang mahn me adaneki kamel en dil nan pwoaren dikek ehu.”
Irail me rongorong Sises ko ahpw kalelapak, patohwan, “Ma ih duwen met, a ihs me kak mourla?”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Mehkot me sohte mwahn kak pahn aramas, e uhdahn kak pahn Koht.”
Piter ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing, komw mwahngih mahs duwen kiht, pwe se tounmeteikilahr mehkoaros me aht oh iangkomwilahr.”
Sises ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail en ese pwe kumwail koaros me tounmeteikilahr imwarail, de ar pwoud, de riarail, de samarail, de neirail seri kan pwehki Wehin Koht,
re pahn ale pwaisarail laud nan mouret, oh mour soutuk palio.”
Sises ketin kahrehla tohnpadahk ehk riemeno oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kilang pwe kitail kohkohdalahng Serusalem, wasa me soahng koaros me soukohp ako ntingdier duwen Nein-Aramas pahn pweida ie.
E pahn pengpengla rehn mehn liki kan, wiahla mehn kepit rehrail; re pahn kihsang wauwi oh kandipih.
Re pahn wokih oh kemehla; a ni kesiluhn rahn e ahpw pahn iasada.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw sohte mwahn wehwehki mahsen pwukat; wehwehn mahsen pwukat me rirsang irail, iei me re sohte dehdehki dahme Sises mahmahsanihong irail.
Sises ketiket kohla limwahn kahnimw en Seriko, a ohl maskun men mwomwohd wie pekipek limwahnialo.
Ni eh rongada mwoarong en pokono me kekeid wasao, e ahpw idek, “Dahkot mwo?”
Re ahpw ndaiong me Sises mehn Nasaret me ketiket kolahng nan kahnimwo.
Ohlo eri likwer, patohwan, “Sises, kisehn Depit! Komw ketin kupwure ie!”
Aramas ako me mi mwowe ahpw lipwoarehda oh ndahng en nennenla. A e ahpwte kalaudehla ngileo, patohwan, “Maing, komwi me kisehn Depit! Komw ketin kupwure ie!”
Sises eri ketin uhdi oh mahsanih pwe ohlo en pakahrdohng reh. Ni ohlo eh kerendo, e ahpw keinemwe, mahsanih,
“Dahme ke anahne I en sewesehkin uhk?” A e patohwan, “Maing, I patohwan anahne pwurehng kilangada wasa.”
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong, “Nna! Kilangada wasa! Omw pwosonen me kakehlaiukadahr.”
Ni ahnsowohte e pa pehdpeseng oh kilangada wasa. E ahpw idawehnla Sises oh kapikapinga Koht. Ni pokono ar kilangada manaman wet, irail koaros ahpw pil kapikapinga Koht.
Sises eri ketilong oh ketiket kohla nan kahnimw en Seriko.
A ohl kepwehpwe men mie wasao, ede Sakies, me lapalap rehn sounrik daksis ko.
E iang songosong en kilangki mese Sises, a pwehki eh paliwar mwotomwot, iei me e sohte kak pwehki pokono.
Ih eri tangalahte mwohn pokono, doudahng nin tuhke pwoat me mi limwahn wasa me Sises pahn ketin keid ieo.
Ni Sises eh ketin lel wasao, e ahpw mahsendahlahte mahsanihada Sakies nan tuhkeo; e ahpw mahsanilahng, “Sakies, doudi mwadang, pwe rahnwet I pahn pas rehmw ni imwomwo.”
Sakies eri pitipitte doudihsang nan tuhkeo oh kasamwolong Sises nan imweo ni eh peren laud.
Aramas koaros me iang kilang met, re ahpw tapihada lipilipahnedki, ndinda, “Ohl menet iangehr pedolong nan imwen aramas dipan emen!”
Sakies eri uhda mwohn silangin Kaun-o oh patohwanohng, “Maing, komw mwahngih pwe I pahn kisekisehki me semwehmwe kan apalien ei kepwe kan; a ma mie emen me I pitihasang mehkot, I pahn kapwungohng ni uwe ieu me laudsang pak pahieu.”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Rahnwet komour me lelohngehr ni ihmw wet; pwe pil nein Eipraam aramas menet.
Pwe Nein-Aramas ketidohn rapahki oh komourala me salongalahr akan.”
Ni aramas ako ar rongorong mahsen pwukat, Sises pil mahsanihong irail apwoat karasaras. E ketin kerenlahngehr Serusalem, oh aramas akan kin lemeleme me Wehin Koht nektehn pahn sansalda.
Ih eri mahsanih, “Ohl lapalap emen mie me seiloaklahng nan sahpw doh ehu pwe en kesepwildahng nanmwarki; e ahpw pahn ketin sapahldohng nan uhdake.
Eri, mwohn eh pahn ketin mwesel, e ahpw malipepene sapwellime ladu ehk oh ketikihong emenemen paunen kohl ehu, oh mahsanihong irail, ‘Kumwail kilang dahme kumwail kak wihnkihda sang ni mwohni pwukat, I lao pwurodo.’
Eri, aramas en sahpwo kin kailongki mehlel ohlo, iei me re kadarkihla mwuri meninkeder kei pwe re en kairehki duwen ar sohte pwungki en wiahla ar nanmwarki.
“Kedekedeo, ohlo ahpw wiahla nanmwarki oh sapahldo. E ahpw mwadang mahsanihong sapwellime ladu ehko, me e ketikihong mwohni ko, re en pwarala pwe e men mwahngih uwen mwohni me irail wihnkiher.
Me keieu pwarala mahs ahpw patohwanohng, ‘Maing, iet paunen kohl eisek me I wihnkiher sang ni me komw ketikihong ie.’
Ohlo ahpw mahsanihong, ‘Meid mwahu! Aramas lelepek men kowe. Eri, pwehki omw loalopwoat ni mehkot me tikitik, I pahn kihong uhk mwaren kaunen kahnimw eisek.’
Keriemen en laduwo ahpw pil leledo oh patohwanohng, ‘Maing, iet paunen kohl limau me I wihnkiher sang ni me komw ketikihong ie.’
A e mahsanihong, ‘Ke pahn ale mwaren kaunen kahnimw limau.’
Pil emen ladu pwarodo oh patohwanohng, ‘Maing, iet sapwellimomwi mwohni; I patohwan nekidala nan limwinpwudo wet.
Pwe I masak komwi, pwehki komwi ohl sakon emen. Komw kin ketikihsang me komw sohte kin ketikidi, oh kin dolungasang me komw sohte kin kamwarak.’
Ohlo ahpw mahsanihong, ‘Aramas mwersuwed men kowe! I pahn kadeingkinuhkada pein omw koasoi. Ke ese me ohl sakon emen ngehi, me kin ale me I sohte kin kihdi, oh kin dolung me I sohte kin kamwarak.
Eri, mehnda ke sohte kihdiong nei mwohni nan pangk, pwe en neitik; pwe ni ei pahn pwurodo, I en ale iangahki wah kan?’
Ih eri mahsanihong irail me iang mi wasao, ‘Kumwail kihsang mwohnio oh kihong me nah paun eiseko.’
A re patohwanohng, ‘Maing, mieier nah me paun eisek!’
A e ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, ‘Kumwail en ese pwe mehmen me ahneki mehkot, kalaudpe pahn pil kohieng; a me sohte naineki mehkot, pil mehkis me e naineki pahn pehdsang.
Eri, a duwen irail ko me ei imwintihti, me sohte men I en kaunirailda, kumwail kahreiraildo met oh kemeirailla mwohi!’”
Ni Sises eh ketin kaerala sapwellime mahsen pwukat, e ahpw ketin tiengla mwohrail ketiketlahng Serusalem.
Ni eh ketin kerenlahng Pedpeiti oh Pedani, limwahn dohl me adaneki Nahnahn Olip, e ketin poaronehla riemen sapwellime tohnpadahk ko,
mahsanih, “Kumwa kohwei nan kahnimwen. Ni amwa pahn pedolong, kumwa pahn kilangada ahs pwul men me wie sensel, me saikinte aramas emen dake. Kumwa lapwahda oh kahrehdo met.
A ma mehmen idek rehmwa, mehnda rehmwa ahso, kumwa sapengki me Mwohnsapwo me anahne.”
Ira eri kohla oh diarada soahng koaros nin duwen Sises eh mahsanihong ira.
Ni ara lapwalapwa ahs pwulo, aramas ekei me neirail ahso idek rehra, “Ser, mehnda kumwa lapwahda ahsen?”
Ira ahpw sapeng, nda, “Mwohnsapwo me ketin anahne.”
Ira eri kahredohng rehn Sises. Irail eri irepehkihdi powe arail likou kan oh sewese Sises en ketidahng powe.
Ni eh ketiket kohla, re perekihwei ar likou kan nanialo.
Ni eh karanih Serusalem, wasa me ahlo tangdilahng Nahnahn Olip, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko koaros tiakada koulen kaping pwoat ong Koht oh ngihl laud kapikapinga ih, pwehki manaman koaros me re iangehr udiahl, kokoulki,
“Koht en ketin kupwuramwahwih nanmwarki me ketiket kohdo ni mwaren Kaun-o! Popohl ong nanleng oh kaping ong Koht!”
Parisi kei me iang pokono ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Sounpadahk, komw ketin angiangihada mahs sapwellimomwi tohnpadahk kan pwe re en nennenla.”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kumwail en ese pwe ma re pahn nennenla, takai pwukat pahn uhd pein lokaiahda.”
Ni Sises eh ketin karanih Serusalem, ni eh mahsanihada kahnimwo, e ahpw tentenihrki,
oh mahsanih, “I ahpw men ke en dehdehki rahnwette, dahme uhdahn pahn kahrehiong uhk omw popohl! Ahpw met e rirsang mesomwen.
Pwe rahn ekei pahn kohdo, me omw imwintihti kan pahn keleiukpene, kapiluhkpene, koaitonuhkala sang ni pali koaros.
Re pahn karangkeiukediong nanpwel, iangahki noumw seri kan. Sohte ehu takai pahn luhwehdi pohn ehu, pwehki omw sohte dehdehki ahnsou me Koht ketidohn komouruhkala!”
Sises eri ketilong nan Tehnpas Sarawio oh tapihada angiangihieisang sounnetinet kei,
mahsanihong irail, “E ntingdier nan Pwuhk Sarawi me Koht mahsanih, ‘Imwei pahn adaneki imwen kapakap.’ A kumwail ahpw wiahkilahr deun lipirap ekei!”
Ih eri kin ketin padapadahk rahn koaros nan Tehnpas Sarawio. Samworo lapalap ako, sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko, oh kaunen aramas ako men kemehla Sises.
Re ahpw sohte kak diarada duwen ar pahn kapwaiada irair wet, pwe aramas koaros kin men rongorongete Sises, sohte men katihasang ehu sapwellime padahk kan.
Rahn ehu, nindokon Sises eh ketin wiewia sapwellime padahk ong aramas akan nan Tehnpas Sarawio oh ketin kapakapahrengki Rongamwahu, samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei, iangahki kaunen mehn Suhs kei, ahpw pwarodo
oh patohwanohng, “Komw mahsanihong kiht mahs, ia pwungen omwi ketin wiewia soahng pwukat? Ihs me ketikihong komwi manaman en wia mepwukat?”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “I men kalelapak rehmwail mahs mehkot. Kumwail sapeng ie mahs.
Ia duwen en Sohn Sounpapidais eh manaman en pepidais, e tepisang Koht de aramas?”
Irail ahpw tapihada mengimengloalki, ma kitail pahn nda, ‘E tepisang Koht,’ e pahn mahsanihong kitail, ‘A dahme kumwail sohte pwosonki Sohn?’
A ma kitail pahn nda, ‘E tepisang aramas,’ pokon wet pahn koasuk kitail, pwe irail kin wiahki Sohn soukohp men.”
Irail eri sapeng Sises, patohwan, “Se sohte patohwan wasa e tepisang ie.”
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Eri, I sohte pahn ndaiong kumwail ni manaman en ihs me I wiewiahki mepwukat.”
Sises eri mahsanihong pokono karasaras pwoatet: “Ohl emen koadoakihada mwetin wain ehu; e ahpw kihong soumwet kei re en kohwahkihong. E ahpw seiloakla sang ni imwe mihmihki liki ahnsou reirei.
Ni eh lel ahnsoun dolung wahn mwetin waino, e ahpw kadaralahng soumwet ko eh ladu men pwe en ale rehrail pwaise sang ni eh mwahto. Soumwet ko uhdahte wokiseli laduwo oh kapwurehla kahiep.
E pil pwurehng kadarala emen eh ladu ko; a soumwet ko pil pwurehng kemeseli, re ahpw kasarowehdi oh pil kapwurehla kahiep.
Ohlo pil song kadarala kesilimenen eh ladu. Soumwet ko pil kemehte oh keseieisang nan mwetin waino.
Eri, ohl me ahneki mwahto ahpw mengimengloalki, ‘Dahme I pahn wia? I pahn kadarala nei pwutak kompoake; re uhdahn pahn wauneki!’
A ni soumwet ko ar kilangada pwutako, re ahpw ndapene nanpwungarail, ‘Ih nein ohlo pwutako met. Kitail kemehla, pwe kitail en uhd ahnekihla mwetin wainet.’
Irail eri sikeneisang nan mwahto oh kemehla.” Sises ahpw ketin keinemwe, “Eri, dahme mwohnsapw en mwetin waino pahn wiahiong soumwet ko?
E pahn pein piserla pwe en kemehla soumwet pwuko, oh ketikihong ekei soumwet mwetin waino.” Ni aramas ako ar rong mepwukat, re ahpw nda, “Met sohte kak wiawi!”
Sises ahpw ketin mahmahsanih irail oh mahsanih, “A ia wehwehn mahsen en Pwuhk Sarawi wet: ‘Takai me sounkou ihmw ko kesepwekelahr pwehki eh soh katepe uhd wialahr takaien pwukakeimw?’
Eri, mehmen me pahn pwupwudiong pohn takaio pahn ohla; a mehmen me takaio pahn pwupwudiong powe, e pahn kamwutepene.”
Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko oh samworo lapalap ako song en salihedi Sises wasao, pwehki re ese me e ketin karasaraskin irail; ahpw re masak aramas ako.
Iei me re mwasamwasahnkihte ahnsou mwahu. Irail eri kadaralahng Sises lipoahrok kei, ni mwomwen aramas mwahu, pwe re en lidipihedi ni eh mahsen kan oh pangalahng pahn manaman en kepina.
Irail pwukat eri kalelapak rehn Sises, patohwan, “Maing Sounpadahk, se patohwan ese me omwi mahsen kan oh padahk kan me inenen pwung, pwe komw sohte kin kupwurohki mwomwen aramas, pwe kupwur en Kohtohte ong aramas me komw kin ketin kupwurohki kawehwehda.
Eri, ia duwen kupwuromwien ong irair en daksis? Me pwungiong atail Kosonnedo de soh, atail kin kihda daksis ong Sihsar?”
Sises mwahngih ar widing, e ahpw mahsanihong irail,
“Kumwail kasalehiong ie mahs ehu mwohni silperen. Sansal en ihs oh mwaren ihs me ntinting powe?” A re sapeng, patohwan, “Sihsar.”
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Eri, kumwail kihong Sihsar dahme en Sihsar, a ong Koht dahme sapwellimen Koht.”
Eri, irail sohte kak kasapwunge ni mehkot mwohn pokono, re ahpw nennenlahte oh medemedewe sapwellime pasapeng kapwuriamwei wet.
Sadusi kei ahpw pwarodo rehn Sises. (Irail pwukat iei soangen aramas ko me kin nda me dene me melahr akan sohte pahn mourda sang mehla.) Irail eri idek rehn Sises, patohwan,
“Maing Sounpadahk, Moses koasoanediong kiht kosonned wet: Ma ohl emen mehsang eh pwoud sohte neira seri, eri, rien ohlo me pahn pwoudikihda liohdio pwe ira en kapwaiong rie me melahro nah seri.’
Eri, pwihn pirien ehu mie, ohl isimen. Me laud rehrailo pwoudikihda lih emen, ahpw mehsang, sohte wiahda seri.
“Me keriemeno ahpw pwoudikihda liohdio;
me kesilimeno pil wiahda duwehte. Eri, ih duwen irail me isimeno koaros, re mehsang ar pwoudo, sohte neirail seri.
Ni imwilah, liho pil mehla.
Eri, ni rahn me me melahr kan pahn mourda, ihs me pahn en liho eh pwoud? Pwe irail me isimeno koaros pwoudikihda.”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ohl oh lih akan en sampah wet kin pwopwoud,
a ohl oh lih akan me warohng mourda sang mehla oh mourki mouren mwehi me pahn kohdo, re sohte kin pwopwoud.
Pwe re duwelahr tohnleng kan, oh re solahr kak mehla. Irail me sapwellimen Koht, pwehki ar mourdahsangehr mehla.
Moses pil kadehdeier ni mehlel duwen me melahr akan ar pahn mourda. Pwe ni koasoiepen kisin tuhke tekatek me mpwumpwulo, Moses kahdaneki Kaun-o ‘Koht en Eipraam, Koht en Aisek, Koht en Seikop.’
Met wehwehki duwen eh wia Koht en me momour kan, a kaidehk Koht en me melahr akan—pwe aramas koaros kin momouriong ih.”
Ekei sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing Sounpadahk, me pwung omwi mahsenen!”
Irail eri sohla men idek rehn Sises mehkot.
Sises ketin mahsanihong irail, “Ia duwen amwail kak nda me Mesaia sapwellimen Depit?
Pwe pein Depit mahsanih nan Pwuken Melkahka kan: ‘Kaun-o ketin mahsanihong ei Kaun: Komw ketidiong ni palimauni,
I lao wiahkihda omwi imwintihti kan utupen aluweluwomwi kan.’
Eri, ma Depit wiahki eh ‘Kaun,’ a ia duwen Mesaia eh kak nein Depit?”
Ni aramas koaros ar rongorong, Sises ahpw mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko,
“Kumwail kalekeikumwailsang sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kan me kin mwahuki mi nan likou reirei ahpw moamoahlseli mwohn aramas akan, oh kin men aramas akan en rahnmwahwih ihr nan pokon akan; me kin pilada dewerail lempahntamw nan sinakoke kan oh kin mwahuki moangehda tehpel kan ni kamadipw kan;
me kin adihasang liohdi kan ar mehkoaros, ahpw kin liliosohski wia kapakap reirei! Arail kadeik uhdahn pahn laud mehlel!”
Sises eri ketin mahmahsenseli nan Tehnpas Sarawio, oh mahsanihada duwen ekei aramas kepwehpwe ar kesekese ar mehn meirong kan nan dewen meirongo.
E ahpw pil mahsanihada liohdi semwehmwe men me kesehdi sens toatoal riau.
Ih eri mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Kumwail en ese pwe en liohdi menet eh meirong laudsang mehlel en meteiko koaros ar meirong.
Pwe meteiko koaros meirongkihong Koht mehkot me peisengen ar pai, a lih menet sang nan eh semwehmwe e meirongkihla mehkoaros me e naineki oh kin mourki.”
Ekei sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw koasoakoasoia duwen Tehnpas Sarawio, duwen kaselel en wiepen koasoakoasoak en takai ko me wiahda tehnpaso, oh duwen lingan en kapwat me aramas akan kin meirongkihong Koht loale. Sises eri mahsanih,
“Kumwail kilang pwe rahn ehu pahn kohdo me mepwukat koaros me kumwail uduhdiahl sohla pahn mie, sohte takai ehu pahn luhwehdi pohn ehu, koaros pahn rengkidi.”
Irail eri kalelapak reh, patohwan, “Maing Sounpadahk, iahd me soahng pwukat pahn pweida? Oh kilel da me pahn kadehdehda me ahnsoun soahng pwukat kerendohr?”
A Sises ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail mwasahn, pwe aramas de keteweikumwaildi. Pwe me tohto pahn pwarodo, ndinda, ni mwarei, ‘Iei ngehi Krais!’ oh, ‘Ih ahnsoun Kraiso met!’ Eri, kumwail dehpa dukiong irail.
Kumwail dehpa salohda ni amwail pahn rong rongen mahwen oh moromor akan; pwe soahng pwukat uhdahn pahn wiawi mahs, ahpw e sohte wehwehki me imwilah kerendohr.”
E ahpw pil mahsanih, “Pei pahn wiawi nanpwungen sahpw akan, oh mahwen pahn pweida nanpwungen wehi kan;
rerrer en sahpw kamasepwehk, lehk lapalap, soumwahu lusulus laud pahn wiawi wasa koaros; soahng kamasepwehk oh kilel kapwuriamwei kei pahn pwarada pahnlahng.
A mwohn mepwukat koaros ar pahn wiawi, kumwail pahn selidi oh kamakam; kumwail pahn pakadeikada nan sinakoke kan oh wisikiong nan imweteng kan; kumwail pahn wisikiong mwohn nanmwarki kan oh mwohn kaunen wehi kan pwehki ngehi.
Eri, iei ahnsowo me kumwail pahn kadehdeiehda.
Kumwail lemeleme mwowe pwe kumwail dehr pwunodki dahme kumwail pahn sapengkin irail;
pwe I pahn kihong kumwail soangen pasapeng kei oh soangen loalokong kei me sohte emen rehn amwail imwintihti kan kak pelianda oh kasohwe.
Amwail pahpa oh nohno kan, riamwail kan, kisehmwail kan oh kompoakepahmwail kan, iei irail me pahn pengkumwailla; oh re pahn kemehla ekei kumwail.
Aramas koaros pahn kailongkinkumwailla pwehki ngehi.
Ahpw sohte mwahn pitenmoangamwail ehu pahn pwupwusang.
Kumwail nantiheng oh kanengamahiong, pwe ih duwen amwail pahn komourala ngenomwail kan.”
“Ni amwail pahn kilang karis en sounpei kei me kapilpenehr Serusalem, kumwail pahn esehki me ahnsoun eh ohla kerendohr.
Eri, ni ahnsowo irail kan me mihmi nan Sudia, re en sopolahng pohn dohl kan; oh me mihmi nan kahnimwo, re en sopohsang loale; oh me mihmi nansapw, re dehpa pwurolong nan kahnimwo.
Pwe rahn pwuko, iei ‘Rahnen Kalokolok,’ ahnsou me mehkoaros me ntingdier nan Pwuhk Sarawi pahn pweida.
Meid suwediong me liseian akan oh me wie kadihdi seri pwelel kan ni rahn ako! Pwe lapalahn apwal ehu pahn lel sahpw wet, oh engieng en Koht pahn lel towe kan.
Re pahn mehkihla kedlahs oh sellahng nan wehin liki koaros, oh Serusalem pahn tiatipeseng pahn nehn me rotorot akan, lao ar ahnsou pahn imwisekla.”
“Kilel kei pahn pwarada ni ketipin, ni maram, oh pil ni usu kan. Nin sampah, wasa koaros nan wehi kan, aramas akan pahn salohkihda ngiringirisek laud en nan madau oh kumwukumwusek laud en pwuki kan.
Re pahn lipwongmaskihla ar masak ni ar pahn awiawih mehkan me pahn wiawihong sampah pokon; pwe poahsoan en pahnlahng kan pahn pingida oh rerrer.
Ih ahnsowo me Nein-Aramas pahn pwarada ketiket kohdo nan depwek ehu ni roson oh lingaling lapalahpie.
Ni mepwukat eh pahn tepida wiawi, kumwail uhda oh sarada, pwe komourpamwail kerendohr.”
Eri, Sises pil ketin mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet: “Kumwail tehk mwahu duwen tuhke pik oh tuhke teikan koaros.
Ni tehntuhke pwukat ar kin pwarada, kumwail kin esehki me rahk kerendohr.
Pil duwehte, ni amwail pahn kilang mepwukat ar pahn wiawi, kumwail pahn esehki me Wehin Koht kerendohr.
“Kumwail en ese pwe mepwukat koaros pahn wiawi mwohn aramas en dih wet koaros ar pahn mehla.
Lahng oh sampah pahn sohrala, a ei mahsen kan sohte pahn sohrala.”
“Kumwail pein mwasamwasahn kumwail. Kumwail dehr kedirepwehkin kumwail mwenge laud oh sakau kehlail, oh pwunod kan en sampah wet; pwe Rahno kakete leledohng kumwail ni ahnsou mwadang.
E pahn kohdo, rasehng nsar ehu ong aramas koaros pohn sampah.
Kumwail eri mwasamwasahn, oh kapakap ahnsou koaros pwe kumwail en kehlail oh itarohng pitsang mepwukat koaros me pahn wiawi, oh pil warohng uh mwohn silangin Nein-Aramas.”
Sises kin ketin wia sapwellime padahk ni rahn akan nan Tehnpas Sarawio, a nin soutik kan e kin ketieisang nan kahnimwo oh ketilahng ni Nahnahn Olip, wasa e kin ketiket ie nipwong.
Nimenseng kan aramas koaros kin sangkalahng nan Tehnpas Sarawio pwe re en rong sapwellime padahk.
Ahnsoun Sarawien Pilawa Sohte Doal Ihs, me adaneki Pahsohpa kerendohr.
A samworo lapalap ako oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko raparapahki dahme re kak wia pwe re en kemehla Sises; pwe re masak kowahlap aramas akan.
Sehdan eri pedolong nan kapehd en Sudas, me adaneki Iskariot, emen me ehk riemeno.
Sudas eri kohla oh kalelapak rehn samworo lapalap oh kaunen Tehnpas Sarawio ko duwen eh pahn pangalahng irail Sises.
Irail eri perenkihda kowahlap oh pwungkipene re en pwainkihong mwohni.
Sudas pil perenkihda oh tapihada awiawih ahnsou mwahu me e kak pangohng irail Sises ni aramas akan ar sohte pahn ese.
Sarawien Pilawa Sohte Doal Ihs ahpw leledo, ahnsou me sihmpwul en kamadipw en Pahsohpa kin kamala.
Sises eri ketin poaronehla Piter oh Sohn, mahsanihong ira, “Kumwa kohwei oh kaunopadahng kitail atail tehpel en Pahsohpa.”
Ira eri patohwan idek, “Ia wasa komw kupwurki se en patohwan onopada ie?”
A e ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kumwa kilang, ni amwa pahn pedolong nan kahnimwo, kumwa pahn tuhwong ohl emen me weuwa pekid en pihl ehu. Kumwa idawehn, e lao pedolong nan ihmw ehu.
Kumwa ahpw pahn ndahng kaunen ihmwo, ‘Sounpadahko poaroneikitodohng rehmwi, mahsanih: Ia pere me ngehi oh nei tohnpadahk kan pahn tungoale ie kamadipw en Pahsohpa?’
E ahpw pahn kasalehiong kumwa pere kalaimwun ehu powe me koasoansoandier, oh ih wasao me kumwa pahn kaunopada ie soahng koaros.”
Ira ahpw patopatohla oh diarada soahng koaros duwen Sises eh mahsanihong ira, oh ira ahpw kaunopada kamadipw en Pahsohpa.
Ni ahnsoun konoto eh leledo, Sises oh sapwellime wahnpoaron ko ketidiong nan mwoalarail nin tehpelo.
Ih eri mahsanihong irail, “I ngoangkihlahte mehlel iang kumwail wia kamadipw en Pahsohpa wet mwohn ei pahn lokolok.
Kumwail en ese pwe I solahr pahn pwurehng iang tungoale Pahsohpa wet, e lao pahn ale kawehwehpe unsek nan Wehin Koht.”
Sises eri ketikihda dahl ehu, kapingkalahngan ong Koht, mahsanih, “Kumwail ale dahl wet oh iang nimasang.
Kumwail en ese pwe I solahr pahn pwurehng nim wain wet sang met kohla, lao lel ahnsou me Wehin Koht pahn pweida.”
Mwuhr, e ahpw ketikihda pilawa ieu, kapingkalahngan ong Koht, ketin pilitikihpeseng pilawao oh ketikihong irail, mahsanih, “Iei werei met me pengpengkinkumwaillahr. Kumwail wia met ong ni katamanpei.”
Pil duwehte, mwurin konoto, e ketikihong irail dahl ehu, mahsanih, “Dahl wet iei delen sapwellimen Koht inou kapw me wiawihkidahr ntai, me kepwilipwildier pwehki kumwail.
“Ahpw iet! Me pengiehlao iang ie mihmi met nin tehpel wet!
Mehlel pwe Nein-Aramas pahn mehla duwen Koht eh ketin kileledier; ahpw meid suwediong aramaso me pahn pangala!”
Irail eri tapihada peidekpene nanpwungarail, ihs rehrail me pahn kak wia soahng wet.
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw akamaikihda ihs me pahn lapalap rehrail.
Sises ketin mahsanihong irail, “Nanmwarki kan en sampah kin sapwellimanki manaman en kaunda wasa pohn sapwellimarail aramas akan, oh aramas akan kin kamwarehki arail kaun akan ‘Mwohnsapw Kalahngan.’
Ahpw e sohte pahn duwehte rehmwail; pwe me keieu lapalap rehmwail pahn duwehte me keieu tikitik, oh me kin kaun pahn duwehte lidu.
Pwe ihs me lapalap rehn me kin mwohndiong nin tehpel pwe en konot, de me kin papah? Kaidehkin me kin mwohndiong nin tehpel? Ahpw iet, ngehi I kin mihmi rehmwail duwehte papah men.
“Kumwail kin mihmihte rehi ahnsou koaros nan ei apwal akan;
oh nin duwen Semei eh ketikihongieier manaman en kaunda wasa, I pil pahn kihong kumwail soangen manamanohte.
Kumwail pahn iang ie konot de sak ni ei tehpel nan ei Wehi, oh kumwail pahn iang mwohd nan mwoalomwail mwoalen kopwung pwe en wia kapwungpen kadaudok eisek riaun Israel.”
“Saimon, Saimon! Kilang pwe Sehdan aleier mweimwei pwe en song kumwail koaros duwehte soumwet men eh kin koakoahsang kilin wahn pilawa.
Ahpw I kapakapkin uhk, Saimon, pwe omw pwoson en dehr luwetala. Oh ni omw pahn sapahldohng rehi, ke pahn kakehlahda pwoson en riomw kan.”
Piter sapeng, patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, I onopadahr I en iangkomwihla nan imweteng oh iang komwi pwoula.”
A Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Piter, ke en ese pwe rahnwet, mwohn keieun malek eh pahn kakorot, ke pahn kahmahmkin ie pahn silipak me ke sehse ie.”
Sises ahpw keinemwe rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Ni ei kadarkumwailewei sohte wa edin mwohni, koaruk en seiloak, de suht, mie mehkot me kumwail apwalkihda?” Re patohwanohng, “Sohte, Maing.”
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Eri met, ma mie me nah edin mwohni oh koaruk en seiloak mie, a en wahda; a me sohte nah kedlahs, a en netikihla eh likou puhp oh pwainkihda apwoat kedlahsen.
Pwe kumwail en ese pwe mahsen en Pwuhk Sarawi wet uhdahn pahn pweida rehi, me mahsanih, ‘E ahpw iang wadawad ong aramas dipan akan.’ Pwe me ntingdier duwen ngehi, e kin pweida.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing at Kaun, iet kedlahs riapwoat!” A Sises mahsanih, “E itarehr!”
Sises eri ketieisang nan kahnimwo, ketilahng ni Nahnahn Olip, duwen me e kin ketin epwehnki wia; sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw iangala.
Ni eh ketin lel wasao, e ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kapakap pwe kumwail dehr lohdiong nan songosong.”
Ih eri ketin tohrohrala sang irail, ni uwen dohen aramas eh kin koaski takai ehu; e ahpw ketin kelehpwikihdi oh loulou,
mahsanih, “Ipa, ma komw ketin kupwurki, a komw ketikihweisang ie delen lokolok wet. Ahpw soh, kaidehkin nsenei, pwe kupwuromwihte en pweida.”
[Tohnleng men sang nanleng ahpw pwarodohng oh karosonda.
Oh ni eh pwunodadahr kowahlap, e ahpw ketin ngiangiong sapwellime kasakas; pwudowe lao kerediong nanpwel likamwete dingiding en ntahn aramas.]
E ahpw ketida sang sapwellime loulou oh ketidiong rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh diarihrada ar memeirkelik, pwehki eh sohla angihrki ar nsensuwed.
Ih eri mahsanihong irail, “Dahme kumwail memeirki? Kumwail pwourda oh kapakap pwe kumwail dehr lohdiong nan songosong.”
Nindokon eh mahmahsen, pokon ehu ahpw lel wasao; Sudas, emen me ehk riemeno, me kahre irail. Ih eri keilahngete mpen Sises, metik ih.
A Sises mahsanih, “Sudas, metik ehu me ke pangkilahr Nein-Aramas?”
Ni tohnpadahk ko me iang Sises ar kilangada dahme pahn wiawio, re ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing at Kaun, se en doadoahngki nait kedlahs kat?”
Emen irail ahpw pelehte en Samworo Lapalap eh ladu men, pelehsang salenge palimaun.
Sises ahpw mahsanih, “Eriher!” Ih eri ketin doahkehte salengen ohlo, kamwawihala.
Sises eri mahsanihong samworo lapalap ako oh soumas en Tehnpas Sarawio, oh pil kaunen mehn Suhs ako me iang patohdohng reh, “Kumwail kohieidohng rapahkin ie wisik kedlahs oh mehn pei, likamwete kumwail kodohng rapahki loallap suwed men?
I kin mihmihte rehmwail rahn koaros nan Tehnpas Sarawio, kumwail ahpw sohte mwahn song en salihiehdi. A met, iei amwail ahnsou, oh ahnsoun manaman en rotorot.”
Irail eri salihedi Sises oh kahrelahng ni imwen Samworo Lapalap; a Piter ideidawehnte ahpw mwur dohsang ekis.
Nanwerengen kelen Samworo Lapalapo, kisiniei kis ahpw souda. Piter eri iang mwohndi rehn me mwomwohd kapilpene kisinieio.
Ni emen lidu ko eh kilangda eh iang mwomwohd limwahn kisinieio, e ahpw kangkakil oh nda, “Lahp menet pil iengen ohlo.”
Piter eri kahmahmkihda, ndalahng, “Lih, I sehse ohl menet!”
Mwurin ahnsou kis, ohl emen pil kilangada Piter, e ahpw pil ndalahng, “Kowe pil emen ienge ko!” A Piter sapeng, nda, “Nahn, kaidehkin iengei!”
Kedekedeo, mwurin awa ieu, pil emen akahkpwungkihte, nda, “Mehlelete pwe lahp menet uhdahn iengen ohlo, pwe ih mehn Kalili men!”
Piter sapeng, nda, “Maing, I sohte wehwehki dahme ke ndindahn!” A ni ahnsowohte, nindokon eh lokolokaia, malek pa kakorot.
Kaun-o eri ketin sohpeidohng Piter oh ketin kamoalehdi. Piter ahpw tamankihda mahsen en Kaun-o, me mahsanih, “Rahnwet, mwohn keieun malek eh pahn kakorot, ke pahn kahmahmki pahn silipak me ke sehse ie.”
Piter eri kohkohlahsang, kohieila liki oh sengiseng kowahlap.
Aramas ako me sinsile Sises ahpw kin kapikapitih oh kin wokih.
Re kin perehla silangi oh kin idek, “Ihs me wokih komwio? Komw kasawihada mahs!”
Re ahpw pil kin lahlahwe oh wiahiong kapweikeng tohto.
Ni eh rahnpeseng, kaunen mehn Suhs ako, samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw pokonpene, oh Sises ahpw pakahrdohng mwohn Tohn Mwoalen Kopwung Lapalapo.
Irail eri idek, patohwan, “Komw mahsanidohng kiht mahs, ma komwi iei Mesaia.” A e ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ma I ndaiong kumwail, kumwail sohte pahn kamehlele ie.
A ma I idek rehmwail mehkot, kumwail sohte pahn sapeng ie.
Ahpw kumwail en ese pwe sang met kohla Nein-Aramas pahn ket nan mwoale ni palimaun en Koht, Wasa Lapalahpie.”
Irail koaros eri patohwan idek, “Eri, Sapwellimen Kohto komwi?” A e ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Pein kumwail ndinda pwe iei ngehi ih.”
Irail ahpw nda, “Eri, kitail sohte anahne sounkadehde, pwe pein kitail rongasangehr nan pein sapwellime mahsen kan!”
Tohnpokono koaros ahpw kesihnenda oh kahrelahng Sises mwohn Pailet.
Re ahpw tapihada kedipa, ndinda, “Se saikedi ohl menet ni eh wiewia kaweid sapwung ong nait aramas akan, ndindaiong irail re dehr kin kihda daksis ong Sihsar; oh e pil kin kakahski me pein ih Mesaia, nanmwarki men.”
Pailet eri keinemwe rehn Sises, mahsanih, “Komwi nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan?” Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Komwi me mahsanih.”
Pailet eri mahsanihong samworo lapalap ako oh pokono, “Sohte mehkot I diarada rehn ohl menet pwe en pakadeingkihda.”
A irail ahpw ngidingidkihong, ndinda, “E tapihadahr kamwoarong ehu rehn aramas akan sang ni padahk me e kin kihong irail. E tapihada nan Kalili, kohdo nan sahpw koaros en Sudia, oh lelohngehr sahpwet.”
Ni Pailet eh karonge met, e ahpw keinemwe, “Pwe da, mehn Kalili men ohl menet?”
Ni eh mwahngihada me Sises kisehn wehi ehu me Erod ketin kakaun, e ahpw ketin kadaralahng rehn Erod, me pil iang ketiket Serusalem ni ahnsowo.
Erod inenen perenkihda kowahlap eh mahsanihada Sises, pwe e kin karongehte duwen Sises oh ahnsou reirei e kin anahne en mahsanih, pwe e koapworopworki me Sises pahn ketin wiahda ekei manaman mwowe.
Ih eri ketin wiahiong Sises soangen peidek tohto, a Sises sohte mwahn ketin sapeng.
Samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw uh wasao nannantihki ar kedikedipa Sises.
Erod oh sapwellime sounpei ko ahpw kepitki Sises oh wia mwahlkihla. Re kalikawihkihda likou puhp kaselel ehu oh kapwurelahng Pailet.
Rahnohte Pailet oh Erod ira nsenamwahula; pwe sang mahs kohdo ira kin imwintihtipene.
Pailet eri ketin kapokonepene samworo lapalap ako, kaun ako, oh pil aramas koaros,
oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail pangodohngieier ohl menet, dene e kamwoakamwoaronge tohn amwail wehi. Eri, kumwail en ese pwe I kalelapakehr reh mwohmwail, ahpw sohte mehkot sapwung I diarada duwen mehkan me kumwail kedikedipahki.
Erod pil sohte diarada sapwung reh, ihme e ketin kapwurehkidohng rehtail ohl menet. Eri, kumwail en ese pwe ohl menet sohte wiahda mehkot me pahn konehng en kamakamkihla.
Iet me I pahn wiahiongen: I pahn kihong en wowoki rehn nei sounpei kan; oh mwuhr I ahpw pahn kasaledekihala.”
[Ni ahnsoun Sarawien Pahsohpa koaros, Pailet uhdahn kin ketin lapwadahng mehn Suhs ako emen loallap suwed me sensel nan imweteng.]
Tohnpokono koaruhsie eri wiahkihteieu ngihl laudida, patohwan, “Mehmenen en kamakamala! Komw ketin lapwadohng kiht Parapas!” (
Eri, Parapas loallap suwed men, me lekdekiong nan imweteng pwehki moromor ehu me wiawi nan kahnimwo oh kamaramas ehu me e wiadahr.)
Pailet kupwukupwurehte en kasaledekala Sises, ihme e pil pwurehngete mahseniong pokono.
A irail wiakihteieu patohwan werkilahng, “Komw kalohpwuwehla! Komw kalohpwuwehla!”
Pailet eri mahsanihong irail kesilipak, “Pwe suwed da me e wiahda? Sohte mehkot I kak diar reh me konehng en kamakamkihla! I pahn kihong en wowoki, mwuhr I ahpw pahn kasaledekihala.”
A irail ahpwte kalaudehla ar weriwerki pwe Sises en kalohpwuwala. Ni imwilah ar pekipeko ahpw pweida.
Pwe Pailet ketin mahsanih sang nan mwoale me Sises en mweimweiong irail, pwe re en kalohpwuwehla.
Ih eri ketin lapwahda ohl me re peki en lapwadahng irailo, me selikihdi moromor oh kamaramas; e ahpw ketikihong irail Sises pwe re en wiahiong nsenarail.
Irail eri ale Sises oh kahluwaieisang nan kahnimwo; re ahpw kasaingedi ohl emen nanialo, ede Saimon, mehn Sairihni, me patopatohdo sang nan sapwe likin kahnimwo. Re ahpw koledi oh itonehng en kapaikada lohpwuwo oh idawehnla Sises.
Lapalahn pokon en aramas ahpw iang ideidawehn Sises; lih ekei pil iang me mwahmwahieiki oh wie sengisengki Sises.
Sises ketin sohpeiong irail oh mahsanih, “Kumwail, lihen Serusalem kan! Kumwail dehr sengisengkin ie, kumwail sengisengki pein kumwail oh noumwail seri kan.
Pwe rahn ekei pahn kohdo, me aramas akan pahn nda, ‘Meid pai lih depwen kan oh me sohte kin neitik oh kedihdi!’
Pwe ih ahnsowo me aramas pahn ndaiong nahna kan, ‘Kumwail pwupwudiong poht!’ oh ong dohl akan, ‘Kumwail koaduhpwalkitedi!’
Pwe ma ih duwen me soahng pwukat kin wiawihong tuhke mour, a dahme pahn wiawihong tuhke meng?”
Irail eri pil kahreieila loallap suwed riemen, pwe ira en iang Sises kamakamala.
Ni arail lel wasa me adaneki “Tihn Moang,” re ahpw pasurdiong Sises nin lohpwuwo iangahki loallap suwed riemeno, emen mi ni palimaun, a emen palimeing en Sises.
Sises eri mahsanih, “Semei, komw ketin mahkohng irail, pwe re sehse dahme re wiewia.” Irail eri usuhski sapwellime likou ko oh nehkpeseng nanpwungarail.
Pokono ahpw mi wasao uduhdiahl soahng koaros, nindokon kaunen mehn Suhs ko ar kepikepitki Sises, ndinda, “E komourala ekei; eri, a en komourala pein ih, ma iei ih Mesaiao me Koht ketin piladahr!”
Sounpei ko pil iangala kapailoke Sises. Re keiong mpe oh kihong wain
oh ndahng, “Komw kepitkomwihla, ma iei komwi nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan!”
Pohnangin kadokenmaien Sises nin lohpwuwo mahsen pwukat ntingdier ie: “Iei met Nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan.”
Emen loallap suwed ko me iang kalohpwuwala ahpw lahlahwe Sises, ndinda, “Ma komwi Mesaiao, a komw kepitkomwihla oh pil kiht!”
A meteio ahpw kapwungohng, nda, “Ke sohte masak Koht? Kita koaros mihmi nan soangen kadeikteieu.
Ahpw ata kadeik me pwung, pwe kita konehng ale kalokolok wet, pwehki ata wiewia kan me kahrehda; a ohl menet sohte suwed ehu e ketin wiahda.”
Ih eri patohwanohng Sises, “Maing Sises, komw ketin kupwure ie, ni omwi pahn ket nan sapwellimomwi wehi duwen nanmwarki men!”
A Sises ketin mahsanihong, “I men ke en ese pwe rahnwette ke pahn iang ie mi nan Paradais.”
Kolahng nin souwas limwahn kulok eisek riau, ketipin ahpw rotala oh rotorot kipehdi wasa koaros nan sahpwo lel kulok siluh mwurin souwas.
Oh kahdeng me pereh mwoahl sarawien nan Tehnpas Sarawio teipeseng nanwerenge sang powe lel pah.
Sises ahpw ketin kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Semei, I mweidalahr ngeniet nin limomwi kan!” Ni eh mahsanih met, e ahpw ketin kadarala ngene.
Kaunen sounpei men lao kilangada me wiawiero, e ahpw kapinga Koht, patopatohwan, “Mehlelete me ohl menet ohl pwung men!”
Aramas koaros me pokonpene wasao pwe re en iang udiahl, re ahpw pikipikir nan mwaremwararail kan pwurala ni imwarail ko, uwen ar nsensuwed.
Oh kompoakepahn Sises koaros, iangahki lih ako me idawehndo sang Kalili, re pil iang kesihnen wasao, ahpw ekis dohsang, uduhdiahl mepwukat koaros.
Ohl emen mie me mwarenki Sosep, mehn Arimadea, kahnimw ehu nan Suda. Ohl kadek emen oh poadidi, oh e kin iang awiawihodo Wehin Koht. E kin iang towe Mwoalen Kopwung Lapalap, ahpw e sohte mwahn iang pwungki arail koasoandi oh arail mwekid kan ong Sises.
<range>
Ih eri patohla rehn Pailet oh pekihda ereksohn Siseso.
Ih eri kihdi sang nin lohpwuwo, kidimkipene likou linen ehu, oh kihlong nan sousou ehu me weiweida nan paip ehu—saikinte aramas emen seridi nan sousowo.
Rahno ni alem, oh rahnen Sapad, de ahnsoun Sapad, nektehn tepida.
Lih ako me ideidawehndo Sises sang Kalili ahpw idawehnla Sosep oh iang udiahl sousowo oh duwen ereksohn Sises eh nekinekdi loale.
Irail eri pwurala ni imwarail ko oh onopada pwohtik pwohmwahu kei oh mehn kei kei. Rahnen Sapad, re ahpw kommoal, duwen me kileldier nan Kosonnedo.
Nin sohrahn en rahnen Santi, lih ako ahpw sangkalahng nin sousowo wa pwohtik pwohmwahu ko me re kaunopadahr.
Re ahpw diarada me takaio katapwursangehr ni ewen sousowo.
Irail eri pedolong loale; re ahpw sohte kilangada ereksohn Kaun Sises.
Irail ahpw sansaloh kesikesihnen wasao sehse dahme re pahn wia; a iet mwahnakapw riemen pa uh mwohrail, mi nan likou pwetepwet lingan oh melengileng.
Nan ar masepwehkadahr kowahlap, oh itihtiekidiongete nanpwel, mwahnakapw ako ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Dahme kumwail raparapahkihki me momour emen nanpwungen me melahr akan?
E soher ket met. E ketin kaiasadahr. Tamanda dahme e ketin mahsanihong kumwail, ni eh ketikette rehmwail nan Kalili:
‘Nein-Aramas uhdahn pahn pengpengla rehn me dipan akan oh kalohpwuwala, oh eh pahn iasada ni kesiluhwen rahn.’”
Irail eri tamanda sapwellimen Sises mahsen ko
oh pwurala sang nin sousowo, re ahpw kohla kairehki me ehk emeno oh meteiko koaros soahng me wiawihongirailo.
Iet mwaren lih ako; Mery mehn Makdala, Sohanna, oh Mery inen Seims; irail oh ekei lih me iang irail me kairehki wahnpoaron ko duwen mepwukat.
Wahnpoaron ko ahpw wiahki rohng pwukat koasoien aramas sahliel kei, iei me re sohte mwahn kamehlelehki lih ako.
Eri soh, Piter uhdahte tenge sousowo; e pedolongala, oh sohte mehkot me e kilangada pwe likou kaselel kohte me wonohn wasa kis; e ahpw pwurala ni ihmwo, pwuriamweiki dahme wiawiheret.
Ni rahnohte, tohnpadahk riemen patopato kolahng ni kisin kahnimw kis, me adaneki Emaus, me dohsang Serusalem ele mwail isuh.
Ira eri koasoakoasoia duwen mehkoaros me ahpwtehn wiawi.
Eri, nindokon ara koasoakoasoi kohla, pein Sises pa ketin keiong mpara oh iang ira ketiket kohla nanialo.
Ira kilangada, ira ahpw sohte kadehde me iei ih mwo.
Sises eri ketin keinemwe rehra, “Dahme kumwa koasoakoasoia kohdo?” Ira ahpw uhdi, mwomwen pahtou.
Emen ira, ede Kleopas, ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Pwe dah? Komwihte mehn keiru men nan Serusalem me sohte mwahngih dahme wiawiher kohdo rahn pwukat nan kahnimwo?”
A e ketin sapeng ira, mahsanih, “Pwe dahkot?” Ira patohwanohng, “Duwen mehkan me wiawihong Sises mehn Nasareto. Soukohp emen ih, me inenen manaman ni eh wiewia kan oh ni eh mahsen mwohn Koht oh mwohn aramas koaros.
At samworo lapalap ako oh kaun ako ahpw pangala pwe en pakadeida en kamakamala oh kalohpwuwala.
Eri kiht, se koapworopworkihla me ih me pahn kamaiauda Israel! Ahpw lel rahnwet, rahnehr siluh mwurin mepwukat ar wiawi.
Lih ekei me kiseht kasaloweikitadahr, ni ar sangkalahng kilang sousowo,
re sohte kilangada erekso. Re pwurodo reht ndinda me re kilangada tohnleng kei me mahsanihong irail me dene e iasadahr.
Pil ekei kiseht ko pwaralahr nin sousowo oh kadehdeier duwen me lih ako pakairkidohr, re ahpw sohte kilangada Sises.”
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong ira, “Kumwa meid loalopwon oh nan kapehd tikitik en kamehlele mehkoaros me soukohp ako kohpadahr!
Pwe kaidehn Mesaia uhdahn pahn lokolongki soahng pwukat koaros mwohn eh pahn ketilong nan lingan en sapwellime wehi?”
Sises eri ketin kawehwehiong ira wasa kan me Pwuhk Sarawi mahsanih duwen pein ih, tepisang pwuhken Moses kohdo lel ni pwuken soukohp koaros.
Irail eri ketin lel nan kahnimw me re ketiket kolahng ie. Sises ahpw ketin mwomwehda me e pahn ketin dodouluhllahte.
Ira ahpw ngidingidki patohwanohng, “Komw ketin pweiekdi reht, pwe ketipin peiklahr oh wasa pwongier.” Ih eri ketilong rehra nan ihmwo pwe en iang pweiekdi wasao.
Eri, ni arail ketiket nin tehpel, e ketikihda pilawa ehu, loulou oh kapingkalahngan ong Koht. E ahpw ketin pilitikihpeseng pilawao oh ketikihong ira.
Mesara ko pa pehdpeseng, ira ahpw esehda me Sises mwo; a ni ahnsowohte Sises ahpw sohrasang mwohra.
Ira ahpw ndapene, “Nan kapehdita kat soh kin mwekimwekidki peren, rasehng kisiniei, ni eh kin mahmahsen oh kawehwehiong kita Pwuhk Sarawi, kohdo nanialo?”
Ira uhdahte pwuralahng Serusalem, rehn tohnpadahk ehk emeno me pokopokon rehn iangarail ko
oh ndindapene nanpwungarail, “Mehlelete me Kaun-o ketin iasadahr! Pwe e ketin pwarehr rehn Saimon!”
Ira eri uhd koasoia dahme wiawihong ira nanialo, oh duwen ara esehda Kaun-o ni eh ketin pilitikihpeseng pilawao.
Ni arail koasoakoasoia mepwukat, pein Sises ahpw ketin uh nanpwungarail oh mahsanihong irail, “Popohl ong kumwail!”
Nan arail saloh oh masak, re lemehiong me re kilikilang eni men.
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Dahme kumwail salohkidahr? Dahme kumwail peikasalki nan kapehdomwail kan?
Kumwail kadehde pehi kat oh nehi kat, oh kilang mwahu pwe ngehi met. Kumwail doahke ie, kumwail ahpw pahn kadehde mehlel pwe eni sohte kin mie uduke de tih, duwen me kumwail kilikilang rehi.”
Mwurin eh mahsanih met, e ahpw ketin kasalehiong irail lime ko oh aluweluwe ko.
Re ahpw pil saikinte nohn kamehlele, oh nan ar diren peren oh pwuriamwei, e ketin keinemwe rehrail, “Mie kisin mwenge rehmwail met?”
Re ahpw patohwanohng kisin mwomw inihn kis,
e ahpw konote mwohn masarail ko.
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Ih met wehwehn mahsen ko me I padahkihongkumwailehr nindokon ei mihmi rehmwail, duwen mehkoaros me ntingdier nan Kosonned en Moses, rehn soukohp ako, oh nan Pwuhken Melkahka Kan, uhdahn pahn pweida rehi.”
Ih eri ketin kamarainihada kapehdirail ko pwe re en dehdehkihla Pwuhk Sarawi,
oh mahsanihong irail, “Ih duwen me ntingdier en met: Mesaiao uhdahn pahn lokolok oh iasada sang mehla ni kesiluhwen rahn,
oh rongamwahu en koluhla en nan kapehd oh lapwapen dihp akan pahn lohkseli nan wehi koaros, ni mware, tepisang Serusalem.
Eri, kumwail me pahn kin sounkadehdehn mepwukat.
Oh kumwail en ese pwe I pahn kadarodohng kumwail me Semeio ketin inoukidahr. Kumwail eri uhdahn pahn awiawihete nan kahnimw wet, kumwail lao pahn audaudkihda manaman en powe.”
Mwuri, Sises ahpw ketin kahluwaieisang irail nan kahnimwo, ketiketlahng Pedani; ih wasao me e ketikihda lime ko oh ketin kupwuramwahwih irail.
Ni eh ketin kupwukupwuramwahwih irail, e ahpw ketida sang rehrail, ketiketdahla nanleng.
Irail eri poaridi oh pwongih, oh pwuralahng Serusalem pereperen kowahlap.
Re ahpw kin kalap tounmeteikihla ar ahnsou kan nan Tehnpas Sarawio, kapikapinga Koht.
Mahseno ketiketier rehn Koht mwohn tepin kawa; pwe Mahseno, iei me Koht.
Iei ih me ketiketier rehn Koht mwohn tepin kawa.
Koht ketin kapikekihda mehkoaros Mahseno: oh sohte mwahn mehkot mie me Mahseno sohte ketin kapikada.
Mahseno iei ih poahsoan en mour; oh mour wet, iei me kin kamarainih aramas akan.
Marain wet ahpw kin dakedaker nan rotorot, oh rotoroto ahpw sohte mwahn kasohrehla.
Mie aramas emen me pekederdo sang rehn Koht, me ede Sohn.
Aramas menet pwarodo pwe en wia kadehdepen maraino, pwe aramas koaros en rong Mahseno oh pwosonla.
Kaidehn ih me maraino, ahpw e pwarodo pwe en kadehdehda duwen maraino.
Eri, Mahseno, iei me marain mehlelo me pwarodohng sampah pwe en kamarainih aramas akan koaros.
Eri, Mahseno ketier nin sampah, oh iei ih me Koht ketin kapikekihda sampah. Ahpw tohn sampah kan sohte ese ih.
E ahpw ketidohng sapwellime wasa, a sapwellime kan sohte kasamwo.
Eri soh, ekei kasamwoier oh pwosonlahr. Eri, e ahpw ketikihong irail pwung en wiahla sapwellimen Koht.
Irail pwukat sohte wiahla sapwellimen Koht sang ni elen kaipwidi aramas, pwe pein Koht, iei me ketin sapwellimanikinirailla.
Mahseno eri wia-aramasala oh ketiketier rehtail. Kitail kilangehr sapwellime lingan, me diren kalahngan oh mehlel, sapwellime lingan me ih, Iehros en Koht, ale sang rehn Seme.
Eri, Sohn kadehdehda duwen ih ni eh liklikwerki, “Iei ih ohlo me I koasoakoasoia duwe ni ei nda, ‘Emen pahn ketido mwuri, me lapalapasang ie, pwe e ketiketier mwohn ei ipwidi.’”
Sang ni reken sapwellime kalahngan, e ketin kapaiahkin kitail poatopoat soangen kapai koaros.
Koht ketikihong Moses audepen Kosonnedo pwe en patohwanohng kitail, a kalahngan oh mehlel sang rehn Sises Krais.
Sohte me kin kilangki Koht mese. Sapwellime Iehrosohte, me duwehte Koht, me kin ketiket ni palimaun en Sahmo, iei ih me ketin kasalehiong aramas akan duwen Koht.
Lapalap en mehn Suhs ako kadarala sang Serusalem samworo kei oh mehn Lipai kei pwe re en idek rehn Sohn, “Ihs komwi?”
Sohn sohte kahng sapeng, e ahpw koasoiada ni sansal, “Kaidehn ngehi Mesaia.”
Irail eri kalelapak, “A da? Komwi me Elaisa?” Sohn sapeng irail, nda, “Soh. Kaidehn ngehi ih.” Irail pil kalelapak, “Eri da? Komwi Soukohpo?” A e sapeng, “Soh.”
Irail ahpw nda, “A komw padahkihong kiht ihs komwi, pwe se en kak sapengki irail ko me kadarkitodo. Dahme komw pahn mahsaniheki duwen pein komwi?”
Sohn ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ngehi ‘ngihl ehu me likilikwerseli nan sapwtehn: Kumwail kainenehla elen Kaun-o pwe en ketin keid ie!’” nin duwen me soukohp Aiseia mahsaniher.
Sounkair pwukat me pekederdo sang rehn Parisi ko,
ahpw idek rehn Sohn, “A dahme kahrehda komw wiewiahki papidais, ma kaidehn komwi Mesaia, de Elaisa, de Soukohpo?”
Sohn eri sapengkin irail, “Ngehi I kin papidaiski pihl, a mie emen me ketiket nanpwungamwail, me kumwail sehse,
iei ih me pahn ketido mwuri; oh I sohte warohng I en lapwahda selin sapwellime suht.”
Mepwukat koaros wiawiher nan Pedani, palio Pillap Sordan, wasa me Sohn kin wiewia ie papidais.
Mandahn rahno, Sohn ahpw kilangada Sises eh ketiket kodohng reh, e ahpw patohwan, “Kilang! Ien Sihmpwul en Kohto me kin ketikihsang dipen sampah koaros.
Iei ih ohlo me I koasoakoasoia duwe ni ei patohwan, ‘Ohl emen pahn ketido mwuri, me lapalapasang ie, pwehki eh ketiketier mwohn ei ipwidi.’
Pein ngehi sohte ese ih. Ahpw iet kahrepen ei pwarodo oh papidaiski pihl, pwehn kasalehda ih ong mehn Israel.”
Iet kadehde me Sohn pil kasalehda: “I kilangehr Ngehn Sarawio eh ketidihdo sang nanleng, ni mwomwen mwuroi men; e pihrdi oh ketiket powe.
Pein ngehi saikinte ese ih, ahpw Koht, me ketin kadariehdo pwe I en kin papidaiski pihl, e pil mahsanihong ie, ‘Mehmen me ke pahn kilang Ngehno eh pihrdi oh ketiket powe, iei ih me kin papidaiski Ngehn Sarawi.’
I kilangehr oh I pil kadehdeier me iei ih Sapwellimen Koht.”
Mandahn rahno, Sohn pil mihmi wasao, iangahki nah tohnpadahk riemen.
Ni eh kilangada Sises eh ketiket kohla, e ahpw patohwan, “Kumwa kilang! Ien Sihmpwul en Kohto!”
Tohnpadahk riemeno ahpw rongada eh koasoi; ira eri idawehnla Sises.
Sises ahpw ketin sohpeido oh mahsanihada ara ideidawehn, e ahpw mahsanihong ira, “Dahme kumwa raparapahki?” Ira eri sapeng, patohwan, “Rapai, (lepin mahsen wet wehwehki “sounpadahk”) ia wasa komw kin ketiket ie?”
E ahpw ketin sapeng ira, mahsanih, “Kumwa kohdo kilang.” Eri, ira ahpw iangada oh kilangada wasa me e kin ketiket ieo, ira eri patopatohte reh rahno (pwehki eh kereniong kulok pahieu mwurin souwas.)
Emen ira iei Andru, rien Saimon Piter.
Andru ahpw mwadang diarada rie Saimon, oh ndaiong, “Se diaradahr Mesaiao!” (Ih wehwehn lepin mahsen pwoatet Krais.)
E ahpw kahrelahng Piter rehn Sises. Ni Sises eh mahsanihada Piter, e ahpw mahsanihong, “Ih kowe Saimon, me nein Sohn. Ke pahn adanekihla Kepas.” (Met wehwehki Piter, me pil wehwehki ‘Paipalap.’)
Mandahn rahno, Sises kupwurehda en ketilahng Kalili, e ahpw diarada Pilip, oh mahsanihong, “Idawehniehdo!”
(Eri, Pilip mehn Pedsaida, iei nan kahnimw wet me Andru oh Piter kin kousoan ie.)
Pilip eri tuhwong Nadaniel oh ndaiong, “Se diaradahr ohlo, nin duwen me Moses ntingihedier nan Pwuken Kosonnedo, oh pil soukohp ako. Iei ih Sises nein Sosep, sang Nasaret.”
Nadaniel ahpw idek reh, “Ia duwe, kakete mehkot mwahu en pwarada sang Nasaret?” Pilip ahpw sapengki, “Nna, kohdo kilang.”
Ni Sises eh mahsanihada Nadaniel eh kohkohdo, e ahpw mahsanih, “Iet uhdahn ohl mehlel en Israel men, me sohte kin widing!”
Nadaniel ahpw patohwanohng, “Komw mwahngih ie sang ia?” Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I kilanguhkadahte mwohn Pilip eh ekeruhkodo, ni omw mihmi pahn tuhke piko.”
Nadaniel ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing Sounpadahk, uhdahn Sapwellimen Kohto komwi! Komwi me Nanmwarkien Israel!”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ia duwe, ke kamehlele pwehki ei ndaiong uhk me I kilanguhkada ni ahnsou me ke mihmi pahn tuhke piko? Ke pahn kilang soahng kei me lapasang mepwukat!”
E pil ketin mahsanihong irail, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel, kumwail pahn kilang nanleng eh ritidahr, oh tohnleng en Koht akan ni ar douda oh doudi pohnangin Nein-Aramas.”
Mwurin rahn riau, kapwopwoud ehu ahpw wiawi nan kahnimw Kena, nan Kalili; oh inen Sises pil iang mi wasao.
Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahko ko pil lukohng ni kapwopwoudo.
Ni ahnsou me nimarail wain rosalahr, inen Sises ahpw patohwanohng, “Solahr nimarail wain.”
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Lih, ke dehr ndaiong ie dahme I en wia. Ei ahnsou saikinte leledo.”
Eri, ineo ahpw patohwanohng ladu ko, “Kumwail wiahda mehkoaros me e pahn mahsanihong kumwail.”
Eri, sah takai laud weneu mie wasao, mehn kamwakel nin duwen tiahk en palien lamalam en mehn Suhs ako, me audepahr mihmi nanpwungen kalon riesek de silihsek.
